story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Weinst du schon? 😂

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Shut up
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Halt die Klappe

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm already exhausted and we only warmed up
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin schon erschöpft und wir haben nur aufgewärmt

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Looks like the muscles aren't arriving as fast as you thought
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sieht so aus, als würden die Muskeln nicht so schnell kommen, wie du dachtest

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: At least {{name:aiden}} says I have potential
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Zumindest sagt {{name:aiden}}, dass ich Potenzial habe

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: All you have is two useless legs
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast nur zwei nutzlose Beine

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good thing I just finished work
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut, dass ich gerade mit der Arbeit fertig bin

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm not stupid
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin nicht dumm

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I booked the session right after you got home on purpose

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dafür bist du nicht interessant genug

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Sure
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Klar

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks anyway
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Danke trotzdem

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: 1 H 15 LATER
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 1 H 15 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Chris will be there in an hour
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Chris ist in einer Stunde hier

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Chris is fucking insane
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Chris ist echt verrückt

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Already crying? 😂

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Shut up

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm already exhausted and we only warmed up
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin schon erschöpft und wir haben nur aufgewärmt

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Looks like the muscles aren't arriving as fast as you thought
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sieht so aus, als würden die Muskeln nicht so schnell kommen, wie du dachtest

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: At least I can still walk
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Zumindest kann ich noch laufen

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't say the same for you
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Kann ich von dir nicht sagen

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good thing I just finished work
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut, dass ich gerade mit der Arbeit fertig bin

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm not stupid
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin nicht dumm

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I booked the session right after you got home on purpose
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich hab die Session direkt nach deiner Rückkehr gebucht, absichtlich

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Wow
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wow

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You managed to use your brain while lying in bed all day
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast es geschafft, dein Gehirn zu benutzen, während du den ganzen Tag im Bett lagst

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Careful or I'll move it to six in the morning
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vorsicht, sonst verschiebe ich es auf sechs Uhr morgens

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Alright alright
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Okay, okay

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into German.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: 1 H 15 LATER
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 1 H 15 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Hey
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Hey

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: She'll be happy to hear that reaction 😄
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Sie wird sich über diese Reaktion freuen 😄

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Jokes aside, I think she can catch up if she stays consistent
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Scherz beiseite, ich denke, sie kann aufholen, wenn sie konsequent bleibt

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: That's reassuring
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Das ist beruhigend

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Fortunately, I don't have another student taking this time slot right now
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Glücklicherweise habe ich gerade keinen anderen Schüler in diesem Zeitfenster

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: So if you'd like, I can keep working with her all the way to the exam
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Wenn du möchtest, kann ich bis zur Prüfung weiter mit ihr arbeiten

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: I think she'd benefit from that
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Ich denke, das würde ihr helfen

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Please keep me updated on her progress
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Bitte halte mich über ihren Fortschritt auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Don't hesitate to send pictures
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Zögere nicht, Bilder zu schicken

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: I will make an album of her working, she'll love it
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Ich werde ein Album von ihr beim Arbeiten machen, das wird ihr gefallen

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Haha, I'll try to send some then
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Haha, ich werde versuchen, ein paar zu schicken

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Quick update regarding {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Kurzes Update zu {{name:hailey}}

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: I'll keep you updated on her progress
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Ich halte dich über ihren Fortschritt auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Thanks, I appreciate it
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Danke, ich schätze das

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: How did it go?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Wie lief's?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Honestly, better than expected
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, besser als erwartet

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: She has some gaps to work on, but nothing alarming
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Sie hat ein paar Lücken, an denen sie arbeiten muss, aber nichts Schlimmes

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: Most of the issue seems to be organization rather than ability
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Das Hauptproblem scheint eher die Organisation als die Fähigkeit zu sein

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: This was from earlier while we were reviewing her notes
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Das war von früher, als wir ihre Notizen durchgegangen sind

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: She stayed focused for most of the session
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Sie war während der meisten Sitzung konzentriert

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.source: That's surprising
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_TUTOR_FIRST_MEE.translation: Das ist überraschend

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, do you have a minute? 😊
Well, it looks like you're trying clothes
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Nun, es sieht so aus, als würdest du Kleidung anprobieren.
Die sind perfekt, ich werde diese verwenden.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Maybe we should add one or two more daring photos
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Vielleicht sollten wir ein oder zwei gewagtere Fotos hinzufügen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'll put them on the profile and everything should be ready
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich werde sie ins Profil stellen und dann sollte alles bereit sein.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: With how beautiful you are, we'll probably be able to start tomorrow
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mit wie schön du bist, können wir wahrscheinlich morgen starten.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It actually feels nice to make an effort and see myself differently for once
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es fühlt sich tatsächlich schön an, sich Mühe zu geben und mich mal anders zu sehen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I always have time for you
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe immer Zeit für dich.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I think it would help attract more attention
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich denke, das würde helfen, mehr Aufmerksamkeit zu erregen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just one or two, nothing crazy
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Nur ein oder zwei, nichts Verrücktes.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Careful, keep saying things like that and I'll start believing you 😉
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Vorsicht, wenn du so weitermachst, fange ich an, dir zu glauben 😉
Hör auf, ich sehe komisch aus

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: There's no way this won't work
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es gibt keinen Weg, dass das nicht funktioniert

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It actually feels nice to make an effort and see myself differently for once
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es fühlt sich tatsächlich schön an, sich Mühe zu geben und mich mal anders zu sehen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I did a few test photos like you asked
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe ein paar Testfotos gemacht, wie du es gewünscht hast

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You should be proud of yourself
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du solltest stolz auf dich sein
Du hast heute großartige Arbeit geleistet

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm starting to feel a little more confident because of you
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich fange an, mich wegen dir etwas sicherer zu fühlen
Lass uns hoffen, dass morgen gut läuft

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: MeetAndGreet is ready. Laurent is available as the first profile.
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: MeetAndGreet ist bereit. Laurent ist als erstes Profil verfügbar.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Can you tell me honestly what works and what doesn't?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Kannst du mir ehrlich sagen, was funktioniert und was nicht?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And he doesn't make me feel stupid when I get something wrong
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und er lässt mich nicht dumm fühlen, wenn ich etwas falsch mache

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You mean he didn't panic after meeting you?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du meinst, er hat nicht panisch reagiert, als er dich getroffen hat?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He handled my chaos pretty well
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat mein Chaos ziemlich gut gemeistert

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then you should keep working with him
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dann solltest du weiter mit ihm arbeiten

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made a whole plan for me
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat einen ganzen Plan für mich gemacht
Ich hasse es, wenn du recht hast

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I had to open a notebook willingly
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich musste freiwillig ein Notizbuch aufschlagen

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But if I become a perfect student because of this, I'm blaming you 😊
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber wenn ich wegen dir eine perfekte Schülerin werde, mache ich dich dafür verantwortlich 😊
Ich nehme die Schuld auf mich

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I need sleep after all that brain damage
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich brauche Schlaf nach all dem Gehirnschaden

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Habe wieder die Hälfte eines Films geschaut.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then got too comfortable to finish it
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann wurde ich zu bequem, um es zu beenden.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sounds like a successful rest day
I think I needed a day like this
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich denke, ich brauchte einen Tag wie diesen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I promised myself an early night
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mir eine frühe Nacht versprochen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to make me smile at my phone again
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du wirst mich wieder zum Lächeln bringen, wenn ich auf mein Handy schaue.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie war der Rest deines Tages?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So how was your first session?
I thought you were supposed to get a dream body
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich dachte, du solltest einen Traumkörper bekommen.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I still did more today than you've done all week
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich hab heute mehr gemacht als du die ganze Woche.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Being carried through a workout doesn't count
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Durch ein Workout getragen zu werden zählt nicht.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Neither does lying in bed and pretending to be useful
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Genauso wenig wie im Bett liegen und so tun, als wärst du nützlich.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Be carefull, your secretary might take some long vacation
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Pass auf, deine Sekretärin könnte sich eine lange Auszeit nehmen.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yooo
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Yooo

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I am performing a public service
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich leiste einen öffentlichen Dienst

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Sure
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Sicher

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: But for real, hope they clear you soon
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Aber im Ernst, ich hoffe, sie lassen dich bald frei.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Being stuck like that must be annoying as hell
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: So festzustecken muss verdammt nervig sein.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: It is, imagiine having to play games all day
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Es ist, stell dir vor, den ganzen Tag Spiele spielen zu müssen.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I just want to move normally again
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich möchte einfach wieder normal bewegen.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You asshole
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Du Arschloch

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I will make fun of you for being slow in real life too
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich werde dich auch im echten Leben wegen deiner Langsamkeit auslachen.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Can't wait
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Kann es kaum erwarten

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Until then, wanna play something
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Bis dahin, willst du etwas spielen?

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yooo
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Yooo

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I still have way too much free time
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich habe immer noch viel zu viel Freizeit.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yeah, I'm down, i have free time too
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ja, ich bin dabei, ich habe auch Freizeit.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Good
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Gut

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I need someone to blame when we lose
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich brauche jemanden, den ich beschuldigen kann, wenn wir verlieren.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You heard anything from the doctor yet
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Hast du schon etwas vom Arzt gehört?

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Not yet
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Noch nicht

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I have a check-up today, then another on Friday
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich habe heute einen Termin zur Untersuchung, dann noch einen am Freitag

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Hopefully they tell me I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Hoffentlich sagen sie mir, dass ich den Gips bald abbekomme.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Finally
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Endlich

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You might actually stop living inside your phone
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Du könntest tatsächlich aufhören, in deinem Handy zu leben.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You say that like you are not texting me right now
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Du sagst das, als würdest du mir gerade nicht schreiben.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Different
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Anders

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I think I can start doing some light exercises today
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich denke, ich kann heute mit ein paar leichten Übungen anfangen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Just be careful and don't overdo it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Sei einfach vorsichtig und übertreibe es nicht

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I don't want to set back my recovery
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich möchte meine Genesung nicht zurückwerfen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Please keep it elevated when you can
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Bitte halte es hoch, wenn du kannst

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Do you have any idea what time your work might start?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Hast du eine Ahnung, wann deine Arbeit beginnen könnte?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: They said it can happen at any time between 9 AM and 6 PM
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Sie haben gesagt, es kann jederzeit zwischen 9 und 18 Uhr passieren

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So I need to try to do everything else outside that window
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich muss also versuchen, alles andere außerhalb dieses Zeitfensters zu erledigen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Then I will prepare breakfast and bring it to you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Dann bereite ich das Frühstück vor und bringe es dir

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way you can stay ready if they contact you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: So kannst du bereit sein, falls sie dich kontaktieren

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm bringing it up to your room
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich bringe es in dein Zimmer
Und wie geht es deinem Bein?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I made something filling, just in case
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich habe etwas Herzhaftes gemacht, nur für den Fall

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I have not been called yet
But I'm keeping an eye on the site and the live feeds anyway
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Aber ich behalte die Seite und die Live-Feeds im Auge

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And call me if you need anything
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Und ruf mich an, wenn du etwas brauchst

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: My leg feels about the same
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mein Bein fühlt sich ungefähr gleich an
Ich hoffe, es wird weiterhin besser

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Read the question twice before answering
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Lies die Frage zweimal, bevor du antwortest

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wenn ich sterbe, lösche meinen Suchverlauf

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And tell my friends I was not that stupid 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und sag meinen Freunden, ich war nicht so dumm 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und tue so, als wäre ich ein Mädchen, das die Kapitel versteht

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because you bullied me with quizzes
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Weil du mich mit Quizfragen gequält hast

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay now I have a problem
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay, jetzt habe ich ein Problem

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're going out looking like that and I'm supposed to stay calm?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du gehst so raus und ich soll ruhig bleiben?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The most beautiful girl in the world is going to university and I won't even be there to protect her
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das schönste Mädchen der Welt geht zur Universität und ich werde nicht einmal da sein, um sie zu beschützen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're the only one for me anyway ❤️
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du bist sowieso der Einzige für mich ❤️

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And the one I'm thinking about
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und an den, an den ich denke

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: If someone comes near me, I'll kick him in the balls 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Wenn mir jemand zu nahe kommt, trete ich ihm in die Eier 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I kind of like it when you're like that 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich mag es irgendwie, wenn du so bist 😌
Viel Glück beim Überleben an der Universität!

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And good luck at work later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und viel Glück bei der Arbeit später.
Und es hat gerade erst begonnen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then my part time job after
At least I tried to look cute to survive it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Zumindest habe ich versucht, süß auszusehen, um es zu überstehen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: And luckily, I'm not working today
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Und zum Glück arbeite ich heute nicht.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I think we went too hard yesterday
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Ich glaube, wir haben es gestern übertrieben.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: My legs are filing a complaint
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Meine Beine reichen eine Beschwerde ein.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: For once, you said something smart
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Du hast einmal was Kluges gesagt.
Da bin ich ganz deiner Meinung.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm glad I found something like this
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin froh, dass ich so etwas gefunden habe

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: It sounds much better for you than anything outside the house
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Das klingt viel besser für dich als alles draußen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to cook for everyone soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde bald für alle kochen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Wann immer du hungrig bist, sag einfach Bescheid

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat it up and bring it to you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich wärme es auf und bringe es dir

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: This is something I can do
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist etwas, das ich tun kann

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And it makes me feel useful too
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Und es lässt mich nützlich fühlen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: But only if you rest too
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Aber nur, wenn du dich auch ausruhst
Jetzt konzentrier dich auf deine Arbeit
Hast du schon mit der Arbeit begonnen?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I had a big session from 10 to 11:30
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich hatte eine große Sitzung von 10 bis 11:30
Es ist ehrlich gesagt einfach genug

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is my after-class brain fried face
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist mein Gesicht nach dem Unterricht, wenn mein Gehirn durch ist

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well, I need to go recover from this trauma now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Naja, ich muss mich jetzt von diesem Trauma erholen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Maybe a walk outside will help
I will go for a walk before the next test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde vor dem nächsten Test einen Spaziergang machen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will be back after the test!
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin nach dem Test wieder da!

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will try to enjoy it 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde versuchen, ihn zu genießen 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am not sure if I can enjoy anything right now, but I will try 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich gerade irgendwas genießen kann, aber ich werde es versuchen 😌
Als wäre sie wirklich wütend auf mich

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin immer noch der gleiche Idiot.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But fine, i'm not a pussy
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber gut, ich bin kein Feigling.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But if I fall, you're cleaning it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber wenn ich falle, putzt du das.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I hope you burn your mouth
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hoffe, du verbrennst dir den Mund.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into German.
Ich hab was zu essen gemacht.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Only if you bring it to me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Nur wenn du es mir bringst.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You remember I have a cast on my leg, right?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Du erinnerst dich, dass ich einen Gips am Bein habe, oder?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And I remember you still have two hands
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Und ich erinnere mich, dass du immer noch zwei Hände hast.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you actually take some time for yourself today?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hast du dir heute tatsächlich etwas Zeit für dich genommen?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I was resting on the couch while waiting for you to finish work
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich habe auf der Couch gelegen, während ich auf dich gewartet habe, dass du mit der Arbeit fertig wirst

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm glad you finally slowed down for a bit
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du endlich mal einen Moment langsamer gemacht hast

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Actually, do you want to come downstairs and watch something with me?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Willst du eigentlich runterkommen und etwas mit mir schauen?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I just need to take a shower first
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich muss mich nur zuerst duschen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do you need help getting into the shower?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich denke, es wird schon gehen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But if I need help, I'll call you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Aber wenn ich Hilfe brauche, rufe ich dich
Ich habe heute mit der Arbeit abgeschlossen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's a little difficult staying focused for hours and paying attention to everything
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Es ist ein bisschen schwierig, stundenlang fokussiert zu bleiben und auf alles zu achten

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But it's still better than working in a supermarket or doing something physical right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Aber es ist immer noch besser, als in einem Supermarkt zu arbeiten oder gerade etwas Physisches zu machen

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Your leg probably agrees with that too 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Dein Bein wird da wahrscheinlich auch zustimmen 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But being this smart is exhausting
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Aber so schlau zu sein, ist anstrengend

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I can still come over and traumatize you more than the test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich kann immer noch vorbeikommen und dich mehr traumatisieren als der Test

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: At your pace I think I will survive until tomorrow 😇
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: In deinem Tempo denke ich, dass ich bis morgen überlebe 😇

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe even the day after if I am lucky
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vielleicht sogar bis übermorgen, wenn ich Glück habe
Eine erschöpfte, fragile Schülerin zu bedrohen 😔

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: This is my exhausted victim face 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Das ist mein Gesicht als erschöpfte Opfer 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Und trotzdem schreibst du mir weiter

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Which is very annoying for me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Was sehr nervig für mich ist

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Time to turn off my brain
You should get some rest then
I will try to sleep early tonight 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich werde versuchen, heute früh zu schlafen 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am tired, not a grandma 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin müde, nicht eine Oma 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That walk was not long enough to recover from the trauma of the test 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Der Spaziergang war nicht lang genug, um mich von dem Trauma des Tests zu erholen 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: My brain feels like soup right now 😵‍💫
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mein Gehirn fühlt sich gerade wie Suppe an 😵‍💫

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I moved around the house a bit again
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe mich wieder ein bisschen im Haus bewegt.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dann habe ich eine Weile gespielt

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the doctor came to see me later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und der Arzt kam später, um mich zu sehen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If everything looks good, I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wenn alles gut aussieht, sollte ich den Gips bald abbekommen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay wait I'm actually so happy right now 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay warte, ich bin gerade so glücklich 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me really happy for you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das macht mich wirklich glücklich für dich.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have to tell me exactly how it goes
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du musst mir genau sagen, wie es läuft.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, I have to go soon or I'm going to be late for work 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay, ich muss bald gehen oder ich komme zu spät zur Arbeit 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und viel Glück für den Rest des Tages

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I guess that's a win 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich schätze, das ist ein Sieg 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That might count as a workout
Don't make me regret thanking you earlier
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Mach, dass ich es nicht bereue, dir vorher gedankt zu haben.
Meine Arme tun immer noch weh.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: And my hands are not much better
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Und meine Hände sind auch nicht viel besser.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think the controller would finish us tonight
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich glaube, der Controller würde uns heute Abend fertig machen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to finish my anime and sleep
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich werde meinen Anime zu Ende schauen und schlafen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If I can lift the blanket without dying
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Wenn ich die Decke ohne zu sterben heben kann.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ich freue mich so für dich.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: That makes me want to hug you right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Das bringt mich dazu, dich jetzt gleich zu umarmen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Because you're getting one when I see you 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Weil du einen bekommst, wenn ich dich sehe 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: So what are we doing first when the cast is gone?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Was machen wir zuerst, wenn die Besetzung weg ist?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I just got back from work
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ich bin gerade von der Arbeit zurückgekommen.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Without me worrying every two seconds
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ohne dass ich mir alle zwei Sekunden Sorgen machen muss.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And maybe our park date too ❤️
Maybe even something wilder after that
I'm not even that tired somehow 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ich bin irgendwie nicht mal so müde 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm eating right now but I'm still smiling like an idiot
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ich esse gerade, aber ich lächle immer noch wie ein Idiot.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: You look very cute for someone who's eating
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Du siehst sehr süß aus für jemanden, der isst.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Send me one more later when you're changed and ready for bed
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Schick mir später noch eine, wenn du dich umgezogen hast und bereit fürs Bett bist.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Changed, clean, and ready to sleep 🤍
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Geändert, sauber und bereit zu schlafen 🤍

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Stop complimenting me or I'm never going to sleep 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Hör auf, mir Komplimente zu machen, sonst kann ich nie schlafen 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Now I'm really going to sleep before I fall asleep holding my phone
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Jetzt gehe ich wirklich schlafen, bevor ich mit meinem Handy einschlafe.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And dream about our future park date
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Und träume von unserem zukünftigen Park-Date.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ich sollte den Gips bald abbekommen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It makes me happy that you want to get some fresh air
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Es macht mich glücklich, dass du frische Luft schnappen möchtest

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: But are you sure your not going to hurt yourself?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Aber bist du dir sicher, dass du dir nicht wehtust?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think I can handle it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich denke, ich kann das schaffen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I just need to get out of the house for a little while
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich muss einfach mal kurz aus dem Haus raus

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If it's too much, we can always take a break
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Wenn es zu viel wird, können wir immer eine Pause machen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I should be ready in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich sollte in etwa fünfzehn Minuten fertig sein
Okay, ich mache mich auch bereit

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was thinking of trying to go outside this morning
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe darüber nachgedacht, heute Morgen nach draußen zu gehen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you like to come with me?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: What a bad start 😭
He says it like I am not allowed to fail
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er sagt es, als dürfte ich nicht scheitern

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but also helpful
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Was unhöflich, aber auch hilfreich ist

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are quite smart
Well thanks I guess ?
Also he just walked past and gave me the professor nod
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er ist einfach vorbeigegangen und hat mir den Professor-Nick gegeben

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good sign right ??
Emotional regulation source shifting. Pressing too hard may cause defensive minimization.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Emotionale Regulierung, Quelle verschieben. Zu stark drücken kann defensive Minimierung verursachen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask if his attention helps her calm down
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Frag, ob seine Aufmerksamkeit ihr hilft, sich zu beruhigen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Let her focus before class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lass sie sich vor dem Unterricht konzentrieren

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does it help when he checks on you like that?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hilft es, wenn er so nach dir schaut?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I am outside class
Maybe
Do not make a psychology documentary about it
I just need to pass 😭
Go focus. You can survive this.
That is the correct supportive answer
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das ist die richtige unterstützende Antwort

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Gold star maybe
If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich sterbe, lösche meinen Suchverlauf

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und tue so, als wäre ich ein Mädchen, das die Kapitel versteht

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And tell my friends I was academically brave 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und sag meinen Freunden, ich war akademisch mutig 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You revised yesterday
Because he bullied me with structure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Weil er mich mit Struktur geärgert hat

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Respectfully
He told me to breathe and read the question twice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er hat mir gesagt, ich soll atmen und die Frage zweimal lesen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is good advice
I know

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a bit more useful there
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich fühle mich dort ein bisschen nützlicher.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I have actual things to take care of
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Jetzt habe ich tatsächlich Dinge zu erledigen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably stay longer than usual
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde wahrscheinlich länger bleiben als gewöhnlich.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Be careful not to overdo it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei vorsichtig, es nicht zu übertreiben.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually have a lot to do today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe heute tatsächlich viel zu tun.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since they gave me more responsibilities i need to be there more often
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seit sie mir mehr Verantwortung übertragen haben, muss ich öfter dort sein.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might be the next one whith a cast
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du könntest der Nächste mit einem Gips sein

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't trip on your first day back
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Stolper nicht am ersten Tag zurück

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll try not to embarrass you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich werde versuchen, dich nicht zu blamieren

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You manage that without even trying
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Das schaffst du ganz ohne Mühe

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Did the doctor finally put you out of your misery?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Hat der Arzt dich endlich aus deinem Elend erlöst?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I should be able to walk again soon
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich sollte bald wieder laufen können

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was getting tired of waiting for you every time we went somewhere
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich wurde müde, jedes Mal auf dich zu warten, wenn wir irgendwohin gegangen sind

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You make it sound like I'm slowing you down on purpose
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du lässt es so klingen, als würde ich dich absichtlich ausbremsen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What time do you start at the bar today?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wann fängst du heute in der Bar an?
Und ich werde auch später fertig sein

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'll make a little more money because of it !
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich werde dadurch ein bisschen mehr Geld verdienen!

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just make sure you don't get too tired
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Achte nur darauf, dass du nicht zu müde wirst

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But thank you for worrying about me ❤️
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber danke, dass du dir Sorgen um mich machst ❤️

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That walk did me a lot of good
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Der Spaziergang hat mir sehr gut getan

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We didn't exactly go very far
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wir sind nicht wirklich weit gegangen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And we came back pretty quickly too 😄
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Und wir sind auch ziemlich schnell zurückgekommen 😄

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But it was perfect for me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber es war perfekt für mich

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It didn't bother me at all
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es hat mich überhaupt nicht gestört

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We'll try to do it more often then
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Dann versuchen wir, das öfter zu machen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My professor wants me to come by his office before the next class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mein Professor will, dass ich vor der nächsten Stunde in sein Büro komme

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just five minutes to check what I missed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Nur fünf Minuten, um zu checken, was ich verpasst habe

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That is a lot of extra attention
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das ist eine Menge extra Aufmerksamkeit

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He is taking it really seriously
Subject reports brief office review between classes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Betreff berichtet von einer kurzen Büroüberprüfung zwischen den Klassen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to believe this is just a quick review, so why am I already bracing for something else?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich will glauben, dass das nur eine kurze Wiederholung ist. Warum rechne ich dann schon mit etwas anderem?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need a walk after this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich brauche nach dem hier einen Spaziergang

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor and you both making sense is unfair
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dass der Professor und du beide Sinn machen, ist unfair

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I read it twice like he said
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich habe es zweimal gelesen, wie er gesagt hat

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is better than guessing while internally screaming
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das ist besser, als zu raten und innerlich zu schreien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home a bit later
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich komme etwas später nach Hause

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What time are you coming home?
There's no reason for anything to go wrong
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Es gibt keinen Grund, warum etwas schiefgehen sollte

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll text you when I'm home
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich zu Hause bin

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:evelyn}} needs your help with something in the attic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:evelyn}} braucht deine Hilfe mit etwas auf dem Dachboden
Ich bleibe noch ein bisschen länger

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I prepared dinner for tonight 😊
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Hey, ich habe das Abendessen für heute Abend vorbereitet 😊

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you, don't go to bed too late
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und du, geh nicht zu spät ins Bett

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you can't go downstairs, just ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}} to bring it to you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wenn du nicht nach unten gehen kannst, frag einfach {{name:hailey}} oder {{name:mason}}, ob sie es dir bringen können.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope it's going to be okay
My manager isn't supposed to be working tonight
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mein Manager sollte heute Abend eigentlich nicht arbeiten.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then try to enjoy the shift with your coworkers
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Dann versuch, die Schicht mit deinen Kollegen zu genießen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can send him one answer tonight if I panic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich kann ihm heute Abend eine Antwort schicken, wenn ich in Panik gerate

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This is my exhausted victim face
Don't fall asleep in the couch
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Schlaf nicht auf der Couch ein

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: unless i close my eyes for a second
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: es sei denn, ich schließe für einen Moment die Augen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You keep texting me anyway, that should keep you awake
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du schreibst mir trotzdem, das sollte dich wach halten

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But yeah, i'm going straight to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber ja, ich gehe direkt ins Bett

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He noticed the exact part I messed up
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat den genauen Teil bemerkt, den ich vermasselt habe

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But not in a bad way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber nicht auf eine schlechte Weise

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels good to be trusted with more things
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es fühlt sich gut an, mit mehr Dingen betraut zu werden.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know it probably sounds boring from the outside
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, es klingt von außen wahrscheinlich langweilig.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not if you're happy about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht, wenn du darüber glücklich bist.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's strict, but he explains things clearly
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er ist streng, aber er erklärt die Dinge klar.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want today to become heavy
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich möchte einfach nicht, dass heute schwer wird.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you after work if I'm not dead 😅
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir nach der Arbeit, wenn ich nicht tot bin 😅

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But work is moving fast today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber die Arbeit geht heute schnell voran.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm still learning where everything is and what they expect from me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lerne immer noch, wo alles ist und was sie von mir erwarten.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du bist ziemlich schnell nach Hause gekommen
Ich habe nach dem Training etwas geholt

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You could still come sit with us
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du könntest trotzdem zu uns kommen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Am I really going to have to come drag you out of your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Werde ich dich wirklich aus deinem Zimmer ziehen müssen?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Good luck climbing the stairs with your leg
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Viel Glück beim Treppensteigen mit deinem Bein

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Behavior change detected after gym session
Subject avoided shared dinner without clear explanation
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Subjekt hat gemeinsames Abendessen ohne klare Erklärung vermieden

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Conversation pattern deviates from established baseline
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Gesprächsmuster weicht von etabliertem Baseline ab

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The joke sounds like {{name:mason}}, but the distance doesn't feel familiar.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Der Witz klingt nach {{name:mason}}, aber diese Distanz fühlt sich fremd an.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Straight to the shower and your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Direkt unter die Dusche und dann in dein Zimmer?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't know just making sure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich weiß nicht, wollte nur sicherstellen

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He's demanding but... it pushes me in a good way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Er ist fordernd, aber... es motiviert mich auf eine gute Weise.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I like the way he works
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich mag die Art, wie er arbeitet.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I just want things to stay simple right now
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich möchte, dass die Dinge gerade einfach bleiben.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm not trying to make things tense
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich versuche nicht, die Dinge angespannt zu machen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Everything feels heavier when I'm like this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Alles fühlt sich schwerer an, wenn ich so bin.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll probably just shower and go to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich werde wahrscheinlich einfach duschen und ins Bett gehen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I wouldn't make it past ten minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich würde es nicht mal zehn Minuten schaffen.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't expect to handle that much today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe nicht erwartet, heute so viel zu bewältigen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Actually, things moved faster than expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Eigentlich ging alles schneller als erwartet.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I received a lot of notifications last night and this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe letzte Nacht und heute Morgen viele Benachrichtigungen erhalten.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: There are already enough requests for me to choose a good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Es gibt schon genug Anfragen, damit ich ein gutes Profil auswählen kann.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If everything looks right, you might be able to do your first outing today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Wenn alles gut aussieht, könntest du heute dein erstes Treffen haben.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: That is why we will start slowly
Maybe just one or two hours outside, nothing more
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Vielleicht nur ein oder zwei Stunden draußen, nicht mehr.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just enough for you to get used to it and see how it feels
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Gerade genug, damit du dich daran gewöhnen und sehen kannst, wie es sich anfühlt.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was afraid you were going to tell me it would be something long right away
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich hatte Angst, du würdest mir gleich sagen, dass es etwas Längeres sein würde.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then I will go get ready
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Dann werde ich mich fertig machen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Message me when you know more, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Schreib mir, wenn du mehr weißt, okay?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Please do not push yourself too much today
Where are we with the work?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Wo stehen wir mit der Arbeit?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Mentally prepared to suffer for your grades
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mentale Vorbereitung, um für deine Noten zu leiden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But definitely ready to see my handsome {{name:tutor}} 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aber ich bin auf jeden Fall bereit, meinen gutaussehenden {{name:tutor}} zu sehen 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And of course you're not thinking about your studies
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und natürlich denkst du nicht an dein Studium

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study, you know
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er kommt trotzdem, um dich zum Lernen zu bringen, weißt du

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ethan said he wants to review the weak points he noticed yesterday
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ethan hat gesagt, er will die Schwächen durchgehen, die er gestern bemerkt hat

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Your peace was never going to survive exam season
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dein Frieden hätte die Prüfungszeit nie überstanden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: School outfit check before I disappear into class
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Schul-Outfit-Check, bevor ich in den Unterricht verschwinde

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's the nicest fake compliment I've heard today 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das ist das netteste falsche Kompliment, das ich heute gehört habe 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm officially on my way to school
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich bin offiziell auf dem Weg zur Schule
Das nennt man einfach wach sein

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate how accurate that is 😭
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich hasse, wie genau das ist 😭

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ready for another study session later?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bereit für eine weitere Lernsitzung später?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enough to function like a normal human
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Genug, um wie ein normaler Mensch zu funktionieren
Das ist alles, was wir brauchen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought about what you said the other day
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe über das nachgedacht, was du neulich gesagt hast.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to get ready or I'm going to be late 😭
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich muss mich fertig machen, sonst komme ich zu spät 😭

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I didn't even wake up during the night for once 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin in der Nacht nicht einmal aufgewacht 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a lot more awake today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich fühle mich heute viel wacher.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Hey, wie fühlst du dich heute Morgen?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Perfect
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Perfekt

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll book another coaching session for you today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich buche dir heute eine weitere Coaching-Sitzung.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: No fucking way
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Auf keinen Fall.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Everything hurts
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Alles tut weh.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You need to give me at least one day to recover
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du musst mir mindestens einen Tag geben, um mich zu erholen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then you better shut up and let me make noise as much as i want
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dann halt besser den Mund und lass mich so viel Lärm machen, wie ich will.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Alright alright
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Okay, okay

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How about we play a game together and call it even?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Wie wäre es, wenn wir zusammen ein Spiel spielen und es damit gut ist?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Maybe
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Vielleicht

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Come on
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Komm schon

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm good
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Mir geht's gut

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll even let you lose with dignity
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich lass dich sogar mit Würde verlieren.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Warum?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Because you made so much noise in your room this morning that you woke me up
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Weil du so viel Lärm in deinem Zimmer gemacht hast, dass du mich geweckt hast.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry princess
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sorry, Prinzessin.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I didn't know you needed your beauty sleep
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich wusste nicht, dass du deinen Schönheitsschlaf brauchst.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should be more worried about yours
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du solltest dir mehr Sorgen um deinen machen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Your face needs all the help it can get
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dein Gesicht braucht jede Hilfe, die es kriegen kann.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I hope your whole body is sore today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich hoffe, dein ganzer Körper tut heute weh.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It already is
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tut er schon.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hey

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He must feel really lonely in his life to ask for that on an app
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er muss sich in seinem Leben wirklich einsam fühlen, um das in einer App zu fragen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It happens more often than people think
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das passiert öfter, als die Leute denken.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Some people spend their whole life working and end up with no one to talk to
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Einige Menschen verbringen ihr ganzes Leben mit Arbeiten und haben am Ende niemanden, mit dem sie reden können.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: For them, even one calm hour with someone kind can mean a lot
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Für sie kann sogar eine ruhige Stunde mit jemandem Freundlichen viel bedeuten.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I think I understand a little better what I am supposed to do now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich glaube, ich verstehe jetzt ein bisschen besser, was ich tun soll.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Not just be pretty and sit there
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Nicht nur hübsch sein und da sitzen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But actually make him feel less alone for a while
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Sondern ihm tatsächlich helfen, sich eine Weile weniger allein zu fühlen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Exactly
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Genau

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And you are naturally good at that
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Und das kannst du ganz natürlich gut.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I hope so
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das hoffe ich auch.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I found a really good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe ein wirklich gutes Profil gefunden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to get ready and then I will go
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich werde mich fertig machen und dann losgehen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will keep you updated, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich halte dich auf dem Laufenden, okay?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Okay
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Okay.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Good luck {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Viel Glück {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You will do great
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Du wirst großartig sein

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Danke 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: 1 H 30 LATER
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: In 1 H 30

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Already?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Schon?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What kind of profile?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Was für ein Profil?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: A man around your age
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ein Mann in deinem Alter

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He's name is Laurent
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er heißt Laurent

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Single, businessman, the kind of person who works all the time and barely has a personal life
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Single, Geschäftsmann, so ein Typ, der die ganze Zeit arbeitet und kaum ein Privatleben hat

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He said he would like to spend a little time with a girl
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hat gesagt, er würde gerne ein bisschen Zeit mit einem Mädchen verbringen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Nothing strange, just a coffee for about an hour
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Nichts Seltsames, nur ein Kaffee für etwa eine Stunde

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds... kind of sad
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das klingt... irgendwie traurig

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's way too handsome when he's focused 😭
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er ist viel zu gutaussehend, wenn er konzentriert ist 😭

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's there to help you study
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er ist da, um dir beim Lernen zu helfen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But he keeps leaning over the notebook to explain things
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber er beugt sich ständig über das Notizbuch, um Dinge zu erklären

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And my brain just stops working for a second
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Und mein Gehirn hört für einen Moment einfach auf zu arbeiten

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That's the exact opposite of studying 😶
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das ist das genaue Gegenteil von Lernen 😶

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You can panic about how handsome he is later
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du kannst später in Panik geraten, wie gutaussehend er ist

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If I pass this exam, you owe me something
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn ich diese Prüfung bestehe, schuldest du mir was

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're in the middle of studying
Okay I'm going back before he notices I'm distracted 😶
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Okay, ich geh zurück, bevor er merkt, dass ich abgelenkt bin 😶

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's actually really good at explaining stuff

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hurry up and get the pizza
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Beeil dich und hol die Pizza.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm getting destroyed by zombies here
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde hier von Zombies zerfetzt.
Schlechtester Uber Eats Fahrer aller Zeiten.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: At least my customers usually survive long enough to get their food
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mindestens überleben meine Kunden normalerweise lange genug, um ihr Essen zu bekommen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just bring the pizza and shut up
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Bring einfach die Pizza und halt den Mund.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Try not to lose until I get back
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Versuch nicht zu verlieren, bis ich zurück bin.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I know that's difficult for you
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich weiß, dass das für dich schwierig ist.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Studienupdate
Das hab ich ein bisschen bemerkt

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: She also said it's because she thinks you're very handsome
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie hat auch gesagt, dass es daran liegt, dass sie dich sehr attraktiv findet
Ah
Tut mir leid dafür
Mach dir keine Sorgen darum

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: I'll keep the atmosphere calm and structured
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Ich halte die Atmosphäre ruhig und strukturiert
Das würde helfen
Ich könnte eine Idee haben

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: If she struggles to stay focused, I can turn parts of the session into short quizzes
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Wenn sie Schwierigkeiten hat, sich zu konzentrieren, kann ich Teile der Sitzung in kurze Quizze umwandeln
Kleine Ziele, sofortiges Feedback

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: We're in the middle of the session right now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Wir sind gerade mitten in der Sitzung

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: And if she does well, I can give her a small reward after each section
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Und wenn sie gut abschneidet, kann ich ihr nach jedem Abschnitt eine kleine Belohnung geben
Was für eine Belohnung?
Etwas, das sie mag

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: A break, a compliment, letting her choose the next topic, things like that
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Eine Pause, ein Kompliment, ihr das nächste Thema wählen lassen, solche Sachen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: The point is to give her something to aim for
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Es geht darum, ihr etwas zu geben, auf das sie hinarbeiten kann

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: It should help her redirect that nervous energy into work
