story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Das sollte ihr helfen, diese nervöse Energie in Arbeit umzuleiten
Ich denke, das ist in Ordnung

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: If it helps her focus, go ahead
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Wenn es ihr hilft, sich zu konzentrieren, mach ruhig

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: But be careful, she's very demanding
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Aber sei vorsichtig, sie ist sehr anspruchsvoll
Ist schon okay, mach dir keine Sorgen
Sie macht insgesamt gute Fortschritte

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: I'll try it gently and see how she responds
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Ich werde es sanft versuchen und sehen, wie sie reagiert
Ich halte dich auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: She has trouble staying focused for long periods, but she understands quickly when she pays attention
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie hat Schwierigkeiten, sich lange zu konzentrieren, aber sie versteht schnell, wenn sie aufmerksam ist
Das klingt nach ihr
Sie hat mir gerade geschrieben, tatsächlich
Ist alles okay?
Ja

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: She said she was having trouble concentrating
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie hat gesagt, dass sie Schwierigkeiten hat, sich zu konzentrieren

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just finished and I'm heading home 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin gerade fertig und mache mich auf den Weg nach Hause 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I was
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich war

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But after a few minutes it felt completely natural
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber nach ein paar Minuten fühlte es sich ganz natürlich an

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He was polite and easy to talk to
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Er war höflich und leicht zu reden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That's exactly what I was hoping for
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Genau das habe ich mir erhofft

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If that's what the job is like every day, I think I'll be very happy
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wenn das der Job ist, wie er jeden Tag ist, denke ich, dass ich sehr glücklich sein werde

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Remember, you're the one who decides where things go
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Denk daran, du bist diejenige, die entscheidet, wohin es geht

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You can take things at whatever pace you want
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du kannst alles in deinem eigenen Tempo angehen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you'll probably get to meet a lot of interesting people
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und du wirst wahrscheinlich viele interessante Menschen kennenlernen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I think that's part of what I enjoyed
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich denke, das war ein Teil dessen, was mir gefallen hat

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It felt good to have some interaction outside the house again
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es fühlte sich gut an, wieder etwas Interaktion außerhalb des Hauses zu haben

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And to take a little time for myself
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und mir ein bisschen Zeit für mich selbst zu nehmen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I didn't realize how much I missed that
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe nicht realisiert, wie sehr ich das vermisst habe

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then it sounds like a success to me
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Dann klingt das für mich nach einem Erfolg

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I think so too 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das denke ich auch 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for helping me take the first step
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Danke, dass du mir geholfen hast, den ersten Schritt zu machen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Anytime
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Immer gerne

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for the coffee. I enjoyed how calm the conversation felt.
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Danke für den Kaffee. Ich fand es angenehm, wie ruhig das Gespräch war.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 12
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: TAG 12

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 12
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: TAG 12

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How was it?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wie war es?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Honestly?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ehrlich?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It was much more pleasant than I expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es war viel angenehmer, als ich erwartet hatte

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You picked a really good person
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du hast wirklich eine gute Person ausgewählt

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We spent most of the time talking
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wir haben die meiste Zeit geredet

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And in the end I agreed to stay for two hours instead of one
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und am Ende habe ich zugestimmt, zwei Stunden statt einer zu bleiben

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm glad everything went well
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin froh, dass alles gut gelaufen ist

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You sounded really nervous this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du hast heute Morgen wirklich nervös geklungen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I barely passed the last quiz
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe das letzte Quiz gerade so bestanden

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So I asked for his number 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Also hab ich nach seiner Nummer gefragt 😌
Das bedeutet nicht, was du denkst

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But seriously, focus on studying first
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber ernsthaft, konzentrier dich zuerst aufs Lernen

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: The annoying part is that it actually worked
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das Nervige ist, dass es tatsächlich funktioniert hat

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I studied harder because I wanted the reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe härter gelernt, weil ich die Belohnung wollte

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I guess Ethan knows what he's doing
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dann weiß Ethan wohl, was er tut

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:hailey}} shows increased responsiveness to Ethan's approval
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}} zeigt erhöhte Reaktionsfähigkeit auf Ethans Zustimmung

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Tutor-student boundary remains stable for now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Die Grenze zwischen Tutor und Schüler bleibt vorerst stabil

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Risk detected: relationship may not remain strictly academic
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Risiko erkannt: Die Beziehung könnte nicht rein akademisch bleiben

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted her to take studying seriously. I didn't expect his approval to matter this much.
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich wollte, dass sie das Lernen ernst nimmt. Ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass ihr seine Anerkennung so wichtig wird.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He gave me little quizzes during the session
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat mir während der Sitzung kleine Quizze gegeben

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I passed, I got a reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wenn ich bestanden habe, gab's eine Belohnung

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I failed, I got a punishment
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wenn ich durchgefallen bin, gab's eine Strafe

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little of both sounds right 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen von beidem klingt richtig 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One teacher kept repeating the same thing for 20 minutes
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Lehrer wiederholte 20 Minuten lang dasselbe.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I almost gave up on life halfway through
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe fast mitten im Leben aufgegeben.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for validating my struggle
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du meinen Kampf validierst.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My brain is starting to drift a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mein Gehirn fängt an, ein wenig abzudriften.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just resting and moving a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Einfach ausruhen und mich ein wenig bewegen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I should go back before I completely disconnect from reality
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, ich sollte zurückgehen, bevor ich völlig von der Realität abgekoppelt werde.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself staring at nothing for a full minute earlier
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich ertappte mich dabei, eine volle Minute lang ins Nichts zu starren.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Hey, what did you do with my controller?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Hey, was hast du mit meinem Controller gemacht?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to pay for that
You better find it or I'm considering it stolen
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du solltest ihn finden, sonst betrachte ich ihn als gestohlen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: What would I even do with it?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Was würde ich damit überhaupt machen?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You think I hid it inside my cast or something?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Denkst du, ich hab ihn in meinen Gips versteckt oder so?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With how desperate you are to finally beat me, I wouldn't put it past you
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Bei so verzweifelt, wie du bist, um mich endlich zu besiegen, würde ich es dir zutrauen.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I booked another coaching session for you tomorrow morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich habe dir für morgen früh eine weitere Coaching-Sitzung gebucht.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Maybe it'll teach you something about life
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Vielleicht lehrt es dich etwas über das Leben.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Blanket mode is not a joke
But this is a very exclusive report
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Aber das ist ein sehr exklusiver Bericht.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I think I needed this tonight
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich glaube, ich brauchte das heute Abend.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Peace, quiet, and you being sweet to me
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Frieden, Ruhe und du bist süß zu mir

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're very good at it when you want to be ❤️
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du bist sehr gut darin, wenn du es willst ❤️

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Only when I want to be?
Mostly when you're not trying to act tough
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Meistens, wenn du nicht versuchst, tough zu sein.
Jetzt ruhen wir uns beide aus.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm going to stay wrapped up a little longer
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich werde mich noch ein bisschen länger einwickeln.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then sleep before I become useless tomorrow
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dann schlaf, bevor ich morgen nutzlos werde.
Schlaf gut, wenn du es tust.
Hast du Probleme mit den Klassen?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I feel like my social battery has filed a complaint
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, meine soziale Batterie hat eine Beschwerde eingereicht.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am currently wrapped in a blanket and accepting no responsibilities
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin gerade in eine Decke eingewickelt und übernehme keine Verantwortung.

story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Do not get used to it. I am giving you one calm message for free.
story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Gewöhne dich nicht daran. Ich gebe dir eine ruhige Nachricht kostenlos.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And if you want anything special for lunch, tell me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Und wenn du etwas Besonderes zum Mittagessen möchtest, sag mir Bescheid

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I can make it for you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich kann es für dich machen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will message you if I need anything
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich etwas brauche

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will bring the clothes up in a minute
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich bringe die Klamotten in einer Minute hoch

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You need to be ready in case work starts
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Du musst bereit sein, falls die Arbeit anfängt

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I still did not see any light in your room when I walked past
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich habe immer noch kein Licht in deinem Zimmer gesehen, als ich vorbeigegangen bin

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will come upstairs and drop off your clean clothes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich komme nach oben und bringe dir deine sauberen Klamotten

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Do well tonight and we can discuss benefits 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Mach heute Abend gut und wir können über Vorteile reden 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Many chances to regret my choices
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Viele Chancen, meine Entscheidungen zu bereuen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I will probably need help after the second one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich werde wahrscheinlich nach der zweiten Stunde Hilfe brauchen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Now I have no excuse to fail 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Jetzt habe ich keine Ausrede mehr zu versagen 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Go to your classes, quickly before I heal completely
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Geh schnell zu deinen Klassen, bevor ich mich komplett erhole

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The injured tutor threat level is rising 😔
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Die Bedrohung durch den verletzten Nachhilfelehrer steigt 😔

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming you 💅
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wenn ich gegen meinen Willen etwas lerne, mache ich dich dafür verantwortlich 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Blink twice if your leg is being dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Blinzle zweimal, wenn dein Bein dramatisch ist

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still need my favorite tutor functional
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich brauche meinen Lieblings-Tutor noch funktionstüchtig

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I would have wanted that too
You would have had to protect me from the evil sky 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du hättest mich vor dem bösen Himmel beschützen müssen 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I take that responsibility very seriously
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich nehme diese Verantwortung sehr ernst.
Ich bin im Grunde ein Sturm-Spezialist.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Send me a picture of my brave survivor then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Schick mir ein Bild von meinem tapferen Überlebenden dann.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I haven't finished doing my makeup yet 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich habe mein Make-up noch nicht fertig gemacht 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I didn't say full glam was required
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich habe nicht gesagt, dass volles Glamour erforderlich ist.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You get the almost ready version
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du bekommst die fast fertige Version.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And don't forget your leg exercises today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und vergiss heute deine Beinübungen nicht.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There was a storm during the night
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Es gab einen Sturm in der Nacht.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay maybe more than a little
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay, vielleicht mehr als nur ein bisschen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really wanted to sleep with you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich wollte wirklich mit dir schlafen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You say that like you're the responsible one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Du sagst das, als wärst du der Verantwortliche.
Im Vergleich zu dir? Ganz leicht.
Ich bin trotzdem noch ein bisschen verspannt.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Maybe we do a small session today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Vielleicht machen wir heute eine kleine Einheit.
Also nichts, was du selbst geplant hast.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'm trying to be responsible here

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to do some grocery shopping
Is there anything you want me to buy?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Gibt es etwas, das du möchtest, dass ich kaufe?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you get me a water bottle or a flask?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Könntest du mir eine Wasserflasche oder einen Thermobecher besorgen?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Something I can keep in my room with clean water
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Etwas, das ich in meinem Zimmer mit sauberem Wasser aufbewahren kann

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll see what I can find
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich schaue, was ich finden kann

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll try not to come back too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich versuche, nicht zu spät zurückzukommen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you have time to bring me something to eat?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hast du Zeit, mir etwas zu essen zu bringen?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat up your lunch and bring it to you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde dein Mittagessen aufwärmen und es dir bringen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm coming to pick up your plate
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich komme, um deinen Teller abzuholen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you need anything else while I'm here?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Brauchst du noch etwas, während ich hier bin?
Nein, ich denke, es geht mir gut

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Do not say it like that
Your bullying tutor method might be working
Can you ask {{name:mason}} if {{mason:he}} can come pick me up at university?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Kannst du {{name:mason}} fragen, ob {{mason:he|er|sie}} mich von der Uni abholen kann?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I would ask {{mason:him}} myself but {{mason:he}} is less scary when you are involved
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich würde {{mason:him|ihn|sie}} selbst fragen, aber {{mason:he|er|sie}} wirkt weniger einschüchternd, wenn du mit im Spiel bist.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will take care of it
But if you get home early, you revise again
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Aber wenn du früh nach Hause kommst, musst du wieder lernen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I knew there was a trap
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich wusste, dass es eine Falle gibt

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You cannot say that after I survived class
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Du kannst das nicht sagen, nachdem ich den Unterricht überlebt habe

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am way too cute to be forced to revise 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin viel zu süß, um gezwungen zu werden, zu lernen 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is discrimination against adorable people 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist Diskriminierung gegen niedliche Menschen 😭
Ich habe mehr verstanden als sonst

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll destroy you on that game
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich werde dich in diesem Spiel zerstören.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I see you still have hope
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich sehe, du hast immer noch Hoffnung.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go to work before you embarrass yourself more
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Geh zur Arbeit, bevor du dich noch mehr blamierst.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Genieß die Stille, solange sie anhält.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And why would that interest me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Und warum sollte mich das interessieren?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Because your day is clearly empty without my updates
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Weil dein Tag ohne meine Updates offensichtlich leer ist.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Bold of you to assume that
I try to match the audience
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich versuche, mich dem Publikum anzupassen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If I don't get home too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn ich heute Abend nicht zu spät nach Hause komme.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can already transfer you 300 dollars
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich kann dir schon mal 300 Dollar überweisen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I already received money for the work I did
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich habe also schon Geld für die Arbeit, die ich gemacht habe, erhalten

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich weiß gar nicht, wie ich dir danken soll, dass du das alles machst

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ein Lächeln und ein Kuss, dann

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Dann muss ich dir vielleicht mehr davon schicken
Darüber würde ich mich nicht beschweren 😄

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Komm essen, bevor das Abendessen kalt wird

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Und geh heute Nacht nicht zu spät ins Bett

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It was calmer than yesterday too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Es war auch ruhiger als gestern

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I managed to buy everything we needed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich habe alles gekauft, was wir brauchten

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: We are almost out of money
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Wir haben fast kein Geld mehr

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich habe beschlossen, heute Abend nützlich zu sein
Du hast mir beim Lernen geholfen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So I am repaying my debt
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Also zahle ich meine Schulden zurück
Ich bin früh nach Hause gekommen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: {{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} kommt in dein Zimmer, um dir Essen zu bringen und dein Zimmer aufzuräumen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin ein großzügiger kleiner Engel 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Aber du hast meinen ganzen PC beim Aufräumen abgezogen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Wie kannst du es wagen, ein Foto von mir zu machen?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Es zeigt eindeutig, dass du die Kabel berührst

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Danke, dass du {{name:mason}} gefragt hast, mich abzuholen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Es zeigt ein fleißiges, unschuldiges Mädchen, das zu Unrecht beschuldigt wird

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du hältst das Kabel buchstäblich in der Hand

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vielleicht hat mich das Kabel zuerst angegriffen

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du kennst die ganze Geschichte nicht

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And you are taking secret pictures of me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Und du machst heimlich Fotos von mir

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Geh lernen, bevor du noch mehr Elektronik kaputt machst

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Aber wenn der PC stirbt, war er schon schwach

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Erhöhter Herzschlag während der letzten privaten Interaktion erkannt
Visuelle und emotionale Marker werden abgeglichen...

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Relevante emotionale Aufzeichnung in HAK Evidence archiviert

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Die Nähe zu {{name:hailey}} lässt mich nicht los, und ich wünsche mir mehr solcher Momente.
Bist du also sicher zu Hause?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Am Leben, sicher und nur leicht dramatisch

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich muss immer noch nach Hause.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I finally collapsed on the couch
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin schließlich auf die Couch gefallen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich stehle Snacks aus der Küche wie eine kleine Ratte.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Es tut mir wirklich leid, dass ich deine Anrufe verpasst habe.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte einen sehr glamourösen Tag voller Stress und kleiner Katastrophen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ein Kunde, der sich verhielt, als hätte ich sein Leben persönlich ruiniert.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe ständig daran gedacht, zu Hause zu sein und mit dir zu reden.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Deshalb wollte ich ein wenig länger hier bei dir bleiben.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du solltest trotzdem nicht zu spät ins Bett gehen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich wollte nur ein bisschen mehr von dir zuerst.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Morgen wirst du mehr von mir haben.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und hoffentlich wird morgen auch für dich einfacher.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du sagst immer das nervig richtige 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Geh duschen, wenn du mit dem Essen fertig bist.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und soll ich dir ein Bild von mir schicken?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber nur, weil ich euch den ganzen Tag vermisst habe.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Versprich, dass du es niemandem zeigst.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin immer noch in meinen Arbeitsklamotten 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du siehst so gut (und sexy) aus, ich bin fast gestorben.
Weil es jedes Mal wahr ist
Okay, das ist eine gute Antwort

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now
It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Es fühlte sich an, als wäre der ganze Tag nur ein Problem nach dem anderen gewesen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Du hast diese Niederlage ziemlich hart genommen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Das sind viele Ausreden für einen Abend.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Next time we should bet something
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Beim nächsten Mal sollten wir etwas wetten.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Der Verlierer schuldet dem Gewinner einen Gefallen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich hoffe, du verlierst nicht zu oft dann 😏

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Komm in 5 Minuten vorbei, um dir den Hintern versohlen zu lassen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe den ganzen Tag darauf gewartet, dich zum Weinen zu bringen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich versuche, nicht zu viel zu lachen.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Mal sehen, wer in ein paar Minuten lacht.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Brauchst du einen Teddybär zum Schlafen heute Nacht? 😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hey, ich habe Frühstück für dich gemacht 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich hatte viel Zeit, also habe ich Frühstück gemacht

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Du musst jeden Tag mit deinem Chef klarkommen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Das ist das Mindeste, was ich im Haus tun kann.
Das ist wirklich süß von dir.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich bin unten, wenn du bereit bist.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Okay, gib mir ein paar Minuten 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Lass dir Zeit beim Aufstehen und ruh dich aus.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Du hattest eine lange Nacht bei der Arbeit.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Es tut mir so leid, ich habe viel zu viel geschlafen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I didn't even hear my alarm
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe meinen Wecker nicht einmal gehört.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Du hast spät gearbeitet, es ist normal, müde zu sein.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich soll vorbeikommen, wenn die zweite Klasse meine tragischen Lücken aufdeckt

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich bin mir sicher, seine Worte waren netter

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du verlässt dich ganz schön auf ihn
Ich verlasse mich darauf, zu bestehen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er weiß einfach, wie er mein Gehirn dazu bringt, sich zu benehmen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Jetzt habe ich keine Ausrede mehr zu versagen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich gegen meinen Willen etwas lerne, mache ich euch beiden einen Vorwurf 💅

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und wahrscheinlich Professorenrettung nach der zweiten

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Part-time job from morning to evening

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie geht es dir heute Morgen?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich kann.
Alles klar, hab einen schönen Tag.
Ich habe diesen Schlaf wirklich gebraucht.
Aber ich fühle mich jetzt okay.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Hey, wie fühlst du dich heute Morgen?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was starting to think the doctor had fixed your personality too
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich dachte schon, der Arzt hätte auch deine Persönlichkeit repariert

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Not even medicine can save yours
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Nicht mal die Medizin kann deine retten

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I need to reconnect a few things in my room
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich muss ein paar Dinge in meinem Zimmer wieder anschließen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The console, the screen and some cables
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Die Konsole, den Bildschirm und ein paar Kabel

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And you need me for that?
You might actually be useful for once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du könntest tatsächlich mal nützlich sein

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then your console can stay broken
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dann kann deine Konsole kaputt bleiben

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can't I ask how you're doing?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Kann ich nicht fragen, wie es dir geht?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It was almost better when you kept your mouth shut
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Es war fast besser, als du den Mund gehalten hast

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks again for this morning
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Danke nochmal für heute Morgen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That looks delicious
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das sieht köstlich aus.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Good 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Gut 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then it was worth the effort
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Dann hat sich die Mühe gelohnt.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: By the way, are you working the same hours tonight?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Übrigens, arbeitest du heute Abend zur gleichen Zeit?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Nein.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Since my manager is working tonight, I'm back to my usual schedule
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Da mein Chef heute Abend arbeitet, bin ich wieder im gewohnten Rhythmus.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'll leave a little earlier
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Also werde ich ein bisschen früher gehen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then make sure you take some time for yourself before work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Dann sorge dafür, dass du dir vor der Arbeit etwas Zeit für dich nimmst.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Werde ich 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'm going to watch some TV for a bit
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich werde ein bisschen fernsehen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It's nothing, really
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es ist nichts, wirklich.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And then I'll start getting ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Und dann fange ich an, mich fertig zu machen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds like a good plan 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das klingt nach einem guten Plan 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Vielleicht für dich.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I still think it was really sweet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich finde es trotzdem wirklich süß.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I made a cake for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Also habe ich einen Kuchen für dich gemacht.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You didn't have to do that
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das hättest du nicht tun müssen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'm definitely not complaining 😄
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich beschwere mich definitiv nicht 😄

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I hope you'll like it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hoffe, er gefällt dir.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Wow
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wow

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Der Professor hat gesagt, er kann mich nach Hause bringen, wenn er mit der Arbeit fertig ist

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I am waiting in the school office
It is quieter than the hallway
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es ist ruhiger als im Flur

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And he said he's almost done
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Und er hat gesagt, er ist fast fertig

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I will just wait here
It actually went kind of well
Subject accepted professor's offer instead of waiting for alternative pickup
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Subjekt hat das Angebot des Professors angenommen, anstatt auf eine alternative Abholung zu warten

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Pattern of one-on-one contact frequency continues to increase
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Muster der Häufigkeit von Eins-zu-eins-Kontakten nimmt weiter zu

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavior remains explainable but trend analysis flagged for review
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Verhalten bleibt erklärbar, aber Trendanalyse zur Überprüfung markiert

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: His help is becoming part of her routine, and that makes me uneasy.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Seine Hilfe wird Teil ihres Alltags, und das macht mich unruhig.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor provided transportation following a private revision session. Interaction remains within a plausible academic context, though HAK notes a growing pattern of personal assistance and increased familiarity.

Die Interaktion bleibt im Rahmen eines plausiblen akademischen Kontexts, obwohl HAK ein wachsendes Muster persönlicher Unterstützung und zunehmender Vertrautheit vermerkt.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm leaving the school office now

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe mehr verstanden als sonst

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not say it like a proud spreadsheet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sag das nicht wie eine stolze Tabelle

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I feel safer asking when you are involved
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich fühle mich sicherer, wenn du dabei bist

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're using that leg as an excuse for everything now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du benutzt das Bein jetzt als Ausrede für alles

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really should stop watching business videos
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du solltest wirklich aufhören, Business-Videos zu schauen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Also... bringst du die Einkäufe mit?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But only because I don't trust you to shop alone
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Aber nur, weil ich dir nicht zutraue, alleine einkaufen zu gehen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just because I'm outside doesn't mean I'm your personal delivery service
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Nur weil ich draußen bin, heißt das nicht, dass ich dein persönlicher Lieferservice bin

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't you help a poor injured man? 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Kannst du einem armen verletzten Mann nicht helfen? 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I'm about to leave for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Hey, ich mache mich gleich auf den Weg zur Arbeit

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 2 HOURS LATER
Hey, I'm on my break
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Hey, ich bin in meiner Pause

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How is it going?
It's okay
But we got the new outfits my manager ordered
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber wir haben die neuen Outfits bekommen, die mein Chef bestellt hat

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly I don't like them at all
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und ehrlich gesagt mag ich sie überhaupt nicht

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: What do the others think about them?
Most of them are pretty divided
But everyone listens to whatever the manager says
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber jeder hört auf das, was der Chef sagt

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: So we'll have to wear them no matter what
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Also müssen wir sie tragen, egal was passiert

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready for dinner as usual
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Alles ist wie gewohnt für das Abendessen vorbereitet

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just tell yourself it's only for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Sag dir einfach, dass es nur für die Arbeit ist

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And try to make the best of it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und versuche, das Beste daraus zu machen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'll try
You'll be fine
I know you can handle it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich weiß, dass du damit umgehen kannst

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thanks ❤️
I need to get back to work now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich muss jetzt zurück zur Arbeit

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Good luck
See you tomorrow since I won't get to see you tonight
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wir sehen uns morgen, da ich dich heute Abend nicht sehen kann

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: See you tomorrow 😊
{{name:hailey}} will bring it to your room so you don't have to move around too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}} bringt es dir ins Zimmer, damit du dich nicht zu viel bewegen musst

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 3 HOURS LATER
Workplace anomaly detected
{{name:evelyn}} reported concerns regarding new work outfits
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} hat Bedenken bezüglich der neuen Arbeitsoutfits geäußert

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Repeated references to management decisions detected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wiederholte Hinweise auf Entscheidungen des Managements erkannt

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Additional monitoring recommended to evaluate workplace influence patterns
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Zusätzliche Überwachung empfohlen, um Einflussmuster am Arbeitsplatz zu bewerten

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I don't like how much her work seems to be deciding for her.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mir gefällt nicht, wie sehr ihre Arbeit ihr die Entscheidungen abzunehmen scheint.

HAK archived an image from a fitting session involving the new work outfits introduced by management
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK hat ein Bild von einer Anprobe der neuen Arbeitsoutfits archiviert, die vom Management eingeführt wurden

DAY 13
Thank you

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I will
1 H LATER
I'm so good at picking the right outfit right ?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin echt gut darin, das richtige Outfit auszuwählen, oder?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I can understand that, but you also don't want to fall into the trap of avoiding work because it's hard
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das kann ich verstehen, aber du willst auch nicht in die Falle tappen, die Arbeit zu vermeiden, nur weil sie schwer ist.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: LATER, AFTER {{name:hailey}} BROUGHT FOOD TO YOUR ROOM
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: SPÄTER, NACHDEM {{name:hailey}} ESSEN IN DEIN ZIMMER BRINGT

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everything went well with your professor?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Alles gut gelaufen mit deinem Professor?
Ich habe gesehen, wie du es gemacht hast.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said my answer from earlier was closer than he expected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat gesagt, meine Antwort von vorher war näher dran, als er erwartet hat.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Like someone finally understands where I get lost
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wie wenn endlich jemand versteht, wo ich verloren gehe.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't rely on him too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Verlass dich nicht zu sehr auf ihn.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But he already knows all the exam stuff
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber er kennt schon alle Prüfungsdinge.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And he explains things in a way that actually makes sense
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und er erklärt die Dinge so, dass sie wirklich Sinn machen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come back tomorrow if I need the quiet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich kann morgen wiederkommen, wenn ich die Ruhe brauche.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I am going to sleep before you start thinking too loudly
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Naja, ich gehe schlafen, bevor du zu laut denkst.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He's actually very nice when he doesn't talk about homework
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er ist eigentlich sehr nett, wenn er nicht über Hausaufgaben redet

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come back tomorrow if I want to revise somewhere quiet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich kann morgen wiederkommen, wenn ich irgendwo ruhig lernen will.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little weird that he offered that, but good that he did
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ein bisschen komisch, dass er das angeboten hat, aber gut, dass er es getan hat.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Yeah, but I don't know if I will go
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ja, aber ich weiß nicht, ob ich gehen werde.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm not built for academic suffering
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin nicht für akademisches Leiden gemacht.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am just a tiny little victim 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin nur ein kleines Opfer 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going to sound stupid
I felt like my manager was looking at me a bit weird today
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass mein Manager mich heute ein bisschen komisch angeschaut hat.
Vielleicht bilde ich mir das nur ein.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a really long day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war ein wirklich langer Tag

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm probably just tired and overthinking
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin wahrscheinlich einfach müde und denke zu viel nach.
Fang nicht an, dir auch Dinge einzubilden.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you don't have to worry about me
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber du musst dir keine Sorgen um mich machen.
Ich bin heute Abend einfach wirklich müde.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gehe duschen und dann ins Bett.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I get a goodnight pic?
I really don't have the energy
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe wirklich nicht die Energie.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll make it up to you tomorrow
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde es morgen wieder gutmachen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AlphaMana posted: New assistant ! A good one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: AlphaMana hat gepostet: Neuer Assistent! Ein guter!

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I barely had time to breathe
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte kaum Zeit zu atmen.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just a lot of work all at once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Einfach eine Menge Arbeit auf einmal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: New stuff, more responsibility, everything at the same time
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Neue Dinge, mehr Verantwortung, alles zur gleichen Zeit

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I have to stop by the gym first
I'll grab it and come back
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich hole es und komme zurück

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You'll be back for dinner at least?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Bist du wenigstens rechtzeitig zum Abendessen zurück?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Don't eat everything before I get home
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Iss nicht alles, bevor ich nach Hause komme

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Subject remains at gym longer than expected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das Subjekt bleibt länger im Fitnessstudio als erwartet

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I was ready to laugh about the delay, and now I'm worried about what happened at the gym.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich wollte noch über die Verspätung lachen, und jetzt mache ich mir Sorgen, was im Fitnessstudio passiert ist.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} appears to be in an uncomfortable situation at the gym.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} scheint in einer unangenehmen Situation im Fitnessstudio zu sein.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't come downstairs for nothing
I'm surprised you even found the kitchen
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin überrascht, dass du überhaupt die Küche gefunden hast

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Du hast das echt gut gemacht

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I honestly did not expect that much
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe ehrlich gesagt nicht mit so viel gerechnet

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want to try again today?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Willst du es heute nochmal versuchen?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Alright, I'll keep you updated when I find a good client
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Okay, ich halte dich auf dem Laufenden, wenn ich einen guten Kunden finde

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Come eat when you're done, okay?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Komm essen, wenn du fertig bist, okay?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think yesterday helped a lot
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich denke, gestern hat mir echt geholfen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I feel much less stressed now
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich fühle mich jetzt viel weniger gestresst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I have some good news

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Der Ausflug gestern wurde mit 300 $ bezahlt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're starting to look like part of the furniture
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du fängst an, wie ein Möbelstück auszusehen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You should come eat with us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du solltest mit uns essen kommen
Dann solltest du dich besser beeilen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Even if you have to crawl all the way here 😭
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Auch wenn du hierher krabbeln musst 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll ask your private {{name:tutor}} to give you extra exercises today
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich werde deinen privaten {{name:tutor}} fragen, ob er dir heute zusätzliche Übungen geben kann.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That should keep your funny ideas out of my breakfast
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das sollte deine lustigen Ideen von meinem Frühstück fernhalten

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The pancakes belong to me now
The leg is getting better every week
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das Bein wird jede Woche besser.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: When do you see the doctor again?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wann siehst du den Arzt wieder?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Hopefully he'll finally get rid of the cast
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hoffentlich wird er endlich den Gips los

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist nicht schlecht, ich verspreche es.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You saying that makes me stress more
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das, was du sagst, macht mich noch gestresster.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just thought a lot about where we are
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe viel darüber nachgedacht, wo wir sind.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About how much I trust you
And about how I feel when I'm honest with myself
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und darüber, wie ich mich fühle, wenn ich ehrlich zu mir selbst bin.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's actually more positive than anything
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist tatsächlich positiver als alles andere.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to talk about it properly tonight
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte heute Abend richtig darüber sprechen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not quickly before I start my day
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nicht schnell, bevor ich meinen Tag beginne.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just the two of us, when I can explain it right
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur wir beide, wenn ich es richtig erklären kann
Bist du dir sicher, dass ich mir keine Sorgen machen sollte?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you carrying stress all day because of me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte nicht, dass du den ganzen Tag wegen mir gestresst bist.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I need to fix that
A sleepy mess, but you love me anyway right ?😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein schlafender Chaos, aber du liebst mich trotzdem, oder?😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that when I look half asleep
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du sagst das, wenn ich halb schlafend aussehe.
Ich werde versuchen, nicht zu viel nachzudenken.
Ich habe nicht so gut geschlafen.
Das ist anscheinend heute mein Job 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I had too much in my head
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich hatte zu viel im Kopf.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How does it feel getting up early just to suffer?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Wie fühlt es sich an, früh aufzustehen, nur um zu leiden?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich gebe {{mason:his|sein|ihr}} Handy zurück, bevor {{mason:he|er|sie}} anfängt zu weinen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The idiot kept looking at it instead of focusing
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Der Idiot hat ständig darauf geschaut, anstatt sich zu konzentrieren.
Gib es ihm noch nicht zurück.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How does it feel getting up early just to suffer?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Wie fühlt es sich an, früh aufzustehen, nur um zu leiden?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: {{mason:He}} needs more focus, but {{mason:he}}'s doing great
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: {{mason:He|Er|Sie}} muss sich besser konzentrieren, aber {{mason:he|er|sie}} macht das wirklich gut.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can you do me a favor?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Kannst du mir einen Gefallen tun?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Send me a photo of {{name:mason}} suffering during the session please
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Schick mir bitte ein Foto von {{name:mason}}, wie er während der Einheit leidet.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Just to keep some memories of this moment
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Nur um ein paar Erinnerungen an diesen Moment zu haben.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry, I can't read that right now
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tut mir leid, ich kann das gerade nicht lesen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm too busy imagining you suffering through your workout
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich bin zu beschäftigt damit, mir vorzustellen, wie du durch dein Workout leidest.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I took it away because {{mason:he}} wasn't focusing on the session
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich habe es weggenommen, weil {{mason:he|er|sie}} sich nicht aufs Training konzentriert hat.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It has been a long time since I went to the cinema
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es ist schon lange her, dass ich im Kino war

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep you updated with the place and the final details
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich halte dich mit dem Ort und den finalen Details auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Try to enjoy it and have a good day
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Versuch, es zu genießen und einen schönen Tag zu haben

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I have a new profile for you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe ein neues Profil für dich

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just arrived at the place
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin gerade am Ort angekommen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I feel less comfortable with people looking at us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich fühle mich unwohler, wenn die Leute uns ansehen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Try to focus on the moment
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Versuch, dich auf den Moment zu konzentrieren

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: If people are looking, they are probably just jealous
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn die Leute schauen, sind sie wahrscheinlich einfach nur neidisch

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It reassures me to have you close, even if it is only through the phone
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es beruhigt mich, dich nah bei mir zu haben, auch wenn es nur über das Telefon ist

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: If anything happens, you message me right away
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn irgendetwas passiert, schreib mir sofort

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I liked the movie, but I liked walking out with you even more.
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich mochte den Film, aber ich mochte es noch mehr, mit dir rauszugehen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He would like to take you on a movie date
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er würde dich gerne zu einem Filmdate einladen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I already feel like some subjects are getting easier
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe schon das Gefühl, dass einige Fächer leichter werden

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe Ethan knows what he's doing
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vielleicht weiß Ethan, was er tut

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or maybe it's because he's handsome
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Oder vielleicht liegt's daran, dass er gut aussieht

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That's definitely not how education works

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Die Beweise scheinen ziemlich überzeugend zu sein 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or I'll tell him to give you extra punishments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Oder ich sag ihm, er soll dir extra Strafen geben.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I might need some extra punishments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich könnte ein paar extra Strafen gebrauchen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have something annoying to admit
I'm just taking every possibility into consideration 😇
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich ziehe einfach alle Möglichkeiten in Betracht 😇

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you do me a favor?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Kannst du mir einen Gefallen tun?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a package waiting for pickup
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe ein Paket, das abgeholt werden muss.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you grab it for me?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Kannst du es für mich holen?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Using your injured leg to get free labor 😭
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dein verletztes Bein für kostenlose Arbeit nutzen 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And I'll bring it over after my tutoring session
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Und ich bring's nach meiner Nachhilfestunde vorbei.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's supposed to arrive soon anyway
You owe me pancakes for this 😌
I understood a few things in class today that would've completely confused me last week
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe heute in der Klasse ein paar Dinge verstanden, die mich letzte Woche total verwirrt hätten

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You fucking asshole, I'm going to make you pay for that photo
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du verdammter Arschloch, ich werde dich für dieses Foto bezahlen lassen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: No
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Nein

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Was

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Why
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Warum

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: As your secretary, it's my duty to handle your appointments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Als deine Sekretärin ist es meine Pflicht, deine Termine zu verwalten

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I knew calling you that was a mistake
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich wusste, dass es ein Fehler war, dich so zu nennen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You finally gave me a purpose in life
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast mir endlich einen Sinn im Leben gegeben

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Managing the schedule of an ungrateful little princess
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Den Zeitplan einer undankbaren kleinen Prinzessin zu managen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm doing something useful with my life
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Zumindest mache ich etwas Nützliches mit meinem Leben

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're just using my calendar to feel important
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du benutzt meinen Kalender nur, um dich wichtig zu fühlen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Someone has to keep your life organized
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Jemand muss dein Leben organisieren

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What photo?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Welches Foto?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You better watch yourself
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Pass besser auf dich auf

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Once I'm muscular, I'm going to make you regret all of this
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sobald ich muskulös bin, wirst du es bereuen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Wow
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wow

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm so scared
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich hab so Angst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hopefully i have a few decade before you get muscular enough
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hoffentlich habe ich noch ein paar Jahrzehnte, bevor du muskulös genug bist

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I have no idea what you're talking about
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe keine Ahnung, wovon du redest.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah right
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja, klar.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You probably saved it as your wallpaper
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast es wahrscheinlich als Hintergrundbild gespeichert.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That's actually a great idea 😂
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Das ist tatsächlich eine großartige Idee 😂

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You looked so happy suffering through that workout
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast so glücklich ausgesehen, während du durch das Workout gelitten hast.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Fuck you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Fick dich

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Give me the number
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Gib mir die Nummer.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll book my own sessions from now on
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde meine eigenen Einheiten von jetzt an buchen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: She's getting more comfortable teasing me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie wird immer mutiger darin, mich zu ärgern.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: Some of her jokes are a little bold
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Einige ihrer Witze sind ein bisschen gewagt.
