story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: She even said she might fail a quiz on purpose if the punishment is not extra exercises
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie hat sogar gesagt, sie könnte einen Test absichtlich vermasseln, wenn die Strafe keine extra Übungen sind.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: I wanted to ask how you would prefer me to react
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Ich wollte fragen, wie du möchtest, dass ich reagiere.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: Act how you think is best
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Mach, was du für das Beste hältst.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: As long as she passes her exams, I don't really care
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Solange sie ihre Prüfungen besteht, ist mir das egal.
Wiss einfach, dass sie sehr gerne ärgert.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: Do you still want me to keep you informed about everything?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Willst du, dass ich dich weiterhin über alles informiere?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: I want to know how things are going
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Ich will wissen, wie es läuft

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: Then I'll be transparent with you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Dann werde ich ehrlich zu dir sein
Sie hat das letzte Quiz bestanden

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: So she asked for her reward
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Also hat sie nach ihrer Belohnung gefragt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: What did she ask for this time?
She asked if she could sit on my lap while we finish the last part of the session
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie hat gefragt, ob sie auf meinem Schoß sitzen kann, während wir den letzten Teil der Sitzung beenden

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: If she earned it, it's fine
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Wenn sie es sich verdient hat, ist das in Ordnung

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: But make sure she still finishes the work
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Aber stell sicher, dass sie die Arbeit trotzdem beendet

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: The study goal stays the priority
She still jokes a lot, but she understands faster than yesterday
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Sie macht immer noch viele Witze, aber sie versteht schneller als gestern.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.source: Even when she's embarrassed about not understanding something, she keeps trying
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_TUTOR_STUDY_UPD.translation: Selbst wenn sie sich schämt, weil sie etwas nicht versteht, versucht sie es weiter.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm heading home now 😊
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich mache mich jetzt auf den Weg nach Hause 😊

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: The goal is also to get closer to your clients, as long as it stays within what you are comfortable doing
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das Ziel ist auch, näher zu deinen Kunden zu kommen, solange es in dem bleibt, was dir angenehm ist

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you feel okay with something, you do not have to hesitate too much
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wenn du dich mit etwas wohlfühlst, musst du nicht zu zögern

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And usually, people add tips when you make those little efforts
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und normalerweise geben die Leute Trinkgeld, wenn du diese kleinen Anstrengungen machst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Tips?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Trinkgeld?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ja

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just received the transfer
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe gerade die Überweisung erhalten

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He paid $400 for the date and added $100 as a tip
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Er hat $400 für das Date bezahlt und $100 als Trinkgeld hinzugefügt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: For a movie and holding hands?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Für einen Film und Händchenhalten?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ja

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How did it go?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wie lief es?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You made him feel good, and he wanted to reward that
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du hast ihn gut fühlen lassen, und er wollte das belohnen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I really did not expect that
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das habe ich wirklich nicht erwartet

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I think I am starting to understand little by little
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich glaube, ich fange langsam an, es zu verstehen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I still need to improve, but...
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich muss mich noch verbessern, aber...

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Earning that much money while having fun and meeting people is actually pretty nice
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: So viel Geld zu verdienen, während ich Spaß habe und Leute treffe, ist eigentlich ziemlich schön

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That's why we take it slowly
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Deshalb nehmen wir es langsam

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You learn what feels right for you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du lernst, was sich für dich richtig anfühlt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for guiding me through it
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Danke, dass du mich dabei führst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'll be home soon 😊
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin bald zu Hause 😊

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 'll make a good meal for my little manager
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich werde ein gutes Essen für meinen kleinen Manager machen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Honestly, really well
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, wirklich gut

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Can't wait to taste it!
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Kann es kaum erwarten, es zu probieren!

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Noah sent you a tip
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Noah hat dir ein Trinkgeld geschickt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 13
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: TAG 13

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 13
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: TAG 13

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: The movie was good, and he was nice too
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Der Film war gut, und er war auch nett

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: There was just one moment where I wasn't completely sure what to do
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Es gab nur einen Moment, in dem ich mir nicht ganz sicher war, was ich tun sollte

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: What happened?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Was ist passiert?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: At one point, he asked if we could hold hands
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Irgendwann hat er gefragt, ob wir Händchen halten könnten

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I wasn't very comfortable at first, but I accepted
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich war zuerst nicht sehr wohl dabei, aber ich habe zugestimmt

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you think I should not have?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Denkst du, ich hätte das nicht tun sollen?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You did fine
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du hast das gut gemacht

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I figured if I’m gonna pass this exam
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich dachte mir, wenn ich diese Prüfung bestehen will

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I might as well get something extra out of it
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Kann ich auch gleich etwas Extra rausholen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And by the end of the session I just sat on his lap
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und am Ende der Sitzung saß ich einfach auf seinem Schoß

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Damn you’re really getting bold huh
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Verdammte Axt, du wirst ja wirklich mutig, was?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Does it bother you that I flirt with my professor that much 😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Stört es dich, dass ich so viel mit meinem Professor flirte? 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And you’ve got a lot of guts
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und du hast echt viel Mut

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So how did it go with your professor tonight?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wie lief es heute Abend mit deinem Professor?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I can shock you if I want to 😇
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich kann dich schocken, wenn ich will 😇
Wenn du nicht so nervig bist 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I just want to know how your session went
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich will nur wissen, wie deine Sitzung war.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Umm it went well I guess 😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ähm, es lief gut, schätze ich 😌
Und ich habe meine Belohnung bekommen 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Well that’s good news at least
It’s nice to have some fun after all the studying I’ve been doing lately 😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Es ist schön, nach all dem Lernen, das ich lately gemacht habe, ein bisschen Spaß zu haben 😌
Ich weiß, mach dir keine Sorgen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I was a little shy at first
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich war zuerst ein bisschen schüchtern

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But then I decided to take advantage
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber dann habe ich beschlossen, es auszunutzen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: How can I not flirt with a professor who's so hot? 😇
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wie kann ich nicht mit einem so heißen Professor flirten? 😇

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I wanted to wait until tonight
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deshalb wollte ich bis heute Abend warten.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I could say it properly
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Damit ich es richtig sagen könnte.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me 5 minutes and I'm all yours 😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gib mir 5 Minuten und ich gehöre ganz dir 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought a lot about us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe viel über uns nachgedacht.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About how safe I feel with you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie sicher ich mich mit dir fühle

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And about how honest you've been with me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wie ehrlich du mit mir gewesen bist

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first, I was scared because I didn't understand it
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zuerst hatte ich Angst, weil ich es nicht verstand.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought maybe it meant something was wrong between us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, vielleicht bedeutet es, dass etwas zwischen uns nicht stimmt.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Or at least I'm starting to
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oder zumindest fange ich an, das zu tun.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought about what you said
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe über das nachgedacht, was du gesagt hast.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I mostly listened to how I felt
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich habe hauptsächlich darauf gehört, wie ich mich fühlte.
Und wie hast du dich gefühlt?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because every time I imagined talking about it with you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich mir jedes Mal vorgestellt habe, mit dir darüber zu sprechen
Das stärkste Gefühl war nicht Angst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe a little curiosity too 😳
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und vielleicht auch ein wenig Neugier 😳

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I need you to understand something
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber ich muss, dass du etwas verstehst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not saying yes to anything tonight
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich sage heute Abend zu nichts Ja.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not promising I know exactly where my limits are
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich verspreche nicht, dass ich genau weiß, wo meine Grenzen liegen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm not running away from this anymore
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber ich laufe davor nicht mehr weg.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to understand you
I know I made you stress a little this morning
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, ich habe dir heute Morgen ein wenig Stress gemacht.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can go as slow as you need
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir können so langsam gehen, wie du es brauchst.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I feel safe saying this
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deshalb fühle ich mich sicher, das zu sagen.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If we keep talking about it
And if either of us feels bad, we stop and talk
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn einer von uns sich schlecht fühlt, hören wir auf und reden.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I think that's my answer for tonight
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann denke ich, das ist meine Antwort für heute Abend.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm willing to learn more about what you feel
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin bereit, mehr darüber zu lernen, was du fühlst.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you so much for being so open with me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielen Dank, dass du so offen mit mir bist.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for being honest about it
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du ehrlich darüber bist.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wanting your girlfriend to get fucked by someone else is just a little?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deine Freundin von jemand anderem gefickt werden zu wollen, ist das nur ein bisschen?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay maybe more than a little 😭
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, vielleicht mehr als nur ein bisschen 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then what counts as a lot? 😭
Thank you for being patient with me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du geduldig mit mir bist.
Du hast gesagt, es war positiv.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll buy you another cake tomorrow
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich kaufe dir morgen einen anderen Kuchen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You have a session tomorrow at 8 AM
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du hast morgen um 8 Uhr einen Termin

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Your session starts as soon as you get home then
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Deine Sitzung beginnt, sobald du nach Hause kommst

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I already talked to your coach
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich habe schon mit deinem Trainer gesprochen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: He said it's going to be intense
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Er hat gesagt, es wird intensiv

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You really need to find a hobby that doesn't involve obsessing over me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du musst wirklich ein Hobby finden, das nicht damit zu tun hat, mich zu obsessieren

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then you ate the last piece of it
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Dann hast du das letzte Stück davon gegessen

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You ate the last piece of cake?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du hast das letzte Stück Kuchen gegessen?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You look really proud for someone who just signed {{mason:his}} own death warrant
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du siehst ganz schön stolz aus, obwohl du gerade {{mason:his|dein|dein}} eigenes Todesurteil unterschrieben hast.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I still need to be careful for a bit though
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich muss trotzdem noch ein bisschen vorsichtig sein.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Did you try that app I sent you ?
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Hast du die App ausprobiert, die ich dir geschickt habe?

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: For now I'm just waiting to see what it becomes
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Für den Moment warte ich einfach ab, was es wird.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: But I check it from time to time
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Aber ich überprüfe es von Zeit zu Zeit.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'm sure you will enjoy it when you find something you like
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich bin mir sicher, dass du es genießen wirst, wenn du etwas findest, das dir gefällt.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: My room looks like a crime scene
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Mein Zimmer sieht aus wie eine Tatort.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And my desk cables are trying to form a new species
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Und meine Schreibtischkabel versuchen, eine neue Spezies zu bilden.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If I disappear, assume the wires won
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Wenn ich verschwinde, geh davon aus, dass die Drähte gewonnen haben.
Hast du wieder mit dem Training angefangen?

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Just testing if my body still hates me
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich teste nur, ob mein Körper mich immer noch hasst.

story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: It only hates me a normal amount now
story/DAY13/DAY13_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Es hasst mich jetzt nur noch in normalem Maße.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Now I don't know what's sweeter
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Jetzt weiß ich nicht, was süßer ist

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Then I hope the cake wins
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Dann hoffe ich, dass der Kuchen gewinnt

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Come downstairs while it's still warm
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Komm nach unten, solange es noch warm ist

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Ready for another day of work?
Do you need help with anything?
In fact, I even made a cake for breakfast
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Tatsächlich habe ich sogar einen Kuchen zum Frühstück gemacht

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: So I will probably go shopping after class 😌
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Also werde ich wahrscheinlich nach dem Unterricht shoppen gehen 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I think studying is killing me
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich glaube, das Lernen bringt mich um.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: How can you say no to this 😔
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wie kannst du da nein sagen? 😔

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I can reward you if you let me go 😇
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Aber ich kann dich belohnen, wenn du mir erlaubst zu gehen 😇

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Maybe I can be very convincing when I want to
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Vielleicht kann ich sehr überzeugend sein, wenn ich will.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But it better be worth it
Now let me survive this horrible morning first 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Lass mich zuerst diesen schrecklichen Morgen überstehen 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still have a huge morning too 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich habe morgen auch einen riesigen Tag 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: But I wanted to make you smile before class
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aber ich wollte dich vor dem Unterricht zum Lächeln bringen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Normally I finish at noon today
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Normalerweise bin ich heute Mittag fertig.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I can come see you later 😌
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Damit ich dich später besuchen kann 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I thought you might like that
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich dachte, das könnte dir gefallen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you'll survive one more morning without me
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann wirst du einen weiteren Morgen ohne mich überleben.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come save me this afternoon then
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Komm mich dann heute Nachmittag retten.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You can't just send that first thing in the morning
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du kannst das nicht einfach gleich am Morgen senden.
Weil ich jetzt schon abgelenkt bin.
Klingt nach einem Problem für dich 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'll do the jump rope then

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Schade, dass du nicht mitmachen kannst
Ich würde auch gegen dich antreten

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I don't think that cast would appreciate it 😏
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Aber ich glaube nicht, dass der Gips das zu schätzen wüsste 😏

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: The weather's too good to waste
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Das Wetter ist zu schön, um es zu verschwenden

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich koche das Abendessen für alle

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And the two of us can eat in front of the TV
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Und wir zwei können vor dem Fernseher essen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Now I have something to look forward to
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Jetzt habe ich etwas, worauf ich mich freuen kann

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Then finish your work properly first
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Dann mach zuerst deine Arbeit ordentlich fertig

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: The series can wait for you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Die Serie kann auf dich warten

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you have time to bring me something small to snack on?
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hast du Zeit, mir etwas Kleines zum Snacken mitzubringen?

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll bring you something in a minute
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bringe dir in einer Minute etwas mit

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Also, after work tonight, I'd like to watch the next episode of that series we started yesterday
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Außerdem würde ich gerne nach der Arbeit heute Abend die nächste Folge von der Serie schauen, die wir gestern angefangen haben

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was hoping you would say that
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich hatte gehofft, dass du das sagst
Ich fand sie auch wirklich gut

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Then as soon as I finish work, I'll take a shower and we can watch it
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Sobald ich mit der Arbeit fertig bin, dusche ich und dann können wir sie schauen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And you would get a full private fashion show later 😇
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Und du bekommst später eine private Modenschau 😇

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You should feel lucky a girl even offers that 💅
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Du solltest dich glücklich schätzen, dass dir ein Mädchen sowas anbietet 💅

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Today and tomorrow are revision days
If you agree to revise properly, I will even pay for some clothes
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wenn du zustimmst, richtig zu lernen, bezahle ich sogar für ein paar Klamotten
Ich liebe es plötzlich zu lernen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You better not take it back later
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Du solltest es später nicht zurücknehmen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And I think the quiz actually went okay 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Und ich glaube, das Quiz lief tatsächlich okay 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will become the smartest girl alive for free clothes 😌
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde das klügste Mädchen der Welt für kostenlose Klamotten 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And now I deserve shopping therapy 😌
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Und jetzt hab ich Shopping-Therapie verdient 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going home first to change
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich gehe zuerst nach Hause, um mich umzuziehen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't want to show up still dressed for class
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich möchte nicht noch im Klassenoutfit auftauchen.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into German.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'd be distracted all over again
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Du würdest dich wieder ablenken lassen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So how long until I see you?
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Wie lange dauert es, bis ich dich sehe?

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Let me get home, change, and breathe for five minutes 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lass mich nach Hause gehen, mich umziehen und fünf Minuten atmen 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But I want proof when you're ready
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aber ich will Beweise, wenn du bereit bist.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Changed, ready, and on my way 😌
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Geändert, bereit und auf dem Weg 😌

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Because you're the one I'm coming to see ❤️
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Weil du derjenige bist, den ich besuchen komme ❤️

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: This morning felt longer than it should have
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dieser Morgen fühlte sich länger an, als er sollte.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And now I can actually come see you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Und jetzt kann ich dich tatsächlich besuchen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Best part of my day already
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Der beste Teil meines Tages ist schon vorbei.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle this on the game
I can't wait to get home
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, nach Hause zu kommen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Just so I can shut you up properly
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Nur um dich richtig zum Schweigen zu bringen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go work before you start crying at your phone
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Geh arbeiten, bevor du anfängst, an deinem Handy zu weinen
Bewahr dir dieses Selbstbewusstsein für später auf

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Still thinking about that jump rope
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Denk immer noch an das Seilspringen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'm pretty sure I could do better with the cast
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin mir sicher, ich könnte es mit dem Gips besser machen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You couldn't jump over a charging cable right now
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Du könntest jetzt nicht mal über ein Ladekabel springen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And yet somehow I'd still look better doing it
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Und trotzdem würde ich dabei besser aussehen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You'll need something to look at when you're losing tonight
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Du wirst etwas brauchen, um es dir anzusehen, wenn du heute Abend verlierst

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do I look like I gained weight in that photo?
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Sehe ich auf diesem Foto dicker aus?

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I feel like I look bigger than usual
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, ich sehe größer aus als sonst

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But I might still try to be a little more careful with what I eat
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Aber ich könnte trotzdem versuchen, ein bisschen mehr auf meine Ernährung zu achten

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Maybe do some gymnastics or yoga too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Vielleicht auch ein bisschen Gymnastik oder Yoga machen

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You have plenty of room before you need to worry about anything
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Du hast noch genug Platz, bevor du dir Sorgen machen musst

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But yoga or gymnastics is good for health anyway
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Aber Yoga oder Gymnastik sind sowieso gut für die Gesundheit

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So if you want to do it for yourself, that sounds great
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Wenn du es also für dich selbst machen möchtest, klingt das großartig

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That was exactly the kind of answer I needed
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Das war genau die Art von Antwort, die ich gebraucht habe

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm coming for the series now 😄
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich komme jetzt für die Serie 😄

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Sustained emotional proximity detected between {{name:player}} and {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Nachhaltige emotionale Nähe zwischen {{name:player}} und {{name:evelyn}} erkannt

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Heartbeat intensity increased during shared private moment
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Herzschlagintensität während des gemeinsamen privaten Moments erhöht

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Relevante emotionale Erfassung in HAK Beweis archiviert

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: HAK can measure my pulse, but it can't tell me what to do with these feelings.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: HAK kann meinen Puls messen, mir aber nicht sagen, was ich mit diesen Gefühlen anfangen soll.
Ich bin fast mit dem Kochen fertig

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: The kitchen pro preparing a beautiful dish
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Der Küchenprofi bereitet ein wunderschönes Gericht zu

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I hope the dish is good at least 😄
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich hoffe, das Gericht schmeckt wenigstens gut 😄

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for spending so much time with me lately
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Danke, dass du in letzter Zeit so viel Zeit mit mir verbracht hast.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Even with all the studying stuff 😌
I like spending time with you too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich verbringe auch gerne Zeit mit dir.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I am even expanding my little goblin photo album with all your pictures
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Und ich erweitere sogar mein kleines Goblin-Fotoalbum mit all deinen Bildern.
Und ich habe das Essen gemacht

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just call me a goblin?
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Hast du mich gerade Goblin genannt?

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I open my heart and this is my reward 😔
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich öffne mein Herz und das ist meine Belohnung 😔

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe because someone keeps asking for them 💅
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vielleicht, weil jemand ständig danach fragt 💅

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: One more for the creepy goblin collection 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Noch eins für die gruselige Goblin-Sammlung 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So hurry up and drag your little larva body down here 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Also beeil dich und zieh deinen kleinen Larvenkörper hier runter 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You look way too proud of yourself
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du siehst viel zu stolz auf dich aus

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I survived classes AND cooked !
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Weil ich die Stunden überlebt UND gekocht habe!

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It made everything feel more real
It felt really good having you here
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Es fühlte sich wirklich gut an, dich hier zu haben.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I don't want today to be a one time thing
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Weil ich nicht möchte, dass heute eine einmalige Sache ist.
Bist du gut nach Hause gekommen?

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hoffe wirklich, es hat dir auch gefallen.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Talking together about what I like before
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Darüber sprechen, was ich vorher mag.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And moving forward while making your partner feel good too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dabei vorankommen, während du auch deinem Partner ein gutes Gefühl gibst.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das hat wirklich, wirklich gut für mich funktioniert ❤️

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das freut mich sehr zu hören.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Weil ich mehr davon mit dir will

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jetzt muss ich mich ein bisschen beruhigen, bevor ich ins Bett gehe 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich vermisse dich schon ein wenig.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dich leichter bewegen zu sehen, hat mich so glücklich gemacht.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} keeps getting more competitive.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Das Geplänkel zwischen dir und {{name:mason}} wird immer wettbewerbsfähiger.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Every game now feels like a personal challenge.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Jedes Spiel fühlt sich jetzt wie eine persönliche Herausforderung an.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm starting to care more about being there with {{name:mason}} than winning.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Langsam ist mir wichtiger, bei {{name:mason}} zu sein, als zu gewinnen.
Sag mir nicht, dass du dich versteckst

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You'll get a free lesson on how to exercise properly
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Du bekommst eine kostenlose Lektion, wie man richtig trainiert

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Had to be clean before destroying you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Musste sauber sein, bevor ich dich zerstöre

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Repeated cardiac anomalies detected during today's private interactions
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Wiederholte Herzanomalien während der heutigen privaten Interaktionen festgestellt.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Relevant moments have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Relevante Momente wurden in HAK Evidence archiviert.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: The little moments with {{name:lena}} are staying with me more than I expected.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Die kleinen Momente mit {{name:lena}} beschäftigen mich mehr, als ich erwartet hätte.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sie wird nie wieder Lärm machen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I mean she promised to be quieter
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich meine, sie hat versprochen, leiser zu sein

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: For a second I was actually worried
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Für einen Moment war ich wirklich besorgt

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Although {{name:hailey}} is making enough noise for the whole house right now 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Obwohl {{name:hailey}} gerade genug Lärm für das ganze Haus macht 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Can you tell her to be a little quieter?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Kannst du ihr sagen, sie soll ein bisschen leiser sein?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Otherwise I'll have to go upstairs and do it myself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sonst muss ich selbst nach oben gehen und es tun

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Study is killing me 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das Lernen bringt mich um 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He heard me talk about it whith my friends
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er hat mich gehört, wie ich mit meinen Freunden darüber gesprochen habe.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Apparently I have to come revise with him after class instead
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Offenbar muss ich stattdessen nach dem Unterricht mit ihm lernen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Seriously?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Echt jetzt?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ja 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But then he made a deal with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aber dann hat er mir einen Deal angeboten.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I do well on the quiz tomorrow, he will personally take me shopping himself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich morgen beim Quiz gut abschneide, nimmt er mich persönlich zum Shoppen mit.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said that?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hat er das gesagt?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: YES 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: JA 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said I need motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er meinte, ich brauche Motivation.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And that he heard shopping is apparently my natural habitat
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und dass er gehört hat, dass Shoppen anscheinend mein natürlicher Lebensraum ist.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: My brain is swollen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mein Gehirn ist geschwollen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but accurate 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Was unhöflich, aber zutreffend ist 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Look at this face
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sieh dir dieses Gesicht an.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does this look like someone built for revision suffering?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sieht das aus wie jemand, der für das Lernen gemacht ist?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Looks like someone trying to negotiate her way out of studying
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sieht aus wie jemand, der versucht, sich aus dem Lernen herauszuwinden.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Correct 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Richtig 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But honestly the shopping promise is kind of motivating me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aber ehrlich gesagt motiviert mich das Versprechen, shoppen zu gehen, ein bisschen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate that it is working
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich hasse es, dass es funktioniert.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Reward-based attention from an authority figure is strengthening emotional attachment patterns.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Belohnungsbasierte Aufmerksamkeit von einer Autoritätsperson stärkt emotionale Bindungsmuster.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask why he wants to take her shopping
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Frag ihn, warum er mit ihr shoppen gehen will.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Focus on helping her survive the quiz
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Konzentrier dich darauf, ihr beim Bestehen des Quiz zu helfen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably illegal
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wahrscheinlich illegal.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why does he want to take you shopping himself?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Warum will er dich selbst zum Shoppen mitnehmen?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because apparently stressed students need rewards
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Weil gestresste Studenten anscheinend Belohnungen brauchen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And because he thinks I work better when I have motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und weil er denkt, dass ich besser arbeite, wenn ich Motivation habe.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are making this sound way more dramatic than it is 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du machst das viel dramatischer, als es ist 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Survive the quiz first. Shopping after.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Überlebe zuerst das Quiz. Shoppen danach.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Siehste 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You and him are bullying me together now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ihr beiden mobbt mich jetzt zusammen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Huge morning today 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Riesiger Morgen heute 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Fine
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Okay

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I become the smartest girl alive, somebody defenetly owes me clothes 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich das klügste Mädchen der Welt werde, schuldet mir definitiv jemand Klamotten 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive this horrible morning first 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lass mich zuerst diesen schrecklichen Morgen überstehen 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Afternoon free though
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nachmittag ist aber frei.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which means shopping should legally happen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Was bedeutet, dass Shopping gesetzlich stattfinden sollte.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's not a good idea
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das ist keine gute Idee.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: 15 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 15 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is exactly what my professor said 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Genau das hat mein Professor auch gesagt 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He literally told me I am not allowed to go shopping today
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er hat mir wörtlich gesagt, dass ich heute nicht shoppen gehen darf.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Zuerst die Universität, dann wieder arbeiten

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I think it'll be fine 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich denke, es wird gut sein 🙂
Schwer, das nach gestern nicht zu tun.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want every morning to feel like an interrogation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte nicht, dass jeder Morgen sich wie ein Verhör anfühlt.
Ich kümmere mich nur um dich

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I care about you too
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich kümmere mich auch um dich.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just need you to trust me a little
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich brauche nur, dass du mir ein wenig vertraust.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have to get ready now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich muss mich jetzt fertig machen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I fell asleep fast after yesterday 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin nach gestern schnell eingeschlafen 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll make sure you're the one getting dragged out of bed tomorrow
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich werde dafür sorgen, dass du morgen aus dem Bett gezerrt wirst

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Keep talking and you'll be late for work
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Wenn du weiter redest, kommst du zu spät zur Arbeit

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If you don't get up soon
I'll drag my cast all the way to your room just to wake you up 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ziehe ich meinen Gips bis zu deinem Zimmer, nur um dich aufzuwecken 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, I was looking for you
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hey, ich habe nach dir gesucht

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And you took a photo of me? 😳
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Und du hast ein Foto von mir gemacht? 😳

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Tut mir leid, ich wollte dich nicht unwohl fühlen lassen
Du hast einfach friedlich ausgesehen
Und sehr schön

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Besides, you're right to take care of your body
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Außerdem hast du recht, auf deinen Körper zu achten
Danke

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That's sweet of you to say
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das ist süß von dir zu sagen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be in shape for tonight
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich möchte einfach für heute Abend fit sein

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I did a little workout before getting ready
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Deshalb habe ich ein kleines Workout gemacht, bevor ich mich fertig gemacht habe
Das macht Sinn
Ich konnte dich nirgendwo finden

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just don't push yourself too hard
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Drück dich nur nicht zu sehr
Keine Sorge, ich werde es nicht tun
Über den Spaziergang

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: How about we do it tomorrow?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wie wäre es, wenn wir es morgen machen?
Klar, das passt mir
Super

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I have to go get ready now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich muss mich jetzt fertig machen
Okay, bis später!

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted to ask if you wanted to walk a little with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich wollte fragen, ob du ein bisschen mit mir spazieren gehen möchtest
EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER...

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I didn't think to look for you in the garden
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hätte nicht daran gedacht, dich im Garten zu suchen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'm glad you started yoga again 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich freue mich, dass du wieder mit Yoga angefangen hast 🙂
40 MINUTEN SPÄTER
Oh mein Gott
Ich habe dich nicht einmal gesehen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is good because I need it
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Was gut ist, weil ich es brauche.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: When I think about all the things I will be able to choose with professor money 💅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn ich an all die Dinge denke, die ich mit dem Geld des Professors aussuchen kann 💅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not get your hopes up
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mach dir nicht zu viele Hoffnungen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be hopeful for once 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich will nur einmal hoffnungsvoll sein 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have been so stressed about school that I have not allowed myself to be excited about anything else
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich war so gestresst wegen der Schule, dass ich mir nicht erlaubt habe, mich über etwas anderes zu freuen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Unexpected emotional variance detected during private revision session
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Unerwartete emotionale Schwankungen während der privaten Überprüfung festgestellt.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavioral analysis indicates discomfort but excitement from subject {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Verhaltensanalyse zeigt Unbehagen, aber auch Aufregung bei Subjekt {{name:hailey}}.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Observed interaction pattern exceeds expected academic boundaries
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Beobachtetes Interaktionsmuster überschreitet die erwarteten akademischen Grenzen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds more personal than a revision session. I need to understand what's happening.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das klingt persönlicher als eine Nachhilfestunde. Ich muss verstehen, was da passiert.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK detected repeated body language markers and emotional responsiveness inconsistent with a standard teacher-student revision session
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat wiederholte Körpersprache-Marker und emotionale Reaktionen festgestellt, die nicht mit einer normalen Lehrer-Schüler-Überprüfungssitzung übereinstimmen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Then he made me correct the one answer I guessed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dann hat er mich gezwungen, die eine Antwort zu korrigieren, die ich geraten habe.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know, I am so happy 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich weiß, ich bin so glücklich 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He said I have to come by after class to review the quiz and go over the material I missed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich soll nach dem Unterricht vorbeikommen, um das Quiz zu besprechen und das Material, das ich verpasst habe, durchzugehen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, i have a small break at work 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey, ich habe eine kleine Pause bei der Arbeit 🙂

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm still faking half of it
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich täusche immer noch die Hälfte davon vor.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's one way to say it 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist eine Möglichkeit, es zu sagen 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Quick one before I go back
Finally sitting down for a minute
You're lucky I had a second
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast Glück, dass ich einen Moment hatte.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go before I get in trouble
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich muss gehen, bevor ich in Schwierigkeiten gerate.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you have a good morning?
But today is better than yesterday
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber heute ist besser als gestern

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I actually know what I'm doing now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß tatsächlich, was ich jetzt tue.
Schau dich an, wie professionell du wirst!

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mach einfach nicht, dass ich zahlen muss

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Conversation tone no longer appears relaxed
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Der Gesprächston scheint nicht mehr entspannt zu sein

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I need to know whether {{name:mason}} is okay before I decide what this means.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Bevor ich entscheide, was das bedeutet, muss ich wissen, ob bei {{name:mason}} alles okay ist.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:mason}} appears visibly uncomfortable during an interaction at the gym.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:mason}} wirkt während einer Interaktion im Fitnessstudio sichtbar unwohl.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Do you want to go to the movies tonight?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Willst du heute Abend ins Kino gehen?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: It's just to thank you for waking me up this morning
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Es ist nur ein Dankeschön, dass du mich heute Morgen geweckt hast

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And I just don't feel like staying home all evening
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Und ich habe einfach keine Lust, den ganzen Abend zu Hause zu bleiben

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich mache mich jetzt auf den Weg zur Arbeit
Hey, ich bin in meiner Pause

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Good luck with the rest of the rush
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Viel Glück mit dem Rest des Ansturms

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Workplace monitoring detected unusual activity during closing hours
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Die Überwachung am Arbeitsplatz hat ungewöhnliche Aktivitäten während der Schließzeiten festgestellt

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Something is changing at work. I should look at what HAK found before jumping to conclusions.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Bei der Arbeit verändert sich etwas. Ich sollte mir ansehen, was HAK gefunden hat, bevor ich voreilige Schlüsse ziehe.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived an image showing {{name:evelyn}} wearing the new work outfit introduced by management
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK hat ein Bild archiviert, das {{name:evelyn}} in der neuen Arbeitskleidung zeigt, die von der Geschäftsführung eingeführt wurde

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: She's starting to let go a little
If you need anything, just ask
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wenn du etwas brauchst, frag einfach

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I can move around by myself now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich kann mich jetzt selbstständig bewegen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You don't need to worry so much
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du musst dir nicht so viele Sorgen machen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you think you'll finish late tonight?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Denkst du, dass du heute Abend spät fertig wirst?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'd like a quiet shift for once 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich hätte gerne mal eine ruhige Schicht 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: See you tomorrow if your're aslep when i come back ❤️
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wir sehen uns morgen, falls du schläfst, wenn ich zurückkomme ❤️

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That is not a chef face
It is a dangerous chef face
Thank you for still talking to me when I am like this
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Danke, dass du immer noch mit mir redest, wenn ich so bin

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I will get emotional and then blame exams
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sonst werde ich emotional und schiebe die Schuld auf die Prüfungen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You didn't get a text when you left
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du hast keine Nachricht bekommen, als du gegangen bist
Es ist jetzt ganz schön spät

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I have to cook because I promised myself I would be a functional person
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und ich muss kochen, weil ich mir versprochen habe, eine funktionierende Person zu sein

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du machst dir manchmal zu viele Sorgen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't like when something feels off
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es einfach nicht, wenn sich etwas seltsam anfühlt.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do, by playing video games
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich tue es, indem ich Videospiele spiele.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you do today, exept gaming?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was hast du heute gemacht, außer zu zocken?
Ich bin meistens zu Hause geblieben.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should come entertain me at work next time
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du solltest mich das nächste Mal bei der Arbeit unterhalten kommen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, I might actually do that
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vorsicht, ich könnte das tatsächlich tun.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'm going to sleep early again
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich glaube, ich werde wieder früh schlafen gehen.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But it was better than yesterday
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber es war besser als gestern

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I just overthought it yesterday
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich glaube, ich habe gestern einfach zu viel nachgedacht.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AlphaMana posted: She have a real tamperament !
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: AlphaMana hat gepostet: Sie hat echt Temperament!

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin gerade nach Hause gekommen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unlike you, I don't leave the house looking like I just woke up
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Im Gegensatz zu dir verlasse ich das Haus nicht, als hätte ich gerade geschlafen

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll be downstairs in a minute
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin in einer Minute unten

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: We're going to be late for the movie
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Wir werden zu spät für den Film sein

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Inconsistencies detected in subject {{name:lena}}'s recent statements
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Inkonsistenzen in den jüngsten Aussagen von {{name:lena}} festgestellt.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Speech hesitation patterns exceeded normal baseline
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Die Sprachzögerungsmuster haben die normale Basislinie überschritten.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Cross-referencing verbal claims with workplace observation logs...
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Überprüfung verbaler Aussagen mit Beobachtungsprotokollen am Arbeitsplatz...

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Relevant captures have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Relevante Beweise wurden in HAK Evidence archiviert.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Good morning 😊 I'm going out for a few groceries
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Guten Morgen 😊 Ich gehe ein paar Lebensmittel einkaufen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: We'll look at work once you're back
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Wir schauen uns die Arbeit an, wenn du zurück bist

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm taking your umbrella just in case
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich nehme deinen Regenschirm für den Fall der Fälle

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: They said it might rain later today
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sie haben gesagt, es könnte später heute regnen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you need anything while I'm there?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Brauchst du etwas, während ich dort bin?
Ich habe alles, was ich brauche
Ich werde nicht lange weg sein

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Is that okay with the work though?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ist das mit der Arbeit in Ordnung?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Can I afford to go out for a bit?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Kann ich es mir leisten, kurz rauszugehen?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And maybe because my {{name:tutor}} is very motivating 😌
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und vielleicht, weil mein {{name:tutor}} sehr motivierend ist 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: As long as you pass your exams, you can do whatever you want with your professor
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Solange du deine Prüfungen bestehst, kannst du mit deinem Professor machen, was du willst
Ich schreibe dir nach dem Unterricht

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: When i'm comming home to kill you 😊
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich nach Hause komme, um dich zu killen 😊

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Awake, dressed, and not already complaining?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wach, angezogen und noch nicht am Jammern?
Ich hasse es, dass du recht hast

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I wanted to make you smile before class
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich wollte dich vor dem Unterricht zum Lächeln bringen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Normally I finish at noon today
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Normalerweise bin ich heute Mittag fertig.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I can come see you later 😌
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Damit ich dich später besuchen kann 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you might like that
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, das könnte dir gefallen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then you'll survive one more morning without me
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann wirst du einen weiteren Morgen ohne mich überleben.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Come save me this afternoon then
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Komm mich dann heute Nachmittag retten.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can't just send that first thing in the morning
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du kannst das nicht einfach gleich am Morgen senden.
Weil ich jetzt schon abgelenkt bin.
Klingt nach einem Problem für dich 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Guten Morgen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I know you two are plotting something
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich weiß, dass ihr zwei euch etwas ausdenkt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Er ist dein bester Freund und ihr redet die ganze Zeit.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm just being a supportive coaching assistant
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich bin nur eine unterstützende Coaching-Assistentin.
Egal, viel Glück heute!

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Try not to be too tired when you get home
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Versuch, nicht zu müde nach Hause zu kommen.
Du kleiner gruseliger Bastard.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Warum bist du so früh nett?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I just wanted to wish you good luck at work

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You've never cared about my day at work before
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du hast dich noch nie für meinen Arbeitstag interessiert.
Menschen können sich ändern.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I hope work isn't too exhausting today
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich hoffe, die Arbeit ist heute nicht zu anstrengend.
Was hast du mit {{name:aiden}} geplant?
Guten Morgen
Gar nichts.
Ich glaub dir nicht.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You really need to learn how to accept kindness
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du musst echt lernen, Freundlichkeit anzunehmen.
Egal, viel Glück heute!
