story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why are you being nice so soon?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Warum bist du so früh nett?
Was hast du gemacht?
Nichts

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I just wanted to wish you good luck at work
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich wollte dir nur viel Glück bei der Arbeit wünschen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that's not suspicious at all
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ja, das ist ja gar nicht verdächtig

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I hope you have a nice day
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich hoffe, du hast einen schönen Tag

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And that work isn't too exhausting
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Und dass die Arbeit nicht zu anstrengend ist

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: What did you arrange with Chris?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Was hast du mit Chris ausgemacht?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just hope it doesn't rain
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hoffe nur, dass es nicht regnet

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You have a meeting with him in one hour at the park
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Du hast in einer Stunde ein Treffen mit ihm im Park

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'll go get changed and I'll message you when I get there
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich ziehe mich um und schreibe dir, wenn ich dort bin

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It's a little cloudy but the temperature is really nice
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es ist ein bisschen bewölkt, aber die Temperatur ist wirklich angenehm

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I have a client for you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe einen Klienten für dich
Und ich bin in guter Gesellschaft

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That doesn't stop you from enjoying yourself
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das hält dich nicht davon ab, Spaß zu haben.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe I am enjoying it a little
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Vielleicht genieße ich es ein bisschen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Detected elevated comfort level during client interaction
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Erhöhtes Komfortniveau während der Interaktion mit dem Klienten festgestellt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Proximity and emotional engagement increased beyond previous meeting baseline
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Nähe und emotionale Bindung über das vorherige Treffen hinaus gestiegen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted her to enjoy herself, but seeing their closeness become real takes some getting used to.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich wollte, dass sie Spaß hat, aber dass aus ihrer Nähe jetzt etwas Wirkliches wird, ist noch ungewohnt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Do you have some time today?
HAK detected reduced personal distance, increased comfort, and elevated emotional responsiveness during a second outing between {{name:evelyn}} and a returning client
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat eine verringerte persönliche Distanz, erhöhten Komfort und gesteigerte emotionale Reaktivität während eines zweiten Treffens zwischen {{name:evelyn}} und einem zurückkehrenden Klienten festgestellt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Yes, I just finished the dishes
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ja, ich habe gerade das Geschirr abgewaschen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He would like to go for a walk in the park with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er würde gerne mit dir im Park spazieren gehen.
Oh, das würde mir tatsächlich gefallen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It will be nice to walk around a little
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es wird schön sein, ein bisschen herumzulaufen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should be used to it by now
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du solltest mittlerweile daran gewöhnt sein

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still get nervous every time
You'll do fine, just remember to focus on the quiz and not on your {{name:tutor}}'s looks
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du wirst das gut machen, denk nur daran, dich auf das Quiz zu konzentrieren und nicht auf das Aussehen deines {{name:tutor}}.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I can't promise anything when he's looking at me like that 😇
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber ich kann nichts versprechen, wenn er mich so anschaut 😇

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don't let it distract you too much
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lass dich nicht zu sehr ablenken

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to see if his quiz idea works again
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich will sehen, ob seine Quiz-Idee wieder funktioniert

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You mean the thing you've been complaining about for three days?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Meinst du das, worüber du seit drei Tagen jammerst?
Die Uni ist für heute vorbei

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Also, do you think he'll give me another impossible quiz today?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Glaubst du, er gibt mir heute wieder ein unmögliches Quiz?
Kann es kaum erwarten, bestraft zu werden

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That's what happens when you study
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: So ist das, wenn man lernt

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway, I have another tutoring session later
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab später noch eine Nachhilfestunde

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: DMy brain i don't think so

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going home first to change
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gehe zuerst nach Hause, um mich umzuziehen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to show up still dressed for class
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich möchte nicht noch im Klassenoutfit auftauchen.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into German.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd be distracted all over again
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du würdest dich wieder ablenken lassen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So how long until I see you?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie lange dauert es, bis ich dich sehe?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me get home, change, and breathe for five minutes 😭
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lass mich nach Hause gehen, mich umziehen und fünf Minuten durchatmen 😭

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I want proof when you're ready
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber ich will Beweise, wenn du bereit bist.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Changed, ready, and on my way 😌
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Geändert, bereit und auf dem Weg 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you're the one I'm coming to see ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil du derjenige bist, den ich sehen komme ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning felt longer than it should have
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dieser Morgen fühlte sich länger an, als er sollte.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now I can actually come see you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und jetzt kann ich dich tatsächlich besuchen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Best part of my day already
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Der beste Teil meines Tages ist schon vorbei.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Why the fuck is {{name:aiden}} waiting for me at home?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Warum zur Hölle wartet {{name:aiden}} auf mich zu Hause?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck with the run 🙂
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Glück beim Laufen 🙂

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 45 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Yo, it's {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hey, hier ist {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I still have {{name:mason}}'s phone
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich hab immer noch {{name:mason}}s Handy.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: The idiot kept trying to text while running
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Der Idiot hat versucht, beim Laufen zu texten.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A real child
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein echtes Kind.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: How is {{mason:he}} handling the run?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wie kommt {{mason:he|er|sie}} mit dem Laufen zurecht?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Better than I expected honestly
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Besser als ich erwartet habe, ehrlich gesagt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:His}} lower body is really solid for sports
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:His|Sein|Ihr}} Unterkörper ist fürs Sporttraining wirklich kräftig.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: He says he's about to make me run twelve kilometers through the forest
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Er sagt, er will mich zwölf Kilometer durch den Wald rennen lassen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:His}} legs and endurance are carrying {{mason:him}} because {{mason:his}} upper body still sucks
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:His|Seine|Ihre}} Beine und die Ausdauer helfen {{mason:him|ihm|ihr}} durchzuhalten, weil {{mason:his|sein|ihr}} Oberkörper noch immer nichts taugt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That's exactly what I thought
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Genau das hab ich gedacht.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck dealing with {{name:mason}}
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Glück mit {{name:mason}}

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Bro, you're the one who needs luck 😂
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Alter, du bist derjenige, der Glück braucht 😂.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:He}} keeps growling your name between breaths
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:He|Er|Sie}} knurrt zwischen den Atemzügen ständig deinen Namen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I've already heard at least ten different ways {{mason:he}} wants to punish you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe schon mindestens zehn verschiedene Arten gehört, wie {{mason:he|er|sie}} dich bestrafen will.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hopefully the fresh air will clear {{mason:his}} head
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hoffentlich macht die frische Luft {{mason:his|seinen|ihren}} Kopf wieder klar.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Really?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wirklich?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That's strange
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Das ist seltsam.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I have no idea why he'd do that
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich hab keine Ahnung, warum er das tun würde.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Bullshit
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Quatsch.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You two definitely planned this together
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ihr zwei habt das definitiv zusammen geplant.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Maybe {{name:aiden}} just wants to spend some quality time with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vielleicht will {{name:aiden}} einfach ein bisschen Zeit mit dir verbringen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy your little forest date
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Genieß dein kleines Wald-Date.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You better have your bags packed by the time I get back
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du solltest deine Sachen gepackt haben, wenn ich zurückkomme.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Why the fuck is Chris waiting for me at home?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck with the run 🙂

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 45 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hey, it's Chris again
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hey, hier ist Chris wieder.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I still have {{name:mason}}'s phone because {{mason:he}} kept trying to use it while running
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe immer noch das Handy von {{name:mason}}, weil {{mason:he|er|sie}} beim Laufen ständig versucht hat, es zu benutzen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A real child
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein echtes Kind.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: How is {{mason:he}} handling the run?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wie kommt {{mason:he|er|sie}} mit dem Laufen zurecht?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Honestly, I'm a little impressed
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, ich bin ein bisschen beeindruckt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:His}} lower body is really reliable for sports
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Auf {{mason:His|seinen|ihren}} Unterkörper ist beim Sport wirklich Verlass.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:His}} endurance and legs are much better than {{mason:his}} upper body
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:His|Seine|Ihre}} Ausdauer und Beine sind viel besser als {{mason:his|sein|ihr}} Oberkörper.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: He says he's about to make me run twelve kilometers through the forest
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Er sagt, er will mich zwölf Kilometer durch den Wald rennen lassen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I noticed the same thing
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Das hab ich auch bemerkt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck with the rest of the session
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Glück mit dem Rest der Einheit.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You might need the luck more than me
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du wirst das Glück eher brauchen als ich.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:He}} hasn't stopped growling your name
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:He|Er|Sie}} hat nicht aufgehört, deinen Namen zu knurren.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{mason:He}}'s also listing every punishment {{mason:he}} wants to inflict on you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{mason:He|Er|Sie}} zählt außerdem jede Strafe auf, die {{mason:he|er|sie}} dir verpassen will.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hopefully the fresh air will clear {{mason:his}} head
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hoffentlich macht die frische Luft {{mason:his|seinen|ihren}} Kopf wieder klar.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Really?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Wirklich?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That's strange
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Das ist seltsam.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I have no idea why he would do that
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich hab keine Ahnung, warum er das tun würde.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're such a terrible liar
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du bist so ein schrecklicher Lügner.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You sounded suspicious all morning
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast den ganzen Morgen verdächtig geklungen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Maybe Chris just thinks you need some fresh air
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Vielleicht denkt Chris einfach, dass du frische Luft brauchst.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: It might help with your attitude
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Das könnte deinem Verhalten helfen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You better have your bags packed by the time I get back
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du solltest deine Sachen gepackt haben, wenn ich zurückkomme.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Hey, ich bin's wieder
Ist es

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: She's starting to trust the routine
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sie fängt an, der Routine zu vertrauen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: And she seems more motivated when she has a clear goal
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Und sie scheint motivierter zu sein, wenn sie ein klares Ziel hat

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: Be careful if you're the goal
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sei vorsichtig, wenn du das Ziel bist
Werde ich 😂

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: I prepared a few short quizzes again
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Ich habe wieder ein paar kurze Quiz vorbereitet

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: The reward system still seems to help her concentrate
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Das Belohnungssystem scheint ihr immer noch zu helfen, sich zu konzentrieren
Wette, das tut es

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: This was from the break before the last quiz
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Das war von der Pause vor dem letzten Quiz

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: Today's session is going well too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Die heutige Sitzung läuft auch gut

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: She looked tired, but she still wanted to continue
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sie sah müde aus, wollte aber trotzdem weitermachen
Gut
Sie ist härter, als sie tut.
Da bin ich ganz deiner Meinung.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: I'll send you a final note after the session if anything important changes
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Ich schicke dir nach der Sitzung eine letzte Nachricht, falls sich etwas Wichtiges ändert.
Aufmerksamkeitsmuster aktualisiert.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: {{name:hailey}} shows increased motivation during Ethan's sessions
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: {{name:hailey}} zeigt während Ethans Sitzungen mehr Motivation.
Belohnungsbasiertes Fokusloop scheint effektiv zu sein.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: Boundary drift risk detected: academic routine may become emotionally reinforced
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Risiko für Grenzverschiebung erkannt: akademische Routine könnte emotional verstärkt werden.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: Is she focused on the lessons, or on impressing him?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Konzentriert sie sich auf den Unterricht oder darauf, ihn zu beeindrucken?
HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: HAK archived a tutoring-session update showing {{name:hailey}} responding strongly to Ethan's reward structure
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: HAK hat ein Update zur Nachhilfestunde archiviert, das zeigt, dass {{name:hailey}} stark auf Ethans Belohnungsstruktur reagiert.
NACHMITTAG
Fokussierte Sitzung
{{name:hailey}} ist konzentrierter als sonst

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: She still gets distracted sometimes, but she catches herself faster now
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sie lässt sich zwar manchmal ablenken, aber sie fängt sich jetzt schneller
Das ist Fortschritt
Definitiv

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: She asked more questions today too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sie hat heute auch mehr Fragen gestellt
Nicht nur zu den Antworten

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.source: About how to understand the method behind them
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_01_TUTOR_ATTENTION.translation: Sondern auch, wie man die Methode dahinter versteht
Das klingt ernst für sie

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm back home, but I got completely soaked by the rain 😅
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin wieder zu Hause, aber ich bin total vom Regen durchnässt 😅

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I will 😊
Give me a little bit
30 MINUTES LATER
Can I talk to you about something?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Kann ich mit dir über etwas reden?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Of course
What's on your mind?
First...
What do you think about this job?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Was hältst du von diesem Job?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Honestly?
As long as you're comfortable with it, I'm really happy to do this work with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Solange du dich dabei wohlfühlst, freue ich mich wirklich, diese Arbeit mit dir zu machen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How did it go?
That is really kind of you ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das ist wirklich nett von dir ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you
But don't you find it strange?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber findest du es nicht seltsam?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Sending me to spend time with strangers and knowing everything that happens?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mich zu fremden Leuten zu schicken und alles zu wissen, was passiert?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No
Actually, I prefer it this way
I can keep an eye on everything and make sure you're safe
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich kann alles im Auge behalten und sicherstellen, dass du sicher bist.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly, I feel like it brings us closer too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Und ehrlich gesagt, ich habe das Gefühl, dass es uns auch näher bringt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm really happy to share all of this with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich freue mich wirklich, all das mit dir zu teilen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That touches me more than you think...
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das berührt mich mehr, als du denkst...

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It was okay
Which is why I want to be honest with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Deshalb möchte ich ehrlich zu dir sein

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He kissed me at the end of the date
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Er hat mich am Ende des Dates geküsst

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I didn't really know what to do
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich wusste wirklich nicht, was ich tun sollte

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then it started raining and I just ran home
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Dann hat es angefangen zu regnen und ich bin einfach nach Hause gerannt

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That's why I was soaked when I got back
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Deshalb war ich durchnässt, als ich zurückkam

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Are you okay?
Did he force you?
No, not at all
I'm okay
Then how do you feel about it?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wie fühlst du dich dann dabei?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But it started raining, so I'm completely drenched
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber es hat angefangen zu regnen, also bin ich komplett durchnässt

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Did you hate it?
Do you want me to warn him or put a note on his account?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Soll ich ihn warnen oder einen Vermerk auf seinem Konto machen?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No...
I actually liked it
That's what makes me feel guilty
Because of you
You don't have to feel guilty
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du musst dich nicht schuldig fühlen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You're an adult
You deserve to have your own life as a woman too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Du hast es verdient, auch dein eigenes Leben als Frau zu leben

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Are you really sure it's okay? 🥺
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Bist du dir wirklich sicher, dass es okay ist? 🥺

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
I'm sure
I promise
That makes me feel relieved 😌
It doesn't mean it will happen every time
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das bedeutet nicht, dass es jedes Mal so sein wird

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But I already feel less guilty about it
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aber ich fühle mich schon weniger schuldig deswegen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You're really sure it doesn't bother you?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Bist du dir wirklich sicher, dass es dich nicht stört?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No
Actually, I want you to tell me whenever something like that happens
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Eigentlich möchte ich, dass du mir sagst, wann immer so etwas passiert

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I need to know because I have to charge the client extra when things go further than planned haha
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich muss es wissen, weil ich dem Kunden extra berechnen muss, wenn die Dinge weitergehen als geplant haha

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: So you really want me to tell you everything?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Also willst du wirklich, dass ich dir alles erzähle?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
It's better that way
Alright ❤️
Then I'll tell you everything that happens from now on
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Dann werde ich dir alles erzählen, was von jetzt an passiert

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 14
DAY 14
Sorry the rain ended things early. I still liked the walk more than I expected.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tut mir leid, dass der Regen die Dinge frühzeitig beendet hat. Ich mochte den Spaziergang trotzdem mehr, als ich erwartet hatte.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Additional Noah date content unlocked.
Go take a shower quickly
I don't want you catching a cold
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich will nicht, dass du dir eine Erkältung holst.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What reward did you ask for this time?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Welche Belohnung hast du dir diesmal gewünscht?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I'm going to suffer through quizzes, I deserve benefits
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wenn ich schon durch Quizzes leiden muss, verdiene ich auch Vorteile.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So how did it go with Ethan?
That's not how studying usually works

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dann war das Lernen schlecht gestaltet.
Und ich bestehe trotzdem meine Quizzes.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm putting a movie on downstairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich mache unten einen Film an.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Hurry up and come watch it with me
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Komm schnell und schau ihn mit mir.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: At the speed you move, it'll be over before you get down here 😭
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Bei dem Tempo, in dem du dich bewegst, ist der Film vorbei, bevor du hier bist 😭
Ich halte dir einen Platz frei.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to know if you're actually studying
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich will wissen, ob du wirklich lernst.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Annoyingly enough, it's working very well

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Schaffst du es, dich zu konzentrieren?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It made everything feel more real
It felt really good having you here
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es fühlte sich wirklich gut an, dich hier zu haben.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I don't want today to be a one-time thing
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich nicht möchte, dass heute eine einmalige Sache ist.
Bist du gut nach Hause gekommen?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hoffe wirklich, es hat dir auch gefallen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talking about your cuckold fantasy was... weird at first
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darüber zu sprechen, dass du eine Cuckold-Fantasie hast, war... am Anfang seltsam.
Ich habe es noch mehr geliebt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I hope you liked all the touching too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich hoffe, dir hat das ganze Berühren auch gefallen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially when you talked so close to my ear
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Besonders als du so nah an meinem Ohr gesprochen hast.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hat für mich wirklich, wirklich gut funktioniert ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das freut mich sehr zu hören.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich mehr davon mit dir will

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt muss ich mich ein bisschen beruhigen, bevor ich ins Bett gehe 😭

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich vermisse dich schon ein bisschen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und dich leichter bewegen zu sehen, hat mich so glücklich gemacht.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Are you still alive?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Lebst du noch?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me you wanted to use her bathroom
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:evelyn}} hat mir gesagt, dass du ihr Badezimmer benutzen wolltest.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Even though you have one upstairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Obwohl du eines oben hast.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Are your legs having a little trouble?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Haben deine Beine ein bisschen Schwierigkeiten?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I just didn't feel like climbing the stairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich hatte einfach keine Lust, die Treppe hochzuklettern.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Of course
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Natürlich

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You survived twelve kilometers but the stairs defeated you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du hast zwölf Kilometer überlebt, aber die Treppe hat dich besiegt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: At least my legs hurt because I actually used them
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mindestens tun meine Beine weh, weil ich sie tatsächlich benutzt habe.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Keep talking and tomorrow I'll find out how many kilometers it takes to make you crawl
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Red weiter, und morgen finde ich heraus, wie viele Kilometer es braucht, um dich kriechen zu lassen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You wouldn't dare
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das würdest du dich nicht trauen

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Try me
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Versuch's doch

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusually intense physical activity detected
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ungewöhnlich intensive körperliche Aktivität erkannt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Elevated heart rate and sustained physical strain recorded
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Erhöhter Herzschlag und anhaltende körperliche Belastung aufgezeichnet.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason has experienced an intense situation
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason hat eine intensive Situation erlebt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK calls it an intense situation, but I still want to hear how {{name:mason}} felt about it.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK nennt es eine intensive Situation, aber ich möchte trotzdem hören, wie sich {{name:mason}} dabei gefühlt hat.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK//ACTIVITY DETECTED
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK//AKTIVITÄT ERKANNT

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 14
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: TAG 14

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Intense forest training
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Intensives Waldtraining.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason experienced prolonged physical strain during {{mason:his}} forest training session
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason war während {{mason:his|seiner|ihrer}} Trainingseinheit im Wald einer längeren körperlichen Belastung ausgesetzt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Intense situation
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Intensive Situation.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 30 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 30 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unfortunately for you, I'm still alive
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Leider für dich, ich lebe noch.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Your punishment wasn't even that bad
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Deine Strafe war nicht mal so schlimm.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I got to see parts of the forest I'd never seen before
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich hab Teile des Waldes gesehen, die ich noch nie zuvor gesehen habe.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're really terrible at punishing people
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du bist echt schlecht darin, Leute zu bestrafen.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Oh really?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Oh wirklich?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then why aren't you coming upstairs?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Warum kommst du dann nicht nach oben?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Repeated cardiac anomalies detected during today's private interactions
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Wiederholte Herzanomalien während der heutigen privaten Interaktionen festgestellt.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Relevant moments have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Relevante Momente wurden in HAK Evidence archiviert.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Those little moments leave me curious, and a little less sure that this will feel simple.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: Diese kleinen Momente machen mich neugierig, aber auch weniger sicher, dass das alles einfach bleiben wird.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Because now I have no time to do anything else
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Weil ich jetzt keine Zeit habe, um etwas anderes zu tun.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That is my entire personality now
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Das ist jetzt meine gesamte Persönlichkeit.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And I hope you are ready too
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Und ich hoffe, du bist auch bereit.
Um mit mir den Schlaf zu verlieren

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Do not act like you have better plans
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Tu nicht so, als hättest du bessere Pläne.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I have good news and bad news
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich habe gute Nachrichten und schlechte Nachrichten.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I might, i have to train for a marathon
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich könnte, ich muss für einen Marathon trainieren.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope it itches under your cast
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ich hoffe, es juckt unter deinem Gips.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Patch notes wait for no one
No pain, no weird feeling, everything felt clean
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Kein Schmerz, kein seltsames Gefühl, alles fühlte sich sauber an.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yeah, I missed it more than I thought
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ja, ich habe es mehr vermisst, als ich dachte.
Unser Spiel hat ein Update erhalten.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You should open your window more often
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Du solltest dein Fenster öfter öffnen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It's not good staying locked in your room all day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Es ist nicht gut, den ganzen Tag in deinem Zimmer eingesperrt zu sein.
Auch wenn es für die Arbeit ist.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I should probably air the room out more
I feel like you've been moving around a lot lately
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass du in letzter Zeit viel herumläufst.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm worried you're going to hurt yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich mache mir Sorgen, dass du dich verletzt.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Honestly, it feels better every day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, es wird jeden Tag besser.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: To see if the cast can come off soon
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Um zu sehen, ob der Gips bald ab kann.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And to make you do some movement tests
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Und um dir einige Bewegungstests zu machen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm actually looking forward to it
Anyway, I should get ready for work
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Wie auch immer, ich sollte mich für die Arbeit fertig machen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll message you when I get some free time
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich etwas freie Zeit habe.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And don't forget to drink water
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Und vergiss nicht, Wasser zu trinken.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Do you have clothes that need washing?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Hast du Klamotten, die gewaschen werden müssen?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ja, ich habe ein paar Sachen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll come upstairs and grab them
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ich komme nach oben und hole sie.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I fully intend to abuse it 💅
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und ich habe vor, ihn voll auszunutzen 💅

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I do not return, tell the world I fought bravely
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wenn ich nicht zurückkomme, sag der Welt, dass ich tapfer gekämpft habe

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And that the cafeteria muffins were terrible
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und dass die Muffins in der Cafeteria schrecklich waren

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I wrote it while emotionally unstable
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich habe sie geschrieben, während ich emotional instabil war

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: See you after the academic war 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wir sehen uns nach dem akademischen Krieg 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Today is the big test day
We are about to find out if all this revision actually worked
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wir werden gleich herausfinden, ob das ganze Lernen wirklich etwas gebracht hat.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You know more than you think
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Du weißt mehr, als du denkst

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because if my brain betrays me now I am suing it, and you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Denn wenn mein Gehirn mich jetzt verrät, verklage ich es und dich

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Just focus on tomorrow's shopping reward
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Konzentrier dich einfach auf die Belohnung fürs Einkaufen morgen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: But I had a hard time falling asleep first because I kept thinking about you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aber ich hatte zuerst Schwierigkeiten, einzuschlafen, weil ich ständig an dich denken musste.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You really suffer so much because of me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du leidest wirklich so sehr wegen mir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Can I get a picture of the girl ruining my sleep before she leaves for uni?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Kann ich ein Bild von dem Mädchen bekommen, das meinen Schlaf ruiniert, bevor sie zur Uni geht?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now behave while I'm in class 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Verhalte dich jetzt, während ich im Unterricht bin 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll talk to you at noon
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich spreche um Mittag mit dir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: But maybe a little related to what happened at your place 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aber vielleicht ein bisschen verwandt mit dem, was bei dir passiert ist 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You've been waiting all morning to see this body in action
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Du hast den ganzen Morgen darauf gewartet, diesen Körper in Aktion zu sehen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I need to study proper technique
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Ich muss die richtige Technik lernen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: That's what we're calling it now
So that's why you texted me
Are you ready for your punishment?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Bist du bereit für deine Strafe?
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into German.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Hey, I'm starting to get hungry
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hey, ich fange an, hungrig zu werden.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And you do not need to rush
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Und du musst dich nicht beeilen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was just worried because you did not answer
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich war nur besorgt, weil du nicht geantwortet hast.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: That is very sweet of you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist sehr süß von dir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I will be upstairs in ten minutes with your lunch
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich werde in zehn Minuten mit deinem Mittagessen oben sein

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me something to eat if it does not bother you?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Könntest du mir etwas zu essen mitbringen, wenn es dir nichts ausmacht?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was worried a second ago. Now I'm struggling to find my words.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Eben habe ich mir noch Sorgen gemacht. Jetzt fehlen mir die Worte.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I just got out of the shower
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin gerade aus der Dusche gekommen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll dry myself quickly and bring you something to eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ich trockne mich schnell ab und bringe dir etwas zu essen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist schon mal ein Fortschritt

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin stolz auf deine nicht-leere Seite

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is the face of a soldier between battles
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Das ist das Gesicht eines Soldaten zwischen den Kämpfen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wow, ich fange an zu glauben, dass du wirklich im Krieg bist

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Aber ich bin süß genug, um zu überleben

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Go win the next round then
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Geh und gewinn die nächste Runde!

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am going back to the front
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich gehe zurück an die Front.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wenn ich falle, rächte mich mit dem Geld für das Einkaufen morgen 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Und dann habe ich noch mehr Prüfungen 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: How did the first ones go?
Maybe my brain invented a new academic language
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Vielleicht hat mein Gehirn eine neue akademische Sprache erfunden

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But I did not leave the page blank at least 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Aber ich habe die Seite wenigstens nicht leer gelassen 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: You say that like you don't enjoy watching the chaos
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Du sagst das, als würdest du es nicht genießen, das Chaos zu beobachten.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Ich hoffe nur, dass ich heute Nacht nicht zu spät fertig werde.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: But I really want to talk whith you tonight ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Aber ich möchte wirklich heute Abend mit dir sprechen ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Dann, sobald du zu Hause bist, werden wir reden.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Das gibt mir etwas Schönes, worauf ich mich freuen kann.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Okay, ich sollte zurückgehen, bevor die Mittagspause verschwindet.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Viel Glück für den Rest des Tages

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play to much game
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Vergiss nicht, deinen Körper zu bewegen und spiele nicht zu viel.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Just long and a little boring
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Nur lang und ein bisschen langweilig

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Also im Grunde ein klassischer Universitätsmorgen 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Ich esse gerade mit meinen Freunden.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: And {{name:aiden}} apparently found another group of girls to annoy
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Und {{name:aiden}} hat anscheinend eine andere Gruppe von Mädchen gefunden, die er nerven kann

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle it on the game tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Lösen wir das heute Abend im Spiel

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe we should train somewhere else
If you can with your cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn du mit deinem Gips kannst

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've already seen people swimming with a cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab schon Leute mit Gips schwimmen sehen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: She's probably better than both of us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Die ist wahrscheinlich besser als wir beide zusammen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You were actually pretty impressive for once
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Du warst tatsächlich mal ziemlich beeindruckend

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to sound too surprised
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Versuch nicht zu überrascht zu klingen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Don't let it get to your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Lass es dir nicht zu Kopf steigen
Ich bin heute früh mit der Arbeit fertig

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you've got a problem with me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn du ein Problem mit mir hast

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I'll come downstairs and help you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Dann komme ich nach unten und helfe dir

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can't let you do everything alone
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich kann dich nicht alles alleine machen lassen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Would you like to continue the series?
You don't even need to ask
I'm waiting for you on the couch 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich warte auf dich auf der Couch 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I just finished brushing my teeth
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich habe gerade meine Zähne geputzt

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Relevante emotionale Erfassung in HAK Beweis archiviert

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I'm not imagining how close we've become.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich bilde mir also nicht ein, wie nahe wir uns gekommen sind.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I actually enjoy what I'm doing
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ich genieße tatsächlich, was ich tue

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you already start making dinner?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hast du schon mit dem Abendessen angefangen?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am really proud of you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin echt stolz auf dich.
Hör auf, nett zu mir zu sein 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Later, after you brought food to {{name:hailey}} in her room
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Später, nachdem du {{name:hailey}} in ihrem Zimmer Essen gebracht hast.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I still cannot believe my private professor brought me food in bed 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich kann immer noch nicht glauben, dass mein Privatprofessor mir Essen ins Bett gebracht hat 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That is not an excuse to stare at me while I eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Das ist keine Ausrede, um mich beim Essen anzustarren.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You took a picture of me 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du hast ein Bild von mir gemacht 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally a paparazzi pervert
The evidence shows a tired innocent girl being harassed in her natural habitat 😔
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Die Beweise zeigen ein müdes, unschuldiges Mädchen, das in ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum belästigt wird 😔

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are lucky I am exhausted
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du hast Glück, dass ich erschöpft bin.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Otherwise I would destroy you verbally right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sonst würde ich dich jetzt verbal zerstören.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Erhöhter Herzschlag während der letzten privaten Interaktion erkannt
Visuelle und emotionale Marker werden abgeglichen...

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Relevante emotionale Aufzeichnung in HAK Evidence archiviert

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I keep looking forward to those moments with her, even when I have no clever line ready.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich freue mich immer wieder auf diese Momente mit ihr, auch wenn mir kein schlauer Spruch einfällt.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Tomorrow I am sleeping for ten years
You survived the whole day though
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du hast den ganzen Tag überlebt.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am taking a shower and collapsing into my bed after this
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich gehe jetzt duschen und falle dann ins Bett.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber zuerst werde ich duschen und etwas essen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And yet you still like me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und trotzdem magst du mich immer noch.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep it to yourself, of course
She knows exactly how to catch me off guard. Even now.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sie weiß genau, wie sie mich überraschen kann. Auch jetzt noch.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wie soll ich jetzt ruhig bleiben?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber vielleicht ist das genau das, was ich wollte 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lass mich jetzt essen, bevor ich dramatisch werde.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber ich erwarte später noch einen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Weil ich jetzt satt, sauber, gemütlich und den Rest des Abends ganz dir gehört 😌
Ich wusste, dass es dir gefallen würde.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann hältst du mir die ganze Nacht Gesellschaft.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich muss mich nur ins Bett legen und mich ein wenig aufwärmen, dann gehöre ich ganz dir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und der Tag verlief tatsächlich besser, als ich gedacht hätte.
Ich bin nicht einmal so müde.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe den ganzen Abend für dich ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist genau das, was ich hören wollte.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The playful rivalry between you and {{name:mason}} keeps escalating, turning every game into another excuse to get closer.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Die spielerische Rivalität zwischen dir und {{name:mason}} eskaliert, und jedes Spiel wird zu einer Ausrede, um näher zu kommen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I knew you were a sore loser
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich wusste, dass du ein schlechter Verlierer bist

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: But jumping on me so I couldn't win?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Aber mich so zu überrumpeln, dass ich nicht gewinnen kann?
Ich hab einfach die Gelegenheit genutzt

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Didn't look like you hated it that much 😉
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Hat nicht so ausgesehen, als hättest du es so sehr gehasst 😉

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Can we pretend that never happened?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Können wir so tun, als wäre das nie passiert?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Go to bed before I smash this cast over your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Geh ins Bett, bevor ich dir diesen Gips über den Kopf ziehe

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to be even stronger tonight 😏
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich werde heute Abend noch stärker sein 😏

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I just got out of the shower
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin gerade aus der Dusche gekommen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If you started without me, you're dead
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Wenn du ohne mich angefangen hast, bist du erledigt

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I wouldn't steal your only chance to win 😂
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ich würde dir deine einzige Chance zu gewinnen nicht stehlen 😂

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Das Geplänkel zwischen dir und {{name:mason}} wird immer persönlicher.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Noch eine Runde fühlt sich wie ein Vorwand an, bei ihr zu bleiben, und den nehme ich gern.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Und erkundet ein wenig weiter zusammen

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: By learning what the other person likes and what feels good to them ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Indem man lernt, was die andere Person mag und was ihr gut tut ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Das ist genau das, was ich auch will.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Us figuring it out together feels right
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Es fühlt sich richtig an, dass wir es gemeinsam herausfinden.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want it to stay like that with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Weil ich will, dass es so bleibt mit dir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now you're making me think too much before sleep
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Jetzt bringst du mich dazu, zu viel nachzudenken, bevor ich schlafen gehe.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Dann sollte ich es vielleicht schlimmer machen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And way too proud of yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Und viel zu stolz auf dich selbst

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You're making it very hard to act normal right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Du machst es mir gerade sehr schwer, normal zu handeln.
Ich lerne heute Abend sehr schnell.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Weil ich viel mehr davon mit dir will.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Du hast keine Ahnung, wie glücklich mich das macht.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Ich bin wirklich froh, dass wir neulich darüber gesprochen haben.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Jetzt muss ich wirklich schlafen, bevor es noch schlimmer wird.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And try not to haunt me with those pictures
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Und versuche, mich nicht mit diesen Bildern zu verfolgen.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Es fühlt sich wirklich gut an, wenn wir so ehrlich zueinander sind.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Ich fühle mich so viel besser, jetzt wo die Dinge zwischen uns klarer sind.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Und ich kann wirklich nicht warten, dass wir uns immer mehr öffnen.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I'm sorry I let you make breakfast again
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Es tut mir leid, dass ich dich wieder frühstücken lassen habe.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm happy to take care of you for once
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich kümmere mich gerne einmal um dich.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I don't even know what to say to that
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich weiß gar nicht, was ich dazu sagen soll.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just come downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Komm einfach nach unten, wenn du bereit bist.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And before you ask, I'm fine
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Und bevor du fragst, mir geht's gut.
Mein Bein tut heute nicht weh.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: So don't worry about me and get some rest
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Mach dir also keine Sorgen um mich und ruh dich aus.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Last night must have been exhausting
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Letzte Nacht muss anstrengend gewesen sein.
Tut mir leid, dass ich dich warten ließ

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: More like he already decided I am not allowed
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eher so, als hätte er schon entschieden, dass ich nicht darf

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make me analyze it before battle
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mach mich nicht verrückt, bevor die Schlacht beginnt

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor voice and your voice are merging in my head
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Die Stimme des Professors und deine Stimme vermischen sich in meinem Kopf

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See you after the first battle 🤍
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wir sehen uns nach der ersten Schlacht 🤍

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is definitely a soldier face
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das ist auf jeden Fall ein Soldaten-Gesicht

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor made me review until my soul left my body yesterday
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Der Professor hat mich gestern bis zur völligen Erschöpfung lernen lassen

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So if I fail, I am suing him
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wenn ich durchfalle, verklage ich ihn

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still have a full day ahead
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe noch einen vollen Tag vor mir.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just want this year to be over already 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte einfach, dass dieses Jahr endlich vorbei ist 😌

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'll only have the job to focus on
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich nur noch den Job, auf den ich mich konzentrieren kann.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One thing at a time sounds nice right now
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eins nach dem anderen klingt gerade schön.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you later if I can
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir später, wenn ich kann.
Ich habe nicht so gut geschlafen.
Mein Gehirn wollte nicht aufhören zu reden.
Denkst du wieder an die Arbeit?

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How are things with those idiots at the gym?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Wie läuft's mit diesen Idioten im Fitnessstudio?
Ich kann auf mich selbst aufpassen

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should follow your own advice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Du solltest deinen eigenen Rat befolgen

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich hatte auch eine gute Zeit

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm just getting used to work and the gym
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich gewöhne mich gerade an Arbeit und Fitnessstudio

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin bereit für unseren Spaziergang 😊
Ich ziehe mich gleich fertig an.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Did you put on something light for the heat?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hast du etwas Leichtes für die Hitze angezogen?

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wore my favorite summer outfit
And I feel perfectly comfortable in it
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Und ich fühle mich darin perfekt wohl.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Zwischen den Kämpfen 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He fixed my shirt because it was folded weird
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hat mein Shirt gerichtet, weil es komisch gefaltet war

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Before you say anything, I did not notice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Bevor du irgendwas sagst, ich habe es nicht bemerkt
Das ist ziemlich persönlich
Es waren zwei Sekunden
Und ich hatte Prüfungsbrain

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My soul left my body three hours ago 😭
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Meine Seele hat meinen Körper vor drei Stunden verlassen 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway I still have one more test later
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Jedenfalls habe ich später noch einen Test

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If I survive this week I deserve financial compensation 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn ich diese Woche überlebe, habe ich finanzielle Entschädigung verdient 😌
Du meinst wieder shoppen
Genau 💅
Ich habe Dinge geschrieben

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going back to the front
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich gehe zurück an die Front.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn ich falle, rächte mich mit dem Geld für das Einkaufen morgen 😌
47 MINUTEN SPÄTER
Zusätzliche visuelle Aufzeichnung archiviert

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Detected elevated comfort level during private interaction
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Erhöhtes Komfortniveau während privater Interaktion festgestellt

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavioral tension exceeds expected teacher-student revision baseline
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das Verhalten übersteigt die erwartete Lehrer-Schüler-Überarbeitungsbasis.
Das Selbstvertrauen ist gestiegen.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: She's getting comfortable around him. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sie fühlt sich bei ihm zunehmend wohl. Ich weiß nicht recht, was ich davon halten soll.
HAK//BEWEIS

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK detected prolonged eye contact, reduced personal distance, and elevated emotional responsiveness during an academic interaction between {{name:hailey}} and her professor
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat verlängerten Blickkontakt, verringerte persönliche Distanz und erhöhte emotionale Reaktivität während einer akademischen Interaktion zwischen {{name:hailey}} und ihrer Professorin festgestellt.
Unerwartete Vertrautheit

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Some of them may even be correct
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Einige davon könnten sogar richtig sein
Das ist gut!

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor caught me outside the room
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Der Professor hat mich draußen vor dem Raum erwischt
Er hat gefragt, wie es lief

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I said I did not cry on the paper

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_00_TUTOR_DIRECT_TA.source: As long as the studying stays the priority
