story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Use it if you come home late
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Benutze es, wenn du spät nach Hause kommst

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I put oil on my windowsill
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich habe Öl auf mein Fensterbrett gemacht

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So don't even think about climbing through the window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Denk also gar nicht daran, durch das Fenster zu klettern

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to break my neck before the gym idiots ever get the chance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du wirst mir noch das Genick brechen, bevor die Gym-Idioten die Chance dazu haben

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then use the door like a normal person
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Dann benutze die Tür wie ein normaler Mensch

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hey, wie fühlst du dich heute Morgen?😊
Mir geht's gut

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: We can do one last client today if you want
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Wir können heute noch einen letzten Kunden machen, wenn du willst

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And after that, we take the weekend to rest together
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Und danach nehmen wir uns das Wochenende, um zusammen zu entspannen
Das klingt gut für mich
Danke, dass du alles managst
Es ist Teamarbeit
Du hast recht 😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then keep me updated when you find the client
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Dann halte mich auf dem Laufenden, wenn du den Kunden findest

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And how things go with the doctor
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Und wie es mit dem Arzt läuft
Werde ich
Hast du gut geschlafen?
Ich habe es gemacht, und du?
Ich habe auch ganz gut geschlafen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have your doctor's appointment today, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Du hast heute deinen Arzttermin, oder?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: To see if they can remove the cast
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Um zu sehen, ob sie den Gips abnehmen können
Ja, ich habe nicht vergessen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want me to stay with you today?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Willst du, dass ich heute bei dir bleibe?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I can cancel everything if you need me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ich kann alles absagen, wenn du mich brauchst
Nein, ist schon okay

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still have a session with Ethan later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du hast später noch eine Sitzung mit Ethan
Dann ist das kein Lernen mehr

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It is if I decide it is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Doch, wenn ich das so entscheide

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still need to stay serious until the exam is done
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du musst bis zur Prüfung ernst bleiben
Das ist schon mal ein Fortschritt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I revised so much these last few days
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe in den letzten Tagen so viel gelernt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I think it's going to be okay
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Also denke ich, es wird okay.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just can't wait for it to be over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, dass es vorbei ist.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And the pictures I sent you 😳
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und die Bilder, die ich dir geschickt habe 😳

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That didn't help me sleep either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das hat mir auch nicht beim Schlafen geholfen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least I'm not the only one suffering
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Zumindest bin ich nicht der Einzige, der leidet.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm really happy with how things are evolving between us
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin wirklich glücklich, wie sich die Dinge zwischen uns entwickeln.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like we're getting closer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass wir näher kommen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And also exploring something new at the same time
I want to learn more about it
About how far we can go with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie weit wir damit gehen können

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can take it step by step
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wir können es Schritt für Schritt angehen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I keep thinking about something…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich denke ständig an etwas…

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What the next step even is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was der nächste Schritt überhaupt ist

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Like… where this goes from here
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie... wo es von hier aus hingeht

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will think about it today
I'm really happy about how much you are into it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich freue mich wirklich, wie sehr du darin aufgeht.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just to help you wake up properly 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur um dir zu helfen, richtig wach zu werden 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I really have to get ready
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Jetzt muss ich mich wirklich fertig machen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day at university
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hab einen schönen Tag an der Universität.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play too many games
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vergiss nicht, deinen Körper zu bewegen und spiele nicht zu viele Spiele.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I didn't fall asleep right away
I had a lot on my mind

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe unser Gespräch immer wieder durchgespielt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Do I have a great ass?
Why the fuck are you asking me that?
He said I have a really great ass
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich habe einen wirklich tollen Hintern.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that definitely sounds like something a fitness coach would say 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ja, das klingt definitiv nach etwas, was ein Fitnesscoach sagen würde 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I don't know how I'm supposed to take that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich weiß nicht, wie ich das auffassen soll.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It's probably the only part of your body that deserves a compliment
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Es ist wahrscheinlich der einzige Teil deines Körpers, der ein Kompliment verdient.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Is this another fake act of kindness?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ist das wieder ein falscher Akt der Freundlichkeit?
Aber ich komme früh nach Hause.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why did you answer like that?
What did you plan with {{name:aiden}} this time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Was hast du diesmal mit {{name:aiden}} geplant?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: What horrible thing did you plan this time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Was hast du diesmal Schreckliches geplant?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Things seemed a little awkward between you and {{name:aiden}} when I came back after helping {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Es schien ein bisschen awkward zwischen dir und {{name:aiden}}, als ich zurückkam, nachdem ich {{name:evelyn}} geholfen habe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Do I have a great ass?
Why the fuck are you asking me that?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Chris hat das letzte Nacht gesagt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: He said I have a really great ass
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich habe einen wirklich tollen Hintern.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that definitely sounds like something a fitness coach would say 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ja, das klingt definitiv nach etwas, was ein Fitnesscoach sagen würde 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I don't know how I'm supposed to take that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ich weiß nicht, wie ich das auffassen soll.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It's probably the only part of your body that deserves a compliment
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Es ist wahrscheinlich der einzige Teil deines Körpers, der ein Kompliment verdient.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Is this another fake act of kindness?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ist das wieder ein falscher Akt der Freundlichkeit?
Aber ich komme früh nach Hause.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why did you answer like that?
What horrible thing did you plan this time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Was hast du diesmal Schreckliches geplant?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Things seemed a little awkward between you and Chris when I came back after helping {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Es schien ein bisschen awkward zwischen dir und Chris, als ich zurückkam, nachdem ich {{name:evelyn}} geholfen habe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Since she’s doing so well, I was thinking of giving her some extra time for the next session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Da sie so gut abschneidet, dachte ich daran, ihr für die nächste Sitzung etwas extra Zeit zu geben

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: What do you mean by extra time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Was meinst du mit extra Zeit?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I was thinking of letting her have a break during the session if she needs it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Ich dachte daran, ihr während der Sitzung eine Pause zu gönnen, wenn sie es braucht

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: If it helps her stay focused, then it's a good idea
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Wenn es ihr hilft, konzentriert zu bleiben, ist das eine gute Idee

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Just wanted to give you an update on {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Wollte dir nur ein Update zu {{name:hailey}} geben

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Her grades are getting noticeably better
She’s understanding the material much faster now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Sie versteht den Stoff jetzt viel schneller

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I think she's already ready for the exam of today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Ich denke, sie ist schon bereit für die Prüfung heute

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I'm happy to see how much trust you have in this little demon 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Ich freue mich zu sehen, wie viel Vertrauen du in dieses kleine Monster hast 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: She’s not a demon, she’s a hardworking student 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Sie ist kein Monster, sie ist eine fleißige Schülerin 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Anyway, I wanted to ask you something
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Übrigens, ich wollte dich etwas fragen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Do you already have a client for the afternoon?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hast du schon einen Kunden für den Nachmittag?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: The young guy from yesterday asked for you again
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Der junge Typ von gestern hat wieder nach dir gefragt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He wants to spend the afternoon and evening with you if you are okay with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er möchte den Nachmittag und Abend mit dir verbringen, wenn das für dich in Ordnung ist

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He is offering $1500 to stay with him until tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Er bietet 1500 Dollar, um bis heute Abend bei ihm zu bleiben

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Same kind of thing as last time, acting like a couple while going to the aquarium and then to a restaurant tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das Gleiche wie beim letzten Mal, so tun als wären wir ein Paar, ins Aquarium gehen und dann heute Abend in ein Restaurant
Der Arzt hat den Gips entfernt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I guess I should dress nicely then
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich schätze, ich sollte mich schön anziehen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That would probably be better aha
The date is going really well
The aquarium was even better with you beside me. Thank you for staying close.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Das Aquarium war noch besser mit dir an meiner Seite. Danke, dass du so nah geblieben bist.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It hurts a little, but it is much better now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Es tut ein bisschen weh, aber es ist jetzt viel besser

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am having a really good time 😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Du hast einen schönen Tag verdient

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Biometric activity increased during ongoing date
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Biometrische Aktivität während des laufenden Dates erhöht
Nachhaltige Bewegung in unmittelbarer Nähe erkannt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Relevant capture archived into HAK Evidence
There is more between them now, and I need to be honest with myself about how that feels.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Zwischen ihnen ist jetzt mehr, und ich muss ehrlich zu mir sein, wie sich das anfühlt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:evelyn}} sharing a consensual kiss with her returning client during the aquarium date
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK archivierte Beweise von {{name:evelyn}}, die während des Aquarium-Dates einen einvernehmlichen Kuss mit ihrem zurückkehrenden Kunden teilt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I can walk more easily, I just need to rest
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich kann leichter gehen, ich muss nur ausruhen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But are you really sure you want me to work today?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Bist du dir wirklich sicher, dass du willst, dass ich heute arbeite?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am just going to rest anyway

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: There were still some horrible questions😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es gab immer noch ein paar furchtbare Fragen😭
Aber ich bin nicht komplett eingefroren

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't make me emotional in public 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mach mich nicht in der Öffentlichkeit emotional 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Now I just want the results
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Jetzt will ich nur die Ergebnisse

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I also can't wait to debrief with Ethan
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich kann es auch kaum erwarten, mit Ethan zu debriefen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe he'll even give you a reward if you did well
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vielleicht gibt er dir sogar eine Belohnung, wenn du gut abgeschnitten hast

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm learning from your terrible system
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich lerne von deinem schrecklichen System

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And I refuse to apologize for it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Und ich weigere mich, mich dafür zu entschuldigen
Ich muss mich beeilen, nach Hause zu kommen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have to eat and get ready before Ethan arrives
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich muss essen und mich fertig machen, bevor Ethan ankommt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I think it went pretty well
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich denke, es lief ganz gut
Siehst du? All die Arbeit hat sich gelohnt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I knew more than I expected
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich wusste mehr, als ich erwartet hatte

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A swimming pool? Seriously?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein Schwimmbad? Ernsthaft?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You and your best friend are never letting that go, are you?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du und deine beste Freundin lasst das nie los, oder?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to kill you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde dich umbringen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck catching me from the deep end 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Spaß, mich am tiefen Ende zu fangen 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Have fun
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Spaß.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A little water will do you good
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein bisschen Wasser wird dir gut tun.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You do remember I can barely swim, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du erinnerst dich, dass ich kaum schwimmen kann, oder?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mach dir keine Sorgen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:aiden}} is a really good swimmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:aiden}} ist ein wirklich guter Schwimmer.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And what the fuck is this swimsuit you prepared for me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Und was zur Hölle ist das für ein Badeanzug, den du für mich vorbereitet hast?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Unfortunately, that's the only one I could find
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Leider ist das der einzige, den ich finden konnte.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to haunt you forever for this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde dich dafür ewig verfolgen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And with that great ass of yours, you'll float no matter what so don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Und mit deinem tollen Hintern wirst du sowieso schwimmen, also mach dir keine Sorgen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A swimming pool? Seriously?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein Schwimmbad? Ernsthaft?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really had to bring that up again
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Musstest du das wirklich wieder ansprechen?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to kill you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde dich umbringen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck catching me from the deep end 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Spaß, mich am tiefen Ende zu fangen 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Have fun
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel Spaß.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A little water will do you good
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein bisschen Wasser wird dir gut tun.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You do remember I can barely swim, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Du erinnerst dich, dass ich kaum schwimmen kann, oder?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mach dir keine Sorgen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Chris is a really good swimmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Chris ist ein wirklich guter Schwimmer.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And what the fuck is this swimsuit you prepared for me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Und was zur Hölle ist das für ein Badeanzug, den du für mich vorbereitet hast?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Unfortunately, that's the only one I could find
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Leider ist das der einzige, den ich finden konnte.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to haunt you forever for this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde dich dafür ewig verfolgen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And with that great ass of yours, you'll float no matter what so don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Und mit deinem tollen Hintern wirst du sowieso schwimmen, also mach dir keine Sorgen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might come home late, so do not worry too much
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich könnte spät nach Hause kommen, also mach dir nicht zu viele Sorgen
Ich werde trotzdem auf dich warten

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Sustained intimate interaction exceeds previous date baseline
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Nachhaltige intime Interaktion übersteigt vorherige Basislinie

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Relevant capture archived into HAK Evidence
Their evening clearly mattered to her. How do I feel about where this is going?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Der Abend hat ihr offenbar viel bedeutet. Wie fühle ich mich damit, wohin das führt?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:evelyn}} sharing a close late-evening kiss with her returning client after dinner
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK archivierte Beweise von {{name:evelyn}}, die ihrem zurückkehrenden Klienten nach dem Abendessen einen innigen Kuss gibt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: TAG 15 — Nachdem der Arzt dein Bein untersucht hatte, nahm er dir den Gips ab. Du kannst dich jetzt freier bewegen, aber dein Bein braucht noch Ruhe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation:
Hey.

Du hast vorerst das Ende der verf?gbaren Inhalte f?r diesen Charakter erreicht.

Danke, dass du iNTeRcepted spielst.

Wenn du das Projekt unterstützen, neue Episoden erhalten und auf exklusive Inhalte zugreifen möchtest, kannst du meinen Patreon abonnieren.

Deine Unterstützung hilft mir wirklich, dieses Spiel weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir sehen uns im nächsten Kapitel.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We are in a very fancy restaurant
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Wir sind in einem sehr schicken Restaurant

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He is paying for everything, and he is being incredibly kind
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Er bezahlt alles und ist unglaublich freundlich

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I am honestly having a wonderful time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe ehrlich gesagt eine wunderbare Zeit

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm really glad to hear that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das freut mich wirklich zu hören

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Dinner felt special. You were kind, elegant, and exactly who I wanted there.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Das Abendessen fühlte sich besonders an. Du warst freundlich, elegant und genau die Person, die ich dort haben wollte.
Inhalte des Abendessens mit Lucas freigeschaltet.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But honestly I'm mostly relieved that it's over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber ehrlich gesagt bin ich hauptsächlich erleichtert, dass es vorbei ist

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For once I actually feel proud of myself 😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin tatsächlich mal stolz auf mich 😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: All those hours of studying finally paid off 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: All die Stunden des Lernens haben sich endlich ausgezahlt 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if I complained the whole time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Auch wenn ich die ganze Zeit gemeckert habe.
Außer als wir uns geküsst haben 😌
{{name:hailey}} hat Ethan mit einem Kuss belohnt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: No signs of hesitation detected during the exchange
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Keine Anzeichen von Zögern während des Austauschs festgestellt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A kiss makes this feel different from helping her study, and I'm not as detached as I sound.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ein Kuss fühlt sich anders an als Hilfe beim Lernen, und ich bin nicht so gelassen, wie ich klinge.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived visual evidence of {{name:hailey}} rewarding Ethan with a kiss following a successful tutoring session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK archivierte visuelle Beweise von {{name:hailey}}, die Ethan nach einer erfolgreichen Nachhilfestunde mit einem Kuss belohnt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Wow you're really sending me that ??
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wow, schickst du mir das wirklich??

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Well it's a reward for you too 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Naja, es ist auch eine Belohnung für dich 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't let any opportunity slip by!
Now I just have to wait for the results 😩
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Jetzt muss ich nur auf die Ergebnisse warten 😩

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We talked about the exam for a while
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wir haben eine Weile über die Prüfung gesprochen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But maybe it won't be that bad, if I fail at least I will get punished 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber vielleicht wird es nicht so schlimm, wenn ich durchfalle, bekomme ich wenigstens eine Strafe 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It's supposed to be a bad thing!
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das soll doch etwas Schlechtes sein!

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: TAG 15 — Nachdem der Arzt dein Bein untersucht hatte, nahm er dir den Gips ab. Du kannst dich jetzt freier bewegen, aber dein Bein braucht noch Ruhe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Ethan thinks I did better than I think I did
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ethan denkt, ich habe besser abgeschnitten, als ich denke

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm still overthinking a few questions
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich denke immer noch über ein paar Fragen nach

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everyone does that after an exam
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das macht jeder nach einer Prüfung

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down again before bed 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt muss ich mich wieder beruhigen, bevor ich ins Bett gehe 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I make it worse before bed? 😏
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Soll ich es vor dem Schlafengehen schlimmer machen? 😏

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really want to kill me
But keeping you awake… I'm guilty 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber dich wach zu halten… Ich bin schuldig 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: TAG 15 — Nachdem der Arzt dein Bein untersucht hatte, nahm er dir den Gips ab. Du kannst dich jetzt freier bewegen, aber dein Bein braucht noch Ruhe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor removed the cast today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Arzt hat heute den Gips entfernt
Ich freue mich so für dich

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I need a shower now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, ich brauche jetzt eine Dusche.
Willst du immer noch dein Bild?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to send it to someone else instead?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Möchtest du, dass ich es stattdessen jemand anderem sende?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Trying to understand what you like
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Versuche zu verstehen, was du magst.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to see how you react
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich möchte sehen, wie du reagierst.
Dieser Tag fühlte sich so lang an.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If I was going to do something like that…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wenn ich so etwas machen würde…

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Who would you want it to be with?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mit wem würdest du es gerne machen?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like… who would you want me to send it to?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie… an wen möchtest du, dass ich es sende?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably someone I don't really know
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wahrscheinlich jemand, den ich nicht wirklich kenne.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think the idea of a stranger makes it intense
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich denke, die Idee eines Fremden macht es intensiv.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe safer, for the private part
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und vielleicht sicherer, für den privaten Teil

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber hast du keine Angst, dass er versucht, mich zu stehlen?
Ich vertraue dir voll und ganz.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: then, why not, if we find the right person
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann, warum nicht, wenn wir die richtige Person finden.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kinda… already thought about it…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe irgendwie... schon darüber nachgedacht...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too many classes, too many people 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zu viele Klassen, zu viele Leute 😭
Aber er ist auch mein Freund.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And we don't even know if he would agree
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wir wissen nicht einmal, ob er zustimmen würde.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We both know he's a real charmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir wissen beide, dass er ein echter Charmeur ist.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he always looks at you like that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und er schaut dich immer so an.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I see him, he doesn't hide it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich sehe ihn, er versteckt es nicht.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little… but more like jealous… and excited
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen… aber eher eifersüchtig… und aufgeregt

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proud that my girlfriend is that beautiful
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und stolz darauf, dass meine Freundin so schön ist.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wow… that's really sweet… and hot
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wow… das ist wirklich süß… und heiß
Du machst dich über mich lustig.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We did say we would explore this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben gesagt, dass wir das erkunden würden.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why not with someone I trust?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warum nicht mit jemandem, dem ich vertraue?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber hast du keine Angst, dass er versuchen wird, mich zu stehlen?
Ich vertraue dir voll und ganz.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Also, bist du nicht ertrunken?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit with your best friend knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du hast mich in diesem Badeanzug mit deiner besten Freundin ins Schwimmbad geschickt, obwohl ich kaum schwimmen kann

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du bist so unschuldig wie ein Serienkiller mit dem Messer.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: And {{name:aiden}} have the best tan of the year, unlike me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Und {{name:aiden}} hat den besten Sonnenbrand des Jahres, im Gegensatz zu mir

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm as white as a ghost compared to him
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin im Vergleich zu ihm so weiß wie ein Gespenst

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That's for sure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das steht fest

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin mir sicher, du hattest trotzdem Spaß im Pool.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das habe ich nicht gesagt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Aber du leugnest es auch nicht.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Halt die Klappe

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like my best friend is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Klingt so, als würde mein bester Freund dir gefallen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich habe übrigens deinen alten Badeanzug gefunden.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das ist erst der Anfang des Krieges.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mit Vergnügen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, deine Sekretärin

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Schade

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ungewöhnliche körperliche Nähe im Schwimmbad erkannt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason relied heavily on {{name:aiden}} during the session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason hat sich während der Sitzung stark auf {{name:aiden}} verlassen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eine intensive Interaktion fand zwischen Mason und seinem Trainer statt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I want {{name:mason}} to feel free to choose, even while I'm figuring out where that leaves me.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich möchte, dass {{name:mason}} frei entscheiden kann, auch wenn ich noch herausfinden muss, wo ich dabei bleibe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK//INTENSE PROXIMITY DETECTED
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK//INTENSIVE NÄHE DETEKTIERT

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Poolhilfe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and {{name:aiden}} experienced an intense moment of physical proximity during the swimming session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason und {{name:aiden}} hatten während der Schwimmstunde einen intensiven Moment der Nähe

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Poolhilfe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 50 minutes later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 50 Minuten später.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: My new mission in life is to make yours miserable
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Meine neue Lebensmission ist es, dein Leben miserabel zu machen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't understand why
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich verstehe nicht, warum.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm completely innocent
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin völlig unschuldig.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Also, bist du nicht ertrunken?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du hast mich in diesem Badeanzug in ein Schwimmbad geschickt, obwohl ich kaum schwimmen kann.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Du bist so unschuldig wie ein Serienkiller mit dem Messer.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin mir sicher, du hattest trotzdem Spaß im Pool.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das habe ich nicht gesagt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Aber du leugnest es auch nicht.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Halt die Klappe

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like your torturer is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Scheint, als würde dein Folterer dir langsam gefallen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Das ist erst der Anfang des Krieges.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mit Vergnügen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, deine Sekretärin

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich habe übrigens deinen alten Badeanzug gefunden.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Schade

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ungewöhnliche körperliche Nähe im Schwimmbad erkannt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason relied heavily on Chris during the session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason hat während der Sitzung stark auf Chris vertraut.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Eine intensive Interaktion fand zwischen Mason und seinem Trainer statt.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I want {{name:mason}} to feel free to choose, even while I'm figuring out where that leaves me.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich möchte, dass {{name:mason}} frei entscheiden kann, auch wenn ich noch herausfinden muss, wo ich dabei bleibe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: HAK//INTENSE PROXIMITY DETECTED
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: HAK//INTENSIVE NÄHE DETEKTIERT

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Poolhilfe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and Chris experienced an intense moment of physical proximity during the swimming session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason und Chris erlebten während der Schwimmstunde einen intensiven Moment körperlicher Nähe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Pool assistance
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Poolhilfe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 50 minutes later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 50 Minuten später.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: My new mission in life is to make yours miserable
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Meine neue Lebensmission ist es, dein Leben miserabel zu machen.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't understand why
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich verstehe nicht, warum.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm completely innocent
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin völlig unschuldig.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: TAG 15 — Nachdem der Arzt dein Bein untersucht hatte, nahm er dir den Gips ab. Du kannst dich jetzt freier bewegen, aber dein Bein braucht noch Ruhe.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: ( CONTINUE )
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: ( FORTFAHREN )

Hey.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DEVELOPER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: ENTWICKLER

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Erfasst Gespräche an anderen Orten, indem sie Personen von Interesse überwacht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I feel like drawing a bit of attention
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wenn ich Lust habe, ein bisschen Aufmerksamkeit zu erregen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t get used to being right
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Gewöhn dich nicht daran, recht zu haben

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’ve been thinking about last night
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich hab über letzte Nacht nachgedacht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep wondering what you actually thought when you received it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich frage mich die ganze Zeit, was du wirklich gedacht hast, als du es bekommen hast

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I thought about it more than I should have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich habe mehr darüber nachgedacht, als ich sollte

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s more honest than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Das ist ehrlicher, als ich erwartet habe

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I tried the outfit you chose for me again this morning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich hab das Outfit, das du für mich ausgesucht hast, heute Morgen nochmal angezogen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I don’t know if that makes it better or worse
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich weiß nicht, ob das es besser oder schlimmer macht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich sag mir ständig, es war nur eine dumme Entscheidung mitten in der Nacht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Aber ich habe es auch nicht wirklich bereut, es geschickt zu haben

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Das ist der Teil, der mich stört

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und ich kann immer noch nicht entscheiden, ob ich dir danken oder mich ein bisschen ärgern soll

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Weil es bedeutet, dass ich wollte, dass du mich so siehst

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und ich mache normalerweise keine solchen Dinge, ohne tagelang nachzudenken

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Das ist auch ein Teil des Problems.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Du bist sehr ruhig bei etwas, das sich für mich immer noch ein bisschen gefährlich anfühlt.
Ich bin auch nicht so ruhig.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Es sieht besser aus, als ich erwartet habe

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We’re living in the same house
If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Wenn sich die Dinge ändern, dann geht das schnell.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich dafür bereit bin.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Okay, ich werde mich fertig machen, bevor ich mich weiter in die Enge rede.
Ich bin froh, dass es dir gefällt

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Hab dir doch gesagt, dass ich einen guten Geschmack habe

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t sound so pleased with yourself

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Genug HAK-Punkte gesammelt

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: New skill available: Live Transcription
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Neue Fähigkeit verfügbar: Live-Transkription

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Erfasst Gespräche, die anderswo stattfinden, indem es Personen von Interesse überwacht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: HAK//FÄHIGKEIT VERFÜGBAR

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How does your leg feel this morning?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Wie fühlt sich dein Bein heute Morgen an?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Strange without the cast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Seltsam ohne den Gips

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich erwarte immer, sein Gewicht zu spüren, wenn ich mich bewege

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tut es weh?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ein bisschen steif. Ich mache es langsam

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're doing the short walk today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann machen wir heute den kurzen Spaziergang

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Es gibt eine Bank in der Nähe des Eingangs. Wir können dort anhalten, wann immer du willst

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hast du schon eine Bank ausgesucht?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. Very advanced date planning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ja. Sehr fortgeschrittene Date-Planung

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich kümmere mich um das Abendessen. Du kümmerst dich um die Bänke

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Unser Date heute ☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A balanced relationship 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eine ausgewogene Beziehung 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Frühstück zuerst, aber. Ich gehe nicht mit leerem Magen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lass Platz für heute Abend

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you making?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Was kochst du?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pasta, geröstetes Gemüse und Dessert

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You remembered dessert. Excellent start
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du hast das Dessert nicht vergessen. Ausgezeichneter Start

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du musst warten, um herauszufinden, was es ist

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay. Ich habe auch etwas, auf das du warten musst

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das Outfit?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ist es komisch, dass ich das Wetter schon dreimal gecheckt habe?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich trage das, das du gestern ausgesucht hast 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und ja, ich habe auch deine andere Wahl gekauft

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Jetzt machst du es schwer, mich auf die Einkaufsliste zu konzentrieren

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mach deine Einkaufsliste fertig. Ich will richtig bekocht werden

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Triff mich um drei am Parkeingang?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Three it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Drei ist es

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Schreib mir, wenn du losgehst. Und beeil dich nicht, um vor mir dort zu sein

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Werde ich nicht

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you this afternoon, love ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bis später, mein Schatz ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Kommt drauf an. Erwarten wir einen Hurrikan?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nein 😭

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich will nur nicht, dass unser Park-Date ins Wasser fällt

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Wir finden schon einen Ort, um uns zu verstecken

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das wäre für dich eine Ausrede, um ganz nah bei mir zu stehen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das wollte ich auch bei schönem Wetter machen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann spielt die Wettervorhersage wohl keine Rolle ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich liege hier und spiele unser Gespräch von früher nochmal durch.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Besonders die Stelle, an der ich zugegeben habe, dass ich wollte, dass du dieses Foto siehst

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich kann immer noch nicht glauben, dass ich das laut gesagt habe.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Es war gut, das zu hören, um ehrlich zu sein.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Aber als ich angefangen habe zu reden, fühlte es sich komisch an, aufzuhören.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Normalerweise mache ich Witze, um aus allem herauszukommen, was zu realistisch ist.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Heute Morgen hab ich das nicht wirklich gemacht.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Und du hast mich auch nicht gedrängt.
Das hat es irgendwie schlimmer gemacht.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich wollte dich nicht unwohl fühlen lassen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I was trying not to overdo it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich hab versucht, es nicht zu übertreiben.
Hätte ich mehr Druck machen sollen?
Du gehst vorsichtig mit mir um.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich glaube, du hast das besser gemacht als ich.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Als ich dir dieses Foto geschickt habe…

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Or were you just being polite?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Oder warst du einfach nur höflich?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You really didn’t have to say that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du hättest das wirklich nicht sagen müssen.
Aber ich bin froh, dass du es getan hast.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to try sleeping now
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich werde jetzt versuchen zu schlafen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: At least I’m not the only one
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Zumindest bin ich nicht die Einzige.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Before I ask something even more dangerous
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Bevor ich etwas noch Gefährlicheres frage.
Danke, dass du richtig geantwortet hast.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And… don’t overthink this too much either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Und… überdenk das auch nicht zu sehr.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Im Park 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: So?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Jetzt hast du ein Foto von unserem echten Park-Date

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Besser als die Vorschau letzten Sonntag

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel besser. Du bist hier mit mir drauf

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Meine Schulter zählt kaum

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Für mich zählt es

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Da. Jetzt will ich diese Schulter zurück.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ihr verbringt eine Weile zusammen auf der Bank. {{name:lena}} lehnt sich an dich, während ihr redet, und geht dann mit dir einen kurzen Abschnitt des Weges. Bevor ihr geht, teilt ihr euch ein Eis in der Nähe des Eingangs.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bereit, zurückzugehen?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin am Eingang

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja. Ich glaube, mein Bein hat für heute genug vom Laufen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dann gehen wir direkt zu dir. Du kannst dich vor dem Abendessen ausruhen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Und du kannst mir Gesellschaft leisten.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das war schon Teil des Plans.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ihr verlasst den Park zusammen und geht direkt zu dir. Drinnen lässt {{name:lena}} ihre Tasche neben dem Sofa und hilft dir, dein Bein auf ein Kissen zu legen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Besser?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Viel. Ich bin froh, dass wir die lange Runde übersprungen haben.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich mochte unsere Bank. Besonders bevor der Hund versucht hat, die nächste zu stehlen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Er wusste genau, was er wollte.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich auch.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Der kleine Eisstand hat übrigens geöffnet

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} sitzt neben dir und legt ihre Hand auf deine.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mein Lieblingsmoment war, als du dich geweigert hast, meine Hand loszulassen, um zu essen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe das ganz gut hinbekommen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Du hast Eis auf meinem Daumen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein kleines technisches Problem.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Wir haben noch etwas Zeit, bevor ich mit dem Kochen anfangen muss.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut. Bleib eine Weile hier bei mir.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Darüber will ich nicht streiten.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ihr verbringt den Rest des Nachmittags zusammen auf dem Sofa. {{name:lena}} trägt das Outfit, das du gestern ausgesucht hast, und du lässt dein Bein ruhen, bevor ihr in die Küche geht.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hast du das gefunden, bevor du mich gefunden hast?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich sammle nützliche Informationen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Schau nach links

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oh ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} steckt ihr Handy weg und kommt zu dir. Sie küsst dich und nimmt dann deine Hand. Ihr nehmt den kurzen Weg durch den Park und haltet an einer Bank an, als dein Bein müde wird.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Komm näher. Ich will ein Foto von uns auf dieser Bank.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Früher Abend, bei dir. Nach dem gemeinsamen Ausruhen geht ihr in die Küche, um das Abendessen vorzubereiten.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beweis, dass du tatsächlich für mich gekocht hast.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dass du ein Stück gestohlen hast, bevor ich es serviert habe.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Qualitätskontrolle

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Verdict?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Urteil?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very good. I'm keeping the cook
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr gut. Ich behalte die Köchin.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a relief
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist eine Erleichterung.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jetzt probier es, bevor dein Essen kalt wird.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nach dem Abendessen bringst du das Dessert zum Sofa. {{name:lena}} zieht ihre Beine neben dir zusammen und vermeidet vorsichtig dein schmerzendes Bein. Du legst einen Film auf, pausierst ihn aber immer wieder, um zu reden.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SPÄTER AM ABEND

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What can I do?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was kann ich tun?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here a second.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Komm mal kurz her.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du lehnst dich näher und küsst sie. {{name:lena}} zieht dich näher, lächelt gegen deine Lippen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss on the Sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ein Kuss auf dem Sofa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more for today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Noch einen für heute

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du siehst sehr zufrieden mit dir aus.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte ein Date im Park, Abendessen, Dessert und einen sehr guten Platz auf deinem Sofa.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Guter Platz?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du bist mein Gast. Du kannst dort sitzen und mein Kochen beurteilen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Direkt neben dir.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Obwohl ich glaube, dass ich seit zwanzig Minuten auf deinem Arm lehne.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Es war es wert.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sag mir Bescheid, wenn dein Bein anfängt, dir weh zu tun, okay?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: So ist es in Ordnung.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'd like to stay a little longer
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann würde ich gerne noch ein bisschen bleiben.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd like that too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das würde ich auch gerne.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ihr lasst eure Handys auf dem Tisch und macht es euch zusammen bequem. Der Rest des Abends vergeht mit Gesprächen und Küssen. Als {{name:lena}} schließlich geht, begleitest du sie zur Tür.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SPÄTER

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Zuhause ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dein Gast kann ein Gemüse schneiden. Gib mir ein Brett.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Danke, dass du es mir gesagt hast.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe meine Tasche neben deinem Sofa gelassen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe sie gefunden.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Ein äußerst überzeugender Grund, zurückzukommen.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du brauchst keinen Grund

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich weiß. Ich will trotzdem meine Tasche 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hat das Abendessen das Versprechen gehalten?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber das Beste war, mit dir dort zu sein
