story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dich zum Abschied zu küssen, ohne irgendwohin gehen zu wollen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: In Ordnung. Das Gemüse gehört dir.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly asked you to stay
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe fast gefragt, ob du bleiben willst

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly went back inside
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin fast wieder reingegangen

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Next time, ask me 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Frag mich das nächste Mal 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Werde ich

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jetzt ruh dich aus. Du hast heute mehr gemacht als seit langem

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bereits im Bett

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht, Liebling. Danke für heute ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht. Ich fand es toll, dich hier zu haben

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und du kannst dich setzen, während ich sie mache.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're taking over my kitchen already.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du übernimmst schon meine Küche.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nur das Schneiden. Du hast mir das Abendessen versprochen, also ist die Soße immer noch dein Problem.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} wäscht und schneidet das Gemüse, während du die Soße vorbereitest. Du nimmst Platz zwischen den Aufgaben, und sie bringt die Teller an den Tisch, sobald das Abendessen fertig ist.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ABENDESSEN

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Erfasst Gespräche an anderen Orten, indem sie Personen von Interesse überwacht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich will nicht noch mehr Stress obendrauf.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und ich bin schon glücklich mit dem Diplom, das ich habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich muss nicht noch mehr Druck aufbauen, nur weil ich kann.
Es fühlt sich nicht mehr plötzlich an.
Es fühlt sich einfach… entschieden an.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hast du mit deinem Professor darüber gesprochen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich werde es ihm heute Nachmittag sagen, wenn ich das Buch abgeben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Es fühlt sich nach dem richtigen Moment an, um es zu sagen.
Okay… halte mich einfach auf dem Laufenden.
Ich liege aber noch im Bett.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Alles klar. Schreib mir, wenn du losgehst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich denke schon seit ein paar Tagen darüber nach.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m not taking the next exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich werde die nächsten Prüfungen nicht machen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I thought about it properly this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe diesmal wirklich darüber nachgedacht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen ❤️ Wie ist dein erster Morgen ohne den Gips?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann kein Feiern, indem du heute versuchst, die ganze Stadt zu durchqueren

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da geht mein Nachmittag

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, dass du scherzt, aber ich beobachte dich 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Through the walls?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Durch die Wände?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du verrätst dich normalerweise irgendwann selbst

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du wirst sagen, du bist ein bisschen spazieren gegangen und dann einen Laden drei Straßen weiter erwähnen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a very specific accusation
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist eine sehr spezifische Anschuldigung

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das bin ich, die meinen Freund kennt ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur zur Info, mein großes Abenteuer bisher war, in die Küche zu kommen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you make it back alive?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du es lebend zurückgeschafft?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe die Decke immer noch so hochgehoben, als hätte ich den riesigen Gips darunter

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Barely, the coffee was terrible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Kaum, der Kaffee war schrecklich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dein Kaffee schmeckt immer so, als hättest du einen Groll gegen die Bohnen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It wakes me up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es macht mich wach

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das würde auch ein Feueralarm tun, die trinkst du nicht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du bist sehr gesprächig für jemanden, der das Bett nicht verlassen hat

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excuse you, I'm dressed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entschuldige, ich bin angezogen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe sogar meine Tasche gepackt und beide Schuhe gefunden

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both? Big morning for us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Beide? Großer Morgen für uns

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't ruin my achievements 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Verschandel meine Erfolge nicht 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du auch gefrühstückt oder war das Finden der Schuhe genug?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dein Gehirn hat sich noch nicht eingekriegt 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast and a banana
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toast und eine Banane

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Der Toast war etwas mehr geröstet als geplant

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Burnt
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Verbrannt

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Crispy 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Knusprig 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: War das bevor oder nachdem du meinen Kaffee beleidigt hast?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do two things badly at once, thank you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich kann zwei Dinge gleichzeitig schlecht machen, danke.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now that sounds like the girl I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt jetzt nach dem Mädchen, das ich kenne.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das Mädchen, das du kennst, sorgt auch dafür, dass du heute wirklich Pausen machst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen umherlaufen zu Hause, dann die Übungen, die sie mir gestern gezeigt haben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Offenbar hat es erwartet, dass der Gips für immer bleibt

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No heroic expedition
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Keine heldenhafte Expedition.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut ❤️ Ich warte lieber ein bisschen länger, als dich wieder verletzen zu sehen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist einfach schön, sich nicht mehr festgefahren zu fühlen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I bet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wette ich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wenn du dich wohler fühlst, können wir irgendwohin gehen, ohne dass du jeden einzelnen Schritt planen musst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somewhere with decent coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Irgendwo mit anständigem Kaffee?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und Stühle, ich nehme dich nicht mit zum Wandern 😭.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really know how to spoil me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du weißt wirklich, wie man mich verwöhnt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich dachte an Kaffee und ein Gebäck, aber red weiter, und du kannst Wasser haben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sag das nicht, ich habe auch angefangen, daran zu glauben

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll behave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde mich benehmen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There we go 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da haben wir es 😌.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's your day looking like?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie sieht dein Tag aus?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning, then work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Heute Morgen Unterricht, dann Arbeit.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich muss heute Nachmittag eine Tabelle überprüfen, bevor morgen jemand anderes sie benutzt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds dangerously responsible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt gefährlich verantwortungsbewusst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying not to think about it like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich versuche, nicht so darüber nachzudenken.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich freue mich hauptsächlich darauf, meine Uni-Notizen nicht mehr mit meinen Arbeitsunterlagen herumzutragen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not much longer now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nicht mehr lange jetzt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know ❤️ I'm counting down
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß ❤️ Ich zähle die Tage.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep better without it?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du ohne ihn besser geschlafen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, before I leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Warte, bevor ich gehe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe es tatsächlich geschafft, mich anzuziehen, ohne alles zu zerknittern.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Genieß es, solange es dauert, meine Tasche wird dieses Shirt wahrscheinlich in zehn Minuten ruinieren 😭.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst wunderschön aus

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You answered suspiciously fast
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast verdächtig schnell geantwortet.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't need much thinking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das brauchte nicht viel Nachdenken.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, das war eine gute Antwort ❤️.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do I get the pastry back?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bekomme ich das Gebäck zurück?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never losing the pastry
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast das Gebäck nie verloren.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, until I got up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viel besser, bis ich aufgestanden bin

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was just going to make you ask nicely
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich wollte dich nur dazu bringen, nett zu fragen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Cruel woman
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grausame Frau

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Deine grausame Frau muss jetzt gehen, sonst verpasst sie ihren Bus 😌.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sag mir, wie es dir geht, wenn ich dir zum Mittag schreibe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will, good luck with the morning
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Werde ich, viel Glück mit dem Morgen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, Hübscher ❤️ Ich liebe dich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: My leg still feels like it belongs to somebody else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mein Bein fühlt sich immer noch an, als würde es jemand anderem gehören

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Stiff?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Steif?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, and a bit shaky when I first stand up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, und ein bisschen wackelig, wenn ich aufstehe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, how’s it going over there?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hey, wie läuft's da drüben?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s being really calm about the whole thing
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er bleibt echt ganz gelassen bei der ganzen Sache.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It makes it harder to just drop the bomb and leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es macht es schwerer, einfach die Bombe platzen zu lassen und zu gehen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ve thought about it a lot… I don’t want to take the next exams.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab viel darüber nachgedacht… Ich will die nächsten Prüfungen nicht machen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}}. If you skip them, you won’t get the diploma.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}. Wenn du sie auslässt, bekommst du das Diplom nicht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Fuck, well That’s why I’m telling you now.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Verdammte Axt, genau deshalb sag ich's dir jetzt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: …Is there really no other way?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: …Gibt's wirklich keinen anderen Weg?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What are you proposing, exactly?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Was genau schlägst du vor?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t know… maybe we can find something that works for both of us.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich weiß nicht… vielleicht finden wir etwas, das für uns beide funktioniert.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re good at finding solutions, what do you suggest?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du bist gut darin, Lösungen zu finden. Was schlägst du vor?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Everything’s fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Alles gut.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Event intensity increased
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ereignisintensität gestiegen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Communication patterns show increased emotional reliance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Kommunikationsmuster zeigen eine erhöhte emotionale Abhängigkeit

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Workplace influence markers continue to rise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Die Einflussmarker am Arbeitsplatz steigen weiter an.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Physical proximity exceeds standard academic baseline
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Physische Nähe übersteigt den akademischen Standard.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Additional evidence archived for review
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Zusätzliche Beweise archiviert zur Überprüfung

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to trust her, but this no longer feels like ordinary academic help.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich will ihr vertrauen, aber das fühlt sich nicht mehr nach normaler Nachhilfe an.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a moment of reduced personal distance during the private discussion. The professor’s hand remained on {{name:hailey}}’s arm for an extended period while she spoke about her academic future.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat einen Moment reduzierter persönlicher Distanz während der privaten Diskussion festgehalten. Die Hand der Professorin blieb für eine längere Zeit auf {{name:hailey}}’s Arm, während sie über ihre akademische Zukunft sprach.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Closer Contact
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll think about your proposal.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich denk über deinen Vorschlag nach.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But it's a dangerous and non ethical one.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber es ist gefährlich und unethisch.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If your in i'm in, and it's a win win, i'm a catch you know.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn du dabei bist, bin ich auch dabei, und es ist ein Gewinn für uns beide. Ich bin ein Fang, das weißt du.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway,i’m going to head home now before it gets more awkward.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Egal, ich mach mich jetzt auf den Weg nach Hause, bevor es noch awkwarder wird.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you for listening to me.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Danke, dass du mir zugehört hast.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry I went quiet for a second
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sorry, dass ich kurz still war.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He just asked me something and I had to answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hat mich gerade etwas gefragt und ich musste antworten.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We’re talking about the next exams right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wir reden gerade über die nächsten Prüfungen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Take your time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Nimm dir Zeit

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm done talking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab genug geredet.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll text you when I’m home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich schreib dir, wenn ich zuhause bin.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: See you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Bis später

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s listening properly for once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hört endlich mal richtig zu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you already tell him your decision?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hast du ihm schon deine Entscheidung gesagt?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Not yet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Noch nicht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m getting there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin fast da.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s just… taking a bit longer than I thought
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es dauert nur… ein bisschen länger als ich dachte.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Alles gut?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ja

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over and I've got a little time before work, how's your first day of freedom going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey 😊 Der Unterricht ist vorbei und ich habe ein bisschen Zeit vor der Arbeit, wie läuft dein erster Freiheitstag?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And no spreadsheets
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und keine Spreadsheets.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that now. If you bring one, I'm leaving you there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das sagst du jetzt. Wenn du eins mitbringst, lasse ich dich dort.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave whenever you like
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst gehen, wann du willst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, but I'd rather not spend my first evening out hearing about work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das weiß ich, aber ich möchte meinen ersten Abend draußen nicht mit Arbeit verbringen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just wanted to make sure you still wanted to go
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wollte nur sicherstellen, dass du immer noch gehen willst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich tue es.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst sehr zufrieden mit dir selbst aus.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I not be?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sollte ich das nicht sein?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das habe ich nicht gesagt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly awkward, I'm taking it slowly
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eher unangenehm, ich mach's langsam.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll try not to overdo it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann werde ich versuchen, es nicht zu übertreiben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not trying very hard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du gibst dir nicht wirklich Mühe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The manager moves closer and initiates a kiss
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Der Manager rückt näher und küsst dich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He just kissed {{name:lena}}. My hands have gone cold, and for a second I can't even take in what I'm seeing.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat gerade {{name:lena}} geküsst. Meine Hände sind kalt geworden, und für einen Moment kann ich gar nicht begreifen, was ich da sehe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Crossing the Line
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die Grenze überschreiten

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait... what are you doing?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte... was machst du da?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I shouldn't have done that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entschuldigung. Das hätte ich nicht tun sollen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, you shouldn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, das solltest du nicht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll step back
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich trete einen Schritt zurück.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have a boyfriend
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe einen Freund.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das weiß ich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you can't just kiss me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann kannst du mich nicht einfach so küssen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast recht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't expecting that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das habe ich nicht erwartet.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My bad, your right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mein Fehler, du hast recht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to get back to work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich muss zurück zur Arbeit.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you need to stop looking at me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und du musst aufhören, mich so anzuschauen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will try
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde es versuchen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should try harder
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du solltest dich mehr anstrengen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How was your morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie war dein Morgen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I cancel tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Soll ich für morgen absagen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du dir sicher?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to go. I just... I need a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich will immer noch gehen. Ich brauche nur... einen Moment.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nimm einen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, preferably
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alleine, wenn möglich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll finish the last checks at my desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mache die letzten Überprüfungen an meinem Schreibtisch fertig.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can send it over when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst es mir schicken, wenn du bereit bist.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Let me get my phone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Lass mich mein Handy holen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The professor spent ages explaining something that wasn't even on the right slide
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Der Professor hat ewig gebraucht, um etwas zu erklären, das nicht mal auf der richtigen Folie war.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her shift, at the bus stop...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nach ihrer Schicht, an der Bushaltestelle...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Sorry, I thought I'd be able to text sooner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin raus ❤️ Sorry, ich dachte, ich könnte früher schreiben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you sort out the spreadsheet?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du die Tabelle sortiert?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, irgendwann.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We started with the wrong printout, so that was a great use of everyone's time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben mit dem falschen Ausdruck angefangen, das war also eine tolle Nutzung von everyone's Zeit 😭.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The expensive sandwich deserved a better afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das teure Sandwich hätte einen besseren Nachmittag verdient.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I was hungry again an hour later, so it didn't even do its job
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich hatte eine Stunde später wieder Hunger, also hat es nicht mal seinen Job gemacht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Heading home now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Geht's jetzt nach Hause?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Waiting for the bus, unless it decides not to exist again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte auf den Bus, es sei denn, er beschließt wieder nicht zu existieren.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it late?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist es spät?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone finally told him and he just went 'yes, that's for next week'
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Irgendjemand hat es ihm endlich gesagt und er meinte nur: 'Ja, das ist für nächste Woche.'

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It says four minutes. It also said four minutes when I got here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es sagt vier Minuten. Es sagte auch vier Minuten, als ich hier ankam.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I found a seat
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zumindest habe ich einen Platz gefunden.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Long afternoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Langer Nachmittag?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Longer than I expected, yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Länger als ich erwartet hatte, ja.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alles in Ordnung?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, just a lot going round in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, einfach viel, was in meinem Kopf herumgeht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need food and a bit of time not looking at numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich brauche Essen und ein bisschen Zeit, in der ich nicht auf Zahlen schaue.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can talk about something incredibly unimportant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kann über etwas unglaublich Unwichtiges reden.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach das bitte 😭 Wie lief deine große Tour durchs Haus?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sehr beruhigend.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe entdeckt, dass das Sofa immer noch da ist, wo ich es gelassen habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A successful expedition then
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine erfolgreiche Expedition also.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich habe aufgehört, als mein Bein müde wurde.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schau dich an, wie du mir tatsächlich zuhörst ❤️.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't sound so surprised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kling nicht so überrascht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich genieße den Moment, lass mich das 😌.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel like watching something together later?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du Lust, später etwas zusammen zu schauen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zusammen, als ob wir über denselben Film aus verschiedenen Häusern streiten?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau das.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe einen Kriminalfilm gefunden, der schrecklich aussieht, und ich will nicht alleine leiden.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hab zehn Minuten gedacht, ich wäre das Problem 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst ein so überzeugendes Angebot

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Say yes, I've already saved it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag ja, ich hab's schon gespeichert

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, wir schauen es, wenn du bereit bist

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut ❤️ Mein Bus ist endlich da

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schreib dir, wenn ich zu Hause bin, dann kümmere ich mich um das Abendessen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bis gleich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du es geschafft, dir vor der Arbeit etwas zu essen zu besorgen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein Sandwich von dem Laden bei der Bushaltestelle.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es hat genug gekostet, dass ich die Tüte nach einem zweiten Sandwich durchsucht habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe zwei Zimmer hinter mich gebracht und einen richtigen Schuh angezogen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: War da eins?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, just a napkin and disappointment
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, nur eine Serviette und Enttäuschung.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Immerhin hab ich einen Platz gefunden, um mich kurz hinzusetzen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst nicht so enttäuscht aus.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hatte das Sandwich noch nicht geöffnet 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich lass dich dein sehr teures Mittagessen genießen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du solltest auch etwas essen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hab ich schon.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, one less person to supervise 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut, eine Person weniger zu beaufsichtigen 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schau dich an, wie du in der Welt aufsteigst 😭.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beaufsichtigst du jetzt Leute bei der Arbeit?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eher eine Tabelle, die sich einfach nicht addieren lässt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mein Chef will es mit mir durchgehen, wenn ich komme.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Immerhin wirst du nicht alleine damit sitzen bleiben.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau, und dann kann es aufhören, Platz in meinem Kopf zu beanspruchen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich muss los, ich schreib dir, wenn ich draußen bin ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hab einen schönen Nachmittag

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Später am Nachmittag, im Büro des Chefs...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bürogemurmel in der Nähe von {{name:lena}} erkannt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine Tabelle, das hat sie gesagt. Ich möchte, dass das ein ganz normaler Nachmittag bei der Arbeit ist, aber ich kann den Blick nicht vom Bildschirm lösen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//LIVE TRANSKRIPTION

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist das die Version, die du mir heute Morgen geschickt hast?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Den Schuh anzuziehen, war der schwierige Teil.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It should be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sollte es sein.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this total is different
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil diese Summe anders ist.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte, sag mir nicht, dass ich die alte ausgedruckt habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag du es mir.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hab's vor dem Unterricht geändert. Schau dir die Datei auf deinem Bildschirm an.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Diese hier?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, schau nach unten. Die Zahl ist genau da

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also ist die Tabelle richtig und der Ausdruck nicht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau. Das bedeutet, ich habe meine Mittagspause damit verbracht, mir über ein Problem Sorgen zu machen, das ich schon gelöst habe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich habe Notizen auf der falschen Kopie geschrieben

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du es mal im Stehen versucht?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Na toll, deins landet direkt mit meinem im Müll

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest vorher nachsehen können, bevor du es druckst

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest nachsehen können, bevor du auf jede Seite schreibst

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fair genug

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut, ich bin froh, dass wir uns einig sind, dass das eine gemeinsame Katastrophe ist

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm mal her. Zeig mir, was du geändert hast

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da, diese Zeile war zweimal enthalten

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das habe ich gestern übersehen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Du hast mir gesagt, ich soll meine Berechnung nochmal überprüfen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und das hast du getan

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einmal

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dreimal, weil ich dachte, du musst etwas wissen, das ich nicht weiß

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest es mir sagen sollen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Habe ich gerade

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen früher hätte dir Zeit gespart

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann kann ich das nächste Mal sagen 'Ich hab's dir gesagt', während du noch im Raum bist

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich denke, das hast du dir verdient

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde mir merken, dass du das gesagt hast

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zwei Personen stehen zusammen neben dem Schreibtisch

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sie stehen so nah beieinander. Ich sage mir immer wieder, dass es um die Arbeit geht, aber sie so zu sehen, schnürt mir den Magen zu.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zu nah

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du scheinst jetzt entspannter hier zu sein

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hab ich mir gedacht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mit der Arbeit? Ein bisschen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das war nicht genau das, was ich meinte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann solltest du vielleicht genauer sein

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: In den ersten Tagen standest du immer an der Tür, wenn du etwas hereingebracht hast

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil du immer beschäftigt aussahst

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und jetzt?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt weiß ich, dass du die Hälfte der Zeit nur die gleichen Zahlen anschaust wie ich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also bin ich weniger einschüchternd

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe nicht gesagt, dass du einschüchternd bist

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du wolltest einfach nicht näher kommen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hab mich hingesetzt, bevor du eine Störung spüren konntest.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weißt du, du bemerkst viel für jemanden, der so viel zu tun hat

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einige Dinge sind schwer zu übersehen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst es wieder

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was machen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mich anzuschauen statt den Bildschirm

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast das Spreadsheet erklärt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist keine Antwort.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das war nicht so gemeint.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst es mir echt nicht leicht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was soll ich leicht machen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zu spät, ich hab's gespürt 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein ernstes Gesicht zu bewahren, während ich arbeiten soll.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen später, nachdem die Papierarbeit erledigt ist...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Steht unser Treffen für morgen noch?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das Getränk?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, das Getränk.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe gesagt, ich komme, oder?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast auch gesagt, dass du nach der Arbeit müde sein könntest.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wahrscheinlich schon. Ich kann mich auch irgendwo hinsetzen, wo nicht dieser Stuhl ist.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es gibt einen Ort ein paar Straßen weiter. Gegen sieben?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sieben sollte passen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Im Ernst, tut es weh oder ist es nur unangenehm?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
Even if it means more work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Auch wenn das mehr Arbeit bedeutet

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’s going to help me deeply this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er wird mir diesmal echt tiefgehend helfen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Danke, dass du nach mir geschaut hast.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich muss die Prüfungen wohl doch machen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er hat ziemlich klar gemacht, dass ich das Diplom sonst nicht bekomme.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Okay… aber du hast gesagt, du hättest vielleicht eine Lösung?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich muss mehr Zeit mit ihm verbringen für die Prüfungen.
Extra-Sessions, so was in der Art.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das ist eigentlich gut. Ich bin froh, dass du deine Meinung geändert hast.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich bin zu Hause und versuche, das Abendessen zu machen, bevor wir unseren sehr ernsten Filmabend haben

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir müssen ihn nicht besprechen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er war nicht mal in der zweiten Hälfte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mit den Informationen gearbeitet, die ich damals hatte 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du warst sehr selbstsicher

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I trusted the scarf too much
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe dem Schal zu viel vertraut

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Fehler, den jeder große Detektiv machen könnte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hör auf zu lachen, der Film war zumindest so schlecht, wie ich versprochen habe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hast du gehalten

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es war schöner, es mit dir zu schauen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sogar mit meinem Kommentar?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zukünftige Du findet immer etwas, worüber man sich beschweren kann

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Besonders mit deinem Kommentar ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe das vermisst, einfach über etwas Dummes mit dir zu reden

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das sollten wir wiederholen, aber du suchst den nächsten aus

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst mir nicht die Schuld geben, dass deine Detektivkarriere heute Abend endet

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gehe als Unbesiegte in den Ruhestand, danke 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So ist es nicht passiert

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist die Geschichte, an die ich mich halte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gehe ins Bett, bevor du mich überredest, einen besseren zu schauen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schlaf gut

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur wenn das gegenwärtige Ich das Geschirr stehen lässt 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du auch, Hübscher ❤️ Ich bin froh, dass es heute für dein Bein ein bisschen einfacher war

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie viel hast du bisher gemacht?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine Pfanne, eine Schüssel, ein Löffel

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und einen zweiten Löffel, weil ich den ersten irgendwo dumm hingelegt habe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beeindruckende Effizienz

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du wirst weniger lachen, wenn du mein Meisterwerk siehst

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da, echtes Essen und kein Feuer in Sicht

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das sieht gut aus.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Attempting doesn't sound promising
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Versuchen klingt nicht vielversprechend

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es schmeckt auch gut, ich bin fast misstrauisch 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was hat der zweite Löffel beigetragen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moralische Unterstützung

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde daran denken, das nächste Mal, wenn ich koche

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du heute Abend richtig gegessen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ich habe gegessen und sitze auf dem Sofa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut ❤️ Ich melde mich, sobald ich den Rest weggeräumt habe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essen vorbereiten jetzt? Du hast dich wirklich verändert

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gewöhne dich nicht daran, ich mache das nur, weil ich morgen ausgehe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, ich wollte dir davon erzählen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hätte fast die leere Pfanne auf den Herd gestellt und die Nudeln im Schrank gelassen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mit dem Kollegen, den du neulich erwähnt hast?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My manager, actually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eigentlich mein Chef

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein Chef?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, wir haben heute wieder darüber gesprochen

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast vorher Kollege gesagt

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es getan.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hätte klarer sagen sollen, wen ich meinte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Geht sonst noch jemand?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, just us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, nur wir.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also, wir haben einen starken Start 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Richtig.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es ist nur ein Drink nach der Arbeit.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es gibt eine Bar ein paar Straßen vom Büro entfernt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gegen sieben, ich gehe direkt von der Arbeit.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du willst mitkommen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, will ich.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe die meiste Zeit der Woche damit verbracht, von der Uni zur Arbeit nach Hause zu gehen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich würde gerne etwas machen, das nicht eines von diesen drei Dingen ist.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich verstehe, dass du rausgehen willst.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielleicht fängst du mit dem Wasser an

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allein mit deinem Chef auszugehen, ist ein bisschen anders, als ich mir vorgestellt habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, wie das klingt.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vor allem nach dem, was du gesagt hast, dass er dich anders anschaut.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hätte das wahrscheinlich nicht so groß machen sollen.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast es mir gesagt, weil es dich gestört hat.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es hat mich überrascht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber ich fühle mich nicht unwohl in seiner Nähe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weiß er, dass du mit jemandem zusammen bist?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, das weiß er.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will das nicht in einen Streit verwandeln.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe Wasser, ich bin nicht ganz verloren

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch nicht.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will nur nicht herausfinden, dass ich nur die Hälfte der Geschichte gehört habe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deshalb sage ich dir, wohin wir gehen und mit wem.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich da bin.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn du zu Hause bist?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alles klar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will auch Zeit mit dir verbringen, weißt du.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was gibt's zum Abendessen?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Ich vermisse es, dich zu sehen, anstatt nur auf Nachrichten zu warten.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich vermisse dich auch ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
