story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay. Eine Überraschung innerhalb dessen, was wir tatsächlich besprochen haben, nicht, dass ich raten muss, wie weit die Antwort geht.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Genau.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du klingst überrascht.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Für jetzt reden wir nur darüber, Kontakt aufzunehmen und zu sehen, ob ein erstes Date sich richtig anfühlt.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Ich behandle das nicht so, als hätten wir schon alles andere vereinbart.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn sich etwas falsch anfühlt, sag ich dir das. Ich behalte das nicht für mich, um das Geheimnis zu bewahren.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich. Genauso bei mir.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alles klar. Das macht jetzt mehr Sinn für mich.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich glaube, ich würde lieber nicht alles verfolgen, während es passiert.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber danach würde ich gerne hören, wie es gelaufen ist und wie du dich gefühlt hast.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also lege ich mein Handy weg, führe das Gespräch und wir reden, wenn ich Zeit habe.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich versuche, den Moment nicht zu ruinieren.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Das klingt näher an dem, was ich meinte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay. Das kann ich machen.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn ich früher mit dir reden muss, mache ich das trotzdem.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich. Du musst dich nicht an einen Plan halten, wenn du mich brauchst.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass wir jetzt darüber gesprochen haben.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mir immer vorgestellt, wie ich auf mein Handy schaue und mich frage, ob ich dir etwas schicken sollte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich möchte nicht, dass du dir darüber Sorgen machst.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie war der Rest deines Tages?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Es ist einfacher, jetzt wo wir es tatsächlich gesagt haben.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was möchtest du also morgen machen?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde {{name:aiden}} fragen, ob wir nach dem Unterricht ein paar Minuten reden können.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich möchte erklären, dass wir darüber gesprochen haben, dass ich mit jemand anderem ausgehen könnte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und dass er jemand ist, mit dem ich dieses Gespräch führen würde.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Glaubst du, er wird glauben, dass du es ernst meinst?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben unseren Teil des Projekts abgeschlossen, also kann ich endlich aufhören, darüber nachzudenken.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Du versuchst wirklich, mich beschäftigt zu halten.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich hab nicht erwartet, dass du so etwas nach letzter Nacht vorschlägst.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mach nicht zu lange, sonst fang ich ohne dich an und kaufe nur Junkfood.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich stare seit zwanzig Minuten auf die gleiche Seite.
Wir könnten heute Abend Tacos machen.
Einkaufen + selbstgemachte Tacos. Bist du dabei?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Du bietest an, mit mir zu kochen?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Guten Morgen ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sie hat eine ständige Einladung

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Gut. Behalte das im Hinterkopf 🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Wie geht's deinem Bein nach gestern?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ein bisschen steif, als ich aufgestanden bin, aber besser, nachdem ich mich ein wenig bewegt habe

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich bin froh, dass wir gestoppt haben, als wir es getan haben

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich auch. Ich werde es heute Morgen ruhig angehen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Was hast du geplant?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ein paar Dinge im Haus heute Morgen, dann wahrscheinlich später ein paar Spiele

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und du?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich verbringe den Nachmittag mit meiner Familie

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich griff nach meiner Tasche und erinnerte mich, wo sie war

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Zuerst Mittagessen. Dann spielen wir anscheinend Karten

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Anscheinend?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich wurde informiert. Meine Teilnahme war nicht optional 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Versuch, mit deiner Würde zurückzukommen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich werde höher zielen. Ich werde gewinnen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das ist der Geist

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und dann werde ich ihnen gnädig erlauben, mich zu bewundern

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sehr gnädig

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Genau

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay, ich muss mich fertig machen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sie liegt immer noch neben dem Sofa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pass auf meine Tasche auf. Ich hole sie, wenn ich dich sehe

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Natürlich. Hab einen schönen Tag heute ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dir auch, Liebling

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mindestens einer von uns durfte letzte Nacht bei dir bleiben

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Deine Tasche war eine sehr stille Gesellschaft

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann häng dich nicht zu sehr daran 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Zu spät. Wir haben schon gefrühstückt

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ohne mich? Unhöflich

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hier ist die Person, die du stattdessen hättest einladen sollen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Okay, komm und hilf mir in der Küche.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Einige Zeit später, nach dem Kochen in der Küche.
Du bist echt nicht schlecht im Schneiden.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin immer noch diejenige, die für die Gewürze verantwortlich ist.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du bist auch diejenige, die das größte Chaos macht.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Und ich hab nur drei unnötige Dinge gekauft.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Hast du gerade ein Foto von mir gemacht?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Während ich Sauce im Gesicht habe?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du darfst das nicht sagen, während ich in Taco-Gewürz eingehüllt bin.
Nach gestern fühlt es sich… leichter an.
Du hast fast ein viertes gekauft.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Gewöhne dich nicht daran, dass ich so ruhig bin.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin nur so, weil die Tacos fast fertig sind.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Jetzt hör auf zu reden und hilf mir, das Essen anzurichten.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Die Kekse haben mich komisch angeguckt.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich gebe uns beiden eine solide 8/10.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Die 10 spare ich mir für den Tag, an dem wir nicht fast den Rauchmelder auslösen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du meinst, wenn du nicht fast den Rauchmelder auslöst.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Egal… Ich werde jetzt aufräumen und dann ins Bett fallen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin erschöpft, aber auf die beste Art

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Es hat mehr geholfen, als ich erwartet habe

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sonst fange ich an, wöchentliche Taco-Abende zu verlangen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Egal… Ich werde jetzt aufräumen und dann ins Bett fallen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Beweis, dass ich mindestens eine Tüte getragen hab.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sie schickt dir einen Kuss zurück 😘
Ich habe meine Karten fast fertig

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aber jedes Mal, wenn ich zufrieden aussehe, zwingt mich jemand, mehr zu ziehen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu so, als wäre deine Hand schrecklich

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Okay. Ich vertraue dir mein Ansehen an

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hast du eine gerade Miene behalten?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dann hat jemand gefragt, warum ich aussehe, als würde ich ein Verbrechen verbergen
Also muss der Bluff noch verbessert werden

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich glaube, ich brauche einen neuen Berater

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hart. Ich habe mit begrenzten Informationen gearbeitet

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sie haben gefragt, wem ich ständig schreibe

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hast du ihnen gesagt, dass du fachkundige Hilfe bekommst?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe gesagt, dass mein Freund mir hilft zu verlieren

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Du solltest ihnen die Chance geben, dich zu vermissen. Mach eine Pause

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Habe ich. Ich hole mir ein weiteres Stück Kuchen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin später am Nachmittag zu Hause

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe eine Idee. Ich sag dir Bescheid, wenn ich zu Hause bin ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut. Lass mich zuerst meinen sehr wichtigen Kuchen fertigessen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Plötzlich wird jeder sehr wettbewerbsfähig, wenn ich kurz davor bin zu gewinnen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Schau dir das Gesicht von jemandem an, der unfair behandelt wird

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Du siehst aus, als würdest du Rache planen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SPÄTER ABEND — Du bist wieder zu Hause und hast einen ruhigen Moment für dich.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wirklich?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Ich würde gerne mit dir spielen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du klingst immer so, als hättest du Spaß

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich dachte, ich probiere es lieber mit dir aus, anstatt nur davon zu hören

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann lass uns etwas finden, das uns beiden Spaß macht

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was ist mit dem Rennspiel, das du erwähnt hast?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das würde klappen. Wir können ein privates Rennen machen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Aber du musst mir zuerst die Steuerung erklären

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Abgemacht. Ich schicke dir eine Einladung, sobald du bereit bist

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER — Ihr startet beide das Rennspiel. Bevor ihr beginnt, erklärst du die Steuerung und lässt {{name:lena}} eine Übungsrunde fahren.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin zu Hause

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bereit. Bitte schätze meine Konzentration

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr professionell. Wie läuft die Übungsrunde?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin dreimal gegen dieselbe Wand gefahren

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bremse vor der Kurve, dann lenke

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du versuchst, beides mit voller Geschwindigkeit zu machen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich dachte, Geschwindigkeit ist der Sinn

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Auf der Straße zu bleiben hilft auch

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Noch eine Übungsrunde

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: NACH DEM ERSTEN RENNSPIEL

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich habe eine sehr ernsthafte Frage

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du bist so weit vor mir ins Ziel gekommen 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe es viel öfter gespielt. Vergleich dein erstes Rennen nicht damit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin auch mit der falschen Richtung stecken geblieben

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aber du bist sauber um die letzte Kurve gekommen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist die, gegen die du im Training immer gefahren bist

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das habe ich bemerkt.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Siehst du? Du bekommst das Timing schon hin.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Noch einmal.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gleiche Strecke?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Ich habe noch eine Rechnung mit ihr offen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich höre zu

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: NACH DEM ZWEITEN RENNEN — {{name:lena}} kommt zwar hinter dir ins Ziel, aber fährt die Strecke mit weniger Unfällen zu Ende.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Immer noch verloren.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Überprüf mal deine Zeit.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du bist viel schneller als beim ersten Rennen ins Ziel gekommen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich habe mich nur zweimal gedreht.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Genau. Du hast daran gedacht, vor den scharfen Kurven langsamer zu werden.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe deine Anweisungen in meinem Kopf wiederholt.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Die haben funktioniert. Das war eine viel bessere Runde.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du bist nett, weil ich deine Freundin bin.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich würde es dir sagen, wenn du nicht besser geworden wärst

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Würdest du heute Abend etwas mit mir spielen?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Die schnellere Runde liegt daran, dass du besser gefahren bist.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay, das ist eine gute Antwort ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Willst du aufhören oder eine andere Strecke ausprobieren?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Noch eine auf dieser Strecke.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich will sehen, ob ich es ganz ohne Unfälle hinbekomme.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: NACH EINEM LETZTEN RENNSPIEL

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte es fast.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast nur am Ende die Barriere gestreift.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Weil ich aufgeregt war und vergessen habe zu bremsen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Deine erste Hälfte war wirklich gut. Mach weiter so, und der Rest wird folgen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Warte. Fragst du MICH, ob ich spielen soll?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich will an einem anderen Abend ein Rematch.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Darüber würde ich mich sehr freuen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du musst immer noch lächeln, weil ich gefragt habe, oder?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ein bisschen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich mag es, das mit dir zu teilen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich auch. Auch wenn du nervig schwer zu fangen bist.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jetzt verstehst du, warum ich immer noch eine Runde mehr will.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Leider ja 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hast du als Kind solche Spiele gespielt?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Ich habe mich immer zur Seite gelehnt, als würde mir das beim Wenden helfen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das habe ich heute Abend auch gemacht 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann hast du ausgezeichnete Instinkte.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Offensichtlich hat jeder außer dem Auto verstanden, was ich wollte.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beim nächsten Mal arbeiten wir daran, das Auto einzubeziehen.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Danke, dass du heute Abend geduldig mit mir warst.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte eine gute Zeit. Du musst nicht gewinnen, damit ich Spaß beim Spielen mit dir habe.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte auch Spaß ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Ich mache mich für morgen bereit und gehe dann ins Bett.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht, Liebling. Danke, dass du mich zum Spielen eingeladen hast.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht ❤️ Wir machen das wieder.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Warum bist du so überrascht?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du schlägst das nie vor. Normalerweise erzähle ich dir von meinen Spielen

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich freue mich wirklich, dass du gefragt hast

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Heute habe ich den ganzen Tag frei.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Willst du mit mir shoppen gehen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich brauche neue Hosen. Der Arzt hat mir vor zwei Tagen den Gips abgenommen, also kann ich endlich wieder Hosen tragen, die richtig passen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe auf eine Ausrede gewartet, um ohne akademisches schlechtes Gewissen das Haus zu verlassen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Gib mir dreißig Minuten, um weniger wie ein Chaos auszusehen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ja. Wie fühlst du dich heute?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Immer noch ein bisschen müde, aber mein Kopf ist nicht mehr ganz matschig

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Gut. Wann siehst du deinen Professor wieder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Manchmal jeden Tag, wenn er denkt, ich brauch's.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er nimmt das mit den "extra Stunden" echt ernst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ ich habe beschlossen, dass wir diesen Film nie geschaut haben und mein Ruf immer noch intakt ist.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut, dann war ich nicht die Einzige

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und bei dir? Besser geschlafen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viel besser, ich bin aufgestanden und habe Frühstück gemacht, bevor ich mein Handy gecheckt habe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ohne eine Spur von Dingen zu hinterlassen, die du fallen gelassen hast?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein Löffel, aber den habe ich aufgehoben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin stolz auf deinen sehr ehrgeizigen Morgen ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe auch beide Schuhe angezogen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sitzt du?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich sitze

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Siehst du, du kannst lernen 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen auch dir, Detektiv.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie läuft dein Frühstück?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist okay, das Packen meiner Tasche ist das Problem

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich nehme die Pasta von gestern Abend mit, damit ich nicht von einem anderen Sandwich überfallen werde

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Zukünftige Du hat endlich etwas aus diesem Abendessen mitgenommen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sie hat Essen und eine extrem volle Tasche bekommen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Leg das Essen oben drauf

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann muss ich das Buch tragen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Trag das Buch

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du machst alles so einfach, wenn du nicht diejenige bist, die versucht, diesen Reißverschluss zu schließen 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du könntest etwas zu Hause lassen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fang nicht an, ich habe nicht mal gefrühstückt 😭.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich brauche alles davon

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Inklusive dem, was seit drei Wochen ganz unten liegt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du weißt nicht, was ganz unten ist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Weißt du?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Darum geht's nicht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Warte, ich glaube, ich hab's

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bitte schätze, dass ich angezogen und bereit bin, bevor die letzte Minute kommt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst wirklich gut aus ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, Hübscher 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Würde dir ein roter Schal besser helfen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Die Tasche sieht aus, als würde sie gleich einen Kampf verlieren

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lob das Mädchen, nicht das Gepäck

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das Mädchen ist bezaubernd. Das Gepäck hat mein Mitgefühl

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viel besser 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du heute Morgen wieder Unterricht?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, dann direkt zur Arbeit

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich würde gerne alles fertig bekommen, ohne in der letzten Stunde auf die Uhr zu starren

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein vernünftiges Ziel

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was hast du heute vor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde den Küchenschrank ausräumen, den ich immer gemieden habe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde deine Fernbedienung das nächste Mal verstecken, wenn ich vorbeikomme.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Die, bei der dir beim Öffnen alles entgegenfällt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich ziehe es vor, es als Überraschungsfeature zu betrachten.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du könntest auch einfach weniger Sachen reinpacken 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich mache Platz für die guten Kaffeetassen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wichtig, ich will nicht, dass unser erstes richtiges Kaffee-Date aus einem Messbecher kommt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast meine ganze Präsentation ruiniert.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Spar dir die Mühe für den Kaffee, ich werde die Tasse nicht zu sehr beurteilen ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich würde dich lieber bald mal ausführen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das fände ich toll.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, ich muss los, bevor zu früh sein bedeutet, den Bus zu verpassen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt nach einem Geständnis.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde wahrscheinlich heute Nachmittag nicht viel am Handy sein.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vergiss dein Mittagessen nicht nach all der Mühe.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es drückt schon in meine Seite, ich könnte es nicht vergessen, selbst wenn ich es wollte 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich heute Abend an der Bar bin, wie gesagt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, hab einen schönen Tag.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du auch, Hübscher ❤️ Ich liebe dich.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt wie eine Warnung 😌.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du wenigstens gut geschlafen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, als ich aufgehört habe, zu versuchen, wie das tatsächliche Ende Sinn macht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es hat nicht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Die zweite sieht weniger tragisch aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks for the vote of confidence

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du hast recht, B ist besser.
Siehst du, ich habe guten Geschmack.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab da drüben am Eingang was ganz Nettes gesehen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wir können danach was essen gehen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Wir sind an der Bar, und ich habe endlich irgendwo gesessen, das kein Bürostuhl ist.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst meine Empfehlungen weiter verspotten, aber du scheinst diese hier zu mögen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es hier.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, that wasn't difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siehst du, das war nicht schwer.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du wirst die ganze Nacht unerträglich sein, oder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur bis du aufhörst, überrascht zu tun, dass ich guten Geschmack habe.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das gebe ich dir nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das musst du nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du? Was machst du eigentlich, wenn du nicht im Büro bist?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Geh raus, such dir einen guten Ort zum Essen, fahr irgendwohin, wenn ich einen freien Tag habe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und sag allen, wo sie sitzen sollen, wenn du dort bist?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schön, noch nicht zu voll.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jemand muss sie davon abhalten, den Tisch neben den Toiletten auszuwählen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du leugnest es nicht einmal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why would I?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warum sollte ich?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann mich nicht entscheiden, ob das Selbstbewusstsein oder völliger Mangel an Scham ist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sag mir Bescheid, wenn du dich entschieden hast

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Während die Musiker am anderen Ende des Raumes aufbauen...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Spielen sie heute Abend hier?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks like it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sieht so aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, das wäre nur Equipment von einer anderen Nacht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein einziges Getränk ist fast leer

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben einen kleinen Tisch an der Seitenwand.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hältst du mich auf Zeit?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich überlege, ob ich die Speisekarte bestellen soll

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hier ist eine direkt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hast du bemerkt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe den ganzen Tag übrig gebliebene Pasta mit mir rumgetragen. Lass mich etwas anderes anschauen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein Handy schon wieder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm checking the time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich schaue auf die Uhr

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wartet dein Freund darauf, von dir zu hören?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe gesagt, ich lass ihn wissen, was ich mache

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sag ihm, das Essen ist gut

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warum?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Damit er weiß, warum du bleibst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe noch nicht gesagt, dass ich bleibe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du schaust schon seit fünf Minuten auf die Speisekarte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielleicht habe ich Hunger

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann bleib und iss mit mir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, ich möchte auch ein bisschen von der Musik hören

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber ich wähle das Essen aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd say that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das dachte ich, dass du das sagen würdest

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gib mir eine Minute, ich werde ihm Bescheid sagen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das sieht wirklich schön aus.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir werden etwas essen, bevor wir gehen, hier fängt gleich eine Band an 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also bleibst du ein bisschen länger?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ich hatte nicht bemerkt, dass sie heute Abend Live-Musik haben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was holst du dir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Fladenbrot und Pommes, nichts sehr Aufwendiges

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Besser, als dein Mittagessen den ganzen Abend mit dir rumzutragen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Behälter ist jetzt leer, er kann aufhören, meine Entscheidungen zu beurteilen 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, du gehst nur auf ein Getränk

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch, aber wir haben eine schöne Zeit und ich habe seit dem Mittagessen nichts gegessen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alles klar.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und der Stuhl versucht nicht, meinen Rücken zu zerstören, was ich sehr schätze.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich schreib dir, wenn ich zu Hause bin ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When the food arrives...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wenn das Essen ankommt...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abendessen, bevor ich alle Pommes esse 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sieht gut aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es riecht auch gut, ich werde essen, solange es heiß ist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guten Appetit

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk in a bit ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Reden wir gleich ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darf ich jetzt die Pommes essen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you ordered?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du schon bestellt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab ein Foto gemacht, du wirst überleben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sie sahen besser aus, ohne das Handy zwischen uns

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst meine Aufmerksamkeit haben, ohne so dramatisch zu sein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann leg es weg und probier das

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Fladenbrot?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, the tablecloth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, das Tischdecken

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Red weiter, und ich esse auch deinen Teil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab aus einem Grund extra Pommes bestellt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast deine Verwendungszwecke

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vorsicht, das ist fast ein weiteres Kompliment

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Noch nicht, ich schaue noch.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein paar Lieder in die Setliste...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you say?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was hast du gesagt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Rutsch mit deinem Stuhl hierher, ich schreie nicht über den Tisch

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hättest mich einfach bitten können, neben dir zu sitzen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hab ich gerade

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In the most bossy way possible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Auf die bossigste Art und Weise

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und trotzdem rutschst du mit dem Stuhl

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich dich nicht hören kann, schau nicht so zufrieden aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich halte dich nicht auf

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lass mich meine Tasche wegstellen, bevor du deinen Fuß durchtrittst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lass dich mal machen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bekommt das Buch auch einen eigenen Stuhl?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es hat bessere Manieren als du, es verdient einen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} rutscht mit ihrem Stuhl neben ihren Manager, um ihn über die Musik zu hören

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sie beugt sich näher, um ihm zu antworten, ihre Hand ruht kurz auf seinem Unterarm

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es ist ihre Hand auf seinem Arm, die mir zusetzt. So eine kleine Geste, und ich sitze hier und frage mich, wie viel näher sie sich noch kommen werden.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Little Closer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen näher

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know this one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Kennst du das hier?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, frag mich nicht, es zu singen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte den Abend nicht riskieren

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entschuldige, ich könnte sehr gut sein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Könnte sein. Ich genieße das zu sehr, um es herauszufinden

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du bist schrecklich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the cupboard survive you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hat der Schrank dich überlebt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast gelacht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das macht dich nicht weniger schrecklich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hier bist du anders

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weniger müde als ich um sechs war?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hältst tatsächlich meinen Blick, wenn du mit mir sprichst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielleicht schaust du zu viel

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like looking at you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich schaue dich gerne an

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du könntest versuchen, subtil zu sein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Könnte ich. Ich sehe keinen Sinn darin

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist mir aufgefallen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es liegt gerade in mehreren Haufen in der Küche.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schon eine Verbesserung.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nach dem Set, als die Teller abgeräumt sind...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich sollte die Buszeiten überprüfen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kümmere mich um die Rechnung

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann für mein Essen bezahlen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe dich eingeladen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das heißt nicht, dass ich nicht bezahlen kann

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das bedeutet, dass ich heute Abend bezahle

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So bist du wirklich überall

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hattest keinen langweiligen Abend, oder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, das gebe ich dir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also bist du an dem Punkt, an dem du bereust, angefangen zu haben 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich nehme es

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In etwa zwanzig Minuten kommt ein Bus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viel Zeit. Hol dir deine Jacke

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bitte?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hol dir bitte deine Jacke

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siehst du, du kannst lernen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Deeply
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tief.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lass mir wenigstens eine benutzbare Tasse, okay?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Keine Versprechen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lege mein Handy für eine Weile weg, ich schreibe dir, wenn ich zu Hause bin ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, bis später.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: An ihrem Tisch, ein wenig später...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Gespräch an der Bar wird in der Nähe von {{name:lena}} erkannt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sie sagte, sie würden nach der Arbeit etwas trinken gehen. Ich will glauben, dass ich dabei entspannt bleiben kann, aber ich schaue ständig auf den Bildschirm.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//LIVE TRANSKRIPTION

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du siehst gut aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast mich vor einer Stunde bei der Arbeit gesehen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es gibt auch Essen, also gewinnt es total 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast damals auch gut ausgesehen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ist das der Grund, warum du immer rübergeschaut hast?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dachtest du, ich würde überprüfen, ob du den Bericht fertig hast?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du solltest es sein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The report got finished, didn't it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Bericht ist fertig geworden, oder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Heute Abend kein Arbeitsthema

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast es angesprochen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann schon jetzt sagen, dass du anstrengend sein wirst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
