story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So sprichst du mit deinem Chef?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Soll ich dich daran erinnern, was mein Chef mir angetan hat?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du rechtzeitig fertig geworden?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ..was für ein schönes Wetter wir heute haben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah I thought so
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, das dachte ich mir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du lächelst, seit du dich hingesetzt hast. Ich nehme mein Glück in die Hand

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bist du immer so zufrieden mit dir selbst?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: An einem schönen Abend

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've barely started
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben kaum angefangen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Genau

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, bevor dein Kopf noch größer wird, was nimmst du?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nimm den Ingwer, der ist hier gut

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gibst du überall Anweisungen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So gut wie, ich musste den Lunchbehälter sehr vorsichtig wieder in meine Tasche packen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur wenn ich weiß, wovon ich rede

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also deiner Meinung nach überall

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du lernst mich kennen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unfortunately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Leider

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm having the orange one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich nehme den orangenen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur um mir zu widersprechen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich ihn mag. Schockierend, ich weiß

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, aber frag nicht nach meinem, wenn du deine Meinung änderst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mach dir keine Sorgen, ich würde dir nicht die Genugtuung geben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nachdem ihre Getränke angekommen sind...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trägst du das Buch immer noch mit dir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, der Tisch war eine gute Wahl

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So war die Bar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst ein Kompliment annehmen, ohne die anderen zu sammeln

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warum bei einem aufhören?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you come here a lot?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Kommst du oft hierher?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oft genug, um zu wissen, welcher Tisch nicht neben dem Lautsprecher ist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sehr strategisch

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe letzten Monat einen Freund hierher gebracht, um seinen Geburtstag zu feiern. Er hatte sechs Leute eingeladen und nichts reserviert.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt ja organisiert.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er nannte es spontan sein. Ich habe den Besitzer angerufen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, es hat einen ganzen Arbeitstag erlebt, ohne einmal geöffnet zu werden.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also ist deine Geschichte darüber, den Abend zu retten, eigentlich eine Geschichte darüber, jemanden zu kennen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben gegessen, oder?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hoffe, er hat dir danach das Abendessen bezahlt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich. Wenn ich es organisiere und dafür bezahle, können wir stattdessen meinen Geburtstag feiern.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da ist es.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Teil, wo du dich selbst zur Hauptattraktion machst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst gerne die nächste Geschichte erzählen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich glaube nicht, dass ich mit deiner heldenhaften Tischreservierung konkurrieren kann.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst es versuchen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A useful contribution
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein nützlicher Beitrag.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, gestern hat mein Professor zehn Minuten lang die falsche Folie erklärt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hat niemand etwas gesagt?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben alle mitgeschrieben. Ich hatte eine halbe Seite, bevor jemand endlich gefragt hat.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hättest ihn unterbrechen sollen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war beschäftigt damit anzunehmen, dass er mehr wusste als ich.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Machst du diesen Fehler bei jedem, der das Sagen hat?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Immer weniger in letzter Zeit.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war kein Kompliment für dich.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es nicht so aufgefasst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Emotionale Unterstützungs-Literatur 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes a change
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist mal eine Abwechslung.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} lacht mit ihrer Chefin über ihre Drinks.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses Lächeln tut mehr weh, als ich erwartet habe. Früher hatte ich dabei das Gefühl, dass ich der Mensch bin, bei dem sie sein will.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Away From the Office
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weg vom Büro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was machst du, wenn der Unterricht endet?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schlafen, bis ich meinen Wecker nicht mehr hasse.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danach

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will einen Tag am Strand mit einem Buch und ohne Zeitplan.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht so eine große organisierte Sache, nur genug Zeit, dass ich nicht ständig auf mein Handy schauen muss.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kenne einen schönen Abschnitt, der vom Hauptstrand entfernt ist.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich weißt du das.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's the place like?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie ist der Ort?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich hoffe, dein Professor gibt dir morgen eine Menge Strafübungen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
Extra work with him is… fine
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Zusätzliche Arbeit mit ihm ist... in Ordnung.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Egal, ich geh jetzt schlafen, bevor du mich wieder ausfragst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wir sind shoppen gegangen für meine Hose und irgendwie hast du trotzdem mehr Sachen gekauft als ich.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du bist eine Bedrohung für die Einkaufsindustrie.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und trotzdem hast du mich eingeladen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Etwas nach neun, draußen vor der Bar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du klingst wie ich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Jemand muss es tun

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Okay, ich hole es in einer Minute 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Wie war dein Nachmittag? Hast du den Schrank fertig gemacht?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Habe ihn fertig gemacht und dann irgendwie mit der Schublade darunter angefangen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: So geht's dir!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe genug Takeaway-Besteck gefunden, um ein Restaurant zu eröffnen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bitte sag mir, dass du etwas davon weggeworfen hast!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Den Großteil.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Den Großteil?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Mach, dass ich es nicht bereue, es gesagt zu haben

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Es könnte eine plötzliche Gabel-Notlage geben!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das behalte ich im Hinterkopf, falls meine verschwinden sollte 😌.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Es ist tatsächlich schön, es sortiert zu haben.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Jetzt kannst du die Tassen finden, ohne dass dir etwas auf den Kopf fällt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du wirst beeindruckt sein!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Darüber wollte ich dich fragen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Meine Gabelsammlung?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Komme vorbei, Idiot ❤️.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe die Öffnungszeiten für morgen überprüft, bevor ich heute gegangen bin. Ich bin um fünf fertig.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Kann ich nach der Arbeit vorbeikommen? Gegen sechs?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Zu spät, ich behalte das

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, klar!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hast du nicht noch etwas anderes vor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nein, ich möchte den Abend mit dir verbringen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das würde mir auch gefallen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Wir können etwas zu essen machen, und du kannst einen Film aussuchen, der uns beide nicht beleidigt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bist du dir sicher, dass du ohne einen Kriminalfall klar kommst?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich werde stattdessen den Küchenschrank untersuchen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eine viel gefährlichere Aufgabe!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich bringe Schutzausrüstung mit 😭.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe es vermisst, dich hier zu haben.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Offensichtlich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe es auch vermisst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Und ich will eine echte Umarmung, nicht noch eine Nachricht darüber.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das lässt sich einrichten.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gut ❤️ Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich morgen die Arbeit verlasse.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich werde hier sein.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du solltest es besser sein, ich werde nicht den ganzen Tag warten, nur um herauszufinden, dass du weg bist 😌.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich mache Platz auf dem Sofa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nimm nicht das gute Kissen!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Immer noch Forderungen aus deinem eigenen Haus stellen!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Immer ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Deine Haltestelle ist hier unten

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Okay, ich gehe ins Bett, bevor ich mit dem Licht an einschlafe.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hast du die Brotdose rausgenommen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, sie ist im Waschbecken. Du kannst jetzt aufhören, mich zu überwachen 😭.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich werde darüber nachdenken.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gute Nacht, Hübscher, liebe dich ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich liebe dich auch, bis morgen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bis morgen ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich weiß, wo sie ist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Die Musik war gut. Ich wäre länger geblieben, wenn ich morgen nichts zu tun hätte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das wissen wir für das nächste Mal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du entscheidest dich schon für das nächste Mal?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich sage, ich würde dich nochmal ausführen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du könntest ein bisschen Platz für Ungewissheit lassen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das Gespräch geht weiter, während die beiden zur Bushaltestelle gehen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sie gehen zusammen hinaus. Ich sollte froh sein, dass der Abend zu Ende geht, aber ich werde das Gefühl nicht los, auf etwas Schlimmeres zu warten.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//LIVE TRANSKRIPTION

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Warum? Ich weiß, was ich will.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das muss schön sein.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du hast dich auch nicht gerade zur Tür gedrängt.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nein, das war ich nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sie halten an einer ruhigeren Ecke, mit der Bushaltestelle weiter die Straße entlang sichtbar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich wollte dich die ganze Nacht über wieder küssen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du behältst wirklich nichts für dich.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nicht das.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Komm nicht zu früh in Schwung.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dann hör auf, auf meinen Mund zu schauen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe nicht gemerkt, wie laut es drinnen war, bis wir nach draußen kamen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das tue ich nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe einen Freund. Das hat sich seit gestern nicht geändert.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich weiß. Ich tue nicht so, als hätte ich dich nur eingeladen, um über die Arbeit zu reden.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nein, das hast du sehr deutlich gemacht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Kannst du einmal aufhören, so selbstgefällig auszusehen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das machst du mir schwer.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}} zieht ihn näher an seiner Jacke.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Der Manager beugt sich vor und küsst sie; sie erwidert den Kuss.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Diesmal zieht sie ihn näher zu sich. Ich kann mir nicht mehr einreden, dass nur er ihr das angetan hat.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vor dem Bus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sag es nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Was sagen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du hast es geschafft, dich Gehör zu verschaffen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Was auch immer selbstgefällig du gleich sagen willst.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich wollte sagen, dass ich einen schönen Abend hatte.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Irgendwie hast du das trotzdem selbstgefällig klingen lassen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du wirst dich daran gewöhnen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Übertreib es nicht.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Es ist einen Versuch wert.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich muss jetzt gehen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dein Bus ist noch nicht hier.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich weiß, aber ich werde an der Haltestelle warten.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Okay. Bis morgen.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nur weil du mich dazu gebracht hast, mich ganz rüberzulehnen, um zu antworten

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bei der Arbeit.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Da werde ich sein.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gute Nacht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night, {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gute Nacht, {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ein bisschen später, im Bus nach Hause...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich bin im Bus ❤️ Ich bin bald zu Hause.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hast du einen Platz bekommen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, und meine Tasche wurde endlich von meiner Schulter genommen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das Buch wird erleichtert sein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Es hatte einen viel aufregenderen Tag, als es verdient hat 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Es schien dir nichts auszumachen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: War es ein langer Weg zur Haltestelle?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nein, er ist mit mir bis zur Ecke gelaufen, dann habe ich gewartet, um den Bus zu nehmen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Okay

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich schicke dir eine Nachricht, wenn ich drinnen bin

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Alles klar.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Once she is home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sobald sie zu Hause ist...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hey ❤️ Ich bin zu Hause, hast du es geschafft, wach zu bleiben?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, ich bin immer noch hier

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tut mir leid, wir sind später geblieben, als ich erwartet hatte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hattest du eine gute Zeit?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du bist sehr schnell darin zu entscheiden, was ich mag und was nicht

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, hatte ich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das Essen war gut und die Band hat schließlich ein ganzes Set gespielt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Was für Musik?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vor allem Covers, ein paar kannte ich und mehrere, die ich vorgegeben habe zu kennen 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Machst du das?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ein sehr überzeugendes Nicken bringt dich überraschend weit

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich werde mir das merken, das nächste Mal, wenn du mich etwas spielen siehst

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das ist ganz anders, ich verstehe immer deine hochkomplizierten Spielentscheidungen 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Klar, das tust du

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Die Bar war schön. Ich war vorher noch nie dort

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dann sag mir mal. Hattest du einen guten Abend?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hat dein Manager das ausgesucht?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, und er hat einen großen Teil des Abends damit verbracht, sicherzustellen, dass ich seinen ausgezeichneten Geschmack schätze

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Klingt, als wäre er außerhalb der Arbeit genauso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Er mag es definitiv, seinen Willen durchzusetzen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Und du?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich habe ihn dazu gebracht, 'bitte' hinzuzufügen, als er mir sagte, ich solle meine Jacke holen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Große Leistung

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm choosing to count it 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich wähle, es zu zählen 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Du klingst, als hättest du Spaß gehabt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hatte ich, es war schön, mal rauszukommen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ja, das hatte ich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm glad you're home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich bin froh, dass du zu Hause bist

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ich auch ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gib mir eine Minute zum Umziehen, ich will nicht länger in diesen Klamotten sitzen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Okay

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A few minutes later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ein paar Minuten später...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Da, keine Schuhe und nichts mehr zu tragen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Das sieht bequemer aus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Viel. Die Tasche kann bis morgen warten

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nimm wenigstens die Brotdose raus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There we go
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Da haben wir es

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Also, wie fühlt sich der zukünftige Absolvent heute?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, endlich mein Diplom in den Händen zu halten.
Ich hab vergessen, dass er reich ist 😭.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Leicht zu vergessen, wenn er immer in Sportkleidung ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Will ich vor allem meinen Sommerbody.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dieser Kommentar gestern hat dich echt getroffen, hm?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich will diesen Sommer gut im Bikini aussehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
We have a session planned today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Wir haben heute eine Sitzung geplant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich bin mir über das Diplom noch nicht ganz sicher.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und du bist diejenige, die vorgeschlagen hat, dass ich ihn behalte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aber ich werde bis zum Ende weiterdrücken.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass das Lernen mit Ethan dir so viel Motivation gibt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Die Karotte am Ende des Stocks ist echt motivierend 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du versuchst es nicht mal mehr zu verbergen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Du kannst runterkommen, wann immer du willst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen ❤️ Ich habe einen Ohrring verloren und irgendwie entschieden, dass es deine Schuld ist. Wie läuft dein Morgen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war verdächtig geschmeidig für jemanden, der gerade aufgewacht ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin schon eine Weile wach.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Konntest du nicht schlafen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin früh aufgewacht und konnte mich nicht wieder bequem machen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nichts Dramatisches, nur ein Streit mit den Kissen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hättest mir schreiben können.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hättest geantwortet und mich dann dafür verantwortlich gemacht, dass ich müde bin.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist ganz anders, als dir die Schuld für den Schmuck zu geben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Natürlich

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Warte, ich habe es gefunden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist eine beeindruckende Anschuldigung vor dem Frühstück.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es war die ganze Zeit in meinem Ärmel festgeklebt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich hätte diese Entschuldigung gerne schriftlich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lieber Hübscher, ich bedauere, dass die Beweise meine sehr vernünftige Anschuldigung nicht unterstützt haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Akzeptiert.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ausgezeichnet, hilf mir jetzt zu entscheiden, ob das zusammenpasst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Beide Ohrringe, beide Schuhe, echte Vorlesungsnotizen in der Tasche.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sehr überzeugender Eindruck von einer Frau, die ihr Leben im Griff hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, es hat mehrere Versuche gebraucht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe deine Nachrichten gelesen, während ich sie angezogen habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ja, sie sehen gut zusammen aus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut, denn ich werde mich nicht nochmal umziehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hättest mir nie zugehört, oder?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nicht, wenn du falsch lagst 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie fühlst du dich heute?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe {{name:aiden}} geschrieben, bevor ich mich fertig gemacht habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich gelacht, einen fallen lassen und jetzt habe ich ein sehr elegantes Ohr.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Habe gefragt, ob er ein paar Minuten nach dem Unterricht hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was hat er gesagt?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, und dann hat er gefragt, ob er die geliehenen Notizen mitbringen soll.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Zumindest erinnert er sich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Er hat immer noch keine Ahnung, worüber ich sprechen will.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was mich dazu bringt, die ganze Sache per Text zu erklären, nur um den ersten Satz hinter mich zu bringen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Würde das wirklich einfacher machen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Für etwa zehn Sekunden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann würde ich den ganzen Morgen darüber nachdenken, ob er über sein Handy lacht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du darfst mit etwas Peinlichem anfangen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lass mich den Schaden sehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, aber ich hatte gehofft, gleich charmant sein zu können.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das hast du bei mir geschafft.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du warst ein ungewöhnlich nachsichtiger Zuhörer ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast mich beim ersten Scherz gewonnen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann sollte ich vielleicht damit anfangen, ihm zu sagen, dass er nervig ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Er merkt vielleicht nicht, dass das hier ein besonderes Gespräch ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Genau das ist mein Problem.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde nach dem Unterricht richtig mit ihm reden, bevor ich mir eine weitere Ausrede einrede.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du klingst viel zu erfreut darüber.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Profil veröffentlicht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Schon?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bevor ich die Einleitung zum sechsten Mal umschreiben konnte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das Foto von gestern Abend, der Teil über eine Beziehung und mein sehr attraktives Nudelproblem.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eine starke Einleitung.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe hinzugefügt, dass ich einen echten Kaffee in einem echten Café meine, nicht jemanden, der sich selbst zu mir einlädt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt ganz nach dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Handy danach mit dem Bildschirm nach unten hingelegt, als könnte es anfangen, mir Anweisungen zu geben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du weißt, dass du während des Unterrichts nichts beantworten musst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das weiß ich, und ich lasse es bis zur Pause in Ruhe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vor allem, weil ich nicht will, dass meine erste Antwort einen Satz aus der heutigen Vorlesung enthält.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Kommt auf die Vorlesung an.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Kein Mann verdient meine Notizen über Forschungsmethoden als Einleitung.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vielleicht findest du jemanden mit ganz speziellen Interessen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe schon so jemanden 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fair genug

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es fühlt sich komisch an, dass es jetzt wirklich da ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich bin froh, dass ich den Knopf gedrückt habe, anstatt noch einen Tag mit Kommas rumzuhängen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich sehe das Problem.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wann bist du fertig?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gegen Mittag, es sei denn, jemand findet eine Frage, gerade als wir gehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich muss ein Buch zurückgeben, bevor die Bibliothek mir höflich drohende E-Mails schickt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein arbeitsreicher Tag, um deinen Feinden gegenüberzutreten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du, Uni, die Bibliothek.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich stehe auf der Liste?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast mich vermissen lassen, während ich versucht habe, mich anzuziehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gern geschehen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war kein Dankeschön.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe deine Pasta übrigens in einen separaten Behälter gepackt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Endlich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Jetzt habe ich einen sehr praktischen Grund, bald vorbeizukommen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast schon mehrere sehr unpraktische Gründe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Die sind meine Favoriten ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, ich gehe jetzt, bevor ich wieder mit dir anfange zu quatschen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Viel Glück heute

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, Hübscher.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und iss ein Frühstück, das nicht aus einer Tüte neben der Konsole kommt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast meine Optionen erheblich eingegrenzt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst immer noch wunderschön aus, was deine Argumentation gegen mich schwächt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du stehst immer noch auf ihn, oder?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich bin bereit, lass uns gehen, bevor du noch etwas Schlimmeres sagst

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich wähle immer noch mein Outfit aus

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're not going to a party
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du gehst nicht zu einer Party

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich weiß… aber ich will trotzdem gut aussehen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aber mit dem Outfit wird er nur auf deinen Hintern starren

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich kann immer noch nicht glauben, dass du nach der Hauptprüfung weitermachst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich habe einen echt guten Betreuer.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Oder besser gesagt… echt gute Strafen und Belohnungen 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du musst aber trotzdem wirklich lernen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es ist schwer, sich zu konzentrieren, wenn du das machst…

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Diesmal kam die Belohnung also vor der Arbeit, und meine Gefühle dazu lassen sich nicht mehr so leicht mit einem Witz überspielen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat Beweise für die physische Belohnung während der Studieneinheit archiviert

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich werde mein Bestes geben, damit du die beste Note bekommst

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
Why doesn't he just come to the house?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Warum kommt er nicht einfach zum Haus?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wir fühlen uns bei ihm wohler.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey 😊 Die Kurse sind vorbei, ich habe das Bibliotheksbuch zurückgebracht und mir einen sonnigen Platz auf den Stufen geklaut.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil, wenn wir so etwas versuchen, ich lieber mit jemandem zusammenarbeiten würde, dem wir vertrauen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ihr beide?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Er vertraut dir, und ich auch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß, dass du über absolut alles Witze machen kannst, aber ich weiß auch, dass ich dir sagen kann, wenn etwas wichtig ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: War das der Teil, der dich endlich zum Schweigen gebracht hat?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Für einen Moment, ja.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das bedeutet mir wirklich viel. Ich habe diesen Teil auch nicht erwartet.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sieh nicht so überrascht aus. Ich sage gelegentlich auch nette Dinge über dich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalerweise ohne mich danach sofort einen Idioten zu nennen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie lief der Morgen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das kann ich immer noch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da ist sie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das berührt mich. Wirklich. Es ist nur auch echt komisch zu wissen, dass mein Freund damit einverstanden ist, dass ich mit seiner Freundin ausgehe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst berührt sein und es seltsam finden. Ich schaffe es, gleichzeitig neugierig und verlegen zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe den verlegenen Teil bemerkt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich hast du das.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast fünf Minuten damit verbracht, meinen Blick zu vermeiden, nachdem du hierher gekommen bist, um mich um ein Date zu bitten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hatte gehofft, du würdest das nicht ansprechen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast mich nicht wegen meiner Fähigkeit gewählt, still zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das war offensichtlich ein Versehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ganz gut, als ich tatsächlich anfing zuzuhören.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber du willst das wirklich? Nicht nur, weil er die Idee mag?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wäre nicht hierher gekommen, wenn ich nur ihn glücklich machen wollte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mag es, in deiner Nähe zu sein. Ich bin neugierig, wie es sich anfühlen würde, wenn wir aufhören würden, so zu tun, als wäre das ganze Flirten nur ein Scherz.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast es also bemerkt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist nicht annähernd so subtil, wie du denkst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe versucht, charmant zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Manchmal funktioniert es. Mach mich nicht traurig, dass ich das zugegeben habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst es mir echt schwer, dabei locker zu bleiben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du warst nicht mehr locker, seit ich den ersten Satz gesagt habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fair. Und ja, ich würde dich gerne auf einen Kaffee einladen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Obwohl ich das Datum dreimal an die falsche Stelle geschrieben habe, bevor ich es bemerkt habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du dir sicher?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Überrascht, nicht desinteressiert. Das ist ein Unterschied.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut, denn für einen Moment sahst du aus, als würdest du den Ausgang suchen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe versucht, mir etwas weniger Peinliches einfallen zu lassen, als dich zu bitten, das Ganze ein drittes Mal zu wiederholen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schätze die Mühe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mag dich. Ein peinliches Gespräch hat es nicht plötzlich schwer gemacht, das zuzugeben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einige von uns haben etwas länger gebraucht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das habe ich bemerkt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und bevor du zu stolz auf dich wirst, ich rede von einem ersten Date. Nichts darüber hinaus ist entschieden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Ein Kaffee, und dann sehen wir, wie es sich anfühlt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine abgelenkte Studentin? Das klingt ja gar nicht nach dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Auch wenn es sich komisch anfühlt?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann fühlt es sich komisch an. Ich werde trotzdem über den Kaffee meckern und dir nächste Woche deine Pommes klauen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Idealerweise ohne dem ganzen Tisch zu erzählen, warum wir ausgegangen sind.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich. Ich mache nur Spaß mit dir, nicht dass ich es allen sage.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oder ihn bereuen lassen, ehrlich zu mir zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Ich brauche vielleicht einen Moment, um nicht zu grinsen, wenn ich ihn das nächste Mal sehe, aber ich werde ihn nicht schlecht fühlen lassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wirklich nicht?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er vertraut mir. Du hast mir gerade gesagt, dass du es auch tust. Ich werde da nicht dumm sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nur über alles andere?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erwarten wir keine Wunder.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wähle, das zu ignorieren 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke. Im Ernst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gern geschehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kaffee morgen? Da gibt's dieses Café in der Nähe des Campus mit den unterschiedlichen Stühlen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das, wo du dich beschwert hast, dass die Tassen zu klein waren?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die waren echt zu klein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
