story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das klingt schon wie unsere normalen Gespräche.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich versuche, dich langsam ranzuführen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Morgen könnte klappen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wollen wir die Uhrzeit später entscheiden? Ich muss schauen, wann meine letzte Stunde endet.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, message me when you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, schreib mir, wenn du's weißt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I might be a little awkward at first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich könnte am Anfang ein bisschen unbeholfen sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll give you something to complain about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann gebe ich dir was, worüber du dich beschweren kannst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You do that without trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das schaffst du auch ohne es zu versuchen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See? We have a system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Siehst du? Wir haben ein System.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bis morgen!

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bis morgen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 25 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben geredet, und er hat gesagt, dass er morgen mit mir einen Kaffee trinken möchte 😊.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie fühlst du dich?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Als ob ich seit dem Frühstück meine Schultern bis zu den Ohren hochgezogen habe und es erst jetzt bemerkt habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can put them down now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst sie jetzt entspannen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich versuche es.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er weiß, dass wir über ihn gesprochen haben, und dass ich dir das nicht verheimliche.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben nur einen Kaffee ausgemacht, nichts weiter.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did talking to him feel all right?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und hat es sich gut angefühlt, mit ihm zu reden?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe mein Handy in meiner Tasche gelassen, bis wir fertig waren, wie wir gesagt haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er versteht, dass du Bescheid weißt, und wir haben uns auf einen Kaffee geeinigt, ohne Versprechungen über etwas anderes zu machen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du dich wirklich auf das Gespräch konzentrieren konntest.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich auch, ich hatte schon genug in meinem Kopf.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich behalte die kleinen Details für mich, wie wir gesagt haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber der wichtige Teil ist gut, und er versteht, dass du Bescheid weißt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nur ein Kaffee morgen, nichts, was wir darüber hinaus entschieden haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann sag mir, wie du dich fühlst, anstatt mir das ganze Gespräch zu erzählen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erleichtert und ein bisschen stolz auf mich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich dachte, ich würde mich fühlen, als würde ich das Selbstvertrauen von jemand anderem ausleihen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber nachdem ich den unangenehmen Teil gesagt hatte, war ich immer noch ich selbst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's the person he knows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist die Person, die er kennt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, ich glaube, ich musste mich daran erinnern.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und es gab einen Moment, in dem ich realisierte, dass ich tatsächlich wollte, dass er ja sagt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie war das für dich?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Persönlicher als als wir nur über die Idee gesprochen haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nicht schlecht, gerade genug, um meinen nächsten Satz zu verlieren.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}} steht am Tor zum Innenhof.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did the library forgive you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hat dir die Bibliothek vergeben?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du, sprachlos? Ich bemühe mich sehr, nicht zu erfreut darüber auszusehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Auf keinen Fall, du hättest ein Gesicht gemacht und ich hätte angefangen zu lachen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier, das ist die Version, die sich etwas erholt hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very good smile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ein sehr schönes Lächeln

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I can't quite get rid of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß, ich kann es einfach nicht loswerden

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das musst du nicht

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me do it again ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bringst mich dazu, es wieder zu tun ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er wird mir später seinen Zeitplan sagen, dann suchen wir uns einen Zeitpunkt aus

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight when you're settled
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag mir heute Abend Bescheid, wenn du dich eingerichtet hast

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him I'd be there in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass ich in einer Minute dort sein werde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will, I need to go get something to eat first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach ich, ich muss zuerst etwas essen gehen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've had a few messages on the app
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ein paar Nachrichten in der App bekommen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anything you feel like answering?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gibt's was, worauf du antworten möchtest?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One or two, yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein oder zwei, ja

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde mich irgendwo mit einem Getränk hinsetzen und sie wirklich lesen, anstatt alles zwischen den Türen zu öffnen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wahrscheinlich bequemer, als am Ausgang der Bibliothek zu stehen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wahrscheinlich werde ich auch nicht so höflich entfernt

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schreibe dir, sobald ich die Gelegenheit hatte, richtig zu reden

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you still happy to talk to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du immer noch froh, mit ihm zu sprechen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 50 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 50 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe mein Getränk ausgetrunken und irgendwie eine Person gefunden, mit der ich weiter reden wollte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds promising
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das klingt vielversprechend

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es war nicht der Mann, der gefragt hat, ob ich wirklich Single bin

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihn auf den ersten Satz meines Profils verwiesen und das Gespräch dort beendet

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An efficient reading comprehension test
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein effizienter Leseverständnistest

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very efficient
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sehr effizient

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the other conversation was nice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber das andere Gespräch war schön

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat tatsächlich gelesen, was ich geschrieben habe, einschließlich des Teils über dich

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, ich muss einfach aufhören, zu versuchen, vorher zu entscheiden, wie das ganze Gespräch verlaufen wird.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did that make it awkward?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hat das die Situation awkward gemacht?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat gefragt, ob das etwas war, worauf wir uns geeinigt hatten, ich habe ja gesagt, und er hat nicht weiter versucht, es geheim zu halten

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann konnten wir ein ganz normales Gespräch führen, was ich wollte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was hat dich dazu gebracht, ihm zu antworten?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eines seiner Bilder war eine sehr verbrannte Pizza mit einer Entschuldigung darunter

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also hast du ihn wegen seines Kochens gewählt

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihn gewählt, weil es mich zum Lachen gebracht hat, was ein vernünftiger Anfang schien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seine erste Nachricht fragte, ob die imaginären Leute, für die ich koche, jemals beim Abwasch geholfen haben

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Besser, als zu fragen, ob du single bist

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einen Satz nach dem anderen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine deutliche Verbesserung

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass sie schreckliche Gäste waren, und er sagte, sein einziger Dinner-Gast hätte einmal einen Feuerlöscher als Witz mitgebracht

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wegen der Pizza?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Offenbar gab es mehrere Versuche vor der Pizza auf dem Foto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kann mich nicht entscheiden, ob die Hartnäckigkeit bewundernswert ist

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst ihn nicht für dich kochen lassen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das erwähnt und er hat sofort einen Ort mit echtem Personal vorgeschlagen 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das klingt vernünftig von ihm

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er ist sechsundzwanzig, arbeitet in der Stadt und gehört nicht zu unserem Uni-Kreis.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kenne ihn noch nicht, aber ich fand es toll, dass er reden konnte, ohne mich in jedem zweiten Satz beeindrucken zu wollen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ärgerlich vernünftig.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fühlst du dich wohl, mit ihm zu reden?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bisher ja, und er hat mich zum Lachen gebracht, ohne sich zu sehr anzustrengen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einige kleine Details behalte ich für mich, aber das ist jemand Neues, niemand aus unserem Freundeskreis.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das reicht fürs Erste.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich fand es auch gut, dass ich mir ein paar Minuten Zeit nehmen konnte, um zu antworten, ohne dass er fragte, wo ich hingegangen bin.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es ist ein guter Anfang, das Handy nicht wie Hausaufgaben wirken zu lassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich lege jetzt mein Handy weg, sonst rede ich weiter mit dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Als wir aufgehört haben, haben wir darüber gesprochen, morgen einen Kaffee zu trinken.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du schon einen Ort ausgesucht?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das Café in der Nähe der Hauptstraße vorgeschlagen, das mit den großen Fenstern.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Irgendwo, das ich kenne, am Nachmittag, und nur ein Getränk, um zu sehen, ob wir uns persönlich verstehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fühlt sich das nach etwas an, das du machen möchtest?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe mich dabei ertappt, den Vorschlag zu tippen, bevor er gefragt hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hat mich mehr überrascht als die Nachrichten überhaupt zu bekommen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du klingst glücklich darüber.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach weiter. Ich bin später hier ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe nicht nach jemandem gesucht, um eine Liste abzuhaken, ich hatte ein Gespräch, das mir gefallen hat, und wollte ein weiteres.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das klingt mehr nach dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es fühlte sich auch nach mir an.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und es hat geholfen, nicht gleichzeitig versuchen zu müssen, dich auf dem Laufenden zu halten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt kann ich wirklich mit dir reden, anstatt zwischen zwei Gesprächen hin und her zu springen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ziehe ich vor, als von jedem nur einen halben Satz zu bekommen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Übrigens, das ist deine Freundin, die es geschafft hat, eine normale Nachricht zu senden, ohne sie zwanzigmal umschreiben zu müssen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst zufrieden mit dir selbst aus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das bin ich, und ich gönne mir fünf Minuten davon.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst dir mehr als fünf gönnen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gefährlich, ich könnte unerträglich werden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich nehme das Risiko auf mich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dieses Foto ist übrigens für dich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gebe niemand anderem die Version von mir, die einen sehr kleinen Sieg feiert 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde das Exklusive schätzen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bestätige die Uhrzeit später, wenn ich weiß, ob das Gruppentreffen morgen am Vormittag bleibt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag es mir heute Abend.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach ich ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vergiss nicht, dass du einen Freund hast, der auch Gespräche abseits der Uni mag.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe dich keine Sekunde lang vergessen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber erzähl mir eine gewöhnliche Sache aus deinem Tag, bevor ich gehe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ein Spiel geöffnet, um eine Sache zu tun, und habe eine halbe Stunde damit verbracht, die Steuerung zu ändern.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist schmerzhaft glaubhaft.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich dachte schon, du hättest einen anderen Ausgang gefunden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die Frau am Schalter hat mich nicht einmal angesehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann habe ich sie zurückgeändert, weil ich die alten lieber mochte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke, das hat mich viel produktiver fühlen lassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gern geschehen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schreib mir später, ich will wissen, ob du es wirklich spielst ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fast, aber ich habe den Ruf, zuverlässig zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seit wann?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst einen ausgezeichneten ersten Eindruck.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erster Eindruck? Ich dachte, ich hätte das längst hinter mir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm schon, lass uns ein bisschen spazieren.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zwei Personen betreten den Innenhof.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das Gespräch geht weiter.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kann ihr Raum zum Entscheiden geben, ohne so zu tun, als würde ich nichts fühlen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weg von der Menge.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay, jetzt machst du mich wirklich neugierig.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erinnerst du dich, was ich gestern gesagt habe? Dass ich an einem ruhigeren Ort reden wollte?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, und ich war sehr reif, weil ich dich nicht zwölfmal gefragt habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hatte eine Entschuldigung für eine Maschine vorbereitet, die dann nur gepiepst hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schätze die Mühe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist das ein guter Platz?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, lass uns eine Minute sitzen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst wieder dieses Ding mit dem Riemen deiner Tasche.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was für ein Ding?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du drehst ihn um deine Finger.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist mir nicht aufgefallen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst das hier nicht perfekt klingen lassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist eine gefährliche Menge an Freundlichkeit von dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich halte die Witze zurück, bis ich weiß, worüber wir reden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein sehr bewegender Austausch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} und ich haben darüber gesprochen, dass ich mich mit jemand anderem verabrede

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte, was zur Hölle?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen leiser, bitte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sorry, aber... {{name:player}} will, dass du dich mit einem anderen Typen verabredest?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Wir reden schon eine Weile darüber.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warum? Ist etwas zwischen euch beiden passiert?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, wir sind glücklich zusammen. Es geht nicht darum, uns zu trennen oder jemanden zu finden, der ihn ersetzt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann habe ich definitiv etwas verpasst, denn ich würde mich fragen, warum meine Freundin mit jemand anderem ausgehen will.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat das Thema angesprochen. Er mag die Idee, dass ich mit jemand anderem zusammen bin, und dass wir gemeinsam entscheiden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich denke, wir sind beide als Menschen gewachsen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat das angesprochen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Und nachdem wir darüber gesprochen haben, habe ich gemerkt, dass ich auch neugierig bin.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du ernsthaft? Versucht ihr beiden nicht, herauszufinden, was ich sage?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sehe ich aus, als hätte ich Spaß dabei, das zu erklären?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tut mir leid. Ich lache nicht über dich, ich war einfach wirklich nicht darauf vorbereitet.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich auch nicht, als er es mir das erste Mal gesagt hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay, aber warum sagst du mir das?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil ich fragen wollte, wie du dich fühlen würdest, diese Person zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich? Warte, du meinst, du willst mit mir ausgehen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, der Mann hinter dir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Naja, hier verstecke ich mich für fünf Minuten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach das nicht, ich versuche immer noch aufzuholen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, dich. Deshalb habe ich dich gebeten, mich zu treffen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Heilige Scheiße. Und er weiß, dass ich es bin? Nicht nur irgendein Typ, den er nicht kennt?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben speziell über dich gesprochen, also ist das nichts, was ich hinter seinem Rücken anspreche.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also weiß er, dass du gerade hier bist und mich das fragst?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Er wusste, dass ich nach dem Unterricht mit dir sprechen würde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich dachte, du wolltest Rat zu etwas. Ich habe nicht damit gerechnet, ein Teil davon zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt verstehst du, warum ich den ganzen Morgen überlegt habe, wie ich es sagen soll.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ständig erwartet, dass er mir sagt, ich soll aufhören, mit dir zu flirten. Das hier ist ein ganz anderes Gespräch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du könntest zumindest so tun, als wärst du weniger stolz auf dich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin noch nicht mal stolz. Ich versuche immer noch, dir zu glauben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} hat ein paar Überraschungen für sich behalten, was?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Offensichtlich. Ich hatte genau den gleichen Gesichtsausdruck, als wir das erste Mal darüber gesprochen haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Armer Kerl. Er sagt dir endlich, was ihm durch den Kopf geht, und jetzt sitzen wir hier und vergleichen unsere Reaktionen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist diejenige, die mich anstarrt, als hätte ich dich gebeten, mir zu helfen, eine Bank auszurauben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Einen Banküberfall hätte ich schneller verstanden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das überrascht mich nicht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Im Ernst, ich hätte nie gedacht, dass ich so einen Vorschlag von euch beiden hören würde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Wir entdecken gerne neue Dinge zusammen, aber das hier hat ein bisschen mehr Gespräch gebraucht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hoffe ich doch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst aus, als würdest du die Stille genießen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zuerst war ich mir nicht sicher, was ich dachte. Dann haben wir mehr geredet, und ich wollte sehen, wie es sich anfühlen könnte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und da bin ich ins Spiel gekommen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Irgendwann

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wessen Idee war das?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben über dich gesprochen. Du bekommst nicht die ganze Unterhaltung mit.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich frage mich nur, ob ich dir oder ihm danken soll.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weder noch, bis du meine Frage tatsächlich beantwortet hast.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du genießt es, mir beim Kämpfen zuzusehen, oder?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen. Ich war den ganzen Morgen nervös deswegen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay. Warum ich?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zum ersten Mal kann niemand fragen, ob die nächste Folie wichtig ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich hab echt nicht erwartet, dass sie so auftaucht 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sie hatte schon immer einen Crush auf dich

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Jetzt nutzt sie das einfach voll aus 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Alter, es war echt schwer, mich auf die Übungen zu konzentrieren 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Jeder kann machen, was er will

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Freue mich auf die nächsten Sessions 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Und du, schone dir das Bein
Du hast heute echt gut abgeschnitten 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Der Arzt hat dir den Gips erst vor zwei Tagen abgenommen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Erste echte Einheit ohne Gips und du hast schon die meisten Übungen gemeistert
{{name:hailey}} hat ihren Teil auch gut gemacht

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Es war echt schwer, während der Einheit konzentriert zu bleiben 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich habe gerade das Abendessen auf den Tisch gestellt, hast du schon gegessen oder verhandelst du noch mit dem Spiel?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, so mit dir zu reden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Selbst wenn du Fragen stellst, auf die ich nicht mit einem Witz antworten kann?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gerade dann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obwohl ich mir sicher bin, dass du gleich einen weiteren Versuch starten wirst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich warte auf eine Gelegenheit.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vorhersehbarer Mann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jedenfalls wollte ich etwas anprobieren, bevor ich zu bequem werde, um mich zu bewegen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Für morgen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ich wollte das anziehen, was ich zuerst herausgezogen habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich gemerkt, dass ich tatsächlich etwas auswählen wollte, das mir gefällt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zeig es mir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gib mir eine Minute.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses hier, mit der Jacke, falls es kühler wird.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gefällt mir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast sehr schnell geantwortet.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Möchtest du ein langsameres Kompliment?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hätte lieber eines, das ich glaube.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du siehst aus, als würdest du deinen Nachmittag genießen wollen, nicht dir Sorgen um deine Kleidung zu machen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das sieht gut aus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist genau das, was ich wollte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du siehst wunderschön aus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hilft auch 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann in diesen Schuhen laufen, ohne über jeden Schritt nachzudenken, also bleiben sie.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine sehr praktische Modeentscheidung.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin vielschichtig.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich behalte das Outfit dann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Abendessen oder ich?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn ich mich entscheide, ihm ein Bild zu schicken, bekommst du das auch, wie wir gesagt haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses hier war nur für dich, ich habe es nirgendwo anders geschickt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, die Vorschau zu bekommen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann schätze es, es gab einen sehr unwürdigen Kampf mit der Jacke, bevor ich sie angezogen habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schade, dass ich diesen Teil verpasst habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast mich nach dem Abendessen gefragt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses hier ist übrigens nur zwischen uns.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mache morgen nicht zu einer Sammlung von Dingen, die du dir ansehen musst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wäre trotzdem enttäuscht gewesen, das Kleid zu verpassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deine normalen Freundinnen-Bilder werden nicht eingestellt 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses Foto ist nur für dich, kein Bericht über etwas, das ich ihm geschickt habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst das Kleid genießen und mir trotzdem morgen ein paar kleine Dinge für mich behalten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Damit kann ich leben

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut, denn ich genieße es, nicht jeden einzelnen Satz im Voraus zu planen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du darfst gerne Initiative zeigen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dieses Foto ist nur für dich, ich habe es ihm nicht geschickt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und morgen kann ich mein Handy in Ruhe lassen, während wir reden, und dir danach davon erzählen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt für mich immer noch richtig.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch nicht, ich will unser erstes Kaffee-Date nicht mit einem Blick auf den Bildschirm verbringen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es ist noch etwas passiert, während ich das anprobiert habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Abendessen sieht gut aus, und ich wünschte, ich würde dir gegenüber sitzen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mich dabei ertappt, dass ich mich gefragt habe, ob es ihm gefallen würde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und gleich danach wollte ich dein Gesicht sehen, wenn du es zum ersten Mal siehst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, dass du beides wolltest.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch, tatsächlich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, diese Gefühle könnten sich gegenseitig im Weg stehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stattdessen stand ich hier und wollte dir das Kleid zeigen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du es getan hast.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist besser ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und unser Filmnachmittag findet immer noch statt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe die Dose mit den Nudeln im Kühlschrank ganz nach vorne gestellt, damit ich sie nicht vergesse, wenn ich vorbeikomme.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich würde dich auch ohne das reinlassen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, aber es ist wichtig, dass du verstehst, was für ein großzügiger Besucher ich bin.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Großzügig mit Essen, gnadenlos mit der Fernbedienung.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast zugestimmt, dass ich wählen darf.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich erinnere mich.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut, ich habe etwas gefunden, wo man die Schauspieler wirklich sehen kann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das lässt du nie los, oder?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht, bis ich herausfinde, wer in der Tür stand.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Obwohl du aufhören müsstest, mich zum Lachen zu bringen, während ich esse.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Niemand weiß es, das gehört zum Film.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schreckliches System.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warte, ich ziehe mich um, bevor ich in dem Outfit von morgen einschlafe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viel besser, ich behalte diese Klamotten für absolut niemanden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht mal für mich?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst eine kleine Ausnahme haben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag diese Version auch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut, denn das ist die, die du während unseres Films bekommst.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Keine Versprechen in dieser Hinsicht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solange ich neben dir sitzen kann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darum geht's ja ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lege mein Handy weg, bevor ich einen weiteren Grund finde, dich wachzuhalten.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht, hübsches Mädchen

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht, Hübscher

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und frühstücken, bevor ich morgen fragen muss.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da ist sie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin nie gegangen 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie geht's deinem Bein nach heute?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe gegessen und tatsächlich eine Weile gespielt.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen müde, aber ich hab's nicht übertrieben.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich fand's schön, draußen zu sein, auch wenn es nicht gerade ein Abenteuer war.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es muss kein Abenteuer sein, um gut zu sein.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hör dir an, wie vernünftig du bist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab heute viel Mut gebraucht, ich spare, was übrig ist.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apropos, für morgen ist alles organisiert.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mit genau derselben Tastenbelegung wie vorher?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} ist früh genug fertig, also treffen wir uns um halb vier im Café in der Nähe des Campus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das mit den unterschiedlichen Stühlen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Kam er dir anders vor, als er dir geschrieben hat?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielleicht ein bisschen vorsichtiger.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht unbeholfen, nur weniger entschlossen, aus allem einen Witz zu machen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vielleicht hast du ihn überrascht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mich definitiv selbst überrascht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab meine Sachen weggeräumt, als ich mich daran erinnerte, was ich ihn eigentlich gefragt hatte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und dann stand ich einfach im Flur und lächelte ins Nichts.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hätte ich gerne gesehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das muss nicht nochmal angesprochen werden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, du hättest gefragt, worüber ich lächle, und es nur schlimmer gemacht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fast sicher.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Seltsame ist, dass ich ihn schon kenne.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Morgen werde ich jemanden anschauen, den ich kenne, und mich fragen, ob er gleich etwas sagen wird, das ich noch nicht gehört habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist der Teil, der dich interessiert?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, das denke ich auch.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich versuche nicht, ihn in eine andere Person zu verwandeln, ich möchte nur sehen, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn wir aufhören, so zu tun, als wäre es ein ganz normales Mittagessen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir treffen uns um halb vier im Café an der Hauptstraße.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen muss man das schon ansprechen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es gewählt, weil ich weiß, wo es ist, und ich nicht die ersten zehn Minuten verloren herumirren muss.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Wahl.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich gehe alleine hin, keine Mitfahrgelegenheit von jemandem, den ich noch nicht getroffen habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Habt ihr heute Abend viel geredet?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen vor dem Abendessen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich ihm gesagt, dass ich esse und das Telefon weglegen werde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie hat er darauf reagiert?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie ein normaler Mensch, der auch Dinge zu tun hat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es klingt nach einer Kleinigkeit, aber ich mochte es, mich nicht erklären zu müssen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Glaubst du, ihr werdet euch persönlich gut verstehen?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was hast du gemacht?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hoffe es, aber genau deshalb möchte ich ihn treffen, anstatt seine ganze Persönlichkeit aus Nachrichten zu erfinden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß nicht, ob er am Anfang still ist, mit seinen Händen redet oder über seine eigenen Witze lacht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast schon jemanden, der das Letzte macht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, und er besteht darauf, dass es hervorragende Witze sind.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das sind sie.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siehst du? Völlig unvernünftig 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, dass es Dinge gibt, die ich noch nicht weiß.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht genug, um ihn sofort in mein Leben einzuladen, aber genug, um einen Kaffee zu wollen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Omelett und einen Salat.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay, du bist dran.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wofür bin ich dran?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was war das Erste, was dir durch den Kopf ging, als ich gesagt habe, dass ich ihn morgen tatsächlich treffe?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht die sehr unterstützende Antwort, die erste.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehrlich? Ich habe gelächelt, bevor ich überhaupt zu Ende gelesen hatte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will das, aber es fühlt sich plötzlich viel realer an.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So schnell?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, vor allem weil du so glücklich geklungen hast, als du es mir gesagt hast.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich versucht, etwas weniger Offensichtliches zu sagen, statt zuzugeben, wie sehr ich lächeln musste.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hättest das einfach sagen können.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was ist mit der ganzen Pasta passiert?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte deinen ganzen Nachmittag nicht in meine Reaktion verwandeln.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will trotzdem deine Reaktion hören.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich möchte nicht, dass dein Teil darin nur ist, zu fragen, ob es mir gut geht.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann ja, ich bin aufgeregt und froh, dass du ihn fragen wolltest.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es getan.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich mag es zu wissen, dass du auch da sitzt und lächelst, während du auf dein Handy schaust ❤️.
