story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Echt in einer schlechten Weise?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht schlecht, nur anders, als über einen imaginären Nachmittag zu reden.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mache eine Pause, bevor die Pasta und ich uns gegenseitig nicht mehr mögen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt gibt es eine feste Uhrzeit, und morgen wirst du dich fertig machen und gehen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte genau diesen kleinen Moment, als ich es in meinen Kalender eingetragen habe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich will immer noch, dass du gehst, ich hätte nur nicht gedacht, dass ich den Unterschied so stark merke.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du mir das gesagt hast, anstatt zu versuchen, ganz entspannt zu wirken.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bitte dich nicht, mich davon abzubringen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich werde morgen nicht versuchen, dir eine perfekte Geschichte darüber zu erzählen.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut, denn ich höre lieber von deinem tatsächlichen Nachmittag.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann ist das, was du bekommst ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warte, hier ist der Beweis, dass ich auch ein anderes Gericht machen kann.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Wieder mit dem Sport anzufangen, hat sich echt gut angefühlt

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: War es nicht eher das Flirten mit {{name:aiden}}, das sich gut angefühlt hat?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich habe keine Ahnung, wovon du redest 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich freue mich einfach, dass ihr beide Spaß habt

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Und mach dich bereit, noch mehr zu sehen 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich hatte eine echt gute Session

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich es wirklich schaffen werde

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Schaffen, Ethan ins Bett zu bekommen, ja

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Und trotzdem schreibst du mir weiter

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich muss mich nach heute ausruhen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Denn wenn ja, bist du verdächtig still.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Warum hast du mir dann noch kein Kompliment gemacht?
Ich fange an, mich ignoriert zu fühlen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich bin einfach extrem gut darin, zu bemerken, wenn Leute mit ihren Komplimenten zu spät dran sind.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wie auch immer, ich langweile mich zu Tode.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Warum bereitest du dich nicht auf die Uni vor?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Weil das Jahr praktisch vorbei ist.
Ich weiß nicht mehr so recht.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich muss technisch gesehen nicht mehr erscheinen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Also nehme ich meine wohlverdiente Freiheit sehr ernst.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Es ist kein Überspringen, wenn es nichts mehr zu lernen gibt.
Ich bin jetzt eine freie Frau.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Und eine freie Frau ist gerade sehr gelangweilt.
Komm später vorbei und halte mir Gesellschaft.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ich lag zu lange im Bett.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sonst fange ich an, noch schlimmere Geschichten zu posten, nur um dich zu zwingen zu reagieren.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Neuer Tag, dasselbe Gesicht, immer noch süß 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich hätte fast das Rennspiel anstelle meiner Vorlesungsnotizen geöffnet 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Was gibt's?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich muss eine Präsentation für die Uni vorbereiten.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Die Folien sind fast fertig, aber ich verliere ständig den Faden, wenn ich laut übe.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Komm nach deinem Tag vorbei. Du kannst mit mir üben.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Würdest du dir das antun?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. What is it about?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Natürlich. Worum geht's?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Kundenbindung. Warum die Leute immer wieder zu denselben Geschäften zurückkehren.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich kann Fragen stellen. Besonders wenn du mich verwirrst.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mach das bitte. Ich finde es besser, die verwirrenden Teile mit dir zu klären als vor allen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann bring deine Notizen mit.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Planst du schon dein Comeback?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Uni, Arbeit, dann du. So ist mein Montag geplant.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bereit für den ersten Teil.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Looking very prepared
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sieht sehr vorbereitet aus.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Die Tasche hat die Notizen. Ich muss nur daran denken, sie zu benutzen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du wirst das schon schaffen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du musst heute Abend richtig zuhören.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Kein Ablenken mitten drin.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll save it for after
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich hebe es mir für danach auf.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vielleicht. Aber ich habe mir erinnert, dass ich heute Morgen tatsächlich Unterricht habe.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich bin da direkt reingelaufen 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich sag dir Bescheid, wenn ich von der Arbeit wegkomme.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hab einen schönen Morgen, Liebling.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dir auch ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The rematch can wait
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Das Rematch kann warten.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich habe es wirklich genossen, gestern mit dir zu spielen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du hast mich nicht dumm fühlen lassen, als ich ständig abgestürzt bin.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du hast gelernt. Und du bist besser geworden.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. I want another try soon ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich weiß. Ich will bald einen weiteren Versuch ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Any time
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Jederzeit.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Heute brauche ich allerdings eine etwas andere Art von Hilfe.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: SPÄTER AM ABEND — {{name:lena}} ist nach Hause gegangen. Du hast den Tisch abgeräumt, bevor du dich zu {{name:hailey}} auf die Couch gesetzt hast.
Ich bin da ein bisschen schüchtern.
Mach dich nicht über mich lustig.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Komm schon, bevor ich alles esse.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ein bisschen später auf der Couch.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Was, wenn ich mir Essen von deinem Teller klauen muss?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du hast dir schon die Hälfte davon geklaut.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Es geht darum, dass du dich komisch distanziert verhältst.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich bin buchstäblich direkt neben dir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I might fall asleep like this

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du bist jetzt quasi mein Gefangener 😌.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ich habe sogar Platz für dich gelassen.
Sieh mal, wie großzügig ich bin.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Warum schreibst du mir, wenn du schon im Wohnzimmer bist?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Kurzes Update, bevor ich mit der Arbeit beginne: Ich sollte um sechs fertig sein

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe die Einleitung während des Mittagessens umgeschrieben

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Es klingt jetzt weniger, als würde ich ein Lehrbuch lesen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Wir probieren es aus, wenn du hier bist

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Und ich werde endlich meine andere Tasche abholen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Indem ich eine andere mitbringe?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eine Tasche voller Notizen. Sie sind in verschiedene Kategorien

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Natürlich. Das hätte mir klar sein müssen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mach dir keine Sorgen. Ich werde diesmal mit beiden gehen 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich stelle die alte bei der Tür ab

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Danke, Liebling. Ich muss jetzt gehen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Willst du direkt hierher kommen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bis später ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja. Ich halte unterwegs für etwas zu essen an

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich werde den Tisch für deine Notizen freimachen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mein ganz exklusiver Probenort

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein Platz. Sehr wählerisches Publikum

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Zumindest mag das Publikum mich schon

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sehr

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut. Sei heute Abend nützlich und liebevoll ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich kann beides schaffen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du bist diejenige, die sich an mich lehnt.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Wenn du mich so ansiehst, mache ich etwas.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du hast wirklich keine Angst vor mir, oder?
Normalerweise machst du mehr Witze über mich.
Ich zeige dir, dass ich nicht nur rede.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für den ersten einvernehmlichen Kuss zwischen {{name:hailey}} und {{name:player}} archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich brauche HAK nicht, um zu wissen, dass dieser Kuss mir etwas bedeutet hat.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für den ersten einvernehmlichen Kuss zwischen {{name:hailey}} und {{name:player}} archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für den ersten einvernehmlichen Kuss zwischen {{name:hailey}} und {{name:player}} archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Jetzt bist du mit den Konsequenzen stuck.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du bist nicht diejenige, die gerade den ersten Schritt gemacht hat.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du ziehst sie für einen längeren Kuss zurück.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für einen verlängerten einvernehmlichen Kuss archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich möchte diesen Moment mit ihr genießen, ohne zu drängen, was als Nächstes kommt.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für einen verlängerten einvernehmlichen Kuss archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für einen verlängerten einvernehmlichen Kuss archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Wir werden nach dem hier definitiv nicht mehr normal sein.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Was kann ich tun, wenn du dieses Gesicht machst?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du bist immer noch schlecht in geschmeidigen Antworten

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ich gehe ins Bett, bevor ich etwas anfange, das wir nicht stoppen können

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Versuch, mich nicht zu sehr zu vermissen 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für eine erhöhte emotionale Reaktion bei engem Kontakt archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für eine erhöhte emotionale Reaktion bei engem Kontakt archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für eine erhöhte emotionale Reaktion bei engem Kontakt archiviert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: FRÜHER ABEND — Es ist halb sieben. Du bist zu Hause und wartest darauf, nach der Arbeit von {{name:lena}} zu hören.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ohne einmal nach unten zu schauen 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist gut. Halte die Frage am Anfang

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Schon in sehr großen Buchstaben geschrieben

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alles verstaut. Ich bin mit dem Lernen für heute Abend fertig

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast dir die Pause verdient

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Danke für heute Abend. Den nützlichen Teil UND den Teil auf dem Sofa ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe beides genossen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich auch. Besonders der Teil, nachdem ich den Laptop geschlossen habe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Jetzt mache ich mich bettfertig, bevor ich das Ganze nochmal übe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Verstanden. Die Bühne gehört dir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht, Liebling

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} öffnet ihre Folien und beginnt ihre Präsentation. Du hörst zu, während sie erklärt, wie Qualität, Bequemlichkeit und persönlicher Service die Kunden dazu bringen können, zurückzukommen. In der Mitte hält sie inne und schaut auf ihre Notizen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hier bleibe ich immer stecken.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I ask something?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Darf ich etwas fragen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Dafür bist du hier.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wenn zwei Orte dasselbe zum gleichen Preis verkaufen, was bringt jemanden dazu, den einen über den anderen zu wählen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Die Erfahrung. Ob es einfach ist, dort einzukaufen, ob das Personal dir hilft...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das macht Sinn. Warum nicht diesen Abschnitt mit der Frage beginnen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Statt dieser langen Definition?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Klar. Gib mir zuerst ein Beispiel, dann erklär's mir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin raus. Hole unser Essen und komme dann direkt rüber ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Warte. Lass mich das schnell aufschreiben.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sie fügt die Frage ihren Notizen hinzu und versucht den Abschnitt nochmal, wobei sie zwei Cafés aus der Nachbarschaft als Beispiel nimmt. Diesmal schafft sie es ohne Unterbrechung.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hab alles verstanden.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: War es zu einfach?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nein. Ich hab verstanden, was du meintest. Dann hat die Definition mehr Sinn gemacht.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Das ist echt hilfreich.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Echt?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't ruin your good work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Verschandel nicht deine gute Arbeit.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — {{name:lena}} beendet die Präsentation, schaut auf die Uhr und klappt ihren Laptop zu. Du stellst eine letzte Frage zu ihrem Fazit, und sie antwortet, ohne auf ihre Notizen zu schauen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das fühlte sich viel besser an.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was work?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wie war die Arbeit?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast beim zweiten Versuch auch mehr nach oben geschaut.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast mich jedes Mal direkt angeschaut, wenn ich es getan habe.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast nach einem aufmerksamen Publikum gefragt.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das hab ich. Und ich fand es toll, eins zu haben.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Danke, dass du es ernst genommen hast.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} rückt neben deinen Stuhl und beugt sich runter, um dich zu küssen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nach der Probe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast gewartet, bis ich den Laptop zuklappe, oder?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe mich an die Regeln gehalten. Kein Küssen, bis du fertig bist.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr diszipliniert von dir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: So beschäftigt, dass ich keine Zeit hatte, mir über die Präsentation Sorgen zu machen

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Kann ich jetzt aufhören, so zu tun, als wäre ich nur jemand aus dem Publikum?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mach das bitte.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du brauchst keine Präsentation, um einen Grund zu haben, herzukommen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das weiß ich. Aber ich musste es üben.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich wollte den Abend mit dir verbringen. Das hat gut gepasst.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das hat es.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Nach dem Essen setzt du dich auf die Couch. {{name:lena}} sitzt nah neben dir und lässt Platz für dein verletztes Bein. Dein Arm legt sich um ihre Schultern, und sie dreht sich zu dir für einen weiteren Kuss.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Viel besser als der Tisch.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The table wasn't that bad.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Der Tisch war nicht so schlimm.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I couldn't sit like this there.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich konnte da nicht so sitzen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe unsere Sandwiches. Bis gleich

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Komm her, dann.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Sandwiches
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nach den Sandwiches

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your hand is wandering.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Deine Hand wandert.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can tell me to stop.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du kannst mir sagen, ich soll aufhören.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hab nicht gesagt, dass du aufhören sollst. Höher.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hände, wo sie sie hingelegt hat

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the other one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und die andere?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das kannst du auch haben. Unten. Hab ich schon entschieden.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du machst es mir sehr schwer, den Abend höflich zu halten.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Die Präsentation ist vorbei. Höflichkeit brauche ich nicht.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bis bald

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My turn too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin auch dran.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't have to.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das musst du nicht.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich weiß. Ich will. Mach deine Jeans auf.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ihre Hand

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sag mir, wenn das zu viel ist.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ist es nicht.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: On the Sofa
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Auf dem Sofa

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. That was the point.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Da. Das war der Punkt.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du siehst sehr zufrieden mit dir aus.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bin ich. Du kannst mir später danken.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER — {{name:lena}} kommt mit ihren Notizen und einer Tüte Essen bei dir an. Du begrüßt sie mit einem Kuss, stellst die Sandwiches in die Küche und setzt dich mit ihr an den Tisch.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Nach dem Aufräumen kuschelt sie sich an dich.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bequem?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. Are you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Und du?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then stop moving away to talk.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann hör auf, dich wegzubewegen, um zu reden.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich wollte nach deinem Tag fragen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wie war die Uni?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Obwohl ich die Mittagspause damit verbracht habe, die Einleitung umzuschreiben, anstatt richtig zu essen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Also war das Sandwich wichtig.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr wichtig. Danke, dass du mir mit der Präsentation geholfen hast, bevor ich abgelenkt wurde.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Ich brauche dich, um für zehn Minuten so zu tun, als wärst du nicht mein Freund.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast den Großteil der Arbeit gemacht, bevor du hierher gekommen bist.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du hast mir geholfen, es laut auszusprechen. Das war der Teil, den ich brauchte.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Später schaut {{name:lena}} auf die Uhr und sammelt ihre Unterlagen. Sie verstaut ihren Laptop, nimmt beide Taschen und kommt zu dir an die Tür.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sind beide Taschen da?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja. Ich lasse dir absolut keinen administrativen Grund, mich zurück einzuladen.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich denke, ich komme ohne klar.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hatte gehofft, dass du das tust.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} stellt die Taschen einen Moment ab und tritt einen Schritt zurück zu dir. Sie küsst dich zum Abschied, eine Hand auf deiner Schulter, während dein Arm sich um ihre Taille legt.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Noch eins bevor ich gehe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Okay. Jetzt gehe ich wirklich.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist eine schwierige Eröffnungsanfrage.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Schreib mir, wenn du zu Hause bist.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mach ich. Liebe dich.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Love you too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} nimmt beide Taschen und geht. Du räumst den Tisch auf und machst es dir für den Rest des Abends gemütlich.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — {{name:lena}} IST ZUHAUSE

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Zu Hause ❤️ Beide Taschen sind da

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ausgezeichnet. Irgendwelche vergessenen Notizen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I checked twice
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nein. Ich habe zweimal nachgeschaut.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und ich habe den schwierigen Abschnitt nochmal versucht, während ich ausgepackt habe.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wie ist es gelaufen?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Also eine gewöhnliche Person im Publikum. Die mich nicht küssen darf, bis ich fertig bin.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bist du auch so früh wach?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich habe später am Morgen eine Sitzung

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Er hat sie früher als gewöhnlich angesetzt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nur, dass es besser in seinen Zeitplan passt
Konnte nicht viel schlafen. Und du?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich werde mich langsam fertig machen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I made some breakfast for you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich hab dir auch Frühstück gemacht.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I kept waking up for no reason
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich bin ständig ohne Grund aufgewacht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dann lag ich einfach im Bett und starrte wie ein Idiot an die Decke

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Es ist einfach einer dieser Morgen, an denen das Gehirn zu viel denkt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Brauchst du, dass ich etwas für heute Abend mitbringe?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin ständig aufgewacht, aber es wird mir besser gehen, wenn ich mich bewege

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und bei dir?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ganz gut, und ich bin heute Morgen bis zum Briefkasten und zurück gekommen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wette, es fühlte sich gut an, nicht jemand anderen fragen zu müssen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das tat es, auch wenn ich nur Werbung gesammelt habe

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein enttäuschender Preis für all die Mühe 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde überleben

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's on the menu tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was gibt's heute Abend zu essen?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hühnchen und Reis, nichts, was eine Anleitung braucht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das kriege ich hin

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur dich selbst, den Rest habe ich

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe auch die Limonade, die du magst

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast dich erinnert?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du suchst immer danach, wenn du hier bist

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist wirklich süß ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bringe das Dessert mit, lass mich das übernehmen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde nicht mit dem Dessert streiten

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ausgezeichnet, eine Entscheidung ohne Streit getroffen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Immer noch gegen sechs?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, ich bin um fünf fertig. Ich halte auf dem Weg an und komme direkt rüber

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde hier sein.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hättest nicht alles machen müssen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich freue mich, dass wir das heute Abend machen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich auch

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich sollte mich fertig machen, bevor ich zu spät komme

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bist du noch nicht fertig?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fast, ich stehe hier mit einem Ohrring drin und rede mit dir 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein paar Minuten später, bevor sie geht...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da, beide Ohrringe und alles 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst toll aus.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist Abendessen, keine Hochzeit 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Einen schönen Tag!

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du auch, und iss nicht alle guten Stücke, bevor ich da bin

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Keine Versprechen über die knusprigen Ränder

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Spar mir was oder ich behalte den Nachtisch 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich, bis heute Abend

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to help
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, ich wollte nur helfen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can help me eat it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du kannst mir helfen, es zu essen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I'm very qualified for 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: In dem Bereich bin ich sehr qualifiziert 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning, by the way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen, übrigens

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen, Hübscher ❤️ Ich bin direkt in den Planungsmodus gegangen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du gut geschlafen?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey 😊 Schnelle wichtige Frage, bevor ich zurückgehe: Apfeltarte oder Schokolade?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann lass ich dich fertig machen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich gehe ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kurz vor fünf, im Büro des Managers...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bürogemurmel in der Nähe von {{name:lena}} erkannt.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eigentlich sollte ich mich darauf freuen, {{name:lena}} heute Abend zu sehen. Stattdessen bringt mich jede Meldung aus diesem Büro wieder zu gestern Abend zurück.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//LIVE TRANSKRIPTION

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fertig?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die aktualisierten Summen sind in deinem Posteingang, und die unterschriebenen Kopien sind in diesem Ordner

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bring sie her, ich beiße nicht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kann einen Ordner ohne Anweisungen auf einem Tisch lassen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da ist sie. Du hast den ganzen Tag kaum ein Wort mit mir gewechselt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe darüber nachgedacht, wie die letzte Nacht endete

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apfeltarte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich auch

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nicht so

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du willst mir sagen, dass du es nicht genossen hast?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Habe ich. Das ist nicht das Problem

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin nach Hause gegangen und habe mit ihm gesprochen, als wäre nichts passiert

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es war ein Kuss, kein Heiratsantrag

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er würde das nicht so sehen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er war nicht da

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das macht es nicht besser

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du warst draußen vor der Bar nicht annähernd so besorgt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut, das hab ich gehofft, dass du sagst

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hätte ich sein sollen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich habe dich sogar noch schlimmer zurückgeküsst

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann hör auf, dir einzureden, dass du es nicht genossen hast

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das tue ich nicht. Ich fühle mich nur schlecht wegen dem, was ich getan habe, und dass ich es ihm verheimliche

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wen interessiert, was er denkt? Du hast mich geküsst, und du mochtest es. Das ist alles, was zählt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich will ihn nicht verletzen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wirst du nicht. Du kannst immer noch mit ihm zusammen sein und eine gute Zeit mit mir haben

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß nicht, ob ich das kann

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kannst du. Du musst es nur wollen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm, trink mit mir, wenn du fertig bist

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: War das jemals wirklich eine Wahl?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, ich treffe ihn heute Abend

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abendessen?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abendessen und einen Film. Ich hab ihm gesagt, dass ich gegen sechs da bin

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sehr häuslich

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es ist etwas, das ich machen möchte, du musst es nicht langweilig klingen lassen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst mich an einem anderen Abend sehen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du könntest versuchen, das nicht für mich zu entscheiden

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß, dass du eine gute Zeit hättest

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du wirst nie müde, dir selbst zuzuhören, oder?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nicht, wenn ich recht habe

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest mir zustimmen dürfen 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gehe jetzt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du weißt, wo du mich findest

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich arbeite hier. Es wäre schwierig, nicht zu

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} nimmt ihre Tasche und geht zur Bürotür

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ihr Chef schaut ihr auf den Hintern, während sie geht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sie geht, und endlich lasse ich die Luft heraus, die ich angehalten habe. Selbst jetzt hasse ich es, wie er ihr nachsieht.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pünktlich gehen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um fünf, vor dem Büro...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fünf Uhr, ich bin raus ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alles fertig?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genug für heute, ich habe den Rest dort gelassen, wo er hingehört

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bei der Arbeit?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie läuft dein Nachmittag?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wo es jemand anderen eine Stunde lang stören kann 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich halte für die Torte an und komme dann vorbei

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nimm dir Zeit, das Essen ist noch nicht fertig

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nach einem kurzen Stopp in der Bäckerei...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sie hatten noch zwei Stücke. Das halte ich für hervorragende Planung

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hattest Glück

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bitte ruinier nicht mein sehr organisiertes Freundinnenbild 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Halt die Box aufrecht, das ist alles, was ich verlange

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es bekommt einen besseren Platz im Bus als ich

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fast mit dem letzten Stapel Papierkram fertig

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bis gegen sechs ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bis bald

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gehe trotzdem um fünf, ich lasse mir nicht von einem Ordner unseren Abend stehlen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe noch nicht mit dem Kochen angefangen, du hast Zeit

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß, ich will nur einmal pünktlich rauskommen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Was hast du vor, wenn die Prüfungen endlich vorbei sind?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Darüber hab ich noch nicht wirklich nachgedacht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber das Erste wird wahrscheinlich sein, bis mein Körper mich zwingt, aufzustehen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das wäre mal eine schöne Abwechslung

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich hab so viel Zeit gestresst, dass ich fast vergessen hab, wie sich Freizeit anfühlen sollte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du wirst dich ziemlich schnell erinnern, wenn es vorbei ist

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich freu mich irgendwie darauf, eine Weile völlig nutzlos zu sein

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} hat etwas gekocht, das tatsächlich gut riecht

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Komm essen, bevor sie mir diesen Blick zuwirft

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Komm essen, bevor sie mir diesen Blick zuwirft

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wir setzen uns zum Abendessen mit {{name:evelyn}}. Kommst du dazu?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe schon mit {{name:lena}} gegessen. Sie ist jetzt nach Hause gegangen, also komme ich vorbei und sage Hallo.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Du bist heute in toller Stimmung

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just wanted to annoy you a little
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Wollte dich nur ein bisschen nerven

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich bin unten, und dein Dessert hat die Busfahrt überlebt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ihr Handy geht zurück in ihre Tasche. Als du die Decke über ihre Füße ziehst, dreht sie sich zu dir statt zum Bildschirm. "Was?" fragst du. "Nichts. Komm her." Sie lehnt ihren Kopf an dich und hält deine Hand unter der Decke. Es braucht einen kleinen Schubs von dir, bevor sie merkt, dass der Film schon angefangen hat.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Ihr verbringt den Film nah beieinander, streitet euch gelegentlich darüber, ob der Hauptdarsteller lustig sein soll. Als die Credits laufen, bleibt sie noch ein paar Minuten, bevor sie ihre Sachen holt. An der Tür gibt sie dir eine längere Umarmung, verspricht dir zu schreiben, wenn sie zuhause ist, und macht sich auf den Weg zur Bushaltestelle.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — {{name:lena}} IST ZUHAUSE

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin zu Hause ❤️ Danke für heute Abend

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bist du gut zurückgekommen?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ich habe einen Platz bekommen und wäre fast vor meiner Haltestelle eingeschlafen 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast dein Haargummi auf dem Sofa liegen lassen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Behalte es, ich brauche einen Grund, um mir das Kissen wieder zu schnappen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du brauchst keinen Grund

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du warst heute Abend ein paar Mal still

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tut mir leid, ich hatte viel im Kopf

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Habe ich etwas falsch gemacht?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, du hast nichts falsch gemacht, du bist perfekt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war wirklich glücklich, mit dir dort zu sein

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war froh, dass du gekommen bist

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch, ich habe es vermisst, neben dir zu sein, statt von meinem Bildschirm aus zuzusehen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viel einfacher für dich, die Decke zu stehlen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
