story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das auch 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Weniger beeindruckender Zustand, aber immer noch essbar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich mochte deinen Film, auch wenn ich immer noch nicht denke, dass der Mann lustig sein sollte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast mehr gelacht als ich

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vor allem über dich, wie du über ihn gelacht hast

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nehme ich

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Abendessen war auch wirklich gut ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Auch ohne all mein Hähnchen auf deinem Teller?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fang nicht an, ich habe nur ein Stück genommen 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schlaf ein bisschen, du sahst aus, als würdest du gleich auf mir einschlafen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wäre fast eingeschlafen. Es war schön, eine Weile nicht irgendwohin gehen zu müssen

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir machen das wieder

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: VERFÜGBAR 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das fände ich toll.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht, Hübscher, liebe dich ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch, schlaf gut

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich öffne die Tür, bevor du es schlimmer machst

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mach das bitte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gegen sechs öffnest du die Tür. {{name:lena}} stellt die Tüte mit den Gebäck ab und umarmt dich, bevor du mit dem Hallo sagen fertig bist. Sie küsst dich auf die Wange und bleibt einen Moment an dir stehen, dann tritt sie ein.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Beim Abendessen gießt du die Limonade ein, die du für sie gekauft hast. Sie schaut auf die Flasche, dann zu dir. "Du hast sie sogar in den Kühlschrank gestellt," sagt sie. "Ich dachte, warme Limonade könnte schlecht ankommen." Sie lächelt, wird aber einen Moment still, bevor sie über den Tisch nach deiner Hand greift.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das Gespräch wird beim Abendessen lockerer. Sie erzählt dir von ihrem Morgen und klaut ein Stück Hähnchen von deinem Teller, während du antwortest. Als du es bemerkst, besteht sie darauf, dass deins den knusprigen Rand hatte, den sie versprochen bekam. Als du die beiden Stücke Torte herausstellst, lacht sie über deinen Versuch zu entscheiden, welches größer ist.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTEN SPÄTER — Nachdem sie dir beim Abräumen der Teller geholfen hat, lässt sie ihre Schuhe neben der Couch stehen und nimmt sich das gute Kissen. Sie macht ihr Haar auf, während sie sich neben dich setzt. Bevor der Film beginnt, lehnt sie sich an deine Schulter und macht ein Foto von euch beiden. Sie schickt dir eine Kopie zum Behalten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Was hast du heute so vor?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich muss mit {{name:ethan}} ein paar Lernbücher kaufen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das ist nur ein Codewort für 'zu ihm nach Hause gehen'.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nein, ich brauch wirklich die Bücher.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lustig, dass du nur am Ende des Jahres anfängst, hart zu arbeiten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Das passiert, wenn man einen Professor hat, der motivieren kann 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich werde wahrscheinlich einfach im Bett gammeln.
Ich geh jetzt in den vollen Bombast-Modus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}} wird gar nicht mehr mit dir abhängen wollen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ich schau dir lieber beim Kämpfen zu.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ganz verspannt, mit zerzausten Haaren, siehst halb tot aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey 😊 Ich bin vor dem Weckerklingeln aufgewacht, und jetzt fühlt es sich an, als wäre halb vier noch eine Woche entfernt

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte vor allem, dass du aufhörst, deine eigenen Gefühle als die unwichtigsten zu behandeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich versuche es.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich mag, dass du möchtest, dass ich das als ich selbst mache, nicht als irgendeine Version von mir, die ich erfinden muss.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist das Mädchen, in das ich verliebt bin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war unfair süß ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Jetzt habe ich vergessen, wonach ich gesucht habe, bevor du mich am Küchentisch zum Lächeln gebracht hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Schlüssel?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, tatsächlich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sieh mich an, nützlich und charmant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lass uns das nicht ruinieren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich mich später fertig mache.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hab einen guten Morgen. Und iss, bevor das Meeting deine Mittagspause frisst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du klaust mir heute wirklich meinen Job.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das sieht deutlich besser aus als das, was ich gemacht habe

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du könntest versuchen, etwas auf den Teller zu legen, anstatt über der Spüle zu essen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du warst nicht hier. Du kannst nichts beweisen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich kenne dich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe heute Morgen das Gruppentreffen, dann komme ich nach Hause und ziehe mich um

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Trägst du immer noch das Kleid von gestern?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich weigere mich, diese Entscheidung wieder zu treffen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte dich noch etwas fragen, bevor ich gehe

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Was ist es?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du kannst wieder schlafen. Ich wecke dich im Juni

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Über heute. Über Grenzen, nehme ich an.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wir haben darüber gesprochen, was du danach wissen möchtest, aber nicht wirklich darüber.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Als wir von Kaffee sprachen, meinten wir dann Kaffee und nichts anderes?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nein. Wir haben einen Ort ausgesucht, an dem du dich treffen kannst, nicht eine Regel, wo der Nachmittag enden muss.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Also, wenn es gut läuft und ich länger bleiben will, soll ich dann nicht nach Hause kommen, nur weil wir das erwähnt haben?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Natürlich nicht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte, dass du tust, was du tun möchtest, und nicht ständig überprüfst, ob es auf einer Liste steht, die wir heute Morgen gemacht haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und wenn ich ihn küssen will?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann küss ihn.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das sagst du sehr leicht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sehr hilfreich

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Weil ich es ernst meine.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und wenn ich weiter gehen will?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde dir keine Grenzen setzen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Keine Grenzen von mir. Ich möchte, dass du entscheidest, was du willst, nicht was du denkst, dass ich will, dass du tust.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wirklich?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehrlich. Du musst mich nicht bei jedem Schritt um Erlaubnis fragen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß noch nicht, wie ich mich fühlen werde.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du musst das noch nicht wissen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vielleicht trinkst du einen Kaffee und gehst. Vielleicht möchtest du den Rest des Nachmittags zusammen verbringen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte nicht, dass du dich zurückhältst, nur um einem Plan zu folgen, oder dich zwingst, die Geschichte für mich interessanter zu machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mir ging's gestern Abend gut. Jetzt schaue ich auf die Uhr, während der Wasserkocher kocht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war der Teil, über den ich mir Sorgen gemacht habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nach Hause kommen und das Gefühl haben, entweder zu viel gemacht zu haben oder dich enttäuscht zu haben, weil ich nicht genug getan habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es gibt nichts, was du tun musst, um heute erfolgreich zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Also entscheide ich, was ich wirklich will, und schaue, was er auch will.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Genau.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich kann meine Meinung mitten drin immer noch ändern.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Offensichtlich. Das ist kein Versprechen von dir an uns beide.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist eine viel größere Antwort, als ich erwartet habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe schon gefrühstückt, bevor du fragst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Letzte Nacht hast du gesagt, es fühlte sich plötzlich viel realer an. Hat sich das geändert?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nicht ganz. Ich merke es immer noch, wenn ich daran denke, dass du tatsächlich da bist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber nervös zu sein bedeutet nicht, dass ich deine Entscheidungen für dich treffen will.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mach das Entspanntsein nicht zu etwas, das du für mich leisten musst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das werde ich nicht. Ich sag dir Bescheid, wenn sich etwas anders anfühlt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich will die ehrliche Antwort von dir, auch wenn es einen Moment dauert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast dich erinnert ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lächelst du immer noch so wie letzte Nacht?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja. Ein bisschen abgelenkt auch, aber ich freue mich darauf, zu hören, wie du dich fühlst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entscheide nicht, wie mein ganzer Nachmittag verläuft, bevor ich das Haus überhaupt verlassen habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich versuche mich stattdessen auf das Mädchen zu konzentrieren, das mir ständig schreibt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sie klingt bezaubernd.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist sie ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich konnte praktisch die Vorlesung von morgen hören, bevor ich ins Bett gegangen bin

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sogar mit {{name:aiden}}? Wissen, dass wir ihn danach immer noch sehen werden?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich habe nicht vergessen, über wen wir reden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich vertraue dir. Ich bitte dich nicht, das ganze Date damit zu verbringen, mich davor zu schützen, es seltsam zu finden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vielleicht ist er derjenige, der heute einen Moment braucht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Versuchst du immer noch, gestern zu verstehen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wahrscheinlich. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob die Worte „mein Freund weiß Bescheid“ schon ganz bei ihm angekommen sind.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lass ihn etwas bestellen, bevor du ihn wieder überraschst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich halte kein zweites Referat. Er kann damit umgehen 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das nennt man ein guter Einfluss sein

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich treffe immer noch jemanden, den ich eigentlich noch nicht kenne.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Genau. Frei wählen zu können, bedeutet nicht, dass du ihm plötzlich mit allem vertrauen musst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte immer noch sehen, wie er bei einem Kaffee ist. Das hat sich nicht geändert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dann ist das der Anfang.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich mochte seine Nachrichten. Ich möchte beim Date nicht darüber nachdenken, ob ich der Version entspreche, die ich mir vorgestellt habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vielleicht findest du die echte Person interessanter.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solange er das Kochen dem Café überlässt, haben wir eine Chance.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du gegessen, oder beaufsichtigst du nur alle anderen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und als du gesagt hast, ich könnte einige Dinge für mich behalten, hatten wir nur über ein erstes Date gesprochen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich wollte diesen Teil laut aussprechen, bevor ich die Antwort so behandle, als würde sie mehr bedeuten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du das getan hast. Jetzt weißt du, dass ich möchte, dass du selbst wählst, anstatt wegen mir beim Kaffee stehen zu bleiben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay. Einige Dinge können mein bleiben, ohne dass wir uns missverstehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja. Und alles, was uns beiden Sorgen macht, ist etwas, worüber wir reden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, du würdest mir eine sehr vorsichtige Antwort darüber geben, was erlaubt ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe hier Essen, danke

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Das Kaufen der Bücher hat länger gedauert als gedacht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
{{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} gibt {{name:aiden}} einen Kuss auf die Wange

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Diese Begrüßung wirkt jedes Mal weniger beiläufig, und inzwischen bemerke ich auch meine eigene Reaktion darauf.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat Beweise archiviert, dass {{name:hailey}} einen Wangenkuss bei {{name:aiden}}’s Ankunft initiiert hat

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Seit er angefangen hat, mich zu trainieren 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Er hat ein kleines Dankeschön verdient, weil er so gut auf mich aufpasst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} läuft absichtlich langsam vor dem Sofa entlang

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Subjekt ist absichtlich vor beiden Männern in aufreizender Kleidung gelaufen
Verdammte Axt… sie ist echt erwachsen geworden 👀

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich weiß nicht wirklich, wie man spielt… 😇
Subjekt hat sich auf Aiden’s Schoß gesetzt

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich sehe, wie ihre Nähe wächst, aber ich muss noch herausfinden, wie wohl ich mich damit fühle.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat aufgezeichnet, dass {{name:hailey}} sich unter dem Vorwand, zu lernen, wie man spielt, auf {{name:aiden}}’s Schoß gesetzt hat

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Was? Ich brauch einen guten Blick auf den Bildschirm 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Komm bloß nicht so runter, wie du jetzt aussiehst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Natürlich nicht, du bist genauso schlimm wie sie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es war echt cool, mit euch abzuhängen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Könnt ihr das nicht privat machen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Wenn das eine Herausforderung ist, dann mach ich es noch krasser 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich hab dich gewarnt, dass du dafür bezahlen wirst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey 😊 Ich bin zu Hause und mache mich fertig, und das Kleid hat es überstanden, dreimal überdacht zu werden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Offensichtlich. Ich habe das Gefühl, ein ganzes Kapitel verpasst zu haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es hat auch bei mir eine Weile gedauert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Habt ihr nochmal gesprochen, bevor du hierher gekommen bist?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Heute Morgen, ja.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und? Darf ich fragen, wie das lief, oder ist das privat?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein Teil ist privat. Aber ich habe gefragt, ob Kaffee die Grenze sein sollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du ihn das gefragt?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was hat er gesagt?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dass er mir keine Grenzen setzen will. Er möchte, dass ich entscheide, was ich wirklich machen möchte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst wunderschön aus

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Echt jetzt? So einfach?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben länger als das geredet. Ich gebe dir den nützlichen Teil.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich versuche mir vorzustellen, wie ich dieses Gespräch führe und dabei ernst bleibe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast nicht mal den ersten Satz gestern hinbekommen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Guter Punkt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es ist immer noch seltsam für mich. Nicht schlecht, aber seltsam.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es kann seltsam sein, ohne dass wir das ganze Date damit verbringen, es wieder zu erklären.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast recht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und das bedeutet nicht, dass ich mit einem Versprechen gekommen bin, wie heute endet.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Das heißt, ich sollte dich fragen, anstatt zu raten, was er zugestimmt hat.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich fühle mich gut darin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay. Erste Frage an dich:

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weiter.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Willst du wirklich den Fensterplatz oder hast du den anderen genommen, weil ich schon hier saß?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wollte den Fensterplatz.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann tausch mit mir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wirklich?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Du darfst auch den Stuhl wählen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du wirst jetzt echt nervig sein, oder?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nur bis du aufhörst zu tun, als hättest du keine Vorlieben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wollte dich fragen, ob du denkst, es ist zu viel, dann ist mir aufgefallen, dass ich es tatsächlich mag.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die Probanden wechseln die Plätze.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beobachteter Blick verweilt tiefer als beabsichtigt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wusste, dass da Neugier ist, aber zu sehen, wie aufmerksam sie miteinander umgehen, überrascht mich trotzdem.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erwischt beim Schauen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: NACHDEM IHRE KAFFEE ANGEKOMMEN IST.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist es gut?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sehr. Du darfst deinen auch genießen, selbst wenn er klein ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es ist gut. Nervig gut.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deshalb kommst du immer wieder.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das und es ist ruhig, wenn du die Mittagszeit verpasst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich glaube, ich war noch nie hier, ohne auf die Zeit zu achten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast normalerweise woanders zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann behalte diese Antwort.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kurse, Arbeit, irgendwas, das ich vergessen habe zu beenden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Heute habe ich fast aus Gewohnheit meine Notizen in meiner Tasche mitgebracht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du kannst sie dort lassen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Habe ich. Das versuche ich dir zu sagen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tut mir leid. Ich genieße es, dass du dich entschieden hast, hier zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist eine sehr unpraktisch nette Antwort.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die habe ich gelegentlich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Ich höre sie nur nicht immer ohne drei Witze danach.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich versuche heute, mich nicht so sehr hinter denen zu verstecken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst nicht aufhören, witzig zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach ich ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut, denn schön und still zu sein, klingt anstrengend.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da ist er.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was würdest du mit einem ganzen Nachmittag frei machen? Nicht was du tun solltest. Was du tatsächlich tun würdest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich würde spazieren gehen, ohne zu zählen, wie lange ich brauche.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vielleicht irgendwo sitzen, etwas hören, und eine Weile nicht auf die Klassengruppe antworten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es gibt einen Garten ein paar Straßen weiter.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kenne den. Ich gehe immer am Eingang vorbei.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir könnten diesmal reingehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Das würde mir gefallen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: SPÄTER, DRAUSSEN VOR DEM CAFÉ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie fühlst du dich sonst so?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier links, oder?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Es sei denn, du willst immer wieder um den gleichen Block fahren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich könnte so tun, als würde ich dir eine Tour geben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Von dem Ort, wo ich zur Uni gehe?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da muss noch dran gearbeitet werden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist verdächtig still.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hattest du Angst, ich würde einen Witz machen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe nicht gesagt, dass du ganz aufhören sollst zu reden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe eine schöne Zeit. Ich will nicht jeden ruhigen Moment mit Gerede ruinieren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nervös, aber ich bereue nicht, dass ich abgesagt habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist neu.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gefällt mir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER, IM GARTEN

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hier ist schöner als der Weg draußen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier kann man seine eigenen Gedanken hören.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hatte gehofft, heute weniger darüber nachzudenken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie läuft's?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Besser, seit wir das Café verlassen haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: War ich so schlimm beim Kaffee?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eher wie die zehn Minuten, bevor du etwas tun musst und dein Gehirn keine nützlichen Dinge mehr zu sagen hat.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein. Ich habe aufgehört, mir vorzustellen, was ich als Nächstes tun sollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und jetzt?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt möchte ich, dass du mal kurz stoppst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst aus, als würdest du gleich etwas Gefährliches sagen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich war

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vielleicht wurde ich ungeduldig

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Subjekt initiiert einen Kuss

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kontakt erwidert

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein Kuss macht das auf eine Weise wirklich, wie Gespräche es nie konnten, und ich brauche einen Moment dafür.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst die zehn Minuten nicht mit Denken füllen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Um ihn zum Schweigen zu bringen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe nicht gesagt, dass du das zuerst machen kannst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast aufgehört zu gehen und so zu mir geschaut. Ich habe ein Risiko eingegangen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das war kein Risiko. Das war, dass du vorgegriffen hast

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also hatte ich recht, wo das hier hinführt

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist gerade echt stolz auf dich

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein bisschen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du wolltest mich sowieso küssen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Red weiter und schau, was passiert

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein radikaler Vorschlag.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich dachte, du würdest diese Entscheidung nicht wieder anfangen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was, wirst du mich wieder aufhalten?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Psst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Also sag mir ehrlich, wer besser küsst? Ich oder er?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was? Das ist eine berechtigte Frage.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst aus allem einen Wettkampf. Bei Spielen, im Unterricht, im Leben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und jetzt anscheinend auch beim Küssen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wenn du es wirklich wissen willst, bist du momentan noch ganz weit hinten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wow. Das ist gemein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast gefragt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, ich mag es. Jetzt klingt es nach einer Herausforderung.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das sollte nicht so sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zu spät. Ich nehme es schon persönlich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist unmöglich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und trotzdem hast du mich geküsst, um mich zum Schweigen zu bringen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das sollte dir sagen, wie effektiv Worte gerade bei mir sind.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Willst du eine Weile sitzen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Dort drüben, im Schatten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sieh mal an. Eine Sitzplatzwahl ohne Verhör.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist nur einen Kommentar davon entfernt, alleine zu sitzen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: SPÄTER AM NACHMITTAG

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Soll ich dich zur Haltestelle zurückbringen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das fände ich toll.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Willst du jetzt Pläne für einen anderen Tag machen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nicht gerade jetzt. Ich brauche ein bisschen Zeit, um den Tag zu verarbeiten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: In Ordnung.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist keine höfliche Art, nein zu sagen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Habe ich nicht so aufgefasst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut. Ich bin froh, dass wir das gemacht haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich auch.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schreib mir, wenn du zu Hause bist?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: NACHDEM SIE TSCHEIDEN

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin auf dem Weg nach Hause ❤️ Das war ein schöner Nachmittag.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin froh. Wie fühlst du dich?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Froh und ein bisschen ruhiger als ich erwartet habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich dachte, ich möchte alles auf einmal tippen. Hauptsächlich möchte ich einfach einen Moment darüber nachdenken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nimm dir Zeit. Du musst den Heimweg nicht in einen Bericht verwandeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Ich wollte dir trotzdem das hier schicken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ein wunderschönes Lächeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, ich hatte tatsächlich einen freien Nachmittag.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nicht nur eine Lücke zwischen zwei Dingen, die ich erledigen musste.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du das verstanden hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Können wir richtig reden, wenn ich zu Hause angekommen bin?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und erzähl mir auch etwas von deinem Tag. Ich möchte nicht, dass meiner alles einnimmt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihm gerade ein schnelles Foto geschickt, um zu sagen, dass ich unterwegs bin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das gemacht, bevor ich reingegangen bin. Ich mag, wie viel Licht da drin ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin im Café an der Einkaufsstraße. Ich habe einen Tisch bei den großen Fenstern gefunden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin früh dran, also tue ich natürlich so, als wäre die Wahl eines Getränks eine sehr komplizierte Aufgabe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zumindest wirst du bis zu seinem Eintreffen entschieden haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das könnte man denken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte, er ist draußen. Ich erkenne ihn von den Fotos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich lege jetzt mein Handy weg. Bis später ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dieses hier, nicht das Spiegelbild, das ich dir geschickt habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben bestellt, und ich habe gefragt, ob er damit einverstanden wäre, ein Foto zusammen zu machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat ja gesagt. Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass ich es dir auch schicken möchte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst schon entspannter aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mit jemandem zu sprechen ist tatsächlich einfacher, als sich den ersten Satz auszudenken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genieß deinen Kaffee. Du kannst mir später erzählen, wie es dir geht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach ich 😊.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: SPÄTER AM NACHMITTAG

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jenseits des Kaffees

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein ungeplanter Abschied

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: SPÄTER

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin auf dem Weg nach Hause 😊 Es lief gut.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie fühlst du dich?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut. Besser als ich, als ich die Getränkekarte studiert habe, als ob es eine Prüfung geben würde.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es war schön, nicht das ganze Gespräch alleine führen zu müssen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mag dieses Lächeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: War er so, wie du es erwartet hast?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er war am Anfang tatsächlich etwas ruhiger. Das hat mich weniger albern fühlen lassen, weil ich nervös war.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann hat er gesagt, dass er sich versprochen hat, die ersten zehn Minuten nicht mit der Erklärung des Pizza-Fotos zu verbringen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und hat er es geschafft?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Für etwa vier Minuten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe gefragt, weil ich die Geschichte hören wollte, nicht weil ihm die Themen ausgegangen sind.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ein besserer Grund.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir sind danach noch spazieren gegangen. Ich bin sogar mit einem gebrauchten Buch nach Hause gekommen, das ich nicht kaufen wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein produktiver Nachmittag.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe zwei gemacht. Auf dem ersten sah ich aus, als würde ich versuchen, mich zu erinnern, ob ich die Tür abgeschlossen habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein völlig unnötiger Kauf, aber ich mag es.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du es genossen, dort zu sein, als die Nerven sich gelegt hatten?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja. Ich habe aufgehört zu überlegen, ob es gut läuft, und einfach eine schöne Zeit gehabt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Die kleinen Details behalte ich für mich, aber ich wollte, dass du diesen Teil weißt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du gegangen bist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich auch ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das gemacht, nachdem wir uns verabschiedet haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hattest du?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich ändere es nicht. Ich schaue nur mit unnötiger Intensität darauf.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst glücklich aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das bin ich. Und irgendwie habe ich wieder Hunger.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich würde gerne nach Hause gehen und essen, bevor wir richtig reden, wenn das okay ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich. Ich gehe nirgendwohin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich möchte auch von deinem Tag hören.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es muss sich nicht mit meinem messen, um interessant zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe die Wäsche gewaschen, ohne einen internationalen Vorfall mit der Maschine auszulösen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich war noch drinnen. Also nein 😭.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist Fortschritt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine Socke könnte dabei verloren gegangen sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir werden ihr Opfer in Erinnerung behalten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest dich beschwert, wenn ich es nicht gemacht hätte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich beschwere mich nicht. Ich überlege nur, wie viel Lob du verdienst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mindestens ein bisschen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann gut gemacht, Hübscher. Ich gebe dir heute Abend die längere Version ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe ihm übrigens ein schnelles Foto geschickt, um zu sagen, dass ich unterwegs bin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nur ich an der Tür, nichts Aufwendiges.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst es nicht zweimal schicken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Du hast sowieso schon meine komplette Spiegelinspektion gehabt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gehe jetzt, bevor ich einen weiteren Grund finde, im Flur zu stehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ganz anders.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Viel Spaß. Wir reden, wenn du Zeit hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke für den Morgen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst beim Date nicht darüber nachdenken, was ich als Nächstes wollen würde.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß. Das nehme ich mit ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe das gemacht, bevor ich die Straße überquert habe. Sieht viel schöner aus ohne die Mittagspause.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genau

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich stehe vor dem Café. {{name:aiden}} ist schon hier.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er sieht viel zu zufrieden aus, dass er der Erste ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lass ihn nicht aus fünf Minuten ein ganzes Gespräch machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zu spät, er zeigt auf sein Handgelenk.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich stecke mein Handy weg, bevor er mir auch noch deswegen Zeichen gibt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fünf ganze Minuten zu früh. Ich war schon kurz davor, mir Sorgen zu machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not wearing a watch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du trägst keine Uhr.
