story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know what time it is without one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich weiß auch ohne Uhr, wie spät es ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das Gruppentreffen endete pünktlich, also habe ich sogar ein richtiges Mittagessen geschafft.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann weißt du, dass ich auch zu früh bin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das weiß ich. Ich wollte einfach nur genießen, der Erste zu sein.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wird das das ganze Date so laufen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich würde sagen, ich habe noch ein bisschen mehr zu bieten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das werden wir sehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look really nice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst wirklich gut aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist alles. Du musst dir dafür keine Antwort überlegen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das war ich nicht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du warst ein bisschen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gut. Du wirst das ganze Date nicht damit verbringen, auf die Kuchenauslage zu starren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt bringst du mich dazu, darüber nachzudenken

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm schon. Ich habe zwei Stühle gefunden, die nicht wackeln

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ungewöhnlich rücksichtsvoll von dir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warte, bis du die Tassen siehst. Sie haben nichts an den Tassen gemacht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hättest du was dagegen, ein Foto mit mir zu machen, bevor die Drinks kommen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Machst du das Foto oder bist du drauf?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Being in it. I can hold the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich will drauf sein. Ich kann das Handy halten

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a separate issue
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist ein separates Thema.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For {{name:player}}?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Für {{name:player}}?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like one too. But yes, I'd like to send it to him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hätte auch gerne eins. Aber ja, ich möchte es ihm schicken

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. You can send it to me as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay. Du kannst es mir auch schicken

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm ein bisschen näher, sonst sehe ich nur deine Schulter

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have just asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hättest einfach fragen können

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did just ask. Look at the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe gerade gefragt. Schau auf das Handy

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We found a table 😊 I asked for a photo before he could complain about the coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben einen Tisch gefunden 😊 Ich habe nach einem Foto gefragt, bevor er sich über den Kaffee beschweren konnte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ihr beiden seht aus, als würdet ihr gleich über die Speisekarte streiten

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We already did. This is the peaceful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das haben wir schon. Das hier ist der friedliche Teil

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted to show you before I leave
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich wollte es dir zeigen, bevor ich gehe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genieß es. Wir reden später ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So, how did this morning go?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wie lief der Morgen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir haben die Arbeit tatsächlich beendet. Ich musste nicht so tun, als würde mein Laptop gleich ausfallen, um rauszukommen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist enttäuschend. Ich wollte denken, du hättest für mich geflohen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bekommst den Nachmittag. Fang nicht an, nach einer dramatischen Vorgeschichte zu fragen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich denke immer noch an gestern, weißt du.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The look on your face is going to stay with me for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Der Ausdruck in deinem Gesicht wird mir eine Weile im Gedächtnis bleiben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe jahrelang damit gerechnet, dass er genervt ist, wenn ich mit dir flirte. Ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass es so endet.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er hat ein paar Dinge am Laufen, die nicht nur darin bestehen, mit dir über ein Spiel zu streiten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Bist du immer noch mit ihm?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Did you tell him you’d be back later?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Hast du ihm gesagt, dass du später zurückkommst?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then we can continue the lesson
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dann können wir mit der Lektion weitermachen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This has moved well past a study session, and it's harder to laugh off now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Das geht längst über gemeinsames Lernen hinaus, und jetzt lässt es sich nicht mehr so leicht weglachen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived the first kiss of the evening session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK hat den ersten Kuss der Abend-Sitzung archiviert

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I also have ways to give punishments and rewards… without being the teacher 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich habe auch Möglichkeiten, Strafen und Belohnungen zu geben… ohne die Lehrerin zu sein 😌
{{name:hailey}} fängt an, ihm einen Handjob zu geben

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject initiated a handjob during the private session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Subjekt hat während der privaten Sitzung einen Handjob initiiert

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On this subject… you don’t seem to need any lessons
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: In diesem Punkt… du scheinst keine Lektionen zu brauchen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’ll probably go revise directly at his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich werd wahrscheinlich direkt bei ihm lernen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject increased the intensity of the act
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Subjekt hat die Intensität der Handlung erhöht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: They finish with a kiss while she makes him cum
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sie beenden mit einem Kuss, während sie ihn zum Höhepunkt bringt
Die Sitzung endete mit einer Ejakulation

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we still need to revise now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber wir müssen jetzt noch lernen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But it’s going to be hard to focus after that 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aber es wird schwer sein, sich danach zu konzentrieren 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’ll drop me off a bit later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Er bringt mich ein bisschen später nach Hause

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know… but we have to
I’m not the one who’s going to get eaten
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich bin nicht diejenige, die gefressen wird

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On the contrary… I’m the one who’s going to eat him 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ganz im Gegenteil… ich bin diejenige, die ihn fressen wird 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I know you like it 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und ich weiß, dass du es magst 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know you liked the show 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich weiß, dass dir die Show gefallen hat 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little reward just for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eine kleine Belohnung nur für dich

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Since when do you act like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Seit wann benimmst du dich so?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m done living only for revisions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich hab genug davon, nur für Überarbeitungen zu leben

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ich will mein Leben ein bisschen genießen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I’ve always had a crush on him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Und ich hatte schon immer einen Crush auf ihn

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It seems like it’s mutual… so I’m taking advantage 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Scheint, als wäre es gegenseitig... also nutze ich das aus 😇

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Schämst du dich nicht, das alles vor mir zu machen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich habe geduscht und etwas gegessen. Hast du Zeit für ein richtiges Gespräch?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Genau so wählst du Filme aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat etwas sehr Ähnliches gesagt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es war schön, dass das Gespräch so abschweifte. Ich hörte auf, daran zu denken, dass es ein erstes Date war.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: War irgendetwas anders, als du ihn dir vorgestellt hast?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat länger zugehört, bevor er geantwortet hat, als ich es von den Nachrichten erwartet hätte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zuerst dachte ich, ich hätte etwas Unangenehmes gesagt. Dann wurde mir klar, dass er tatsächlich über das nachdachte, was ich gefragt hatte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht immer das Schlechteste.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein. Ich mochte es, als ich aufgehört habe, jede Pause zu füllen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat sich vergewissert, dass du wusstest, dass wir uns treffen, aber er hat dich nicht ständig erwähnt, als müsste ich mich dafür rechtfertigen, dass ich da bin.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und wenn er sich über etwas nicht sicher war, hat er mich gefragt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe mich endlich richtig hingesetzt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt nach einer guten Möglichkeit, dich kennenzulernen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So hat es sich angefühlt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir haben während eines Teils des Spaziergangs Händchen gehalten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und vor der Buchhandlung habe ich gefragt, ob ich ihn küssen kann.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wolltest du das?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir waren dabei, uns zu verabschieden, und ich habe gemerkt, dass ich versuche, einen anderen Grund zu finden, um zu bleiben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also habe ich gesagt, was ich wirklich wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und er wollte das auch?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das wollte er.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es war ein bisschen awkward, die Worte zu finden. Der Kuss war es nicht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danach war ich vor allem froh, dass ich gefragt habe, anstatt die ganze Heimfahrt zu grübeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du dich dabei wohl gefühlt hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch. Ich wusste heute Morgen nicht, ob ich überhaupt für einen zweiten Drink bleiben wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde nicht so tun, als würde ich ihn nach einem Nachmittag richtig kennen, aber ich habe den Nachmittag, den wir hatten, genossen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du musst heute Abend nichts Größeres entscheiden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass ich es genossen habe, ihn zu treffen, und wir werden wieder reden.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde nicht jeden Moment beschreiben, wie wir gesagt haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du siehst bequem aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das musst du nicht. Erzähl mir, wie es dir geht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Froh. Ein bisschen nachdenklich, aber nicht verärgert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin geblieben, weil ich da sein wollte, und gegangen, als ich nach Hause wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte den Nachmittag nicht auf eine bestimmte Zeit dehnen oder etwas Größeres daraus machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du dich wohl gefühlt, das zu sagen, was du wolltest?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich fühlte mich wohler, als ich aufhörte, alles in meinem Kopf zu proben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Einige Dinge möchte ich vorerst für mich behalten, aber es gibt nichts, was mich belastet und was ich dir nicht sagen möchte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist mir wichtig.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, dir sagen zu können, dass ich es genossen habe, ohne jeden kleinen Grund erklären zu müssen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann für dich glücklich sein, ohne jedes Detail zu kennen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extrem. Die Schuhe waren eine gute Entscheidung, aber ich wollte sie trotzdem ausziehen, als ich drin war.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut. Denn ich bin glücklich ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du? Wie war der Tag eigentlich für dich?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe öfter auf die Uhr geschaut, als ich wusste, dass du dich treffen würdest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann habe ich das Telefon weggelegt und meinen Nachmittag fortgesetzt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du dir Sorgen gemacht?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du nicht die gewählt hast, in denen man nur fünf Schritte gehen kann.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vor allem, dass es echt war, wie wir letzte Nacht darüber gesprochen haben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber ich saß nicht hier und wünschte mir, ich hätte dir gesagt, du sollst absagen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du das sagst, anstatt so zu tun, als hättest du nichts gefühlt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und zu hören, dass du eine gute Zeit hattest, hilft. Ich mag es, dass du wie du selbst klingst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin immer noch ich.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Ich freue mich darauf, dich morgen zu sehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du? War der Tag so, wie du es erwartet hast?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wusste nicht genau, was ich erwarten sollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Manchmal lerne ich aus meinen Fehlern.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war froh, dass du weg warst, aber dann habe ich mich mehr auf deine Nachricht gefreut als auf das Spiel, das ich gespielt habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist eine ganz schöne Leistung.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine riesige.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Am meisten mochte ich, wie du geklungen hast, als du zurückgekommen bist. Du hast mir nicht nur Dinge gesagt, von denen du dachtest, dass ich sie hören wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein. Ich wollte mit dir reden, weil ich einen schönen Nachmittag hatte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hat mich glücklich gemacht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du bringst mich dazu, wieder zu dir zu kommen und dich zu umarmen ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bevor ich dir noch etwas sage, was du heute Morgen gesagt hast, hat wirklich geholfen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hat dir das Foto von uns im Café gefallen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, hat es. Es war schön, dass du mich in diesem Moment einbeziehen wolltest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe ihn übrigens zuerst gefragt. Ob ich es machen und dir schicken kann.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, hast du mir gesagt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und dann habe ich das Handy weggelegt. Ich wollte das ganze Date nicht damit verbringen, das nächste Ding zu schicken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das musstest du nicht. Ich fand es schön, etwas zu bekommen, das du wirklich teilen wolltest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darüber, für dich selbst zu wählen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass ich dir danach in meinen eigenen Worten darüber erzählen konnte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das wollte ich. Du musstest das Date nicht damit verbringen, Dinge für mich zu sammeln.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du hast trotzdem ein Bild von deiner Freundin auf dem Weg nach Hause.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das mochte ich besonders.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deine ganz normalen Privilegien bleiben intakt 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mein Handy bis zum Abschied in Ruhe zu lassen, hat geholfen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht, weil ich nicht mit dir reden wollte. Ich wollte nur nicht in zwei Gesprächen gleichzeitig sein

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich rede jetzt lieber richtig mit dir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch. Ich wollte deine Aufmerksamkeit, als ich wirklich Zeit hatte, sie zu genießen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mag es, dass ich einige Momente für mich behalten kann, ohne heute Abend distanziert zu dir zu sein

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte keine Distanz. Ich wollte, dass du Platz hast, du selbst zu sein

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es fühlt sich anders an, jetzt wo ich das wirklich hatte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zuerst habe ich mich immer wieder gefragt, was du von dem halten würdest, was ich als Nächstes tue.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ich bin da. Bist du gut nach Hause gekommen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bist du morgen nach dem Mittagessen frei?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Für eine Frau mit einem Film und einer unvernünftigen Menge Pasta? Ja

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich will dich sehen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bringe den Behälter mit, und du darfst nicht so tun, als würdest du nicht erinnern, dass du meiner Filmwahl zugestimmt hast

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich erinnere mich. Ich habe sogar Platz auf dem Sofa gemacht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Für mich oder die Pasta?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir können die Prioritäten besprechen, wenn du ankommst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Falsche Antwort

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Für dich. Die Pasta kann einen Stuhl haben

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viel besser

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann ist mir eingefallen, dass du nicht zu Hause sitzt und darauf wartest, dass ich Anweisungen befolge.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es vermisst, heute neben dir zu sitzen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst morgen so viel davon haben, wie du willst

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das habe ich vor

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bist du jetzt müde?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen. Nicht die miserable Art, ich bin nur bereit, aufzuhören, auf einen Bildschirm zu starren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lass mich ins Bett gehen, bevor ich hier einschlafe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab's geschafft. Ich hab sogar daran gedacht, das Handy anzuschließen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine organisierte Frau.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Kurz.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war ich nicht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hier ist nur für dich, bevor ich es weglege.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wünschte, ich wäre dort.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Morgen. Und dann kannst du meine hervorragenden Kommentare zum Film persönlich hören.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ist das im Besuch inbegriffen?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du kannst es nicht ausschalten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hatte ich nicht vor.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht, Hübscher ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gute Nacht, hübsches Mädchen. Ich bin froh, dass du einen guten Tag hattest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch. Ich freue mich darauf, dich zu sehen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich mochte es, etwas zu wollen, ohne es sofort zu einer Frage für dich zu machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das wollte ich, dass du es hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich wollte nicht weitergehen, nur weil du gesagt hast, ich könnte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hat auch einen Unterschied gemacht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut. Keine Grenzen von mir sollten nicht zu einem Ziel werden, das du erreichen musstest.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das tat es nicht. Zum ersten Mal habe ich nicht versucht, die richtige Antwort zu bekommen 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich habe alles abgestellt und fünf Minuten nach dem Handy gesucht, das ich gerade in meine Tasche gesteckt hatte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nach dem Café sind wir in den kleinen Garten ein paar Straßen weiter gegangen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie war er, als du tatsächlich auf dem Date warst?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Immer noch er selbst. Er hat sich über die Tassen beschwert, bevor wir überhaupt bestellt hatten.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber er war ehrlicher als sonst, als er nicht wusste, was er sagen sollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er gab zu, dass er so lange damit gerechnet hatte, dass du genervt von ihm bist, dass er sich immer noch daran gewöhnen musste.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann es mir vorstellen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe ihm nicht unser ganzes Gespräch erzählt. Ich habe ihm nur gesagt, dass ich nicht einer Liste von Dingen folgte, die du erlaubt hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ablenkung?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie hat er darauf reagiert?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er war wieder überrascht. Dann hat er verstanden, dass er mich fragen sollte, was ich wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danach haben wir aufgehört, über die Situation zu reden, und hatten tatsächlich ein Date.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du es geschafft hast, es zu erklären.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch. Er hat sich an viele kleine Dinge über mich erinnert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich durfte hören, wie er etwas Nettes gesagt hat, ohne es sofort zu einem Witz zu machen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist schon einen zweiten Kaffee wert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sag ihm das nicht. Sonst fängt er an, jedes Kompliment anzukündigen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann haben wir im Garten angehalten, und {{name:aiden}} hat mich geküsst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat dich zuerst geküsst?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein bisschen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Bevor ich überhaupt entschieden hatte, was ich sagen wollte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe ihn ein bisschen zurückgeschoben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Warst du okay?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, er hat mich einfach überrascht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte einen zweiten. Er hielt an und sah dann sofort viel zu zufrieden mit sich selbst aus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt nach ihm.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Offensichtlich hatte er beschlossen, dass ich ihn sowieso küssen würde, also war er mir nur einen Schritt voraus.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich hat er einen Weg gefunden, sich recht zu geben.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Genau 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat mich ständig damit geneckt.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ist die fehlende Socke wieder aufgetaucht?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also habe ich ihn selbst geküsst, um ihn zum Schweigen zu bringen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und weil du es wolltest?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Nervigerweise sind diese beiden Dinge gleichzeitig passiert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hat das ihn zum Schweigen bringen funktioniert?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Während des Kusses

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann hat er gefragt, wer besser küsst, er oder du?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hat er dich das wirklich gefragt?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Anscheinend war das eine sehr wichtige Frage.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab ihm gesagt, dass er alles zu einem Wettkampf macht. Spiele, Unterricht, anscheinend auch das.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und das hat ihn gestoppt?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In einem Ärmel. Niemand versteht, wie sie da hingekommen ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich nicht

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also hab ich ihm gesagt, dass er momentan noch sehr weit hinten ist.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Momentan?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, fang nicht auch noch damit an.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab den Nachmittag mit einem wettbewerbsorientierten Idioten verbracht. Ich brauch heute Abend keinen weiteren.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich genieße nur meinen Vorsprung.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und beweis damit meinen Punkt 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wie hat er darauf reagiert?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat gelacht und beschlossen, dass ich ihm gerade eine Herausforderung gegeben habe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab gesagt, dass es nicht so gemeint war. Anscheinend war das egal.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deine Waschmaschine hat einen sehr kleinen Sinn für Humor.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt ganz richtig.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wusste, dass du das Verhalten erkennst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du weißt, du musst es nicht schlimmer machen, um mir einen Gefallen zu tun.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das mache ich nicht. Ich mochte es, ihn zu küssen, auch wenn er danach unmöglich war.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin froh, dass du mir das sagen kannst.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und beim zweiten Mal war ich nicht überrascht oder versuchte herauszufinden, was ich tun sollte. Ich wollte einfach nur

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: War es danach seltsam?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur für einen Moment. Dann hat er wieder zu viel geredet und ich hörte auf, darüber nachzudenken.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wir saßen eine Weile im Schatten. Ich habe gedroht, ihn alleine sitzen zu lassen, wenn er weiter zu allem kommentiert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Romantik lebt und blüht.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, du würdest das Update zu schätzen wissen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du liebst die gleiche Frau. Du weißt, worauf du dich eingelassen hast.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat wieder nach Plänen gefragt, aber ich wollte das nächste Date nicht organisieren, während ich noch mit diesem hier beschäftigt war.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das macht Sinn

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es war kein Versuch, ihn abzuwimmeln. Ich wollte einfach nach Hause und den Tag ein wenig sacken lassen.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab dir doch gesagt, dass wir nach dem Café spazieren gegangen sind.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es gab einen Buchladen, in den er schauen wollte, also haben wir die Regale mit Secondhand-Büchern durchstöbert.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Daher kam das Buch?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich habe es ausgewählt, weil die Beschreibung lächerlich klang und ich wissen wollte, ob die Geschichte noch schlimmer sein könnte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das tue ich. Ich interessiere mich auch für deine sehr ereignislosen Abenteuer.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person
You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Du darfst mich übrigens wieder loben.
Du siehst heute Morgen weich aus.
Ich halte nur die Standards hoch.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Und ich werde so schnell nicht aufstehen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Planst du, den ganzen Tag dort zu bleiben?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Es sei denn, jemand kommt, um mich zu stören.
Ich wollte nur sicherstellen, dass du dich erinnerst.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ich hatte ein bisschen Angst, dass du aufwachst und so tust, als wäre es nie passiert.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich präsentiere heute und plötzlich sieht meine Einführung fremd aus 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich würde es bevorzugen, nur dich wieder im Publikum zu haben

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich könnte voreingenommen sein

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du bist sehr voreingenommen. Ich mag das ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich habe trotzdem richtig zugehört

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hast du. Deshalb schreibe ich dir, anstatt das Ganze neu zu schreiben

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bereit. Notizen überprüft, Laptop aufgeladen, keine Taschen mehr bei dir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann bist du schon besser als gestern

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Erinnere mich bitte nicht an die Taschen-Situation 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du siehst gut aus. Jetzt zeig ihnen, dass du dein Thema kennst

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Die gleiche, die du letzte Nacht ohne deine Notizen durchbekommen hast?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich sag dir später, wie es gelaufen ist

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich werde warten. Viel Glück, Liebling ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Danke. Ich liebe dich

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ja. Mein Gehirn hat sich einen sehr ungünstigen Zeitpunkt ausgesucht, um daran zu zweifeln

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Du hast es gestern klar erklärt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Und du hast meine Fragen beantwortet, ohne durch die Folien suchen zu müssen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich weiß. Es ist nur anders, wenn alle mich anstarren

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nimm dir einen Moment, bevor du anfängst. Du musst nicht gleich in den ersten Satz stürzen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ich eile, wenn ich nervös bin

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dann behalte das Café-Beispiel im Hinterkopf. Du wusstest genau, wie du das erklären kannst

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Okay. Langsam machen und mit dem Beispiel anfangen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Dann komme ich später heute Abend vorbei.
Nein. Ich komme später heute Abend.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Okay. Kann ich später heute Abend vorbeikommen?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Jetzt fragst du, nachdem du schon entschieden hast.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Die Tür wird offen sein, wenn du heute Abend vorbeikommst.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Schreib mir, wenn du bereit bist, vorbeizukommen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Daran zu denken, zu deinem Zimmer zu kommen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Nur damit du weißt, worauf du dich einlässt.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Du redest nicht etwa vom Zimmer, oder?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Was ist mit der ruhigen Version von dir passiert?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Er hat sich nur entschieden, das Leben auch zu genießen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Es ist geschafft. Und es lief gut 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sehr vertraut 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich musste fast lachen, weil wir genau darüber gesprochen hatten

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich konnte antworten, ohne auf meine Notizen zu schauen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das ist großartig. Du wusstest es schon, du musstest nur üben, es zu sagen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Offensichtlich ja

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Es war allerdings nicht fehlerfrei

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Was ist passiert?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe zur nächsten Folie geklickt, während ich noch die erste erklärt habe

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dann habe ich zu weit zurückgeklickt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eine Überraschungstour durch die Präsentation

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Da ist sie. Wie fühlst du dich?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Genau. Jeder konnte den Titel zweimal bewundern 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hast du die richtige Folie wieder gefunden?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja. Ich habe gesagt, der Laptop war ungeduldiger als ich

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ein paar Leute haben gelacht. Dann habe ich weitergemacht

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das ist eine ziemlich gute Wiederherstellung

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das dachte ich auch

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe die Note noch nicht, aber der Professor sagte, die Beispiele waren klar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Darüber solltest du dich freuen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das bin ich ❤️ Und ich bin froh, dass du mir gestern geholfen hast

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich freue mich, dass es geholfen hat. Du hast die Präsentation selbst gemacht

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Erleichtert. Ich glaube, ich habe den Atem angehalten, bevor ich angefangen habe

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Jetzt kann ich aufhören, Sätze zu üben, jedes Mal, wenn ich eine ruhige Minute habe

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Genieß die ruhige Minute dann

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mit Mittagessen diesmal. Ein richtiges

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eine hervorragende Fortsetzung deines akademischen Erfolgs

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Reden wir heute Abend? Ich möchte auch von deinem Tag hören

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Natürlich. Genieß dein Mittagessen, Liebling

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Werde ich ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Kam die Einführung wieder zu dir zurück?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja. Ich habe mich langsamer gemacht, wie du gesagt hast

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Als ich dann im Beispiel mit dem Café war, fühlte es sich viel einfacher an

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut. Was ist mit Fragen?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das wird dir gefallen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Der Professor hat gefragt, was jemanden dazu bringen würde, zwischen zwei Orten mit ähnlichen Produkten und Preisen zu wählen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Das klingt vertraut

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}} senkt ihr Handy und schaut dich an
Ich war mir nicht ganz sicher, dass du es tun würdest.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für intime Nähe im privaten Raum archiviert

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du bist diejenige, die sich an mich drückt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Wenn du mich so ansiehst, küsse ich dich gleich wieder

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Warum schreibst du mir immer noch?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK hat Beweise für einen intimen Kuss in privater Umgebung archiviert

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Der war sogar besser als gestern

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If we keep going I won’t want to stop
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Wenn wir weitermachen, will ich nicht aufhören

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And if I don’t want to stop either?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Und wenn ich auch nicht aufhören will?
Nicht, wenn du so nah bist

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Geh zurück in dein Zimmer, bevor ich meine Meinung ändere
Und… danke, dass du gekommen bist

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Wenn ich jetzt laut rede, werde ich komisch.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Lass mich einfach ein bisschen schreiben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Du stehst da, als wüsstest du nicht, was du tun sollst.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin zu Hause und lege die Folien für heute Abend weg

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Kommst du rüber und bleibst die Nacht bei mir?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Essen, Zeit zusammen und kein Gehen am Ende

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ja ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: JaJaJaJaJaJaJa❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das würde mir echt gefallen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich habe gestern darüber nachgedacht, zu fragen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hättest du mal. Ich wäre versucht gewesen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Morgen ist besser. Ich kann mitbringen, was ich brauche, anstatt improvisieren zu müssen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wann kannst du kommen?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mein Nachmittag ist nach der Uni frei

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut verdient. Wie war der Rest deines Tages?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich kann nach Hause gehen, meine Sachen holen und gegen fünf rüberkommen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Fünf klingt gut.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und diesmal darf ich bleiben, wenn du mich bittest, näher zu kommen 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Darauf freue ich mich

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich auch

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Warte. Ich hole jetzt meine Tasche, bevor ich etwas vergesse

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Zahnbürste, saubere Kleidung für Donnerstag, Ladegerät

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sehr organisiert

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich versuche es. Kann ich ein T-Shirt zum Schlafen ausleihen?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Viel einfacher, als ich nicht mehr an die Präsentation denken musste

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Natürlich. Du hast schon gut in meinen ausgesehen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann lasse ich dich eines für mich auswählen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Betrachte es als bereit

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich hoffe, du weißt, dass ich mich daran gewöhnen könnte

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich nehme das Risiko auf mich

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Da. Fast gepackt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du siehst sehr zufrieden damit aus

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das bin ich. Diese Tasche soll morgen eigentlich bei dir bleiben

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Zusammen mit ihrem Besitzer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was hast du gemacht?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Besonders ihrem Besitzer ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
