story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eigentlich, bevor ich mit dem Packen fertig bin...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was machst du gerade?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dir einen kleinen Vorgeschmack geben 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was denkst du?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du siehst umwerfend aus

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Und dieses Lächeln sagt mir, dass du genau wusstest, was du tust

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich wollte dich ein wenig ablenken 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Einige Besorgungen, ein kurzer Spaziergang, dann ein paar Dinge im Haus

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Es hat funktioniert. Jetzt wünschte ich, du wärst hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was würdest du tun, wenn ich es wäre?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dich nah heranziehen und dich küssen, bevor du die Tasche überhaupt ausgepackt hast.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann lass ich das Auspacken bis später ❤️.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Warte. Noch eins, bevor ich mich umziehe.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: EINE MINUTE SPÄTER

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Da. Dein letzter Vorgeschmack für heute Abend.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du machst morgen sehr gefährlich.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich kann es kaum erwarten, dein Gesicht zu sehen, wenn ich tatsächlich vor dir stehe.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Wie war der Spaziergang?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Komm nah genug, und du musst nicht raten, wie sehr ich es mag.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das habe ich vor 🤍.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Die Bilder behältst du nur für dich.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Natürlich. Die bleiben zwischen uns.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Morgen kannst du dein Handy weglegen und mir persönlich Aufmerksamkeit schenken.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du wirst meine volle Aufmerksamkeit haben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das wollte ich hören ❤️.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Soll ich mir Sorgen machen, dass du dir die ganze Decke schnappst?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nur wenn du planst, sehr weit weg von mir zu schlafen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das hatte ich nicht vor.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Ich gehe immer noch langsam, aber es fühlte sich gut an, rauszukommen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dann wird alles gut 😌.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich kann jedoch nicht versprechen, dass ich dir nicht meine kalten Füße anlege.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das stand nicht in der Einladung.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das gehört zur Freundin dazu. Du hättest die Details lesen sollen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich werde überleben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gut. Ich will auch, dass du da bist, wenn ich aufwache.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du wirst mich da haben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Das ist der Teil, an den ich ständig denke.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sich mit dir wohlzufühlen und nicht ständig zu schauen, wann ich nach Hause muss.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich fand es toll, dich gestern neben mir zu haben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich bin froh ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Morgen können wir so bleiben.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Du lässt die Wartezeit länger erscheinen 🤍.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nur bis morgen Nachmittag.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich werde das Packen beenden und versuchen, nicht ständig auf die Uhr zu schauen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sag mir, ob du willst, dass ich etwas zum Abendessen mitbringe.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Nur du und deine Tasche. Das Essen habe ich.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beides wird diesmal zusammen ankommen 😌.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gute Nacht, Liebling. Ich freue mich auf morgen.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich auch. Gute Nacht ❤️.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ich wollte dich etwas über morgen fragen

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Was denkst du gerade?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen ❤️ Ist mein Haargummi noch sicher, oder hat dein Sofa es beansprucht?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe über dich gesprochen, Idiot

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut, ich habe keine Zeit, um noch einen zu erklären 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Zuerst Unterricht, dann Arbeit. Ich mache mich gerade fertig

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es sei denn, dein Wachmann bringt auch das Haargummi mit

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, Hübscher ❤️ Was machst du heute?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wäsche, dann will ich das Spiel beenden, das ich angefangen habe

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Häng die Wäsche auf, bevor du anfängst zu spielen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich höre lieber von deinem Spiel als von einer Maschine voller nasser Wäsche 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich sollte wieder um fünf fertig sein, dann direkt nach Hause

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du auch. Ich wäre lieber noch auf deinem Sofa, aber der Bus wartet nicht auf mich

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und mein Haargummi 😌 Ich liebe dich

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde einen Wächter darauf setzen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, es verdient eine ordentliche Behandlung

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, besser als die Nacht zuvor

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich hätte noch eine Stunde unter dieser Decke bleiben können

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es war bequem, und ich mochte die Gesellschaft ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Oder hast du Angst vor mir?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're going to be punished for that.
Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Zu sehen, wie persönlich das geworden ist, lässt mir den Magen absacken.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK hat aufgezeichnet, dass das Subjekt während der privaten Sitzung digitale Penetration initiiert hat, nachdem es die Notwendigkeit für weitere Wiederholungen in Frage gestellt hat.
Immer noch am Jammern über die Wiederholung?
Die Reaktion des Subjekts zeigt Akzeptanz an

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich muss wissen, wie sie sich wirklich fühlt. HAKs Deutung reicht mir nicht.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Nach der Stimulation gab der Professor dem Subjekt einen festen Klaps auf den Hintern. Das Subjekt zog sich nicht zurück.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich wollte nur sicherstellen, dass du noch aufpasst.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du genießt das viel zu sehr.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich fange an, diese privaten Lektionen wirklich zu mögen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Warum muss ich trotzdem überarbeiten, wenn wir schon… eine Vereinbarung haben?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hat nur länger gedauert als erwartet

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Weil ich noch beweisen muss, dass du mit mir arbeitest.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Also ist es nur für die Papierarbeit?
Du bist so ein verantwortungsbewusster Erwachsener.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey 😊 Ich habe heute eine Bank zum Mittagessen gefunden, anstatt neben dem Drucker zu essen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist es, bevor du nach Beweisen fragst

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ausgezeichnet, ich bin stolz auf dich ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich muss zurück. Ich schreibe dir, wenn ich draußen bin

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sprechen wir später.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Später an diesem Nachmittag, während sie den Zeitplan für den nächsten Tag im Büro des Managers überprüfen...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bürogemurmel in der Nähe von {{name:lena}} erkannt.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gestern war alles so leicht, als wir zusammen waren. Jetzt beobachte ich wieder dieses Büro und habe Angst, dass ein schöner Abend nichts verändert hat.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//LIVE TRANSKRIPTION

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst gut aus mit offenen Haaren

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist das dein Beitrag zur Arbeit am Nachmittag?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich kann dich bewundern und einen Zeitplan lesen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann versuche, das zweite zu tun

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine große Verbesserung

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Viel weniger interessant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es wird noch länger dauern, wenn du weiter so auf mich schaust.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du warst kaum subtil.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das wollte ich nicht.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Klarerweise

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Komm morgen vorbei. Ich mache das Abendessen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Zu dir?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da ist meine Küche.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du weißt, warum ich frage.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und du weißt, dass ich dich nicht einlade, um über deine Arbeit zu reden.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es macht auch viel besseren Hintergrundlärm

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Darüber haben wir gestern gesprochen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hattest gestern Pläne. Ich frage nach morgen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich meinte den Rest dieses Gesprächs.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich hatte einen wirklich schönen Abend mit ihm.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das glaube ich dir.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann hör auf, so zu tun, als ob etwas fehlt, das du reparieren musst.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich biete nicht an, etwas zu reparieren. Ich will einen weiteren Abend mit dir.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du machst alles so einfach.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das Abendessen ist einfach. Du denkst an alles danach.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich überlege, ob ich überhaupt dort sein sollte.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was hast du dabei?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hattest Spaß neulich Abend.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich fühlte mich danach schrecklich. Du lässt diesen Teil immer weg.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mochte es, dich für einen Abend ganz für mich zu haben. Ich würde das gerne wiederholen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gebe dir jetzt keine Antwort.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann denk darüber nach. Sieben, wenn du entscheidest, dass du kommst.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lass mich das zuerst beenden.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} dreht sich wieder zum offenen Zeitplan auf dem Tisch.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ihr Manager schaut ihr von der anderen Seite auf den Hintern, während er sich in seinem Stuhl zurücklehnt.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er sieht sie an statt die Arbeit vor sich. Ich hasse das Gefühl, der Einzige zu sein, der will, dass das aufhört.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Invitation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eine Einladung

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Kurz vor fünf, mit dem überprüften Zeitplan und der letzten Seite unterschrieben...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist alles. Ich lege diese zu den anderen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein Wrap und einen Apfel. Nichts Dramatisches

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lass sie da, ich hole sie raus.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hättest du sagen können, bevor ich sie sortiert habe.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sie sind jetzt sortiert.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du genießt es wirklich, das Sagen zu haben.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schau mich einen Moment an.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Was?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich will einen weiteren Kuss.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du weißt, warum ich zögere.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das weiß ich. Ich frage, ob du auch einen willst.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay... nur ein Kuss.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nach ihrer Antwort steht der Manager auf und kommt näher zu {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Er beugt sich vor, um sie zu küssen, und zieht sie ein bisschen näher an die Taille; sie erwidert den Kuss

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Visuelle Aufnahme archiviert

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Noch ein Kuss, und sie erwidert ihn. Unser gemeinsamer Abend bedeutet mir noch immer viel, aber gerade fühlt er sich schmerzhaft weit weg an.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ein weiterer Kuss

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay, das reicht jetzt

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das hat mir besser gefallen als die Büroarbeit

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe mir gestern gesagt, dass das nicht nochmal passieren wird

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich fand die Entscheidung von heute besser

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich hast du das. Du bist nicht diejenige, die mit einem schlechten Gewissen nach Hause geht

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich mochte es, dich zu küssen. Ich werde nicht so tun, als hätte ich es nicht getan

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich gehe jetzt

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schreibe dir später wegen dem Abendessen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sieht friedlich aus

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe immer noch nicht zugestimmt

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich habe dich gehört. Denk darüber nach

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nachdem ich die Arbeit verlassen habe, auf dem Weg zur Bushaltestelle...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin raus ❤️ Gehe jetzt nach Hause

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alles fertig?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, der Zeitplan für morgen ist endlich fertig

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Etwas, um das du dir heute Abend keine Sorgen machen musst

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, eine Sorge weniger

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich schicke dir eine Nachricht, wenn ich drinnen bin

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Okay, bis gleich

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist es. Ich genieße es, zehn Minuten lang nicht gefragt zu werden, wo etwas ist

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ist dein Wäscheaufsicht dann außer Dienst?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nur wenn es wirklich hängt

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Du scheinst in letzter Zeit echt glücklich über diese privaten Lektionen zu sein

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ich freue mich sogar darauf, ihn jetzt zu sehen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Du hast dich früher über jede zusätzliche Sitzung beschwert.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Oder vielleicht habe ich einfach einen besseren Weg gefunden zu lernen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Jetzt hör auf, mich zu verhören, und schlaf ein.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Du bist gut gelaunt und lächelst, wenn du nach Hause kommst

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Jemand klingt eifersüchtig auf meinen Professor.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Er ist einfach echt gut in dem, was er macht.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich bin zu Hause. Hast du es geschafft, dein Spiel zu beenden?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sehr glamouröser Abend geplant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du siehst bequem aus.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin ❤️ Obwohl dein Sofa besseres Gesellschaft hatte

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Foto gespeichert, das du letzte Nacht gemacht hast

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having you here
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es war schön, dich hier zu haben

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war es wirklich. Ich habe das vermisst

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Beim nächsten Mal finde ich etwas Besseres zum Anschauen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Film stört mich nicht so sehr

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dass du an den falschen Stellen gelacht hast, war sowieso die halbe Unterhaltung

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nicht ganz, ich stecke seit einer Stunde an der gleichen Stelle fest

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Offensichtlich ist das jetzt meine Rolle

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du bist sehr gut darin 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein wenig später schickt ihr Manager eine Nachricht...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zurück zu deinem Gespräch, ein paar Minuten später...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, ich könnte morgen ein bisschen später nach Hause kommen

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein paar Leute von der Arbeit essen zusammen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein Chef auch?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A group thing this time?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Diesmal ein Gruppending?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, a few of us
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja, ein paar von uns.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hast du versucht, etwas anders zu machen? 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alles klar, sag mir einfach Bescheid, wenn du zurück bist.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mach ich ❤️.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du musst dein Handy nicht die ganze Zeit checken.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde nicht vergessen, dir zu schreiben.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Okay

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I did have a lovely time yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ich hatte gestern eine tolle Zeit.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already told me 😊
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hast du mir schon gesagt 😊.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, ich wollte es nur nochmal sagen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich auch ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde meinen Teller wegstellen und ins Bett gehen.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein paar Dinge

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schlaf gut

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. Love you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du auch, Hübscher. Ich liebe dich ❤️.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Including blaming the controller?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Inklusive den Controller die Schuld geben?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the first thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war das Erste

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very thorough 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sehr gründlich 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was machst du gerade?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bereits gewechselt. Mache etwas Schnelles, dann bewege ich mich nicht viel

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Okay, ich komme, um dich aus dem Bett zu ziehen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} hat {{name:hailey}} nach mehreren ignorierten Nachrichten aus dem Bett gezogen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und du bist diejenige, die immer noch im Bett liegt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Und zieh dir ein bisschen mehr Kleidung an

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t make me come up there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mach mich nicht verrückt, komm da hoch

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey 😊 Heute kein Wecker, und ich habe beschlossen, mich erst nach dem Frühstück anzuziehen ☕.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe den ganzen Morgen darauf aufgepasst

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: BEVOR SIE DAS HAUS VERLÄSST

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, ich habe das Essen, den Film und den Deckel, der diesmal wirklich passt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast für eine kleine Expedition gepackt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur weil man dir nicht trauen kann, genug Servietten zu besitzen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Komm einfach vorbei. Der Rest ist verhandelbar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war so nett, dass ich aufhören konnte zu meckern.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich genieße die Stille, solange sie anhält.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nicht lange. Ich bin schon unterwegs ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Für die nächsten zwanzig Minuten, absolut 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Danach gehe ich zum kleinen Markt bei der Bäckerei.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Für etwas, das du brauchst?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich muss das Haus mal verlassen, ohne den gleichen Weg zu nehmen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich brauche später etwas Schönes zu essen mit dir ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, die Pasta wäre etwas Schönes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist sie. Aber die Pasta zählt nicht als Dessert, egal wie sehr du sie lobst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das war's dann mit meinem Plan für den Nachmittag.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du bekommst auch den Film, den ich ausgesucht habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich erinnere mich. Ich habe keinen mysteriösen Stromausfall organisiert.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt verdächtig nach einem freien Tag.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das solltest du besser nicht. Ich habe endlich einen gefunden, dessen Ende du mir noch nicht verraten hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist einmal passiert.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast gesagt, der Bruder sah verdächtig aus, bevor er überhaupt gesprochen hat.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Er trug drinnen Handschuhe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Er hat Geschirr gewaschen 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eine überzeugende Verkleidung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Heute kannst du deine Detektivarbeit für dich behalten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ist es 😌 Kein Dienst, kein Stress heute Morgen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ich freue mich darauf, dein Gesicht zu sehen, anstatt mich zu fragen, was die Pause zwischen den Nachrichten bedeutet.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Die Pause war hauptsächlich, weil ich die richtigen Worte finden wollte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich weiß. Heute kannst du mit vollem Mund reden wie ein normaler Mensch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das kriege ich hin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich will einen schönen Nachmittag mit dir, nicht noch ein ernstes Treffen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast dich gestern Abend so gefreut, dass ich fast vorbeigekommen wäre, nur um den Gesichtsausdruck zu sehen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du kannst es heute Nachmittag inspizieren.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Fenster geöffnet und trinke meinen Kaffee, solange er noch heiß ist ☕.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das habe ich vor. Aus ganz nah.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde versuchen, nicht zu selbstzufrieden auszusehen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das wäre eine schöne Abwechslung 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bleibst du danach drinnen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe noch nicht den ganzen Abend durchgeplant.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist ein Teil dessen, was ich an heute mag.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eine ungewohnte Erfahrung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} hat mir vorhin ein Bild von einem Spielhallen-Schild geschickt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hat er irgendwo anders entdeckt, wo er sich über das Verlieren beschweren kann?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Offenbar hat er nur einen hilfreichen Vorschlag für meinen freien Tag gemacht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: So kriegt er dich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass ich heute Nachmittag schon Pläne mit dir habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich soll dich fragen, ob der Air-Hockey-Tisch als neutrales Terrain zählt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nur bis er verliert. Dann ist der Tisch in eine Verschwörung verwickelt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich könnte später gehen. Ich würde es genießen, ihm zuzusehen, wie er versucht, das zu erklären.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nimm kein Best-of-Three an, nachdem du schon gewonnen hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sehr. Ich könnte schwierig zu ertragen sein, wenn ich mich daran gewöhne.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe das auf 😌📝.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Der Typ von gestern hat mir eine Nachricht über das Buch geschickt, das wir uns angesehen haben.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das aus dem Laden?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja. Anscheinend war die erste Seite es wert, nach Hause zu kommen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe nur den Klappentext gelesen, also habe ich ihm gesagt, er soll sich noch nicht zu sicher fühlen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ein vielversprechender Start für einen Buchclub.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es geht hauptsächlich darum, dass wir neue Wege finden, um zu vermeiden, dass wir sagen, dass wir weiter reden wollen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast es also bemerkt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Könnte?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vielleicht höre ich später auf, subtil zu sein.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Für jetzt habe ich ihm gesagt, dass ich den Nachmittag mit dir verbringe. Wir reden heute Abend 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich würde es hassen, meine hervorragenden Filmkommentare mit einem Telefon zu teilen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich lasse es in meiner Tasche. Für die Kommentare, nicht für dich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stimmt, ich sollte echte Klamotten anziehen, bevor die Bäckerei alles verkauft, was ich will 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast nicht einmal entschieden, was du willst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Deshalb brauche ich Optionen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde die Untersuchung abwarten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Iss nicht all deine Snacks, bevor ich da bin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vorsicht, ich überlege noch, was ich dir mitbringen soll.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: SPÄTER AM MORGEN

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Kleine Neuigkeit: Die Bäckerin hat sich an mich erinnert

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt schön

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sie hat sich erinnert, dass ich immer sage, ich kaufe nur Brot

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Weniger schön für deine Verteidigung

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sie hatte schon nach einer größeren Tüte gegriffen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist definitiv nicht nur Brot

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da ist Brot drin. Irgendwo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe zwei Apfeltaschen für uns geholt und genug andere Sachen, damit sich der Heimweg lohnt 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst glücklich aus.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Das bin ich. Ich habe zehn Minuten damit verbracht, Blumen anzuschauen, ohne zu rechnen, wo ich als Nächstes sein musste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Habe nichts gekauft. Habe einfach genossen, dort zu sein

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Wir sollten mehr Tage wie diesen haben

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, das sollten wir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich gehe nach Hause, um den Behälter zu holen, dann komme ich nach dem Mittagessen vorbei, wie wir gesagt haben

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ist halb zwei noch okay?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Perfekt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich stelle die Getränke in den Kühlschrank

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Und lass meine Seite der Couch frei

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du siehst aus, als hättest du dich schon mit dem Nichtstun angefreundet.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hast du gesehen, was für einen Hintern ich darin habe? 😌
Du hast auch deinen Spaß daran

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ins Fitnessstudio oder zu deinem Date mit deinem Trainer?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Du schaust doch nicht nach einem anderen anstößigen Outfit, oder?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ich verbringe den Nachmittag mit ein paar Freunden
Schau dich an, wie produktiv du bist 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey ❤️ Ich bin gerade mal die Straße runter und mir ist schon ein weiterer Grund eingefallen, warum deine Theorie über den Film keinen Sinn macht 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Was kommt als Nächstes?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Fotokabine ist verlockend 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Um den Beweis meiner Niederlage festzuhalten?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, weil ich sehen will, ob du vier Bilder ohne Grimasse hinbekommst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Unwahrscheinlich. Das ist eine sehr unfairer Herausforderung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: EIN PAAR MINUTEN SPÄTER, IN DER FOTOKABINE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du weißt schon, dass ich mindestens eines davon ruinieren werde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mindestens eines? Das ist optimistisch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Komm näher, dann. Ich brauche jeden möglichen Vorteil.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So funktionieren Fotokabinen nicht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast den Großteil davon mitgebracht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zu spät. Der Countdown hat begonnen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Teilnehmer betreten die Fotokabine.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine Reihe persönlicher Fotos wird aufgenommen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich möchte, dass sie den Abend genießt, und ich kann zugeben, dass ich neugierig bin, wie nah die beiden sich kommen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fotokabinenstreifen I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fotokabinenstreifen II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast im ersten ein Gesicht gezogen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und du hast in allen gelächelt, also denke ich immer noch, dass ich gewonnen habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So funktioniert Gewinnen nicht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dann erklär mir das letzte Bild.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast mich geküsst, bevor der Blitz losging 😳.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und jetzt ist es für immer festgehalten. Bitte schön.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich meinte den Teil, wo wir aufgehört haben zu reden und einfach zusammen gesessen haben.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du bist unmöglich 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wählst du nach dem hier immer noch Flipper?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Und ich werde nicht den ganzen Abend damit verbringen, Punkte zu zählen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da gibt es auch tatsächlich einen Punktestand.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deinen kannst du für dich behalten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: SPÄTER, DRAUSSEN

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte vergessen, wie laut die Straße sein kann, wenn es ruhig ist.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meine Ohren sind immer noch drinnen und spielen das Rennspiel.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deine Würde ist da drinnen irgendwo auch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte eine gute Zeit.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe nicht gemerkt, wie sehr ich es vermisst habe, dich neben mir zu haben, bis ich dort war.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Auch wenn ich gewonnen habe?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Auch wenn du das nie vergessen wirst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte auch eine gute Zeit.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Soll ich ein Stück mit dir gehen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Ich habe daran gedacht, Tee zu machen, wenn ich zurückkomme.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das klingt vernünftig.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war fast eine Einladung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fast?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Möchtest du auf einen Tee vorbeikommen? Wir haben noch das Gebäck, das du vor deinem großen Auftritt nicht essen wolltest.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das würde ich gerne.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hat mir auch gefallen. Sogar als dein Ellbogen meine Rippen gefunden hat.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und keine Fragen, wo ich einen zweiten Controller aufbewahre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde es nicht einmal erwähnen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gehe nach Hause und mache mir ein bisschen den Sofa für mich 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fehlt dir schon der Filmkommentar?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde überleben. Ich habe ein Buch und jemanden, der anscheinend weiter gelesen hat als ich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein neuer Kontakt?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Wir haben seit ich bei dir war, ein paar Nachrichten ausgetauscht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat sich erinnert, dass ich dich sehe, und hat gewartet, bis ich gesagt habe, dass ich frei bin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast zu viel von dem Kissen eingenommen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich wollte ihn schon daran hindern, die wichtige Kissen-Diskussion zu unterbrechen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Niemand hätte das ohne mehrere Fotos verstanden.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schade, dass es kein Dokumentarfilm darüber gibt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ermutige mich nicht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: WIEDER ZUHAUSE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Habe meinen Platz im Buch gefunden. Es war immer noch das Lesezeichen, das sie im Laden reingemacht haben 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist nicht viel Fortschritt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe beim Gespräch mehr Fortschritt gemacht als beim Lesen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde ihm richtig antworten, anstatt so zu tun, als könnte ich beides machen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sprechen wir später.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja ❤️ Dieses Bild war übrigens für dich. Er hat die peinliche Lesezeichen-Geschichte nicht verdient 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: SPÄTER AM ABEND

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eine Antwort in Bildern

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe zwei Bilder, die dir gefallen könnten. Er hat gesagt, ich darf dir auch seins zeigen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ihr habt Fotos ausgetauscht?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Das ist das Lächeln, das er gewollt hat.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei nett. Ich habe dir diesmal echte Reste dagelassen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und das ist das Foto, das er in seiner Küche gemacht hat. Ich leite es weiter, ohne die Kameraarbeit zu beanspruchen 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: War die Schürze dazu da, seine Qualifikationen zu zeigen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Offenbar konnte das Abendessen nicht für die Kamera lächeln.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist eine Antwort, die dir gefallen würde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das war es. Ich habe gelacht, bevor ich so tun konnte, als würde ich nicht lachen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dein Foto ist übrigens wunderschön.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wusste, dass du das zuerst bemerkst ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und deinen Löffel.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bewahr ihn gut auf. Ich erwarte ein dramatisches Wiedersehen.
