story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hattest zwei Stunden, um es mir zu sagen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich treffe mich mit {{name:aiden}}, nachdem ich den Behälter zu Hause abgestellt habe 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Spielhalle?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ja. Er meinte, es wäre schade, deinen Expertenrat ungenutzt zu lassen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er weiß nicht mal die Hälfte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat mich schon gewarnt, dass eine der Maschinen Münzen frisst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nützlich. Eine Ausrede, die du dir vor deinem Eintreffen überlegt hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lasse ihm genau eine.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war beschäftigt, es zu schauen, während du jeden beschuldigt hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Großzügig.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich wollte ihn wiedersehen, und etwas zu unternehmen klang schöner als ein weiteres vorsichtiges Gespräch bei Kaffee.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Geh und hab Spaß. Du brauchst kein weiteres Briefing von mir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gut. Ich habe genug Anweisungen von dem Detektiv auf der Couch bekommen 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: FRÜHER ABEND, VOR DER SPIELHALLE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin da 🎮 Man kann diesen Ort schon von der Straße aus hören.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lass ihn nicht jedes Spiel auswählen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er ist gerade angekommen und hat auf eine Rennmaschine gezeigt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Natürlich hat er das.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bei einer Person hatte ich recht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich lege mein Handy weg. Drück mir die Daumen 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das wirst du nicht brauchen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: IM SPIELSALON

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du bist gut vorbereitet.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wofür?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sinnvolle Schuhe. Da erwartet jemand zu gewinnen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist jemand, der heute Morgen über einen Markt gelaufen ist.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe dir tatsächlich etwas mitgebracht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Schon ein Trostpreis?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein Gebäck. Das kann ich auch selbst essen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nachdem du alle sieben beschuldigt hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein, ich nehme die Entschuldigung schon mal vorweg an.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du machst es mir echt schwer, nachdenklich zu sein.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke. Das war nett von dir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da. Siehst du, wie wenig Aufwand das war?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wirst du heute Abend jeden Satz überwachen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nur die nervigen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist der Großteil meines Materials.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Da musst du improvisieren.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: NACH IHREM ERSTEN SPIEL

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Der erste Punkt zählt nicht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gründliche Detektivarbeit.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Maschine ist anderer Meinung

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast es getroffen, bevor ich bereit war

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast erklärt, wie einfach das werden würde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich war freundlich

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du hast gesagt, du würdest es mir leicht machen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und das war offensichtlich ein Fehler

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Also gibst du zu, dass ich gewonnen habe?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gebe zu, dass es Platz für ein zweites Spiel gibt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nein. Du hast die erste Maschine gewählt. Ich wähle die nächste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Spiel beendet

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} gewinnt die erste Runde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Und trotzdem hast du nicht bemerkt, dass ich den letzten Bissen von deinem Gebäck geklaut habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ein sehr schlechter Verlierer

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}} hat dich dazu angestiftet

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat mich gewarnt, dass du nach einer weiteren Runde fragen würdest, wenn du verlierst

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich werde mit ihm reden

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darüber, dass er dich zu gut kennt?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Darüber, dass er die Gegner trainiert

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es geschafft, einen Puck zu treffen, ohne dass ihr mir geholfen habt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das hast du. Der letzte Schuss war gut

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entschuldigung, könntest du das wiederholen? Die Maschine hat Lärm gemacht

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Übertreib's nicht

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe es bemerkt. Ich habe dir den Bissen gelassen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich brauche vielleicht einen Moment, um es zu schätzen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich gebe dir fünf Sekunden.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du zählst wirklich alles.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Kann ich ein Foto mit dir machen? Ich würde ihm gerne eins schicken.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Klar. Wird die Anzeigetafel darauf sein?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: War es nicht. Ausgezeichnete Idee!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gib mir wenigstens eine Sekunde, um weniger besiegt auszusehen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das ist, was ich zu glauben wähle.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zu spät. Das ist das Gesicht, das ich will.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: EINEN MOMENT SPÄTER

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat einem Foto zugestimmt. Der Ausdruck ist ganz sein Werk.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich erkenne dieses Gesicht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Er gibt dir die Schuld, dass du mich gewarnt hast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sag ihm, ich genieße meine Rente vom Zuhören seiner Ausreden.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Das erspare ich ihm fürs Erste 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: NACHDEM SIE IHR HANDY WEGGELEGT HAT

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke für diesen Nachmittag ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich weiß, dass du ihr nicht wehtun wirst

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Aber ist das nicht komisch für dich?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Eigentlich macht es die Dinge einfacher

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich konnte nicht anders, als ihn zu knipsen 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sie will mehr Cardio als alles andere 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich bin echt happy, wie es gelaufen ist 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sie wird ihr Geld wert sein 😂

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Im Umkleideraum ist etwas passiert, als wir gegangen sind

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sie wollte die Sitzung noch ein bisschen fortsetzen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Also musste ich mich um sie kümmern 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Happy mit der Sitzung oder mit {{name:hailey}}? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mann, ich hätte nie gedacht, dass ich so ein Gespräch mit dir über {{name:hailey}} führen würde 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Aber auch wenn es komisch ist… es ist irgendwie cool

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich komme morgen für einen Spiele-Nachmittag vorbei

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ich weiß, dass ihr beide aufeinander steht

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hey 😊 Ich schulde dir einen Deckel. Irgendwie habe ich den auch mit nach Hause gebracht 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist deutlich weniger Lärm als in der Spielhalle.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du hast keine Ahnung. Ich habe fast mein Gehör zurück. Andere Teile von mir sind weniger ruhig.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du siehst glücklich aus.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin ❤️ Wir lassen die Handys mal eine Weile in Ruhe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sprechen wir später.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: NACHDEM SIE IHR HANDY WEGGELEGT HAT

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: SPÄTER AN DIESEM ABEND

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Wenn ich so bleibe, vergesse ich, dass ich gehen wollte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist kein Zufall.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dein Shirt ist hochgerutscht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich habe es bemerkt. Du kannst deine Hand da lassen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du machst es mir echt schwer, der Erste zu sein, der aufsteht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dann küss mich noch einmal und steh dann auf. Ich nehme dich heute Nacht nicht mit ins Bett.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich wollte nicht fragen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du hast es gedacht. Ich auch. Deshalb sage ich es jetzt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ein letzter tiefer Kuss auf dem Sofa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Seine Hand an ihrer Taille, ihre unter dem Saum seines Shirts.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das geht schnell, und ich möchte, dass wir weiter ehrlich darüber reden, was sich richtig anfühlt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//HINWEIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mir hat der Abend gefallen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Den ruhigeren Teil auch?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: EIN WENIG SPÄTER, ZUHAUSE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Besonders dieser Teil. Dein Mund. Deine Hände. Alles daran.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du kannst gehen, ohne einen cleveren letzten Spruch zu versuchen, weißt du.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich wollte sagen, dass ich dich gerne wiedersehen würde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das kannst du behalten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Schreib mir morgen. Wir finden schon eine Lösung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mach ich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und nimm die Gebäckschachtel mit. Wenn du sie hier lässt, esse ich den Rest.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eine sehr schwierige Verantwortung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Irgendwie denke ich, dass du damit klarkommst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: NACHDEM ER GEHEN IST.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er ist nach Hause gegangen. Wir haben viel länger auf dem Sofa gesessen, als wir geplant hatten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tee war also eine gute Idee.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Auf jeden Fall. Wir haben geredet, nah beieinander gesessen, und dann habe ich ihn zu mir gezogen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Seine Hände waren unter meinem Top. Meine waren unter seinem Shirt. Wir haben uns geküsst, bis ich ihm sagen musste, dass wir heute nicht weitergehen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er hat endlich aufgehört zu fragen, ob er besser abschneidet als du.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist ein großer Durchbruch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mach aus dem Nicht-Wettbewerb keinen Wettbewerb 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich lerne

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Es fühlte sich heute anders an. Weniger so, als ob wir herausfinden wollten, was passieren sollte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ja. Ich habe versehentlich seinen Deckel mit nach Hause gebracht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich wollte seine Hände auf mir, also habe ich sie dorthin gelegt. Es brauchte keine weitere Ansprache.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du klingst damit ganz entspannt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin ein bisschen rot geworden. Und ich bin froh, dass ich diesen Nachmittag mit dir verbringen konnte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin wieder allein. Es war ein schöner Abend.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du klingst zufrieden.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das bin ich. Müde auf eine angenehme Art, noch ein bisschen warm und sehr froh, dass ich den ganzen Tag nicht nur auf die Uhr geschaut habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Behalte die Details, die du behalten möchtest. Ich freue mich, dass du Spaß hattest.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Danke. Ich möchte noch ein paar Minuten mit dir verbringen, bevor ich schlafe ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ihr beiden werdet eine Inventarliste brauchen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: SPÄTER AN DIESEM ABEND

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ein Grund zum Lächeln

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich habe die App endlich weggelegt 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hast du es geschafft, etwas von dem Buch zu lesen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ein bisschen. Sehr wenig, nachdem wir über gestern gesprochen haben. Und dann noch weniger nach den Fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er hat mir gesagt, dass er nach einem Grund gesucht hat, um die Buchhandlung nicht zu verlassen. Und dass er richtig mit mir rummachen wollte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und du hast versucht, einen Grund zu finden, um zu bleiben.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er hat meinen Löffel. Wir verhandeln.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Genau. Wir scheinen dieses Missverständnis geklärt zu haben 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Die Nachrichten waren heute Abend viel weniger vorsichtig.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du musstest nicht weiter so tun, als würdet ihr nur über das Buch sprechen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Nein. Ich habe ihm gesagt, dass ich ihn wiedersehen möchte. Und nicht nur reden.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und wir haben uns noch ein paar Fotos geschickt. Dann ein paar, die weniger unschuldig waren.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er hat zugestimmt, dass ich dir diese beiden zeigen kann. Die späteren bleiben zwischen ihm und mir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich könnte vermitteln.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist das Lächeln, das normalerweise bedeutet, dass du so tust, als hättest du nichts gemacht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Er hat es auch bemerkt. Sehr ungünstig für mich. Der Träger hat meine Sache nicht gerade verbessert.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und das ist das, das er gemacht und zurückgeschickt hat.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ihr beiden seht aus, als hättet ihr Spaß an der Unterhaltung.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das waren wir. Keiner von uns hat danach viel gelesen. Ich habe die letzten Bilder für mich behalten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das arme Buch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Es wird sich erholen. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich das bis morgen schaffe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: War es einfacher, in Nachrichten zu reden?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du hast einen Punkt angefochten, der in Zahlen angezeigt wurde. Ich glaube nicht, dass du dafür qualifiziert bist.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: In gewisser Weise. Ich konnte einen Moment nachdenken, ohne mir Sorgen zu machen, dass die Stille seltsam aussieht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Aber ich habe mich auch dabei ertappt, wie ich hören wollte, wie er etwas sagt, nicht nur es zu lesen. Und ich wollte seine Hände statt eines weiteren Fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das klingt nach einem Grund für ein weiteres Date.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist es. Wir reden morgen und wählen eine Zeit.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Für heute Abend bin ich fertig mit dem Wechseln zwischen den Gesprächen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich hätte gerne ein bisschen Zeit mit dir, bevor ich schlafe ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin für heute Abend mit dem Nachrichten fertig. Ich hatte einen wirklich schönen Abend.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hat das Buch viel Aufmerksamkeit bekommen?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Willst du Zucker?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Nicht genug, um vorzugeben, dass ich ein ernsthafter Leser geworden bin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich werde mein Urteil zurückhalten, bis du das nächste Kapitel erreichst.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Danke. Den Rest der Details behalte ich heute Abend für mich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist in Ordnung. Wie fühlst du dich?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Froh. Ein bisschen zu warm, um sofort zu schlafen. Und bereit, einfach eine Minute mit dir zu reden ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Einen, bitte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ist das deine Art, einen weiteren Besuch zu arrangieren?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Wie war dein Abend, nachdem ich gegangen bin?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ruhig. Ich habe aufgeräumt und dann eine Weile gespielt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hast du wieder festgehangen beim Nachdenken?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ein bisschen, aber dieser Nachmittag hat mehr geholfen, als hier zu sitzen und alles vorherzusagen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Wir haben immer noch über den Film gestritten, du hast immer noch mein Essen gestohlen. Nichts fühlte sich gezwungen an.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das war es nicht. Ich war genau da, wo ich sein wollte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich weiß. Du bist fast auf mir eingeschlafen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das war ein Kompliment an das Sofa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Offensichtlich

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Siehst du? Eine Vorliebe. Sehr beeindruckend!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du klingst, als hättest du einen richtig guten Tag gehabt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hatte ich. War deiner in Ordnung, nachdem ich gegangen bin?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ja. Ruhiger, aber ich fand es schön, den Nachmittag mit dir zu verbringen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich erinnere mich ständig daran, wie du versucht hast, meinen Arm zu bewegen, ohne zuzugeben, dass du dich anlehnen wolltest.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dein Ellenbogen hat einfach viel zu viel Platz eingenommen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich werde es beim nächsten Mal praktischer einrichten.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Please do. I'm a demanding guest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mach das bitte. Ich bin ein anspruchsvoller Gast.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich bin froh, dass heute nicht einfach nur gestern mit anderen Klamotten war.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You saved that one all the way from yesterday
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du hast den von gestern bis jetzt aufbewahrt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das sollten wir in den Kalender eintragen. Ab und zu mal was anderes machen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du könntest mir sogar erlauben, den nächsten Film ohne formellen Antrag auszuwählen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Let's not get carried away
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lass uns nicht übertreiben.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you, you know ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich liebe dich, weißt du ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich liebe dich auch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Now I'm going to get into bed before I start typing with my eyes closed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Jetzt gehe ich ins Bett, bevor ich anfange, mit geschlossenen Augen zu tippen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: EINIGE MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Made it 😊 This one is just for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Geschafft 😊 Das hier ist nur für dich.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's my favorite end to the day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist mein Lieblingsabschluss des Tages.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I've been waiting for the right moment
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich habe auf den richtigen Moment gewartet.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing me finally stop talking?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mich endlich aufhören zu sehen, zu reden?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing you look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dich glücklich zu sehen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Oh. Now I have to be nice instead of making another joke
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oh. Jetzt muss ich nett sein, anstatt einen weiteren Witz zu machen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can manage one message
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du schaffst eine Nachricht.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night, handsome ❤️ Thank you for today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Gute Nacht, Hübscher ❤️ Danke für heute

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night. I'll keep your side of the sofa ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Gute Nacht. Ich halte deine Seite des Sofas bereit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And my spoon 😌 Don't forget my spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und meinen Löffel 😌 Vergiss meinen Löffel nicht

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER THEY SIT DOWN WITH THEIR TEA
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: NACHDEM SIE SICH MIT IHREM TEE SETZEN.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is much nicer than shouting over a machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Das ist viel schöner, als gegen den Lärm eines Automaten anzuschreien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were the one doing most of the shouting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du warst derjenige, der am lautesten geschrien hat.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I got involved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich habe mich eingemischt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You explained your strategy to a puck
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Du hast einem Puck deine Strategie erklärt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And it refused to listen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Und er wollte nicht zuhören.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I had a nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich hatte einen schönen Abend.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No 😌 I was going to do that without stealing your kitchen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Nein 😌 Ich wollte das machen, ohne deine Küche zu klauen.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: So did I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich auch.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not only saying that because I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ich sage das nicht nur, weil ich gewonnen habe.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know
