story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe schon mehr als genug gute Dinge für mich

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I was trying not to ask too soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich wollte nicht zu früh fragen

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds suspiciously sweet
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Das klingt verdächtig süß

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It was supposed to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Das sollte es sein

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You taking care of me like this is already a lot
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Dass du dich so um mich kümmerst, ist schon viel

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Careful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Vorsichtig

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: If you keep saying things like that, I might start feeling useful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Wenn du so weiter redest, könnte ich anfangen, mich nützlich zu fühlen

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Then maybe I should keep saying them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Dann sollte ich vielleicht weiter so reden

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You deserve to feel useful too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Du verdienst es auch, dich nützlich zu fühlen

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Das werde ich mir merken

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Good
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Gut

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Just keep me updated tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Halt mich heute Abend einfach auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: But do you have any news about that work you mentioned?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Aber hast du Neuigkeiten zu dem Job, den du erwähnt hast?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'm curious about this mysterious job now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich bin jetzt neugierig auf diesen geheimnisvollen Job

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You'll be the first to know
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Du wirst der Erste sein, der es erfährt

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll hold you to that 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Darauf halte ich dich fest 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Almost
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Fast

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I checked most of it already
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich habe schon das meiste überprüft

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I just want to verify a few more things before I promise anything
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ich möchte nur noch ein paar Dinge verifizieren, bevor ich etwas verspreche

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: So it is serious?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Also ist es ernst?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ja

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: If everything is clean, I will tell you properly tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Wenn alles sauber ist, werde ich dir heute Abend richtig Bescheid geben

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It should be something pretty cool for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Es sollte etwas ziemlich Cooles für mich sein

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Do you have two minutes?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Hast du zwei Minuten?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll be doing moderation for a website and live channel
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich werde Moderation für eine Website und einen Live-Kanal machen

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The pay is pretty good
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Die Bezahlung ist ziemlich gut

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And everything can be done from my PC
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Und alles kann von meinem PC aus erledigt werden

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That already sounds much better than having to leave the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Das klingt schon viel besser, als das Haus verlassen zu müssen.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The only downside is the schedule
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Der einzige Nachteil ist der Zeitplan.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: How so?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Wie so?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: There aren't really any fixed hours
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Es gibt eigentlich keine festen Stunden.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: When they need me, I have to be available immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Wenn sie mich brauchen, muss ich sofort verfügbar sein.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And once a moderation session starts, I can't leave my PC until it's finished
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Und sobald eine Moderationssitzung beginnt, kann ich meinen PC nicht verlassen, bis sie beendet ist.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Not for food
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Nicht mal für Essen.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Just finishing drying my hair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich trockne gerade meine Haare 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Barely for the bathroom
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Kaum für das Badezimmer.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That does sound a little rough
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Das klingt ein bisschen hart.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: But I understand it too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Aber ich verstehe es auch.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: If they need urgent moderation, they probably need someone there immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Wenn sie dringend Moderation brauchen, brauchen sie wahrscheinlich sofort jemanden dort.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Will that be okay for you?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Wird das für dich in Ordnung sein?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think so
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich denke schon

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It's not perfect, but it's something I can actually do from home
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Es ist nicht perfekt, aber es ist etwas, das ich tatsächlich von zu Hause aus machen kann.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Then that's what matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Darauf kommt es an.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And now that I'm not working anymore, I'll have plenty of time
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Und jetzt, wo ich nicht mehr arbeite, habe ich viel Zeit.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: So don't worry about the rest
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Mach dir also keine Sorgen um den Rest.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll make sure you always have food, water and everything you need nearby
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich werde dafür sorgen, dass du immer Essen, Wasser und alles, was du brauchst, in der Nähe hast.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You can focus on your work without worrying about anything else
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Du kannst dich auf deine Arbeit konzentrieren, ohne dir um irgendetwas anderes Sorgen zu machen.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You're going to spoil me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Du wirst mich verwöhnen.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: After everything you've done for me lately?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Nach allem, was du in letzter Zeit für mich getan hast?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think it's only fair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich finde, das ist nur fair 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Danke, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Anytime
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Immer gerne

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: DAY 10
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: TAG 10

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Give me five minutes and I'll be there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Gib mir fünf Minuten, dann bin ich da.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 5 MINUTEN SPÄTER

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Alright, I'm available now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Okay, ich bin jetzt verfügbar.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Was gibt's?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It was about the work I mentioned earlier
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Es ging um die Arbeit, die ich vorher erwähnt habe.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to explain what it actually is
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ich wollte erklären, was das eigentlich ist.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Yes finally, I was curious about it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ja endlich, ich war neugierig darauf.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Honestly, I hope I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Ehrlich gesagt, ich hoffe, ich kann den Gips bald abbekommen

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: But don't get stupid with it
That's exactly what someone stupid would say
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Das ist genau das, was jemand Dummes sagen würde

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Don't go to bed too late
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Geh nicht zu spät ins Bett

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: The game won't be ready tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Das Spiel wird heute Abend nicht fertig

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: It's downloading like it has somewhere better to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Es lädt herunter, als hätte es einen besseren Ort zu sein
Bist du nach heute Morgen immer noch okay?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not start pacing like an old man
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Fang nicht an, wie ein alter Mann umherzulaufen
Ich habe an das Lernen gedacht

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Start with what changes, then why it matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Fang mit den Veränderungen an, dann warum es wichtig ist

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: And you did a good job picking the outfit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Und du hast das Outfit echt gut ausgesucht

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not make it a thing
Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Süß und sicher, genau wie du es bestellt hast

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Sag mir, wie süß ich bin 😌
Mach nicht zu viel, kleiner Teufel

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Ich hatte Angst, wie sich die Dinge zwischen uns anfühlen würden.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Aber ich denke, wir haben es gut gemeistert.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Und ich habe den ganzen Tag über nachgedacht, was du heute Morgen gesagt hast.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Außerdem habe ich eines deiner Shirts angezogen.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Das fühlt sich illegal an, wenn ich nicht da bin.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
What a lucky man I am
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Was für ein glücklicher Mann ich bin

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Und ich bin ein wirklich glückliches Mädchen, dich zu haben ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Ich werde mein Gesicht waschen und ins Bett gehen, bevor ich anfange, dich zu laut zu vermissen.
Dafür ist es auch zu spät 😏

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Und lieg eine Weile auf dem Rücken und starr an die Decke.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Schau mir einfach zu, wie ich riesig werde 😏

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Ich wollte dir nur sagen, dass ich es selbst erledigt habe.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Ich gehe auf meine eigene Art und Weise zurück in dieses Fitnessstudio.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Wenn sie mich wieder belästigen, können wir das draußen klären 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Aber du könntest auch darum bitten, dass sie aus dem Fitnessstudio geworfen werden.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Einer von ihnen besitzt den Laden.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Er hat gesagt, ich kann nach dem Unterricht bleiben und er geht die Aufgabe mit mir durch

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist wahrscheinlich der schnellste Weg, um zu lernen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Als ob ich nicht verloren bin, sondern einfach schlecht organisiert

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Wenn ich akademisch leiden muss, dann verdiene ich es, später toll auszusehen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich halte dich nach seiner Hilfe-Session auf dem Laufenden 😇
Die Aufgabe ist immer noch hässlich

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Schick sie später, ich schau drüber

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber die Schule hat schon wegen der Nachhilfe geantwortet

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Die wollen mich bei meinem Hauptprofessor

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Morgen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Neue Outfits oder so etwas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass es etwas Dummes sein wird und ich möchte sowieso das Outfit nicht wechseln.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Was soll ich tun, wenn er mir das aufdrängt?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Deine Antwort hier kann sich in naher Zukunft auswirken.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Warte, um die Outfits zu sehen, und sprich dann mit ihm, wenn dir sie nicht gefallen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vertraue ihm, auch wenn er nervig ist, er führt die Bar doch gut, oder?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Wenn es nicht in Ordnung ist, sag es ihm ruhig und setze eine Grenze.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Also weigere ich mich nicht, bevor ich überhaupt weiß, was es ist.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Genau

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: In Ordnung

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen, wie lief es gestern Abend in der Bar?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast recht, vielleicht mache ich aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Versuche, ihm auf der Arbeit zu vertrauen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Er ist nervig, aber die Bar läuft immer noch, also macht er etwas richtig.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Glaubst du das wirklich?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bleib einfach ruhig und gehe nicht zu früh vom Schlimmsten aus.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde versuchen, ihm den Vorteil des Zweifels zu geben.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es war okay

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mach dir auf jeden Fall nicht zu viele Sorgen um ihn, arbeite einfach normal.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hab auch eine gute Zeit mit deinen Kollegen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und schreib mir, sobald sich etwas falsch anfühlt.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du an meiner Seite bist.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist normal, mach dir keine Sorgen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich hielt meinen Kopf unten und machte meine Arbeit.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber der Manager beobachtete alles wie ein Falke, ziemlich nervig.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es wird alles gut.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Du musst ihn nur ein bisschen ertragen, dann lässt er dich in Ruhe.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, du hast recht.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Zumindest macht es mir Spaß, mit meinen Kollegen zu arbeiten.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh, dieser Bastard hat gesagt, dass er vielleicht bald neue Kleiderordnungsvorschriften einführen wird.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Aber ich schätze, ich brauchte die Wahrheit.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Das bedeutet nicht, dass es sich gut angefühlt hat.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Wissend, dass du mich nicht willst

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's not that I don't want you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Es ist nicht so, dass ich dich nicht will.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Es ist nur so, dass ich gerade nicht bereit dafür bin.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich brauche nur ein wenig Zeit.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I really didn't want to hurt you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich wollte dich wirklich nicht verletzen.
Deshalb bin ich immer noch hier

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich werde ein bisschen aufräumen und eine Weile von zu Hause aus arbeiten.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich muss meinen Kopf beschäftigt halten.
Ich habe diesen Schlaf wirklich gebraucht.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Und... danke, dass du letzte Nacht ehrlich warst.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
Finally ! I always had hope in you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Endlich! Ich hatte immer Hoffnung in dich

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du siehst aus, als ob du mehr beaufsichtigst als putzt

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Hurry up and clean your room
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mach schnell und putz dein Zimmer

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag das nochmal und ich packe dich in den Spendenbeutel

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} hat eine Kiste unter meinem Bett gefunden und mir diesen Mutterblick zugeworfen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mein Anwalt hat gesagt, ich soll schweigen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt muss ich gehen, bevor sie mehr Beweise findet 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} hat beschlossen, dass heute anscheinend der Krieg gegen den Staub ist

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: We are doing a huge cleaning session

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Besonders wenn du so tust, als ob es dir gut geht.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ich vertraue einfach deinen Überlebensinstinkten nicht.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Nimm es einfach ruhig, bis ich fertig bin.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Okay, meine Pause ist fast vorbei

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir nach meiner Schicht 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Nicht schrecklich, gerade genug, um die Zeit langsam erscheinen zu lassen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
Thank you, I practiced that lie
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Danke, ich habe diese Lüge geübt.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dann würdest du wahrscheinlich das andere auch brechen 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm about to leave for the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ich bin gleich auf dem Weg ins Fitnessstudio

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Je früher ich gehe, desto schneller ist es vorbei

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Es tut mir immer noch leid, dass ich nicht wirklich helfen kann

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sag mir einfach Bescheid, wenn etwas passiert

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You'll run over there on one leg?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Wirst du dann auf einem Bein rüberhumpeln?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gute Nachrichten, ich arbeite heute Nacht oder morgen Nacht nicht.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Konzentrier dich einfach darauf, wieder gesund zu werden, das ist gerade das Wichtigste

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Danke für alles, was du tust

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Es tut mir leid, dass ich gerade so eine Last bin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sag das nicht

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du bist keine Last

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und das hier ist alles nicht deine Schuld

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du brauchst einfach Zeit, um dich zu erholen, das ist alles

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nach dem Abendessen heute Abend können wir, wenn du magst, etwas Zeit zusammen verbringen 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das würde ich lieben

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann machen wir das

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann habe ich endlich etwas Freizeit

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich glaube, ich nutze die Zeit, um das Haus zu putzen und Wäsche zu waschen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hast du auch etwas, das gewaschen werden muss?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, ich habe ein paar Sachen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du dir sicher, dass du keine Hilfe brauchst?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nein, mach dir keine Sorgen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst dich ausruhen, bis du vollständig geheilt bist

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bist du dir sicher?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ja, ich weiß, dass du helfen möchtest, aber ich kann das alleine schaffen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich könnte ein bisschen spät dran sein

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for setting everything up
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du alles vorbereitet hast

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Nimm dir Zeit, ich fange ohne dich nicht an 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich kann mir nicht mal die Zähne putzen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich komme in etwa fünfzehn Minuten runter

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe den Film und das Popcorn vorbereitet

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt fehlt mir nur noch du und {{name:mason}}.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Bist du fast fertig im Bad?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: And yet you keep talking to me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Und trotzdem redest du weiter mit mir

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I'll come out when I'm done
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Ich komme raus, wenn ich fertig bin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Weil du schon ewig da drin bist

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Ich muss mir auch die Zähne putzen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Du brauchst keine vierzig Minuten, um dir die Zähne zu putzen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Und ja, ich habe das Arbeitsblatt gemacht, bevor ich gegangen bin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Der Professor würde wahrscheinlich aus den Schatten auftauchen, wenn ich es ausgelassen hätte

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber die Party ist tatsächlich beim Sohn des Direktors 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich bin ihm gerade über den Weg gelaufen

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat mir nur kurz gewunken

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Aber jetzt fühle ich mich komisch schüchtern wegen des Outfits

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Weil ich nicht geplant hatte, so von ihm gesehen zu werden.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Hör auf, so selbstgefällig durch das Telefon zu schauen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Er meinte, ich sehe reifer aus als sonst und jetzt gebe ich euch beiden die Schuld 😇
Dein Geschmack ist immer noch gefährlich

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mein Professor hat gesagt, es sei schön, was irgendwie stressig war 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Süß und sicher, genau wie du es bestellt hast

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Bitte sag, ich sehe aus wie eine verantwortungsvolle Studentin, die definitiv lernt 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Die Party war tatsächlich echt lustig.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab eine Menge Leute gesehen, die ich ewig nicht gesehen habe.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt ist mein soziales Akku komplett leer.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab ein bisschen mit meinem Professor geredet.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Er hat gefragt, ob ich die Party genieße und gesagt, das Outfit steht mir.
Das war tatsächlich ein bisschen stressig.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hab nicht damit gerechnet, ihm dort zu begegnen.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Aber ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich besser darin werde.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Es macht es ein wenig lohnenswerter.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Kann ich dich sehen, bevor du ins Bett gehst?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Ich gehe duschen und dann ins Bett.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Komm spiel mit mir, damit ich dir den Hintern versohlen kann.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Also, wer ist es und wann fange ich an?
Du wirst wahrscheinlich etwas Ausrüstung brauchen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Dein Trainer sollte mir tagsüber schreiben, wenn alles gut ist.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Warum willst du seinen Namen nicht sagen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Or is it because you have no one? 😒
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Oder liegt es daran, dass du niemanden hast? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt viel zu dramatisch für Hilfe bei Hausaufgaben 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Wenn das meine Noten rettet und mich vor Schulerniedrigung bewahrt, dann schulde ich dir was 😇

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich kann immer noch nicht glauben, dass ich so dringend Hilfe brauche 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber jemanden zu Hause oder online zu haben, klingt schon viel weniger schrecklich, als nach dem Unterricht mit Lehrern zu bleiben.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Manchmal ist da viel Arbeit drin 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Hast du wirklich jemanden Seriösen gefunden oder improvisierst du wieder mit Selbstvertrauen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich hab dir gesagt, ich kümmere mich darum.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your future is safe with me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Deine Zukunft ist bei mir sicher.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey, bist du wach?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I want to help
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich möchte helfen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Du bist nicht nutzlos, du bist diejenige, die hier alles am Laufen hält

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Außerdem suche ich nach etwas, das wir zusammen machen können

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich könnte einen Hinweis haben

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich möchte es überprüfen, bevor ich dich zu irgendetwas verpflichten kann

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Was für eine Arbeit?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Is it safe?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ist es sicher?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And is it legal?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und ist es legal?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, natürlich

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es geht hauptsächlich um Terminplanung und Treffen mit Leuten an öffentlichen Orten

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Guten Morgen, ja, ich bin vor ein paar Minuten aufgewacht

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Keine Bar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Keine späten Nächte, die von einem Manager erzwungen werden

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Leute treffen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Wofür?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Passive Einsicht sagt, wie du deine nächste Antwort formulierst, kann ihre Reaktion verändern

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es ist wie einen Tag lang ein Freund zu sein, sie bezahlen für deine Zeit und Gesellschaft

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es sind im Grunde bezahlte Dates, aber mit strengen Regeln und nur an öffentlichen Orten

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Das klingt seltsam

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Zahlen die Leute nur, um zu reden?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Einige Menschen fühlen sich wirklich einsam

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Wie fühlst du dich heute?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sie wollen Gesellschaft ohne Druck

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und du bist gut darin, Menschen ein sicheres Gefühl zu geben

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und wer weiß, vielleicht findest du jemanden, den du magst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast lange auf uns aufgepasst, jetzt ist es an der Zeit, dass du dein Leben lebst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin dafür zu alt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nein, bist du nicht, du bist schön und immer noch jung, gib dir einfach eine Chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hmm... ich werde sehen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Paid dates?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bezahlte Dates?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Besser

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That is not really my world
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist nicht wirklich meine Welt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Das bedeutet nicht, dass du jemandem etwas schuldest, es ist mehr wie einen Tag lang schauspielern

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es geht um Zeit und Gespräche

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It pays really well
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es bezahlt sich wirklich gut

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und wir setzen Grenzen, bevor du einen Kunden annimmst, damit es kein Risiko gibt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und wer weiß, vielleicht findest du jemanden

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Du hast lange auf uns aufgepasst, jetzt ist es an der Zeit, dass du dein Leben lebst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin dafür zu alt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nein, bist du nicht, du bist schön, gib dir einfach eine Chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde sehen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I still feel guilty
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich fühle mich immer noch schuldig

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich mag die Idee nicht, beurteilt zu werden

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Niemand wird dich verurteilen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Und du wirst dabei nicht allein sein, ich werde alles überprüfen, mit dem Kunden sprechen und den ganzen Tag über dich wachen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich werde jetzt die Plattform und die Regeln überprüfen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Wenn sich irgendetwas falsch anfühlt, brechen wir es ab

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Alles klar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich kann es versuchen und wenn es mir nicht gefällt, höre ich auf

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Natürlich hast du sowieso nur eine Woche Verpflichtung

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich bin zu Hause geblieben, wie du gesagt hast, aber ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich meine Kollegen enttäuscht habe

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay, wann fange ich an?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir, sobald ich mehr weiß

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Okay.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Danke, dass du dich um mich kümmerst und mir Arbeit besorgst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Das ist normal, ruh dich ein wenig aus, du hast dir deinen freien Tag verdient

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Fühl dich nicht schuldig, dort zu arbeiten war sowieso nicht gut für dich

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ich habe dir gesagt, dass ich mich um die Arbeit kümmere, und für deine Kollegen ist es in Ordnung, du kannst sie außerhalb der Arbeit immer noch sehen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ja, das stimmt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I do not want to be useless
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aber ich möchte nicht nutzlos sein

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Aber ich bin froh, dass du es mir gesagt hast, anstatt es zu verbergen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich denke, ich brauche jetzt ein wenig Zeit.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Um zu verstehen, wo ich in all dem stehe

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Und wo ich mit uns stehe 😕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Nicht, weil ich denke, dass du mich weniger liebst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mehr, weil ich nicht erwartet habe, dass sich die Dinge so anfühlen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Und du musst dir für mich nichts aufzwängen.
Deshalb gerate ich nicht in Panik.
Ich bin immer noch hier, oder? 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Weil mir das wirklich wichtig ist

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Dann gib mir ein wenig Zeit, um herauszufinden, wie ich über das alles fühle.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Nimm dir alle Zeit, die du brauchst.
Ich habe diesen Schlaf wirklich gebraucht.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Das hilft mehr, als du denkst 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ich werde ein wenig aufräumen und eine Zeit lang von zu Hause aus arbeiten.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Immer noch ein bisschen neblig, aber besser 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Und... danke, dass du letzte Nacht ehrlich zu mir warst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin nach dem Unterricht an einem Bekleidungsgeschäft vorbeigelaufen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und die hatten einen riesigen Sale 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weißt du, wie schwer es war, nicht reinzugehen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du redest, als wäre das ein echtes Problem

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber wenigstens sehen meine Klamotten gut aus

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du hast definitiv vorgehabt, es zu kaufen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich versuche, einen ruhigen Nachmittag zu genießen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I should have an answer sometime today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich sollte heute noch eine Antwort bekommen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich sag dir Bescheid, sobald ich was höre

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bitte stell keinen gruseligen Genie ein
Halte mich dann auf dem Laufenden

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Du musst bald wieder fit werden

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich vermisse es, über deinen Gang zu lachen 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Hallo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Das klingt genau nach dem, was sie braucht.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich fange normalerweise damit an, die Themen zu identifizieren, die die meisten Probleme verursachen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Dann erstellen wir einen Lernplan und arbeiten Schritt für Schritt durch.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Sie kann gut abschneiden, aber...

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Manchmal fällt es ihr einfach schwer, motiviert zu bleiben.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Das ist ganz normal.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Die meisten Schüler sind fähiger, als sie denken.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Sie brauchen nur Struktur und Kontinuität.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Wann hättest du Zeit?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Morgen Nachmittag würde mir passen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Hier ist Ethan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich kann vorbeikommen, sie treffen und einschätzen, wo sie gerade steht.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfekt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich sag's ihr.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Super

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Schreib mir gerne, wenn du vorher Fragen hast.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich habe heute früh deine Anfrage für Nachhilfe erhalten

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Danke, dass du dich gemeldet hast

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich suche jemanden, der {{name:hailey}} bei ihren Prüfungen hilft

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Mit welchen Schülern arbeitest du normalerweise?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich arbeite hauptsächlich mit Schülern der Oberstufe und Studenten

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfekt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Und mein Ziel ist nicht nur, die Lektionen zu erklären

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ich helfe den Schülern auch, Lerngewohnheiten aufzubauen und fokussiert zu bleiben

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ich habe eine Antwort bekommen
Hast du seinen Körper gesehen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Der Typ weiß eindeutig, was er tut
Okay, fair

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Er hat wirklich einen verrückten Körper

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Well that actually makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Das macht mich tatsächlich ein bisschen besser fühlen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: At least I already know him
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Zumindest kenne ich ihn schon

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Und ich weiß, dass er kein komischer Typ ist, den du online gefunden hast

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Du hast wirklich kein Vertrauen in mich

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Du wolltest seinen Namen geheim halten
Das hast du dir selbst eingebrockt
Endlich
Undankbares kleines Miststück

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Immer noch dankbarer, als du verdienst 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sag {{name:aiden}}, dass ich bereit bin, wann immer er es ist

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Er ist ein junger Coach, der neu in der Stadt ist
Er ist ungefähr in deinem Alter
Wie verfügbar ist er?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Hat er überhaupt schon mal jemanden trainiert?
Wer ist das?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And where did you even find him?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Und wo hast du ihn überhaupt gefunden?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Er war früher einer von {{name:aiden}}'s Trainern.
Oh

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Okay, das klingt schon mal viel weniger verdächtig.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Wenn er {{name:aiden}} trainiert hat, weiß er wahrscheinlich, was er tut.
Das hab ich mir gedacht
Dann bin ich dabei!

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ich bin gespannt, was er draufhat.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sag Chris, ich bin bereit, wann immer er es ist.
Es ist {{name:aiden}}
Sein Name ist Chris
Warte
Du meinst deinen besten Freund?
Ja
Warum hast du ihn gefragt?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Besonders wenn du so tust, als wäre alles in Ordnung.
Ich tue nicht so, als wäre ich so sehr.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ich vertraue einfach deinen Überlebensinstinkten nicht.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Bitte mach es ruhig, bis ich fertig bin.
Okay, die Pause ist fast vorbei

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ich schreibe dir nach meiner Schicht 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Nicht schrecklich, gerade genug, um die Zeit langsam vergehen zu lassen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
Thank you, I practiced that lie
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Danke, ich habe diese Lüge geübt.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hey, bist du dir wirklich sicher, dass ich diesen Job machen kann?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber ich kann nicht anders, als mir ein wenig Sorgen zu machen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist vollkommen normal, es ist schließlich eine große Veränderung

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aber ich bin zuversichtlich, dass du großartig sein wirst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Im Moment sorge ich hauptsächlich dafür, dass alles legitim ist

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich möchte alle Details überprüfen, bevor ich dir sage, dass du anfangen kannst

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das macht mich ein bisschen ruhiger

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalerweise sollte ich morgen alle Antworten haben

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wenn alles in Ordnung ist, kannst du danach anfangen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Schon morgen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist früher als ich erwartet habe

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Natürlich

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde dir morgen alles genauer erklären

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Jetzt hast du meine Aufmerksamkeit

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin neugierig, was du herausgefunden hast

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und vielleicht auch ein bisschen nervös

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das ist vollkommen normal

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wir werden es Schritt für Schritt angehen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alles klar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dann warte ich später auf deine Nachricht 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Warum fragst du?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Weil ich ständig darüber nachdenke

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich bin nicht so schlau und habe nicht viel Erfahrung in solchen Dingen

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und ich frage mich, ob ich wirklich gut genug sein werde.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das stimmt nicht, du bist fähiger, als du denkst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Und selbst wenn du keine Erfahrung hast, kannst du lernen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ich werde da sein, um dir bei allem zu helfen, was du brauchst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Das weiß ich, und ich schätze das wirklich.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey 😊 das Abendessen ist fast fertig.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich dachte, das könnte dich motivieren 😌.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I made steak and french fries
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich habe Steak und Pommes gemacht.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I know how much you love that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich weiß, wie sehr du das liebst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Jetzt bin ich noch motivierter, nach unten zu kommen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich sehe dich dann in einer Minute.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Oder soll ich deinen Teller nach oben bringen?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich sollte mich zwingen, mich ein bisschen zu bewegen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Hey, stell dir mal vor, wie unfair das wird.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Pass auf, sonst cancel ich deinen Trainer.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Danke, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, jemanden zu suchen und mir einen Trainer zu finden.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Das ist eine Sorge weniger für mich.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Dass du irgendwas alleine hinbekommst, wäre sowieso ein Wunder.
Ich bin froh, dass ich helfen konnte.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Ich bekomme einen Traumkörper, während du mit deinem kaputten Körper im Bett liegst.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Ein Traumkörper wird dein Gesicht nicht retten.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Und all die Muskeln helfen dir auch nicht, wenn du trotzdem gegen mich verlierst.
Red dir das nur weiter ein, Krüppel.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ich hatte gehofft, du würdest es vergessen.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Er möchte sehen, wo du stehst und was verbessert werden muss.
